title: Murinzi We, Vuz’ Impanda
verses: 1. Murinzi, jy‘ uvuz’ impanda, Uhan’ umuntu wese; Ng’ uzumv’ izo nkuru nziza, Yihan’ akizw’ ibyaha.
2. Yivugirize mu mpinga, Mw’ ishyamba mu gisiza; Ndetse no mu nyanja hose, Bameny’ ako gakiza.
3. Yivugirize mu nzira, Mu rwiherero hose. Dat’ arabategereje, Ntacy’ ataringanije.
4. Uyivugiriz‘ indembe, Nazo zikizw’ ibyaha. Yes’ arabatumir’ ati: Nimuze mbaboneze.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Murinzi we vuz’ impanda! Yivuze cyane hose (hose), Menyesha bos’ ubutumwa, Imbohe zibohorwe.

title: Umwam’ Ageze Kw’ Irembo
verses: 1. Umwam’ ageze kw‘ irembo, Wabambwe ku musaraba; Yaje gukorany’ abera, Babane mw‘ ijuru.
2. Ibyerekana kuza kwe, Birihuta kuboneka; Kandi tugiye guhabwa, Kubaho kw‘ iteka.
3. Ntabw’ intambar’ izashira, Ntabw’ amahor‘ azahora, Kerek’ ibyaha n’ urupfu, Byatsembwe na Yesu.
4. Maze mw‘ isi yagizwe nshya, Niho tuzabahw‘ iteka; Kudapfa kwakuye gupfa, Dushiz’ agahinda.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Kw‘ irembo (Kw‘ irembo), Kw‘ irembo (Kw‘ irembo), Kw‘ irembo, Ub‘ ari kw‘ irembo; Nukw‘ araje (araje), Nukw‘ araje (araje), Kand‘ ageze kw‘ irembo.

title: Nzabona Yesu
verses: 1. Nzabona Yesu mu maso, Umuns’ azatujyana; Niho nzamwitegereza, Kw’ ari we wampfiriye.
2. Ubu ndamutekereza, Ariko simurora; Umuns’ uhiriw’ uzaza, Nzamubonan’ ubwiza.
3. Tuzishimir’ imbere ye, Ubw’ ishavu rishize; Ibigande biganduwe, N’ ahijimye hakeye.
4. Nzanezererw’ imbere ye, Nzamurora mumenye; Nzabana na Yes’ unkunda, Niwe Mukiza wanjye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nzamurora mu maso ye, Turi kumwe mw’ ijuru; Meny’ uk’ ubwiza bwe busa, Nzamusingiz’ iteka.

title: Har’ Amakuru Meza
verses: 1. Har’ amakuru mez’ amenywa n’ abagenzi, Bazerera kure y’ iwabo, Kuk’ Umukiz’ agiye kuza mu bwiza bwe, Kand’ agiye kwim’ ingoma ye.
2. Ibituro by’ abera bos’ uko bangana, Byose bizakingurwa rwose; Kand’ inteko z’ abasinzira mu kuzimu, Bazongera gutura kw’ isi.
3. Nta kizadutanya mur’ iyo si nshya nziza, Tuzaririmb’ uko twakize. Abacunguwe bazaba bavuye hose, Baramy’ Umwami wo mw’ ijuru.
4. Haleluy’ amina, Haleluya iteka; Nitwitonda tuzahatura. Ba maso nezerwa, Kand’ ujye wiringira, Maz’ uzambar’ ikamba ryiza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Azaza, ndabizi kw’ azagaruka, Nukw’ azaza rwos’ azaza. Abagenzi bose barembye, Bazakir’ Umukiza naza kwima.

title: Murinzi We Menyesh’ Igihe
verses: 1. Murinzi we! Menyesh’ igihe! Mbes’ iwacu n’ imuhero? At’ ijoro ryijimye cyane, Ariko buracya. Ntukarire, Gumy’ ugende, Nturorere kwiringira, Kugez’ igih’ uzasohora, Mu muns’ uhoraho.
2. Murwanyi we! Tyo mbwira nawe! Ansubiza yitonz’ ati: Intambar’ igiye gushira. Guma ku rugamba. Wibabara, Ihangane, Wirek’ imirimo yawe, Kuko tuzabon’ ibihembo, Tumaze gutsinda.
3. Ndacyabaz’ ibyaremwe byose, Binsubiza bitya biti: Iy’ is’ igiye guhanguka, Haz’ ind’ idashira. Ntukarir’ ibimenyetso, Byerekan’ aho tugeze, Kand’ ibintu byose byaremwe, Biriteg’ impanda.
4. Imuhir’ ubu ni bugufi, Tunezerwe mu mitima. Duhumure ko tuzakira, Dushir’ agahinda. Ntukarire tuzabana, Amakub’ azab’ ashize. Ntabwo tuzabur’ amahoro mu rugo rwa Data.

title: Mwebw’ Abera Mube Maso
verses: 1. Mwebw’ abera mube maso, Ibyaremwe birahinda. Mukomez’ imuri zanyu, Mwiteg’ Umwam’ ari hafi.
2. Wibuk’ Umuvunyi wawe, Agakiza n’ imbabazi , Ikamba, icyubahiro. Jya wogez’ ako gakiza.
3. Nta bwami budahanguka; Wumv’ amagare y’ asuma. Bwira bos’ iby’ imbabazi, Ubu n’ igihe cy’ impuhwe.
4. Amoko yos’ azashira; Krist’ atebuts’ Ubwami bwe; Is’ igiye guhanguka; Nimwishim’ abahiriwe.
5. Banyabyaha mwe nimuze! Abitwarire kuri Se . Mwese nimugire bwangu! Imbabazi zikiriho.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Araje Yes’ araje! Azanye n’ icyubahiro. Yes’ aje kwim’ ingoma Ye, Araje, Yes’ araje.

title: Ubwo Yes’ Azagaruka
verses: 1. Ubwo Yes’ azagaruka, Kujyan’ abe bose, Bemeye kumuyoboka, N’ abatoni be.
2. Ubw’ azaza gukorany’ abo yatoye bose, Bera baboneye rwose, B’ abatoni be.
3. Yemwe bana! Yemwe bana! Bakund’ Umukiza; Abakunda, abakunda, Nk’ abatoni be.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Bazaka nk’ inyenyeri, Zitatse kw‘ ikamba rye; Bazatangaza cyane, Bakize rwose.

title: Abarokots’ Ibyago Byo Hasi
verses: 1. Abarokots’ ibyago byo hasi bazakoranywa, Ab’ azatumir’ azajyana na bo. Umwami  nagaruk’ ikondera rye rizavuga, Amatek’ azab’ agiye gucibwa.
2. Uwo muns’ abapfuye muri Kristo bazazurwa, Bazava mu bituro nka we rwose. Abo yitoreye bazimana na we mw’ ijuru, Ubw’ azagenda, azajyana na bo.
3. Ni ho tuzajya dukorer’ Umwami tudahwema; Tuzajya dusingiz’ urukundo rwe. Maz’ ubwo tuzarangiz’ imirimo yacu mw’ isi, Tuzateranywa tujyanwe mw’ ijuru.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Azaba yabararitse (…bararitse), Ubw’ azabahamagara (…hamagara). Azaba yabararitse, Abazatumir’ azajyana na bo.

title: Vuz’ Impanda Yumvikane Hose
verses: 1. Vuz’ impanda yumvikane hose, Yesu agiye kuza! Muririmbe bagenzi mwishima, Yesu agiye kuza.
2. Mujye muhererekanya hose, Yesu agiye kuza! Azazan’ icyubahiro cyinshi, Yesu agiye kuza.
3. Yivugirize mu nyanja hose, Yesu agiye kuza! Yivugirize no mu bikombe, Yesu agiye kuza.
4. Mu misoz’ uyihavugirize, Yesu agiye kuza! Imiyag’ ijyan’ ayo makuru, Yesu agiye kuza.
5. Amok’ ubw’ azasubiranamo, Yesu agiye kuza! Ubwenge bwungukwa bwerekana, Ko Yes’ agiye kuza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ari hafi, Ari hafi, Umwam’  agiye kuza.

title: Duhurire Ku Mugezi
verses: 1. Duhurire ku mugezi, Dusang’ abamarayika; Amazi yaw’ atunganye, Atemb’ av’ imbere y’ Imana.
2. Ku nkombe y’ uwo mugezi, Niho tuzatambagira, Turamy’ Umwami w’ iteka, Mu gihe cyiza kidashira.
3. Tuzagera ku mugezi, Dutur’ imitwaro yacu; Tuzakirishw’ imbabazi, Duhabw’ umwambaro n’ ikamba.
4. Ubw’ umugez’ uri hafi, Urugendo ruzashira; Tuzishima mu mitima, N’ indirimbo z’ umunezero.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nuko tujye ku mugezi! Duhurire n’ abera ku mugezi! Ku mugez’ utunganye w’ Imana, Utemb’ imbere y’ intebe.

title: Mukiza Ngukurikire
verses: 1. Mukiza ngukurikire, Ah’ unshakira hose; Ah’ ujya ngukurikire, Mwami ngukurikire.
2. Nahw’ inzira yazitirwa, Naho yakukumuka, Ko wayinyuzemo mbere, Nyicamo mfit’ ishimwe.
3. Naho naterwa n’ ibyago, Nkageragezwa cyane, Warageragejwe nawe, Mwami ngukurikize.
4. Nib’ unyobora mw’ ishavu, Niba nkena nkanenwa, Wigeze kuba ruvumwa, Nanjye ngukurikize.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mukiza ngukurikire, Wamviriy’ amaraso; Nib’ utagir’ ukwitaho, Njye nkwikurikirire.

title: Har’ Isoko
verses: 1. Har’ isokw’ ivamw’ amaraso, Yo mu mitsi y’ Imanuweri. Ni y’ atungany’ abanyabyaha, Bagashirahw’ inenge, Bagatsembwahw’ ibicumuro, Byose bikabacikaho. Ni y’ atungany’ abanyabyaha, Bagashirahw’ inenge.
2. Igisambo ku musaraba, Kiyarabutswe cyarihannye; Nanjye mbwiriza nkwizigire, Noye kujya ncumura; Ibyaha mbicikeho rwose, Noye kujya nkugomera; Nanjye mbwiriza nkwizigire, Noye kujya ncumura.
3. Amaraso yaw’ atunganye, Ahoran’ imbaraga nyinshi; Ni yo wacunguj’ itorero, Aritsembamw’ ibyaha; Ryaganjij’ imbaraga yabyo. Ryarabirokotse rwose. Ni yo wacunguj’ itorero, Yaritsembyemw’ ibyaha.
4. Mperey’ igihe meny’ isoko, Iva mu bikomere byawe. Nogez’ urwo rukundo rwawe, Nzahora ngusingiza; Nzahora ngusingiz’ iteka, Nzajya ngusingiz’ iteka. Nogez’ urwo rukundo rwawe, Nzahora ngusingiza.

5. Mwami mpora ngucumuraho, Mpa kwizer’ imbabazi zawe! N’ amaraso yaw’ atunganye, Mpa kuramishwa nawe! Mpa kuramishwa nawe Yesu! Mpa no kuramishwa nawe! N’ amaraso yaw’ atunganye, Mpa kuramishwa nawe!
6. Har’ indirimbo zera ntazi, Nzaziririmbira mw’ ijuru. N’aho nagobw’ ururim’ ubu, Uzarugobotora; Uzarugobotora Yesu, Ni wow’ uzankiza rwose. N’aho nagobw’ ururim’ ubu, Uzarugobotora.

title: Mwami Yesu Ndifuza K’ Umboneza
verses: 1. Mwami  Yesu ndifuza k’ umboneza; Ndashaka k’ umba mu mutim’ iteka. Noye kujya nita ku bigirwamana. Umboneze rwose nere ndush’ ingwa.
2. Mwami  jy’ undebera ku ntebe yawe! Mpa gutamb’ igitambo kiboneye! Ndeke gushidikanya nitange rwose. Umboneze rwose nere ndush’ ingwa.
3. Yesu ndagutakambira nkomeje! Ngo mbon’ uko nkwitega Mwami mwiza! Ntunganish’ umuvu w’ amaraso yawe! Umboneze rwose nere ndush’ ingwa.
4. Mwami  ngutegereje nihanganye, Yesu ngwin’ ump’ umutim’ utunganye! Nti wari wirengagiz’ abagushaka. Umboneze rwose nere ndush’ ingwa.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ngo nere de! Ndush’ urubura! Mpa kwer’ ubu ngutunganire rwose!

title: Mbeg’ Ukw’ Amaturo Aturwa Neza!
verses: 1. Mbeg’ ukw’ amaturo, Aturwa neza! Yose n’ aya Yesu, Ni we dutura.
2. Fungur’ ibiganza, Utang’ ituro; N’ ituro rya Yesu, Ryo mu bana be.
3. Ubu turi bato, Ni yo dufite; Ubwo tuzakura, Tuzasumbyaho.
4. Nitugira bike, Tukwihe Mwami. Byos’ uzabyakira, Utwikirize.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Tura, tura, tura, tura, Tur’ amaturo. Yose n’ aya Yesu, Ni we dutura.

title: Urukundo rwa Yesu
verses: 1. Urukundo rwa Yesu, Rwageze kuri twebwe; Rudukuraho rwose, Urubanza rwo gupfa.
2. Abatari bahabwa, Ubugingo bw’ iteka, Twihute tubabwire, Urukundo rwa Yesu.
3. Koko yaradukunze, Yadupfiriye twese, Natwe dukunde dutyo, Abakiri mu byaha.
4. Aho Yes’ azazira, Aje kwim’ ingoma ye, Ni bwo tuzumv’ ijwi rye, Ati: Mwakoze neza.
5. Akir’ uyu mutima, Weze maz’ ub’ uwawe, Wambambiwe  ku giti, Nzagukunda mb’ uwawe.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Aradukunda, Aradukunda, Aradukunda, Yesu Mutabazi.

title: Mbonez’ Intoke Zanjye
verses: 1. Mbonez’ intoke zanjye, Zibonere rwose; Ko nazihaye Yesu, Ngo zimukorere.
2. Nteg’ amatwi ngo numve, Nez’ umunsi wose. Nkor’ ibikwiye numva, Ntagir’ icyo mpuga.
3. Mpang’ amas’ amaboko, Ngo ndeb’ iby’ akora; Nyabuze kwenderanya, Akorere Yesu.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nitondesh’ intambwe, Aho njya hose. Ne kuyobok’ undi, Keretse Yesu

title: Njye Nsingiz’ Urukundo
verses: 1. Njye nsingiz’ urukundo, Ni rwo rumbwiriza, Kugirir’ abandi neza, Bakamenya Yesu.
2. Iyi s’ ibamw’ ishavu, N’ ibyaha n’ urupfu; Ntibimbuza kuyobora bamw’ ibwami bwawe.
3. Maz’ ibyo nibishira, Tuzabe mw’ ijuru, Tuzajye tuguhimbaza, Mwami w’ urukundo.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Data we ko nd’ umwana wawe! Data we Ngukurikize! Njye nsingiz’ urukundo, Ni rwo rumbwiriza, Kugirir’ abandi neza, Bakamenya Yesu.

title: Yemwe Ngabo Z’ Umwami
verses: 1. Yemwe ngabo z’ Umwami! Nimutabare! Tujyane na Yesu! Ni w’ utabaza. Twitwaz’ umusaraba! Utujy’ imbere! Mwese nimuze tugabe! Tunesh’ Umwanzi.
2. Ababisha bahunga, Babony’ intwari. Nimuze tuneshe, Ngabo z’ Umwami! Intangiriro z’ isi zinyeganyezwa, N’ ibyishimo by’ ab’ Umwami, bamusingiza.
3. Itorero ry’ Imana, Rirafatanya; Rirahaguruka, Kunesh’ Umwanzi. Nta kizaduteranya, Turakundana, Duhora duhuj’ inama, Twizera kimwe.
4. Nta ngoma zidashira, Zirahanguka. Arikw’ itorero, Rizahoraho. Ukuzimu n’ urupfu, Ntibiririnda. Twarazwe na Yesu Kristo, Ntabw’ ahemuka.
5. Nuko mugabe mwese! Tugerereze. Tubumbire hamwe, Amajwi yacu, Turirimbe dushima, Umwami Yesu, Kukw’ afit’ icyubahiro, Giheranije.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yemwe ngabo z’ Umwami mwese! Dutabare twese! Tujyane na Yesu, Dutsind’ Umwanzi.

title: Ba Mas’ Udacumura
verses: 1. Ba mas’ udacumura! Ibyaha bigota, Bihora bikwegera cyane, Ng’ utajya mw’ ijuru.
2. Ba maso rwana senga! Nturek’ urugamba! Ururasany’ iminsi yose, Utabaz’ Imana.
3. Komeza nturanesha! Wirekur’ intwaro! Dor’ intambara ntirashira, Udahaw’ ikamba.

title: Huguka Mutima Wanjye!
verses: 1. Huguka mutima wanjye! Shishikarir’ ibyiza! Ukomez’ urwan’ ishyaka! Uzambikw’ ikamba.
2. N’ Iman’ iguhamagara, Gira bwangu witabe! Niy’ iziher’ ibihembo, Abatsinze bose.
3. Inteko zikurebera, Ziragutegereje, Ntutekerez’ ah’ uvuye, Reb’ imbere yawe.
4. Mukiza wacu dukunda, Twanesheje ku bwawe, Ubu twaje kugushima, Turagusingiza.

title: Ndeger’ Umusaraba
verses: 1. Ndeger’ umusaraba, Naniwe nkennye mpumye, Singir’ icyo nitaho, Rwose nshaka gukizwa.
2. Nakwifujije kera, Njya mbabazwa n’ ibyaha. Yes’ ambwira nez’ ati: Ngukiz’ ibicumuro.
3. Ubu ndakwihereje, Simbuzwa n’ iby’ iyi si. Mb’ uwawe rwose Mwami, Nguhay’ ibyanjye byose.
4. Ndiringir’ iby’ uvuga, Wamviriy’ amaraso. Ubu ndicuza cyane, Mbambanywe n’ Umukiza.
5. Nezezwa n’ uko nkize, Yesu ni w’ unkomeza. Nta nenge nsigaranye, Mpitam’ icyubahiro.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mwami ndakwizigira, Mukiza wanjye mwiza! Ndicuz’ imbere yawe, Mwami Yes’ unkiz’ ubu!

title: Mwami Mp’ Umugisha Wawe
verses: 1. Mwami mp’ umugisha wawe, Uhera bos’ ubusa. Ndakwinginga ntumpiteho! Arik’ umpire none.
2. Ntunsige mubyeyi mwiza, Ibyaha byandembeje; Nkwiriye gucibwa rwose, Arik’ umbabarire.
3. Niba natinze mu byaha, Njya nkubabaza cyane; Niba ngoswe n’ iby’ iyi si, Ubinkuremo rwose.
4. Ntumpiteho Mwuka Wera! Ni w’ uhumur’ impumyi. Unyemez’ uhamya Yesu! Mbwir’ ibimpumuriza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Umpire! Umpire! Ngo ntatahan’ ubusa.

title: Untambe Hejuru Mwuka Wera
verses: 1. Untambe hejuru Mwuka Wera, Ngo mpirwe nawe! Nyuzuz’ umugisha wawe, Ngwino ngwin’ unyuzure!
2. Ushobora kunyuzura, Ariko sinz’ uburyo. Ndagushaka Mwuka Wera, Ngwino ngwin’ unyuzure!
3. Sinkomeye ndababaye, Ndunam’ imbere yawe. Mwuka mwiza wo mw’ ijuru, Mp’ urukundo nyuzura.
4. Ngwin’ unyeze kand’ unkize! Tuz’ umutima wanjye! Ni w’ umpumuriz’ unkiza, Unyuzure rwos’ ubu.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nyuzura! nyuzura! Yesu ngwin’ unyuzure! Nyuzuz’ umugisha wawe! Ngwino ngwin’ unyuzure!

title: Ndagushak’ Iteka
verses: 1. Ndagushak’ iteka, Mwami mwiza cyane, Ijwi ryawe ryiza, Rizan’ amahoro.
2. Ndagushak’ iteka, Jy’ ungum’ iruhande. Ntsind’ amoshya yose, Iyo turi kumwe.
3. Ndagushak’ iteka, Ntuje n’ iyo nganya. Ngwin’ ubu tubane! Mbone gutungana.
4. Ndagushak’ iteka, Nyigish’ iby’ ushaka! Nkwinging’ unsohorez’ amasezerano!
5. Ndagushak’ iteka, Mwami Wera rwose, Nyobora mb’ uwawe, Wowe munyahirwe!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ku manywa na nijoro, Ndagushak’ iteka. Mpir’ ubu Mukiza we! Twigumanire.

title: Yesu Nd’ Uwawe Nyakira
verses: 1. Yesu nd’ uwawe nyakira, N’ ibyanjye mfite byose! Njye ngukunda nkwizigire, Nkomeze nkuyoboke.
2. Yesu nd’ uwawe nyakira! Niyoroshye nkuramye. Mpaz’ ibyishimo byo hasi, Ubu Yesu nyakira!
3. Yesu nd’ uwawe nyakira! Mukiza ngir’ uwawe! Tum’ Umwuka Wer’ ambwire, Kuko naw’ ur’ uwanjye!
4. Yesu nguhaye byos’ ubu, Umwuk’ ampay’ umwete! Nsingiz’ imbabazi zawe, Nkuramye bihimbaje.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nguhaye byose (Nguhaye byose), Nguhaye byose (Nguhaye byose). Mucunguzi wanjye mwiza, Nguhaye byose.

title: Ubu Nj’ Uko Ndi
verses: 1. Ubu nj’ uko ndi nta kindi cyankiza; Ndokoresh’ amaraso yawe. Nitaby’ ijwi ryawe rimpamagaye, Ndaje, Ntama y’ Imana ndaje.
2. Nj’ uko ndi nyakir’ ubu ngubu Yesu! Nyez’ umutima nkir’ ibyaha! Wowe Nyir’ amaras’ akiza rwose, Ndaje, Ntama y’ Imana ndaje.
3. Nj’ uko ndi mbuyerezwa n’ ubugome; Njya nanizwa n’uko nd’ intebyi, Mfit’ ibindwanya byinshi bincogoza, Ndaje, Ntama y’ Imana ndaje.
4. Nj’ uko ndi nd’ umuhanya, ndi n’ impumyi; Gutungana mbikesha wowe; Ibyamboneza nabibon’ iwawe. Ndaje, Ntama y’ Imana ndaje.
5. Nj’ uko ndi nizigiye k’ unyakira, Nizey’ isezerano ryawe; Yuk’ uzankiza kand’ uzamboneza, Ndaje, Ntama y’ Imana ndaje.
6. Nj’ uko ndi guhamy’ urukundo rwawe, Ko rwambohoy’ ingoyi zose. Uherey’ ubu mbay’ uwawe rwose, Ndaje, Ntama y’ Imana ndaje.

title: Dushim’ Imana
verses: 1. Dushim’ Imana kubw’ Umwana wayo, Kubw’ Umukiza waducunguye twese.
2. Dushim’ Imana kubw’ Umwuka Wera; Atubwiriza kumvir’ Iyaturemye.
3. Dushim’ Intama yatambwe ku bwacu, Yatway’ ibyaha byac’ adukiza rwose.
4. Dushimir’ Iman’ imbabazi zayo, Yaratuguz’ itugir’ abana bayo.
5. Twonger’ umwete, Twuzuz’ urukundo; Umuntu wes’ akuyobokan’ ubwira.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Haleluya Nyirigira, Haleluy’ amina; Haleluya Nyirigira, Twonger’ umwete.

title: Shaka Gutungana
verses: 1. Shaka gutungana, Jy’ uhor’ usenga; Bana n’ Uwiteka, Ujy’ umwumvira; Jy’ ukund’ Abakristo, Fash’ abarembye; Ntuhuge na hato, Gushak’ ihirwe.
2. Shaka gutungana, Hagomye benshi; Horana na Yesu, Mu rwiherero. N’ umwitegereza, Uzaba nka we; Bose bazamenya, K’ umeze nka we.
3. Shaka gutungana, Akuyobore. Ty’ itond’ imbere ye, N’ ugir’ ibyago, Uk’ umera kose, Jy’ umwiyambaza. Jy’ uyoboka Yesu, Mwumvire rwose.
4. Shaka gutungana, Tuz’ umutima. Tekerez’ ibyiza, Wihutiraho. Jya wumvir’ Umwuka, Gwiz’ urukundo; Uzatunganira, Kuba mw’ ijuru.

title: Ungumane
verses: 1. Ungumane ko bugiye kwira, Haj’ umwijima Mwam’ ungumane. Ubwo bagenzi banjye bansiga, Nkaba jyenyine, Mwam’ ungumane.
2. Mur’ iyi si byose birashira, Nta munezer’ uhaba na hato; Nta kidapfa, nta kidahinduka; Wow’ udahinyuka, ungumane.
3. Mwami  niwe nshak’ iteka ryose, Nta moshya ntsinda tutari kumwe. Nta wabasha kunyobora nkawe. Mwam’ iteka ryose, ungumane.
4. N’ ungumana, nta mubisha ntinya; Ishavu rizab’ umunezero; Imbori z’ urupfu zizashira; Ntabwo ntazanesha n’ ungumana.

title: Ngah’ Umuns’ Urakuze
verses: 1. Ngah’ umuns’ urakuze, Burije turuhuke; Kand’ ubw’ imuri z’ ijoro zaka turamy’ Uwiteka, Twebwe twese.
2. Mwami nyir’ ubugingo, Terany’ abagushaka; Buzuze bos’ urukundo, Ubagir’ ubwoko bwawe, Bakuramye.
3. Umwijima n’ ugwira, Dukingir’ imbabazi; Tukwegerez’ imitima, Hirya y’ ubwiza bw’ ijuru, Ngo duhirwe.
4. Duhe kukwiringira, Ng’ ubwo tuzapfa Mwami, Twongere kubon’ umucyo, Ijoro rishir’ iteka, Tugushime.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Wera, Wera, Wera, Mwam’ Imana. Wigwij’ ahantu hose, Nta kitaguh’ ishimwe, Mwam’  Imana.

title: Mukiza We Niwe Mucyo Waka
verses: 1. Mukiza we! Ni we mucyo waka. Ntabw’ umwijim’ uhangar’ ah’ uri, Nyamururahw’ ibinyoshya, Bituma nanduranya nawe.
2. Mukiza mu gihe njya kuryama, Ngo nduhuk’ imirimo nakoze, Umpe kugutekereza, Ngo nsinzire ndi kumwe nawe.
3. Umpagarik’ umunsi n’ ijoro; Ntabwo nabaho tutari kumwe; Ungumane mu makuba, Kuko ntinya gupf’ udahari.
4. N’ ubwo nkanguk’ ungume bugufi; N’ aho ndibujye gukora hose, Kugez’ ubwo nzaz’ iwawe, Meny’ urukundo rwawe rwose.

title: Yesu N’ Urutare Rwacu
verses: 1. Yesu n‘ urutare rwacu, N’ ubwugamo bw’ umugaru; Ni w’ udukiz’ amakuba, N’ ubwugamo bw’ umugaru.
2. Ankiz’ amakub’ iteka, N’ ubwugamo bw’ umugaru. Ntacyo ntinya turi kumwe, N’ ubwugamo bw’ umugaru.
3. Imivu n’ isum’ itera, N’ ubwugamo bw’ umugaru. N’ Umukiza wacu mwiza, N’ ubwugamo bw’ umugaru.
4. Rutare rwiza rushimwa! Ubwugamo bw’ umugaru! Jy‘ utuvuna mu makuba! Ubwugamo bw’ umugaru.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Rutare rwisungwa n’ abantu! Gicucu cy’ uburuhukiro! Muyobozi mwiz’ utayobya! Ubwugamo  bw’ umugaru.

title: Ndanezerwa Kw’ Anyobora
verses: 1. Ndanezerwa kw’ anyobora, Arampumurish’ Ijambo rye. Mu byo nkora, n’ aho ngenda, N’ukoboko kwa Yesu kunyobora.
2. Niba ngir’ ishavu ryinshi, Cyangwa nubwo nezerwa cyane. Mu mahoro n’ amakuba, N’ ukuboko kwa Yesu kunyobora.
3. Mwami nshaka ko tubana; Ntabwo nzinuba nitotomba; Nzagumya nishime cyane, K’ ukuboko kwa Yesu kunyobora.
4. Ndangij’ imirimo yanjye, Nesheje kubw’ imbabazi ze; Ntacyo nzatinya n’ urupfu, K’ ukuboko kwa Yesu kunyobora.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Aranyobora nkanezerwa, N’ ukw’ anyoboresh’ ukuboko kwe. Nshaka kumukorera neza, Yuk’ ukuboko kwe kunyobora.

title: Nimbon’ Amahoro
verses: 1. Nimbon’ amahoro yomboka nk’ uruzi, Naho naba mfit’ ishavu, Uko mba kose, Njya nkunda kuvuga Nti: Nguwe neza mu mutima.
2. Satani nantera, Nkagira n’ ibyago, Nkomezwa no kwiringira, Kuko Kristo yabonye ko nd’ intebyi; Ni ko kumvir’ amaraso ye.
3. Nshima cyane kuko mbabariw’ ibyaha, Nta na kimwe cyasigaye; Byabambanywe nawe ku musaraba; Mutima wanjye shim’ Umwami.
4. Mwami tebuts’ umuns’ uzagarukaho, Ubw’ ibicu bizarundwa, Impand’ ivuze, Umwam’ amanuke Nti: Nguwe neza mu mutima.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ni neza (ni neza) ndatuje (ndatuje); Ko nguwe neza mu mutima.

title: Nkund’ Ubucuti
verses: 1. Nkund’ ubucuti buva mw’ ijuru, Nisung’ amaboko y’ iteka. Ngiz’ amahirwe, mbony’ amahoro, Nisunz’ amaboko y’ iteka.
2. Nezerwa n’ uko Yes’ anyobora; Nisung’ amaboko y’ iteka. Nunguk’ ishimwe, Ngakiranuka; Nisunz’ amaboko y’ iteka.
3. Nta bwoba mfite, Nshiz’ agahinda, Nisunz’ amaboko y’ iteka. Nguwe nez’ ubu, Ndatunganiwe. Nisunz’ amaboko y’ iteka.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Nkiza! Nkiza! Ndokor’ amakuba yose! Nkiza! Nkiza! Nisunz’ amaboko y’ iteka. T. na B.: Nkiza Yesu! Nkiza Yesu nkiza! Ndokor’ amakuba yose! Nkiza Yesu! Nkiza Yesu nkiza! Nisunz’ amaboko y’ iteka.

title: Ni Wowe Nizeye
verses: 1. Ni wowe nizeye, Ntama y’ i Kalvari, We Mukiza! Ngusab’ unyumvire, Nkiz’ ibicumuro, Mperey’ ubu Mwami, Nkuyoboke.
2. Nyuzuz’ imbabazi, Ngir’ inama nziza, Nter’ umwete; Kuko wampfiriye, Nkwerek’ urukundo, Rudatuba rwaka, Nk’ umuriro.
3. Ningotwa n’ ibyaha, Nkagira n’ ishavu, Unyobore. Nkura mu mwijima, Ntsembahw’ amaganya, Kandi ntundekere, Kure yawe.

title: Nkuyoboke Mwami
verses: 1. Nkuyoboke Mwami, Nkuyoboke. N’ aho natendekwa ku musaraba, Naba nkiririmba: Nkuyoboke Mwami, Nkuyoboke Mwami, Nkube bugufi.
2. Nkuyoboke Mwami, Nkuyoboke. Mu makuba yose, Mpagarikira! Ninterwa n’ ibyago, Umpe kwihangana, Nkuyoboke Mwami, Nkube bugufi.
3. Nkuyoboke Mwami, Nkuyoboke. Jy’ untabar’ iteka ngumye nkwizere! Umwanzi nantera, Ujy’ undwanirira! Nkuyoboke Mwami, Nkube bugufi.
4. Nkuyoboke Mwami, Nkuyoboke. Wakinguy’ ijuru, Nyobor’ ah’ uri. Mugenzi komera, Urenda gukira! Nkuyoboke Mwami, Nkube bugufi.

title: Unambe Ku Mana
verses: 1. Unambe ku Mana, ntuyimure; Bona nuterwa n’ impagarara, Uzagarukirwa na Rutare, Iyo tugoswe n’ ibyaha.
2. Nambir’ ukuri jya wihangana, Komez’ ubutwari no kwizera! Rutar’ aduha kuganziriza, Mur’ iyi si y’ igomero.
3. Nambir’ ukuri birakwiriye, We kurambirw’ uzagororerwa. Rutare niw’ uduh’ amahoro, Tumaze gutsind’ ibyago.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Dukomerera kuri Kristo Rutare, Niwe Rutare twisunga. Nitwihangana tuzab’ amahoro, Tugez’ imbere y’ Imana.

title: Nkomeze Njye Niringira
verses: 1. Nkomeze njye niringira, Amaraso y’ Umukiza. Sinagir’ undi niganana, Keretse Yesu wenyine.
2. Umwijima numpumisha, Niringir’ imbabazi ze. Mu makuba no mu byago, Ntagir’ ubw’ anzibukira.
3. Mbonezwa n’ amaraso ye, Ampa kumukurikira. N’iyo nababaye rwose, Aramfasha ngakomera.
4. Naza kw’ ijwi ry’ ikondera, Azasanga mwiteguye; Nambaye gukiranuka, Nta nenge nzaba ngifite.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nikomeze ku Rutare, Nahw’ ahandi n’ umusenyi; Nahw’ ahandi n’ umusenyi.

title: Tubane N’ Umwami
verses: 1. Tubane n’ Umwami, Twumvir’ Ijambo rye; Atujyana mu nzira nziza, Tumwumviye rwose. Akabana natwe, N’ abamwizer’ uko bangana.
2. Ntihakingirizwa, Nta gicu gikuba, Byeyurwa no kumwenyura kwe. Nta shiti n’ ubwoba, Bona n’ igishyika, Bimarwa n’ uko tumwizeye.
3. Nta kitubabaza, Nta shavu tugira; Niw’ uduhembur’ imbu zose; Nta bworo n’ isari, Nta n’ umubabaro; Tuzahirwa nitumwizera.
4. Ntabwo twiyungura, Kugir’ ibyishimo, Kugeza ko tureka byose, Kubw’ imbabazi ze; Impan’ ajy’ atanga, N’ ingororano z’ abizeye.
5. Tuzajya twishima, Turi kumwe nawe. Tuzagendana naw’ iteka, Tumwumvira rwose; Azajy’ adutuma, Ntacyo tuzaba tugitinya.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Jy’ umwumvira, Nta kandi gakiza, Keretse Yesu gusa; Mwizigire rwose.

title: Yes’ Abe Hamwe Nawe Hose
verses: 1. Yes’ abe hamwe nawe hose! Akugir’ inama nziza! Agucyure mu bushyo bwe! Yes’ abe hamwe nawe hose!
2. Yes’ abe hamwe nawe hose! Akurinde mu makuba! Akwongere man’ iteka! Yes’ abe hamwe nawe hose!
3. Yes’ abe hamwe nawe hose! Ubuyerezwa n’ ibyaha, Agukingir’ ukuboko! Yes’ abe hamwe nawe hose!
4. Yes’ abe hamwe nawe hose! Jy’ uguman’ urukundo rwe! Tsind’ urupf’ imbere yawe! Yes’ abe hamwe nawe hose!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Kugez’ ubwo (ubwo) tuzabonana, Ubwo tuzabana na Yesu (na Yesu). Kugez’ ubwo (ubwo) tuzabonana, Yes’ abe hamwe nawe hose.

title: Iyo Turi Kumwe N’ Inshuti
verses: 1. Iyo turi kumwe n’ inshuti, Ntakitubabaza, Arikw’ iyo dutandukanye, Tugir’ agahinda.
2. Iyo twibuts’ inshuti zacu, Turishima cyane. Nitumar’ imirimo yacu, Tuzaban’ iteka.
3. Ntabwo tuzasezeranaho, Tugeze mw’ ijuru; Tuzahahoran’ ibyishimo, Turirimb’ iteka.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mw’ ijuru ntituzatana, Tuzahahorana. Mur’ iyo si y’ amahoro, Ntabwo tuzatana.

title: Gupfa Twiringiye Yesu
verses: 1. Gupfa twiringiye Yesu, Ku bera n’ ugusinzira. Ntaw’ ukangurwamw’ arira, Ntaw’ umwanz’ ashukirayo.
2. Gusinzira muri Yesu, N’ uburuhukiro bwiza, N’ amahirwe y’ abizeye, Ko bazahabw’ ubugingo.
3. Gusinzira muri Yesu, No gukangurwamo na we, N’ imbaraga y’ Umukiza; Ntabw’ izabuzwa n’ ibyago.
4. Gusinzira muri Yesu, Kuzurwa n’ ijwi ry’ impanda. Maz’ ibituro bivemo, Abera bose barame.

title: Ibyo Nkora Nkiriho
verses: 1. Ibyo nkora nkirihw’ aho bizarangirira, Ubwo kudapfa kuzakura gupfa; Nimara gukira nzabon’ Umukiza wanjye, Kand’ azab’ anyakiran’ ibyishimo.
2. Nzanezerwa mbony’ uburanga bwe buhebuje, N’ amaso y’ akey’ arabagirana; Nzajya musingiza mpimbawe n’ urukundo rwe, Ko yambonerej’ aheza mw’ ijuru.
3. Ntabwo mpug’ abadusezeyeho bajya kure, Ubwo twatandukaniye ku cyambu. Nitujya mw’ ijuru nta kizadutandukanya, Cyane nifuza kubon’ Umukiza.
4. Azanjyana mu mudugud’ utabamw’ ishavu, Niho nzambarir’ imyambaro yera, Nzaririmbana n’ aber’ indirimbo ya Mose; Cyane ndifuza kubon’ Umukiza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nzamumenya, Nzamumenya; Nzahagarar’ imbere Ye nkize. Nzamumenya, Nzamumenya, Mbony’ inkovu zo mu biganza bye.

title: Umpe Bibiliya
verses: 1. Umpe Bibliya kukw’ ari y’ inezeza, Uyinyoboresh’ iteka Mwami. Nta kibasha kuzimy’ umucyo wayo, Ko Yesu yaje kuyitwumvisha.
2. Umpe Bibliya mu kababaro kanjye, Igihe mpigwa n’ ibyaha byanjye. Umpe n’ amagambo Yesu yavuze, Kukw’ ariyo mez’ ampumuriza.
3. Umpe Bibliya ngw’ imurikir’ iteka; Kand’ indind’ imitego yo hasi; Niyo rumuri rwaka mu mwijima, Runyerek’ inzira y’ amahoro.
4. Umpe Bibliya ngw’ imbwir’ iby’ ubugingo, Kand’ udukomerez’ uwo mucyo. Ngo tumeny’ inzir’ igana mw’ ijuru, Unyerek’ ubwiza bwawe Data.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Umpe Bibliya kukw’ ari y’ inezeza, Nyoborwe nayo mu nzira ntoya. Amategeko yawe niyo meza, Agaragaz’ inzira y’ ukuri.

title: Jy’ Uhor’ Undinganirije
verses: 1. Jy’ uhor’ undinganirije, Amagamb’ atunganye. Umpugure meny’ ukuri, Kw’ amagambo yawe. Nkund’ amagambo yawe, Kw’ ampa kukwizigira.
2. Krist’ ahet’ abantu bose, Amagamb’ atunganye. Nimwitabe banyabyaha! Mwumv’ iby’ ubugingo! Abayoboz’ ituza, N’ amagamb’ atunganye.
3. Menyesha bos’ ubutumwa! N’ amagamb’ atunganye! Nimuze mubabarirwe! Mwumv’ iby’ ubugingo! Yesu ni we Mukiza, Utwonger’ ubugingo.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Amagambo meza cyane, Anter’ ibyishimo byinshi; Ni yo meza, ndayakunda; Ntabw’ atanezeza.

title: Mpagaze Ku Nkengero Ya Yorodani
verses: 1. Mpagaze ku nkengero ya Yor’dani nubur’ amaso, Ndor’ igihugu cyiza cy’ i Kanani, ni hw’ ibyanjye biri.
2. Hakurya mur’ ibyo bibaya, Hahor’ umucy’ iteka. Yesu Kristo ni w’ uzahaber’ umucy’ ahakur’ ijoro.
3. Aho heza nzahagera ryari ngo mpabe mpiriwe? Nzareba Data mu maso ryari, Nduhukiy’ ibwami bwe?
4. Mfit’ ibyishimo mu mutima, Sinshaka kugum’ aha. Yorodan’ isumira hos’ ariko ntinyuka kuyambuka.
chorus: Gusubiramo: N’ igihugu cyiza cy’ amahoro, Hakurya ku nkengero haratoshye; Tuzahavugir’ indirimbo ya Mose, Tubane na Yes’ iteka.

title: Tuzishim’ Imirim’ Ishize
verses: 1. Tuzishim’ imirim’ ishize, Abasarurir’ Imana, Bashohoj’ umusaruro, I Yerusalemu nshya.
2. Tuzishima no kuririmba, Tuzajya dushima Kristo. Tuzamuhimbariza rwos’ i Yerusalemu nshya.
3. Tuzahishimira by’ ukuri, Tuzaba mu mazu yera; Yesu yaduteguriye, I Yerusalemu nshya.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ishimwe hazabahw’ ishimwe, Ntabw’ ishimwe rizahashira, Umunsi w’ ishimw’ uri hafi, Duteranir’ iwacu.

title: Ntabwo Ndatekereza
verses: 1. Ntabwo ndatekereza, Kw’ iwac’ ari bugufi. Uko bukeye negereza, Gusohora mw’ ijuru.
2. Ku rurembo rwa Data, Hariy’ amazu menshi; Yateguriy’ abera bose, Ngo babane na Yesu.
3. Ninjya kuger’ iwacu, Nzururuts’ umutwaro; Nzoroherwa n’ umubabaro, Nambar’ ikamba ryiza.
4. Ningera ku nkengero, Nzaba ngeze bugufi; Nzaba negerey’ i muhira, Ngiye kuger’ iwacu.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Hafi y’ iwacu, Hafi yaho; Ubu ngeze hafi y’ iwacu, Ngiye gusohorayo.

title: Har’ Igihugu Cyiza Cyane
verses: 1. Har’ igihugu cyiza cyane, Twasezeraniwe n’ Imana; Tugitegereze twizera, Ko Dat’ akitubonereza.
2. Tuzaririmbira mw’ ijuru, Indirimbo z’ abanyahirwe. Ntituzongera kubabara, Tuzaba dushiz’ agahinda.
3. Tuzasingiza Data cyane, Ku mbabazi yatugiriye, No ku buntu bw’ urukundo rwe, N’ umugisha yatwungukiye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Aheza (aheza) mw’ ijuru (mw’ ijuru), Tuzahurirayo bagenzi. Aheza (aheza) mw’ ijuru (mw’ ijuru), Tuzahurirayo bagenzi.

title: Tubatirish’ Umwuka Wera
verses: 1. Tubatirishe Umwuka Wera, Mukiza twegere, duh’ urukundo. Gusubiramo 1, 2,3: Ubu Mwami Yesu turakwinginga, Tubatirish’ Umwuka, Duh’ urukundo.
2. Turatakamba, Twazize byinshi, Udukiz’ utweze, Twishwe n’ ibyaha.
3. Mwuka Wera we, Tumanukire! Duhire rwos’ ubu, Duh’ imbabazi.
4. Ngir’ ijwi ryiza, Ryavuze riti: Ur’ Umwana wanjye, ni wowe nkunda. Gusubiramo 4: Turagusingiza, turakuramya Turaguhimbaz’ ubu, Mwami; Amina.

title: Ngwino Soko Y’ Umugisha
verses: 1. Ngwino soko y’ umugisha, Mp’ umutim’ ugushima. Migez’ idakama myiza, Tugusingize cyane. Unyigishe kukuramy’ iteka, Kandi meny’ ubwiza bwawe. Kwiringir’ ubwami bwawe, Kunyuzuz’ urukundo.
2. Nshyirahw’ icyibutso cyanjye, Ni ho ngeze kubwawe. Ndizeye yuk’ uzanjyana, Nger’ iwaw’ amahoro. Yesu yantaruye nazimiye, Nari ndi kure y’ Imana; Ashaka kunkiz’ urupfu, Yatanz’ ubugingo bwe.
3. Ndimw’ ubwishyu bwawe Mwami, Bw’ imbabaz’ ungiriye. Nyigiza bugufi bwawe, Meny’ urukundo rwawe. Ngoswe n’ ibingerageza byinshi, Ngo ndek’ iyo Mana nkunda. Akir’ umutima wanjye Undinde nkire rwose.

title: Mwuka Wera Muyobozi
verses: 1. Mwuka Wera Muyobozi, Ube hafi y’ abakristo! Mfat’ ukuboko nyobora, Nd’ umugenzi ku gahinga. Abananiwe bishima, Ubwo bumv’ ijwi ryiza, Ribabwira: Bagenzi mwe, Nimuze mbagez’ iwanyu!
2. Ntuduhemukir’ iteka, Ntabwo wanga kudufasha. Dukomeze tukwizere, Dukabakabe hijimye. Amakuba naboneka, Imitima nikuka, Ijwi riti: Bagenzi mwe, Nimuze mbagez’ iwanyu!
3. Tumaz’ imirimo yacu, Dutegereze gukizwa, Dusigarany’ iby’ ijuru, Twibaze ko twanditsweyo. Twikingir’ ibidutera, No kwiringira Yesu. Ijwi riti: Bagenzi mwe, Nimuze mbagez’ iwanyu!

title: Harihw’ Icyo Nkwaka Mwami
verses: 1. Harihw’ icyo nkwaka Mwami, Nubwo mpora ngucumuraho, Unyejeshe, unyejeshe! Amazi cyangw’ umuriro.
2. Nuntunganiriz’ ubwenge, Nzanezerwa nzagusingiza; Arik’ umutima wera, Urutaho, urutaho.
3. Ninezw’ umutima wanjye, Ni ho nzunguk’ ubwenge bwose, Mbubwirijwe nawe Mwami, Bwo mw’ ijuru, bwo mw’ ijuru.
4. Njya nirind’ ibicumuro, Nkitonder’ ibyo ntekereza. Mwami n’ ibyo nkora byose, Ntabwo nera, Ntabwo nera.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mpanagurwe hose Mwami! N’ umuriro nib’ ushaka. Nkir’ ibyaha, birimburwe. Nkir’ ibyaha, birimburwe.

title: Har’ Ubwo Wasanze Yesu?
verses: 1. Har’ ubwo wasanze Yesu ng’ ukire? Se wuhagijw’ amaraso ye? Ubu  wizeye rwos’ imbabazi ze? Se wuhagijw’ amaraso ye?
2. Mbes’ ugendana na Yesu iteka? Se wuhagijw’ amaraso ye? Mbes’ ujy’ ubana n’ uwari wabambwe? Se wuhagijw’ amaraso ye?
3. Umukwe naz’ uzab’ umwiteguye? Se wuhagijw’ amaraso ye? Mbes’ uzakundirwa kujya mw’ ijuru? No gukizwa n’ amaraso ye?
4. Hung’ ibyaha jy‘ ukor’ ibitunganye! Wejeshw’ amaraso ya Yesu! Har’ isokw’ itemb’ ikiz’ imitima, Wejeshw’ amaraso ya Yesu!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Wogejwe (wogejwe) na Yesu (na Yesu)? Watunganijwe n’ amaraso (maraso)? Har’ ubwo yakwuhagij’ amaraso? Mbes’ imyambaro yaw’ irera?

title: Nahabiye Kure Y’ Imana
verses: 1. Nahabiye kure y’ Imana, Ndahabuts’ ubu. Nari naratinze mu byaha, Noneho ndaje.
2. Narapfapfany‘ imyaka myinshi, Ndahabuts’ ubu. Ndakwitwaraho cyane nkiza, Noneho ndaje.
3. Ndembejwe n’ ibyaha no kugwa, Ndahabuts’ ubu. Niringiy’ urukundo rwawe, Noneho ndaje.
4. Yesu yamviriy’ amaraso, Ndahabuts’ ubu. Ubwe niwe wankiza gusa, Noneho ndaje.
5. Wumv’ amaganya yanjy’ unkize, Ndahabuts’ ubu. Nyeza Mwami nse n’ urubura, Noneho ndaje.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Reka nze, reka nze! Ntabwo nzongera. Nyemerer‘ umbabarire! Mwami nyakira!

title: Bayoboke Nimurangurure
verses: 1. Bayoboke nimurangurure, Mwamamaz’ ubutumwa mw’ isi yose! Nimukwiz’ ayo makuru mu bantu! Abashaka nibaze.
2. Ushaka kuza yitindiganya, Niyinjir’ irembo riruguruye. Umwami  ni we nzira y’ ubugingo, Abashaka nibaze.
3. Ushaka wese nagire bwangu! Kand’ agir’ ubutwari yihangane. Ushaka wes’ azahabw’ ubugingo, Abashaka nibaze.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Uwemey’ aze! Uwemey’ aze! Nimubimenyesh’ abatuye hasi! Umubyey’ aratarur’ abana be, Abashaka nibaze.

title: Jy’ Uganza Mwami W’ Iteka
verses: 1. Jy’ uganza Mwami w’ iteka, Bose bakuramye! Nimuzan’ ikamba ry’ ubwami bwe, Ab’ Umwami wa bose! Nimuzan’ ikamba ry’ ubwami bwe, Kw’ ari we Mwami wa bose.
2. Batowe mwe b’ Israeli, Mwa nkehwe mwe nkeya, Muramy’ ubakirish’ imbabazi, Ab’ Umwami wa bose! Muramy’ ubakirish’ imbabazi, Kw’ ari we Mwami wa bose.
3. Amoko yose yo hasi, N’ imiryango yose, Bose bajye bamwubaha cyane! Ab’ Umwami wa bose. Bose bajye bamwubaha cyane! Kw’ ari we Mwami wa bose.
4. Muze tumuririmbire, Tumupfukamire, Tumusingize no kumushima, Ab’ Umwami wa bose. Tumusingize no kumushima, Kw’ ari we Mwami wa bose.

title: Yesu Mukunzi Wanjye
verses: 1. Yesu mukunzi wanjye, Mpa kuguhungiraho. Ubw’ umurab’ usuma, N’ umugar’ ugwa cyane, Umpishe Mukiza we! Kugez’ ah’ uhitira. Unyobor’ ahikinze, Nuk’ unkiz’ unyakire!
2. Nta bundi buhungiro, Mwam’ unyirokorere! Ntunzibukire rwose, Komez’ ujy’ undengera! Nkwizigire wenyine! Ni wow’ ump’ imbaraga, Uhashy’ abanzi banjye, Simpugane na hato.
3. Ngushime Mwami Yesu, K’ utagir’ icy’ unyima, Usindagiz’ urushye, N’ urway’ uramukiza; Urera bihebuje, Ntabwo ngutunganiye, Ndi mubi bikabije, Wow’ urakiranutse.
4. Ubabarira cyane, Kand’ imbabazi zawe, Zirut’ ibyaha byanjye. Nyeza nkomeze nere, We soko y’ ubugingo! Nkundira nkuvomemo! Unyuzur’ umutima, Nzagere ku bugingo.

title: Yesu Utunezeza Twese
verses: 1. Yes’ utunezeza twese, Soko y’ ubuging’ ur’ umucyo w’ abantu; Ibyishimo byose byo hasi, Tubicitseho tugukurikire.
2. Tuvune turakwisunze. Ukuri kwawe ntikugir’ impinduka; Dutabare turakwizeye, Tukwiyeguriye tumaramaje.
3. Mutsima w’ ubugingo we! Dushaka guhazwa naw’ iteka ryose. Soko nziz’ idakam’ iteka! Tumar’ inyota mu mitima yacu!
4. Mu midugararo yacu, Tukwifuz’ iteka, Mwami mwiza rwose. Tunezerwa cyan’ umwenyuye; N’ amahirwe yac’ ubwo duhorana.
5. Yesu bana natw’ iteka! Duh’ amahoro twishim’ iteka ryose! Dukiz’ ibibi bitugota! Murika kw’ is’ umucyo wawe wera!

title: Nkunda Kunguk’ Ibya Yesu
verses: 1. Nkunda kunguk’ ibya Yesu, Kwerekan’ imbabazi ze; Kwunguk’ ubwenge bw’ ukuri, N’ urukundo rw’ Umukiza.
2. Nshishikarir’ ibya Yesu, Meny’ iby’ ashaka binkwiye, Mwuka Wera mfuturira! Mbwir’ uko Yesu yankunze!
3. Nunguk’ ijambo rya Yesu, Mbane n’ Umwam’ antoneshe; Numvir’ iby’ ambwira byose, Mpuze na we muyoboke.
4. Meny’ iby’ ingoma ya Yesu, Menye n’ ubwiza bwe bwose, Menye n’ ukw’ agiye kwima, Ni we Mwami w’ amahoro.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nunguk’ ibya Yesu, Nunguk’ ibya Yesu. Kwunguk’ ubwenge bw’ ukuri, N’ urukundo rw’ Umukiza.

title: Yesu Ndagukunze Rwose
verses: 1. Yesu ndagukunze rwose, Ndakwihaye. Ingeso mbi zose, Nzanz’ uko zingana. Ni wowe Mukiza wanjye mwiza, Nkuyoboke. Ntabwo nigeze kugukunda, Nk’ ubu ngubu.
2. Ndagukunze kuko wabanje, Kunkunda, Waranyiguriy’ unkiriz’ i Kalwari. Ngukundiy’ ikamba ry’ amahwa, Wahambikiwe, Ntabwo nigeze kugukunda, Nk’ ubu ngubu.
3. Mperey’ ubu ngukunda, Nzageza gupfa. Nzajya ngusingiz’ iteka, Ngihumeka; Nah’ urupfu ruzanyegurira, Nzavuga nti: Ntabwo nigeze kugukunda, Nk’ ubu ngubu.
4. Ubwo nzager’ aho, Waduteguriye, Nzajya mpaguhamiriz’ itek’ iteka. Nzaguhimbaza nambay’ ikamba, Ritunganye; Ntabwo nigeze kugukunda, Nk’ ubu ngubu.

title: N’ Iki Cyankiz’ Ibyaha?
verses: 1. N’ iki cyankiz’ ibyaha? N’ amaraso yawe Yesu. N’ iki cyanyeza rwose? N’ amaraso yawe Yesu.
2. Nta kindi cyantunganya, N’ amaraso yawe Yesu. Nta kindi cyiru mfite, N’ amaraso yawe Yesu.
3. Nta cyantsembahw’ ibyaha, N’ amaraso yawe Yesu. Nta byanjye byamboneza, N’ amaraso yawe Yesu.
4. Ni wowe niringira, N’ amaraso yawe Yesu. Ni wow’ ump’ amahoro, N’ amaraso yawe Yesu.
5. Njye ngusingiza cyane, Ku maraso yawe Yesu. Mukiz’ urakarama, Ku maraso wamviriye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Maras’ atunganye, Ni y’ amboneza rwose. Nta cyampa gukira, Nk’ amaraso y’ Umukiza.

title: S’ Uhagarikiy’ Ik’ Umutima?
verses: 1. S’ uhagarikiy’ ik’ umutima? Bibwire Yesu! Bibwire Yesu! Ubabajwe no kubur’ ituza? Ihererane Yesu!
2. Mbes’ ub’ urabogoz’ amarira? Bibwire Yesu! Bibwire Yesu! Utotezwa n’ ibyaha wahishe? Ihererane Yesu!
3. Ujy’ utinya guterwa n’ ibyago? Bibwire Yesu! Bibwire Yesu! Mbes’ ub’ uraganyishwa n’ iby’ ejo? Ihererane Yesu!
4. Mbes’ ujy’ ugir’ ubwoba bwo gupfa? Bibwire Yesu! Bibwire Yesu! Mbes’ urashak’ ingoma ya Kristo? Ihererane Yesu!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Bibwire Yesu! Bibwire Yesu! Ni we nshuti y’ ukuri; Ntugir’ indi nshut’ ihwanye na we, Jy’ ubana na we cyane.

title: Nkunda Kwiringira Yesu
verses: 1. Nkunda kwiringira Yesu, Nkajya mwumvira rwose, No kwizer’ umurage we, N’ amateka y’ Imana.
2. Nkunda kwiringira Yesu; Nkizwa n’ amaraso ye. Ansendahw’ ibicumuro, Ni y’ antunganya rwose.
3. Nimenya kumwiringira, Sinzaba ngicumura. Ni ho nzagir’ ubuhoro, N’ ubugingo bw’ iteka.
4. Mpimbawe no kukumenya, Yesu Mukiza nkunda. Nizeye k’ umpora hafi, Nuko nguman’ iteka.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nkuyoboke Mwami rwose; Najyaga nshidikanya, Yesu Yesu mwiza nkunda, Mfasha nkwumvire rwose!

title: Nshim’ Umunsi Nakwemeye
verses: 1. Nshim’ umunsi nakwemeye, Mwami Yesu Mukiza we! Nshima cyane n’ umutima, Ndabwiriz’ ibinezeza.
2. Biramaze, napfiriwe, Nd’ uwa Yesu wandokoye; Yangiz’ uwe, Nkurikire, Nshima yuko ntowe na we.
3. Mutima wanjye ruhuka; Reba mw’ ijur’ ahejejwe, Ntugasig’ Umwami wawe, Bana na we mwumvikane.
4. Iteka nzagukorera, Iby’ isi ndabizinutswe. Nkugarutseho noneho, Sinzarorera kwishima.
5. Ubw’ umucyo wo mw‘ ijuru uzamurikir’ iyi si. Nsanganir’ Umwami wanjye, Tuzibanire mw‘ ijuru.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mpimbaze, mpimbaze; Yesu wankijij’ ibyaha. Anyigisha kumuramya, Ngo nezerw’ iminsi yose; Mpimbaze, mpimbaze Yesu wankijij’ ibyaha.

title: Abatoni B’ Umwami
verses: 1. Abatoni b’ Umwami! Nimuze dusakaze hos’ umunezero wacu, Turangururire rimwe, Dukikij’ intebe, Dukikij’ intebe.
2. Murek’ ibyigomeke, Byanga gushim’ Umwami. Arikw’ abana b’ Imana, Arikw’ abana b’ Imana, Muhore mwishima, Muhore mwishima.
3. Twishimir’ i Siyoni, N’ umudugudu wera; Tuzahahurira twese, Tuzahahurira twese. Hazahor’ ituza, Hazahor’ ituza.
4. Turirimbe cyan’ ubu, Hataba n’ umw’ urira. Tugiye kuger’ iwacu, Tugiye kuger’ iwacu, Mu gihugu cyiza, Mu gihugu cyiza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Turajy’ i Siyoni, Ku murwa mwiz’ utunganye. Turajy’ i Siyoni, Ku murwa mwiz’ utunganye w’ Imana.

title: Naguzw’ Amaraso Y’ Intama
verses: 1. Naguzw’ amaraso y’ Intama, Ncunguzw’ imbabazi zayo. Ubu nd’ umwana wayo rwose, Ntaho ntazabyamamaza.
2. Mpimbaze Yesu wankijije, Nta wuz’ uko nezerewe. Niwe mucyo mwiz’ unyobora, Ahorana nanjy’ iteka.
3. Ntabwo mpung’ Umukiza wanjye, Njya mutekerez’ iteka. Ntabwo ndambirwa kumurata, Njya nsingiz’ urukundo rwe.
4. Nzi ko nzamubonan’ ubwiza, Nezerwa n’ amateka ye. Andinda nez’ aho njya hose, Mutaramira ndirimba.
5. Nizeye kw‘ ambikiy’ ikamba, Mu rugo rwe rwo mw‘ ijuru. Maze tuzahoran’ iteka, N’ abamuyobotse bose.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nkiza (nkiza), nkiza (nkiza), N’ amaraso yawe Yesu. Mboneza, mboneza! Nd’ umwana wawe rwos’ ubu.

title: Tuzaramban’ Amazi Yera
verses: 1. Tuzaramban’ amazi yera, Y’ isokw’ ibeshaho. Ni ho Yes’ azadutegera, N’ ihuriro ryiza.
2. Imirimo niducogoza, Turuhuke hato! Ku mazi y’ urubogobogo, Ku masoko meza.
3. Tyo nimuze mwisunge Kristo Abah’ imbaraga, Kandi mumeny’ ubury’ akiza! Munywe mwic’ inyota!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Tuzaramban’ amazi yera (yera), Kuramban’ amazi yera (yera), Kuramban’ amazi yera (yera), Tuzatinda kw’ isoko.

title: Igihe Yes’ Azakorany’ Amoko
verses: 1. Igihe Yes’ azakorany’ amoko, Ngw’ ahagarar’ imbere Ye, Twese tuzagenzwa dute mu manza, Dutumiwe gutegekwa?
2. Nind’ uzumv’ Umukiz’ amubwir’ ati: Ur’ umugaragu mwiza? Cyangw’ uzamarwa n’ ubwob’ ubwiwe ngo: Hoshi genda ndaguciye?
3. Azamwenyur’ abonany’ abana be, Icyitegererezo Cye, Azabambik’ ibyiza byo mw‘ ijuru, Ubwo bamupfukamire.
4. Tube maso dutegerez’ Umwami, N’ imuri zigumye zake! Kugira ng’ Umukwe naz’ azasange, Tumaze kumwitegura.
5. Tujye dutekerez’ ibyo mw‘ ijuru, Urugendo nirushira, Tuzahagarar’ imbere y’ Imana, Niba tutagamburura.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Azahunik’ ingano mu bigega, Arik’ umuram’ azawusesa. Twese tuzagenzwa dute mu manza, Z’ uwo munsi wo kuzurwa?

title: Sinita Ku Butunzi
verses: 1. Sinita ku butunzi, Feza na zahabu. Ndashak’ ibyo mw’ ijuru; Nzajyane n’ abera. Yesu Mukiza mbwira: Igitabo cyawe, Cyera cy’ ubwami bwawe, Mbese nanditswemo?
2. Ibyaha byanjye Mwami, Birut’ umusenyi. Ngwino Mwam’ ubinkirish’ amaraso yawe! Wadusezeraniye, Yukw’ ibyaha byacu, Nibisa n’ umuhemba, Ng’ uzabyeza rwose.
3. Mu mudugudu mwiza, N’ amazu yera de, N’ abera bawurimo, Barimban’ ibyera, Nta bibi biwegera, Byakwanduz’ ibyiza, Niho hab’ amahoro, Mbese nanditswemo?
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mbese nanditswemo, Ku mpapuro zera? Mu gitabo cy’ ubwami, Mbese nanditswemo?

title: Har’ Imanz’ Ubu
verses: 1. Har’ imanz’ ubu; Nta kitarondorwa, Mbese tuzamera dute? Tugez’ imbere y’ umucamanza, Abony’ ibyo twakoze byose?
2. Zatangiriye mu basinziriye, Zizaza no mu bariho. Tuzasuzumirwa mu byanditswe, Nibyo bizaduhamya rwose.
3. Tuzavug’ iki tugeze mu manza, Ibitabo bibumbuwe, Umuntu wes’ abwirw’ imanza ze, Atakibon’ umurokora?
chorus: Gusubiramo: Tuzaba mu ruhe ruhande, Kur’ uwo munsi ukomeye? Mbese tuzaba twiringanije? Cyangwa tuzatsindwa n’ ibyaha?

title: Umwami Ni We Udutumira
verses: 1. Umwami  ni w’ udutumira, Ngw’ aduteranye n’ ubwoko bwe. Azasanga tumeze dute, Ahw’ azazira?
2. Tuzatamirizw’ amakamba, Uwaducunguye yimitswe, Tuzahorana na w’ iteka, Ahw’ azazira.
3. Nkuk’ umuraby’ ugaragara, Ni kw’ azagaragaza byose; Azerekan’ ibyo twakoze, Ahw’ azazira.
4. Azishim’ ubw’ azabon’ abe, Bambay’ imyambaro yera de. Nituganza tuzanezerwa, Ahw’ azazira.
5. Ntabwo tuzongera gutana, Abanga kumwumvira bose, Bazataka no kuboroga, Yes’ agarutse.
6. Mwami ni wowe twiringiye; Twigishe kugutegereza, Tutazatinya kukubona, Ah’ uzazira.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mwana wa Data we tyo se; Ubw’ Umwam’ azaza, Twebwe tuzamera dute? Umwami naza?

title: Biba Mu Gitondo
verses: 1. Biba mu gitondo, Imbuto z’ ineza! Jy’ ubiba ku manywa n’ ikigoroba! Rindira ko zera! Hazaz’ usarura, Tuzishima cyane, Dutund’ imiba.
2. Bib’ izuba riva! Biba mu gitundwe! Ntugatiny’ ibihu, N’ imbeho nyinshi! Maz’ umusaruro, N’ imirim’ ishize, Tuzishima cyane, Dutund’ imiba.
3. Tugende turira, Tubibir’ Umwami, Niba tubabazwa N’ abazimira, Ubwo tuzahozwa, Tuzakizwa na we. Tuzishima cyane, Dutund’ imiba.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Dutund’ imiba, Dutund’ imiba. Tuzishima cyane, Dutund’ imiba.

title: Ni Ijwi Ry’ Umwungeri Numva
verses: 1. N’ ijwi ry’ Umwungeri numva, Ritabariza mw’ ishyamba; Kw’ intama ze zazimiye; Mu bushyo ni ho zavuye.
2. Dutabar’ uwo Mwungeri, Dushakan’ izo nzimizi! Tuzigarure mu bushyo, Niho zikirir’ imbeho!
3. Ziratakira mw’ ishyamba, Zigeze habi mu manga. Umwam’ arababwir’ ati: Munshakir’ intama zanjye!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nimuze, nimuze, Tuzikurikire mw’ ishyamba! Nimuze, nimuze, Tuzigarurire Yesu!

title: Kiz’ Abanyabyaha
verses: 1. Kiz’ abanyabyaha, Rwaz’ abarwayi! Ubarokor’ ibyago n’ urupfu! Habur’ abahabye! Byuts’ abaguye! Babwire ko Yes’ azi gukiza!
2. Abamushungera, Na bo ntabanga. Ategerez’ abicuza rwose, Bahate bihane, Jy’ ubasabira! Nibizer’ azabababarira.
3. Toz’ abazimiye! Be kuzuyaza. Barek’ irari ry’ ibidakwiye! Buzur’ urukundo, Bagire neza. Bagarukir’ uwabacunguye!
4. Kiz’ abanyabyaha! Biragukwiye. Umwam’ azaguhet’ imbaraga, Bos’ ubayobore mu nzira ntoya! Menyesh’ indushyi ko zarokowe!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Kiz’ abanyabyaha, Rwaz’ abarwayi! Yes’ umunyambabaz’ arakiza.

title: Nkunda Kwogez’ Amagambo
verses: 1. Nkunda kwogez’ amagambo, Y’ ubwami bwo mw’ ijuru; Ya Yesu n’ ishimwe rye, Ya Yesu n’ urukundo rwe. Ni yo nkunda kwogeza, Kuko nzi kw’ ar’ ukuri; Ni y’ amp’ ibyo nifuza, Nta handi mbibona.
2. Nkunda kwogez’ amagambo, Arut’ ibintu byose; Ahebuz’ umurimbo; N’ ibyo turigira byose, Ni yo nkunda kwogeza. Yangiriy’ umumaro; Simpwema kuyarata, Ngw’ abakize namwe.
3. Nkunda kwogez’ amagambo, Nkomeze njye nyavuga; Aranogera cyane, Kukw’ ambwiriz’ iby’ ijuru; Ni yo nkunda kwogeza, Nyabwir’ abatayazi, Bameny’ ako gakiza, Kava mu nzandiko.
4. Nkunda kwogez’ amagambo, Nyabwira n’ abayazi, N’ abayakennye na bo, Bose bashaka kuyumva. Ubwo nzaba mw’ ijuru, Ndirimb’ indirimbo nshya, Na y’ izab’ impimbaye, Nk’ amagambo nkunda.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ni yo nkunda kwogeza; Nkize nzaba nkivuga, Ukw’ ab’ isi bahoranye, Impuhwe za Yesu.

title: Tujye Dusabir’ Abazimiye
verses: 1. Tujye dusabir’ abazimiye, Bahabiye kure y’ Imana! Tubahinduz’ ubutumwa bwiza, Bamenye k’ Umwam’ abakunda!
2. Tugarurire Yes’ abahabye, Intebyi zidafit’ intege! Tuzerek’ aho zizakirira, Zimeny’ inzira y’ ubugingo!
3. Tugend’ uko Yesu yadutoye, Tujye tumuyobok’ iteka! Rwaz’ abarwayi byuts’ abaguye! Yobor’ abahabye kwa Yesu.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S.,A. na T : Tujye hose dusang’ abantu bose! Tugarurir’ Iman’ abazimiye! Tubane mu bushyo bw’ Umucunguzi, Yesu watambiy’ abanyabyaha. B.,A. Na :Tujye hose, …sang’ abantu bose! Tugarurir’ …man’ abazimiye! Tubane mu …shyo bw’ Umucunguzi, Yesu watambiy’ abanyabyaha.

title: Imirim’ Irez’ Ahantu Hose
verses: 1. Imirim’ irez’ ahantu hose; N’ igihe cyo gusarura. Ubu n’ igihe cyo gusarura, Mu bibaya n’ imusozi.
2. Bohereze mu gitondo kare! Ubohereze ku manywa! N’ igih’ izuba ryenda kurenga, Bategeke basarure!
3. Tyo ntumwa y’ Umwami gir’ umwete! Uterany’ ibisarurwa! Maz’ ah’ uzarangiriza rwose, Uzishimira mw’ ijuru!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mwam’ oherez’ abasaruzi! Tuvune turagutabaza! Bohereze baterany’ imiba! Igihe kiracyariho.

title: Dukoran’ Umwete
verses: 1. Dukoran’ umwete, dukorer’ Imana! Twihute dukurikiz’ Umwami wacu! Ijambo rye ni ryo riduh’ imbaraga; Tugir’ umwete mwinshi tumuyoboke!
2. Dukoran’ umwete! Duhaz’ abashonje! Tuyobor’ abaremby’ aho bakirira. Ni ko kwamamaz’ inkuru y’ Umukiza, Dukomeze twiratan’ umusaraba.
3. Dukoran’ umwete, dutarure bose! Kukw’ ingoma zo hasi zizahanguka. Kand’ Uwitek’ azasingizwa na bose, Abera bazaririmba ko bakize.
4. Dukoran’ umwete, Dutebuts’ Umwami! Kukw‘ igihe cy’ isarura kiri hafi. Tujye gutur’ iwabo w’ abacunguwe, Tuzahora turirimb’ uko twakize.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Dukore (dukore), dukore (dukore), Dukore (dukore), dukore (dukore). Twizere (twizere), twitonde (twitonde), Duhore twitez’ Umwami!

title: Kor’ Ugifit’ Uburyo
verses: 1. Kor’ ugifit’ uburyo, Kora hakibona! Jy’ ukora no mu kime, Jy’ ushir’ ubute! Kora no ku manyw’ akaze! Ntucogore rwose! Kora bugiye kwira, Mar’ imirimo!
2. Kora bugiye kwira! Kor’ amanywa yose! Komez’ ukor’ iteka, Ntukaruhuke! Mu bihe byos’ ukiriho, Ntugahweme rwose! Komeza butarira, Mar’ imirimo!
3. Kora bugiye kwira! Ubu harabona. Bugiye kugoroba, Gira n’ ingoga! Ugeze ko bwira rwose, Izuba rirenze, Ntugatuze gukora, Mar’ imirimo!

title: Mu Gitondo Njya Ndirimba
verses: 1. Mu  gitondo njya ndirimba, Nguhimbaza Mwami, Nguh’ amasengesho yanjye, Kuko  nkwiringiye.
2. Ku  misozi ni ho Yesu, Yajyag’ asabira; No  gutakambira Data, Ngw’ adukiz’ ibyago.
3. Mwam’  unyoboresh’ Umwuka. Mu  nzir’ itunganye. Untunganiriz’ ubwenge, Meny’ ibikwiriye.
4. Abubah’ izina ryawe, Urajy’ ubumvira. Ubakingir’ imbabazi. Bakir’ amakuba.

title: Mwese Musingiz’ Umwami
verses: 1. Mwese musingiz’ Umwami muti: Izina ryawe ryubahwe. Mwami niw’ ugir’ ishimwe ryose, Izina ryawe ryubahwe.
2. Yesu zina ritumar’ ubwoba, Mwubah’ izina ry’ Umwami! Ni nk’ inanga ku bafit’ ibyaha, Mwubah’ izina ry’ Umwami!
3. Adukiz’ imbaraga y’ ibyaha, Mwubah’ izina ry’ Umwami! Amaraso y’ adukiza rwose. Mwubah’ izina ry’ Umwami!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mwubah’ izina, Mwubah’ izina! Mwubah’ izina ry’ Umwami! Mwubah’ izina, Mwubah’ izina! Mwubah’ izina ry’ Umwami!

title: Dushime Nyir’ Umugisha
verses: 1. Dushime Nyir’ Umugisha, Abo mw’ isi tumushime; N’ abo mw’ ijuru bashime, Dat’ Umwan’ Umwuka Wera. Amen.

title: Nsingiz’ Imana Rurema
verses: 1. Nsingiz’ Imana Rurema, Yaremy’ imisozi; Yadendej’ inyanja zose, Yahanits’ ijuru; Nsingiz’ iyahay’ izuba, Kumurika mu munsi. Ih’ ukwezi kubonesha, N’ inyenyer’ umucyo.
2. Nsingiz’ ibambe ry’ Umwami, Wujuj’ is’ imyaka; Yaremeshej’ ijambo rye, Ibizima byose. Mwami mbon’ ibitangaza, Byaw’ aho ndeba hose, Hano hasi no hejuru, Ntabwo bihinyuka.
3. Nta kiriho na gitoya, Kitakwerekana. Imvura n’ izuba biba, Kw’ itegeko ryawe. Uh’ ibizima kubaho, Kand’ ubitunga byose. Ntaho twahungir’ Imana, Kuko ntahw’ itaba.

title: Muramy’ Umwami
verses: 1. Muramy’ Umwami waremye byose, Nimuhimbaze mwes’ urukundo rwe, N’ umuvunyi wacu niw’ Uhoraho, Agoswe n’ ibyiza birabagirana.
2. Mumwamamaze! Nyir’ imbabazi! Yihunz’ umucyo, Akwiriye hose, Ibicu bikoranywa, N’ icyusa cye, Acyahish’ abant’ urusaku rw’ inkuba.
3. Agir’ ubuntu bukwira hose, Bwuj’ ikirere, Buba no mu mucyo, Butemba mu misozi n’ ibisiza, Nibw’ ikime n’ imvura biturukamo.
4. Tur’ igitaka, Tworoshye twese. Turakwizera kuk’ udahemuka; Imbabazi zawe n’ akamenyero. Mubyey’ ugir’ ibambe, Mukiza mwiza.

title: Data Tuj’ Ah’ Uri
verses: 1. Data tuj’ ah’ uri, Ko tudafit’ undi, Ni wow’ udukiza, Niko kuza. Niba tutabana, Is’ irimw’ ishavu. Uduhumurize, Data mwiza.
2. Dukiz’ ababisha, Dukize n’ ibyago, Dutuz’ imitima, Mu makuba. Ntitugir’ intege, Twuzuz’ imbaraga, Dutiz’ amaboko, Ngo tuneshe.
3. Twuzuz’ imbabazi, Tur’ abawe rwose, Tuyobor’ iteka, Twang’ ibyaha. Tugumane Mwami, Kand’ ubwo tuzapfa, Ntuzatwibagirwe, Tuzabane.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Data tuj’ ah’ uri, Ntutubuze. Niw’ uzi gukiza, Twumvir’ ubu.

title: Ntumpiteho Mukiza We
verses: 1. Ntumpiteho Mukiza we! Wumv’ uko nganya. Ubw’ ugenderer’ abandi, Nanjye ntunsige.
2. Njye neger’ intebe yawe, Mpabw’ imbabazi. Ngupfukamire, mbabaye, Mpa kukwizera.
3. Ntaw’ undi nakwiringira, Ni wowe nshaka. Mvur’ ibikomere byanjye, Umbabarire.
4. Ur’ isoko y’ amahoro, Nyir’ ubugingo. Singir’ undi niyambaza, Keretse wowe.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yewe Mukiza! Umv’ uko nganya. Ubw’ ugenderer’ abandi, Nanjye ntunsige.

title: Gihe Cyiza Cyo Gusenga
verses: 1. Gihe cyiza cyo gusenga, Kintarura mu mpagarara; Ngo nigir’ aho Dat’ ari, Muganyir’ ibyo nkennye byose. Mu bihe by’ umubabaro, Nabony’ ibimpumuriza. Ntsind’ ubukana bw’ Umwanzi, Mu bihe byiza byo gusenga.
2. Gihe cyiza cyo gusenga, Jy’ unsohorez’ amasengesho, K’ Uwiteka ntahemuka, Aratwiteze ngw’ aduhire, Ndamwihereje rwos’ ubu, Yuk’ ubwe yampamagaye, Niringiy’ imbabazi ze, Nogez’ ibihe byo gusenga.

3. Gihe cyiza cyo gusaba, Urajy’ uhor’ umpumuriza, Ugez’ aho nger’ iwacu, Nzataha nzamuwe mu bicu, Mpembw’  ibihembo by’ abera, Ni byo bizaramb’ iteka. Ubwo ni bwo nzasezera Ku bihe byiza byo gusenga.

title: Imins’ Itandat’ Ishize
verses: 1. Imins’ itandat’ ishize, Indi Sabat’ itangiye. Nezezwa no kuruhuka, Mur’ uyu muns’ uhiriwe.
2. Nimuze mushim’ Umwami, Wabahaye kuruhuka. Umugisha w’ uyu munsi, Urut’ uw’ iyindi yose.
3. Tunezerwe mu mitima, Twishimir’ ibyo mw’ ijuru. Mu buruhukiro bwacu, Ku Mwami nyir’ Isabato.
4. Ituza riva mw’ ijuru, Ritwuzure twebwe twese, Hos’ itorero ry’ Imana, Rikir’ imitima myinshi.

title: Wicogora Mur’ Iki Gihe
verses: 1. Wicogora mur’ iki gihe, Ba maso n’ imperuka. Rind’ udatsindwa n’ iby’ iyi si, Mukristo jy’ usaba. Uz’ uk’ umubir’ uremba, Kand’ umwanz’ arakaze. Utegereze nyir’ ubukwe, Ba mas’ utarambirwa.
2. Tsemb’ ibishukw’ imbere yawe, Rek’ imitima myinshi. Uzaruhukira mw’ ijuru, Nih’ uzaturiza. Jy’ uhor’ usaba mukristo, Umwam’ arakwiteze. Ibuk’ uko yaguhorewe, Bamuvush’ amaraso.
3. Ntugahweme kwambaza Yesu, Jy’ ubana naw’ iteka Ntugahug’ ibitum’ utsinda, Tegerez’ Umwami. Wirushy’ uzuyaza rwose, Reka gushidikanya. N’ igihe cyo kumwitegura, Ntugahweme kwambaza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Komez’ ujy’ usaba, Komez’ ujy’ usaba. Jya wirind’ iteka ku manywa na nijoro, Ntugahweme gusaba.

title: Wibuk’ Isabato
verses: 1. Wibuk’ Isabato, Umwami yahiriye. N’ umus’ urut’ iyindi, N’ umuns’ unezeza. Turuhukamw’ imirimo, Tubwirwamw’ iby’ ijuru. Ni wo mucy’ umurika, Uva ku Mwam’ Imana
2. Jya wez’ Isabato, Maz’ uramy’ uwo Mwami, Wabwiy’ intumwa z’ ati: Ndi Nyir’ ubugingo. Niba twicisha bugufi, Dukorer’ Umukiza, Tuzajyanwa kw’ isoko, Y’ amazi y’ ubugingo.
3. Twishime, twezwemo, Turirimbire Yesu, Inshuti yacu nziza, Tumutekereze. Mukiza mwiz’ udukunda, Isezerano ryawe, Ng’ uzaba muri twebwe, Ni ryo ritunezeza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Utuzanir’ amahoro, Sabato nziza rwose. Utuzanir’ amahoro, Sabato nziza.

title: N’ Umunsi Wera Wo Kuruhuka
verses: 1. N’ umunsi wera wo kuruhuka, Muns’ uhiriwe w’ amahoro; Ukiz’ intebyi n’ ufit’ ishavu, Mwiz’ ushimwa mu yindi yose. Mwami mur’ uwo munsi, Bose bagusingiza, Ngo weze, weze, weze, Kukw’ ari w’ uhorahw’ iteka.
2. N’ icyambu kibamw’ ituza ryinshi, Ntikibamw’ imidugararo. Ni nk’ umurima w’ i Paradizo, Imigezi myiz’ inyuramo. Usa n’ isokw’ ifuka, Iy’ amapfa yacanye. Ni nk’ aho tubonera, Igihugu cy’ isezerano.

3. N’ umunsi twongerwamw’ imbaraga, N’ umuns’ uduter’ urukundo. Ni w’ utuma turek’ iby’ iyi si, Tukegukir’ ibyo mw’ ijuru. Tuboner’ imbabazi, Mur’ uyu munsi mwiza. Dushake kuruhuka, No ku rurembo rwo mw’ ijuru.

title: Nkunda Guterana Kw’ Isabato
verses: 1. Nkunda guterana kw’ Isabato, Kwig’ Ijambo ry’ Imana. Teraniro ryiza ry’ abigishwa, Undutira byose.
2. Ni ho namenyey’ iby’ ubugingo, Mbon’ uburyo nihana, Nitoraniriz’ ibitunganye, Ni byo binezeza.
3. Aho ni ho Yesu yantoreye, Ambwiz’ ijwi rye ryiza. Ubwo ni bwo namwihitiyemo, Mw’ ihuriro ryiza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Huriro (…riro) rishimwa (…shimwa), Huriro (…riro) rishimwa (…shimwa). Teraniro ryiza ry’ abigishwa, Undutira byose.

title: Dukoze Gatandatu
verses: 1. Dukoze gatandatu, Tubwirizwa n’ Imana. None dushak’ ihirwe, Mu rusengero rwayo. N’ umuns’ urut’ iyindi, Unshuz’ ibyo mw’ ijuru. N’ umuns’ urut’ iyindi, Niw’ unshuz’ ibyo mw’ ijuru.
2. Tugusab’ umugisha, Mw’ izina ry’ Umukiza. Tugirir’ imbabazi, Udutsembehw’ ibyaha. Ducike ku by’ iyi si, Turuhukane nawe. Ducike ku by’ iyi si, Uruhukire muri twe.
3. Twaje kugusingiza, Ngwino dusaban’ ubu, Tubon’ ubwiza bwawe, Mu rusengero rwawe. Mwam’ uduhe kumenya, Ibyiza byo mw’ ijuru. Mwam’ uduhe kumenya, Uko bizaba mw’ ijuru.
4. Ubutumwa bugwire, Bukiz’ abanyabyaha. Imbabazi zihoza, Abagutakambira. Duhe kugusingiza, Twez’ Isabato nziza. Duhe kugusingiza, Tuguman’ itek’ iteka.

title: Nshim’ Isabato Yera
verses: 1. Nshim’ Isabato yera, Imana yaduhaye. Ngo tujye turuhuka, Tuwunezererwemo.
2. N’ umuns’ ubamw’ ituza, Uhoramw’ ibyishimo. Biduhuz’ agahinda, Kugeza ku mperuka.
3. N’ umuns’ uduhimbara, Tukawizihirwamo, Twongerwamw’ imbaraga, Tukuzuzw’ umugisha.
4. Kaze Sabato nziza, Munsi w’ ikiruhuko, Duhabwamw’ umugisha, Tukamererwa neza.

title: Twumvis’ Inkuru Nziza
verses: 1. Twumvis’ inkuru nziza, Ko Yesu akiza. Kwiz’ uwo munezero, Ko Yesu akiza. Bibwir’ abantu bose, Uzambuke n’ inzuzi. Umwami ngo jya hose, Ni Yesu ukiza.
2. Ukwize no mu nyanja, Ko Yesu akiza. Tyo bwir’ abacumuye, Ko Yesu akiza. Himbaz’ abo mu birwa, Kukw’ amakuru meza, Azumvikana hose, Ko Yesu akiza.
3. Mw’ irasaniro muti: Ni Yesu ukiza. Yaducunguye twese, Ni Yesu ukiza. Ririmbir’ abatebye, Bashak’ ubatabara. Ririmba ku bituro, Ko Yesu akiza.
4. N’ imiyag’ ivug’ iti: Ni Yesu ukiza. Amoko yos’ ashime, Ko Yesu akiza. Jy’ urangurur’ ijw’ uti: Mwese muze mukizwe! Dusingiz’ ubutwari, Ko Yesu akiza.

title: Ndagushaka Mukiza We
verses: 1. Ndagushaka Mukiza we! Ntabwo mbasha kwigenza. Ndifuza k’ umpora hafi, Gumy’ unyikomereze.
2. Ndagushaka Mukiza we! Kuko noroshye cyane. Niw’ umbwir’ ibinkomeza, Nta wundi mbitezeho.
3. Ndagushaka Mukiza we! Aho ndi mur’ iyi si. Mu muvumbi no ku zuba, Mu bimbabaza byose.
4. Ndagushaka Mukiza we! Mbwiriz’ ibitunganye. Ungeze kuri Yor’dani, Umpe no kuyambuka.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Sinzagir’ icyo ntinya, Umbwiriz’ iby’ ushaka. Nta cyambuza kuz’ ah’ uri, Ngukurikir’ ah’ ujya.

title: Iyo Nibuts’ Umusarab’ Utangaza
verses: 1. Iyo nibuts’ umusarab’ utangaza, Umwami nyir’ ishema yatangiyeho, Ibyo nungukaga, ntabwo mba nkibyitayeho. Nzinukw’ ibyo niratanaga.
2. Reb’ inkovu zo ku mubiri we wose, Zituma ngir’ ishavu n’ umunezero. Har’ ubw’ ishavu n’ ibyishimo bijya bihura. Har’ utak’ ikamba mu mahwa?
3. Nari narazimiye meze nk’ impabe. Ariko narokotse kubw’ ibyago bye; Ntunzibukira ntagir’ ikindi niratana, Kerets’ umusaraba wawe.
4. Nahw’ ibyaremwe byose byab’ ar’ ibyanjye, Ntacyo nabona nakugereranyaho; Urukundo, n’ ubuntu byaturutse mw’ ijuru, Bituma ndek’ ibyanjye byose.

title: Nta Nshuti Nziza Nka Yesu
verses: 1. Nta nshuti nziza nka Yesu, Atsemb’ ibyaha byacu. N’ amahirwe kumwizera, Kukw’ atwuzuza na Se. Iyo tubabaye rwose, Dufit’ ishavu ryinshi, Adusohoza ku Mana, Yumv’ amaganya yacu.
2. Nitugir’ ibyago byinshi, Tugatotezwa cyane, Byoye kuduter’ ubwoba, Tumwiringire rwose; Nta wundi wabidukiza, Abiduhemuraho. Yes’ az’ integer nke zacu, Jya wisung’ Uwiteka.
3. Nitugir’ ishavu ryinshi, Tukababara rwose, Yesu ni w’ uturokora; Komez’ umwizigire. Nibakugira ruvumwa, Wisung’ Umwami Yesu. Ntazagir’ ubw’ aguhana, Jy’ uhor’ umwizigiye.

title: Yesu Araguhamagara None
verses: 1. Yes’ araguhamagara none, Arakwifuz’ uyu munsi; N’ iki gituma wanga kwitaba, Ukayobagurika?
2. Yes’ arahamagar’ abarushye, Ngw’ abaruhur’ uyu munsi; Umwikorez’ umutwaro wawe; Ntazagushor’ inshucu.
3. Yes’ aragutegereje none, Musange non’ uyu munsi; Zan’ ibyaha byaw’ ubyicujije, Ngwino witindiganya.
4. Yes’ arakwinginga, wumv’ ijwi rye; Mwumvire non’ uyu munsi. Abamwiringira bazishima; Haguruk’ umusange!
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Uyu munsi, uyu munsi ; Yes’ araguhamagaran’ imbabazi ze. T. na B.: Uyu munsi, none, none, Uyu munsi, none, none; Yesu Yes’ Umwami ni w’ Uguhamagaran’ imbabazi ze.

title: Hanze Har’ Umushyitsi
verses: 1. Hanze har’ umushyitsi, Kingura! (Mukingurire, mukingurire!) Yahoz’ ategereje, Kingur’ ubu! (Mukingurire, mukingurire!) Kingurir’ Umukiza, Ataraguhitaho; Yes’ Umwana w’ Imana; Kingur’ ubu! (Mukingurire, mukingurire!)

2. Ugurur’ umutima, Kingura! (Mukingurire, mukingurire!) N’ uzuyaz’ aragenda, Kingur’ ubu! (Mukingurire, mukingurire!) Niwe nshuti - magara; Azajy’ akurengera, Kand’ akurind’ iteka: Kingur’ ubu! (Mukingurire, mukingurire!)

3. Ntiwumv’ ukw’ akwinginga? Kingura! (Mukingurire, mukingurire!) Muhitemw‘ ubu ngubu, Kingur’ ubu! (Mukingurire, mukingurire!) Ahagaze ku rugi; Azaguhesh’ ihirwe, Maz’ ujy’ umuhimbaza; Kingur’ ubu! (Mukingurire, mukingurire!)

4. Akir’ uwo mushyitsi, Kingura! (Mukingurire, mukingurire!) Azasangira nawe, Kingur’ ubu! (Mukingurire, mukingurire!) Azakubabarira; Iby’ isi nibishira, Akujyane mw’ ijuru; Kingur’ ubu! (Mukingurire, mukingurire!)

title: Ubyarw’ Ubwa Kabiri
verses: 1. Harih’ uwasanze Yesu nijoro, Amubaz’ iby’ inzira y’ agakiza. Yes’ amusubiz’ amweruriy’ ati: N’ ukuri nkubwire:
2. Namwe nimwite kur’ iryo jambo rye, Kuko Yesu yarivuz’ aryeruye; Nibyo bizabagirir’ umumaro, Dor’ aravug’ ati:
3. Abashak’ uburuhukiro bose, No kuririmbana n’ abacunguwe, No guhabw’ ubugingo buhoraho, Mwite kur’ ibi ngo:
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ubyarw’ ubwa kabiri (rwose); Ubyarw’ ubwa kabiri (rwose); N’ ukuri, n’ ukuri, ndakubwir’ ubu Kw’ aribw’ uzarama (rwose).

title: Mucunguzi Wanjye
verses: 1. Mucunguzi wanjye, wumv’ uko ntaka; Ngwin’ unyirokorere. Umutima wanjy’ ugoswe n’ ibyago; Ngwin’ unyirokorere.
2. Mwami, singira shinge na rugero; Ngwin’ unyirokorere. Kwitabwaho nawe nibyo byanyura; Ngwin’ unyirokorere.
3. Dore ndi jyenyine, nabay’ impabe; Ngwin’ unyirokorere. Nubuy’ amaso ngo mbeshweho nawe; Ngwin’ unyirokorere.
4. Ntuhinyur’ umutim’ ushenjaguwe; Ngwin’ unyirokorere, Nyamunek’ ita ku gusenga kwanjye, Ngwin’ unyirokorere.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nahabiye kure, nd’ akahebwe; Nahabiye kure y’ iwacu. Nyakira none, maz’ ungez’ iwacu; Ngwin’ unyirokorere.

title: Ashobora Gukiza
verses: 1. Ashobora gukiza! Mubyamamaze hose; Ashobora gukiz’ umwumvira wese, Akamwarura mu murir’ ugurumana. Yes’ ashobora gukiza ushaka wese.
2. Ashobora gukiza! Mbese n’ ukuri koko? Ahw’ afit’ imbarag’ ibasha kunkiza? Mbwira, nyamuna mbwira, Mbese Kristo wishwe, Yashobora kumbohora, akandokora?
3. Ashobora gukiza! Mugenzi we komera! Nuyoboka Yesu azakurokora. Ntugatinye Satani, Jy’ ugundira Yesu; Reka kujy’ ushidikanya, Jy’ umwiringira.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ashobora kugukiza, No kukurokor’ ubu; Mwene  Data numwizera, Azagukiza.

title: Twubake Ku Rutare Rw’ Iteka
verses: 1. Twubake ku Rutare rw’ iteka, Nirwo Yes’ Umucunguzi; Nibwo tuzabasha gushikama, Umugaru nutera.
2. Harihw’ abubaka ku musenyi, Barangamiy’ iby’ iyi si; Abandi bubaka ku muraba w’ ibyaha no kwikuza.
3. Twubake ku Rutare rw’ ukuri, Nirwo rushikam’ iteka. Kurwiringira kuzahoraho, Nirwo gakiza kacu.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Twubake kuri we, Twubake kuri we; Twubake ku Rutare rw’ iteka, Nirwo Yes’ Umwami. A. T. B.: Twubake kuri we, Niwe Rutare; Twubake kuri we, Niwe Rutare; Twubake ku Rutare rw’ iteka, Nirwo Yes’ Umwami.

title: Menyesh’ Ibya Yesu Byose
verses: 1. Menyesh’ ibya Yesu byose, Maz’ ubinyandikemo; Mbwir’ ibye by’ ingenzi byose, Nezezwa no kubyumva. Mbwir’ ukw’ abamarayika baririmbye yavutse, Ngw’ Icyubahiro ku Mana, Amahor’ abe mu b’ isi.
2. Mbwira n’ ibyo mu butayu, N’ iminsi yahamaze; N’ uburyo yageragejwe, Agatsind’ ibishuko; Mbwira n’ iby’ imirimo ye, Vug’ uko yababajwe; Agahemurwa bamwanze, Agahinyurwa nk’ impabe.
3. Mbwir’ iby’ umusaraba we, Uwo bamubambyeho, Mbwira n’ aho bamuhambye, Mbwira n’ uko yazutse, N’ urukundo ruhebuje, Ntacyo narugeraho. Dore, ndababaye, mbwira iby’ urukundo rwancunguye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Menyesh’ ibya Yesu byose, Maz’ ubinyandikemo. Mbwir’ ibye by’ ingenzi byose, Nezezwa no kubyumva.

title: Yes’ Umwungeri Mwiza
verses: 1. Yes’ Umwungeri mwiza, Aragutarura, Ngo winjire mw’ ishyo rye; Ni h’ uzaruhukira. Ngwin’ ugif’ ubusore, Ngwin’ ukiri muto; Injir’ uzarindwa rwose, Ntuzagir’ icy’ uganya.
2. Yes’ Umwungeri mwiza, Yarakwitangiye; Araguhamagara ati: Nyabuna ngwino, Gira bwang’ uve mu kaga, Ntugumye, kwijyana. Injir’ uzarindwa rwose, Wibere mu mahoro.
3. Reka kuragiriza, Isega yateye, Ishak’ intama zose, Zazimiriye kure. Arik’ Umwungeri mwiza, Arakuburira; Injir’ uzarindwa rwose, Muban’ akaramata.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Aragutaruran’ urukundo, ati: Wa  mpabe we, ngwino nsanga. Dor’ Umukiz’ arategereje, Yes’ Umwungeri wanjye.

title: Naratuwe Mu Gipimo
verses: 1. Umucamanza nagera, Akarondor’ ibyacu, Tuzamera nk’ izahabu, Cyangwa s’ inkamb’ itabwa?
2. Mbese tuzumv’ ishimwe ngo: Nuko, wakoze neza; Cyangw’ iteka ryo gupfa ngo: Mwasanzwe mudashyitse?
3. Nimutyo twite kw’ ijwi rye, Igihe kikiriho. Tureke gutindiganya, Tumaramaze rwose.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Naratuwe mu gipimo, Nsangwa ntashyitse; Naratuwe n’ ijambo rye, Nsangwa ntashyitse.

title: Wumv’ Amagambo Y’ Umukiza
verses: 1. Wumv’ amagambo y’ Umukiza; Ni y’ aguhesh’ ubugingo. Wa munyabyaha we, menya ko hahirw’ abakomez’ amategeko.
2. Kuyumva gusa nta kamaro, N’ukutugwabiza rwose; Kuyumva dutinya, ntibyadukiza, Hahirw’ abayumvira yose.
3. Bazinjiran’ umunezero mu mudugudu w’ Imana, Ahatab’ ishavu n’ umubabaro, Beger’ igiti cy’ ubugingo.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Hahirw’ abayakomeza yose, Nibo bahirwa, barahirwa; Hahirw’ abayakomeza yose, Barahirwa, barahirwa.

title: Nta Nshuti Nziz’ Ihwanye Na Yesu
verses: 1. Nta nshuti nziz’ ihwanye na Yesu; Nta n’ imwe! Nta n’ imwe! Nta wundi wabasha kudukiza; Nta wundi! Nta wundi!
2. Nta nshut’ ibahw’ ikomeye nka we; Nta n’ imwe! Nta n’ imwe! Nyamara nta wiyoroshya nka we; Nta n’ umwe! Nta n’ umwe!
3. Nta kanya na gato tutabana; Ye nta ko! Ye nta ko! Nta joro ryira tutari kumwe; Ye nta ryo! Ye nta ryo!
4. Mbese har’ uwo yigez’ ahana? Nta n’ umwe! Nta n’ umwe! Mbese har’ umunyabyah’ aheza? Nta n’ umwe! Nta n’ umwe!
5. Harihw’ impano yahwana na we? Nta n’ imwe! Nta n’ imwe! Mbese har’ uwo yavuts’ ijuru? Nta n’ umwe! Nta n’ umwe!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yes’ az’ ibiturushya byose; Azabana natw’ iteka. Nta nshuti nziz’ ihwanye na Yesu, Nta n’ imwe! Nta n’ imwe!

title: Kurabukw’ Umusaraba Wawe
verses: 1. Kurabukw’ umusaraba wawe, Mwami nibyo byambeshaho; Sinita ku manjwe y’ iby’ isi, Ntez’ agakiza ku musaraba.
2. Ubwo nari nkibon’ Umukiza, Yanyakirany’ ibyishimo; Na n’ ubu ningir’ ibindwanya, Kumurabukwa nibyo byankiza.
3. Nzajya mpang’ amas’ umusaraba, Kandi mwiringire rwose. Nta wutumbir’ umusaraba, Wari wiger’ aneshwa n’ Umwanzi.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. : Kurabukw’ i Golgota, Nibyo bizambeshaho. Mbeg’ amahirwe yanjye, Yo kurabukwa Yesu! A., T. na B. : Kurabu … Go… Golgota, Nibyo bi … mbe … mbeshaho. Mbeg’ amahirwe yanjye …rwe yanjye, Yo kurabukwa Yesu! …rabukwa Yesu.

title: Yesu Araguhamagaran’ Ituza
verses: 1. Yes’ araguhamagaran’ ituza, Ub’ arahamagara; Ategereje k’ umwiyegurira, We kuzuyaza; ngwino.
2. Twatinzwa n’ iki, kand’ ategereje kuturokora twese? Twahinyuzwa n’ ik’ imbabazi zose adufitiye twese?
3. Twakererew’ ibihe birahita, Aradutegereje; Turarindagirira mu mwijima; Nimutyo tumusange.
4. Zirikan’ urukundo ruhebuje, Yadusezeranije; N’ ubwo twagomye, Tuzababarirwa; Aradutegereje.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ngwino ( ngwino); Ngwino (ngwino); Abarushye mwese nimuze. Yes’ araguhamagaran’ ituza, ati: Mukundwa, ngwino.

title: Har’ Irembo Ryuguruye
verses: 1. Har’ irembo ryuguruwe, Ryatumye mpishurirwa. Umusaraba wa kure, Yesu yatangiyeho.
2. Irembo ryugururiwe abashak’ agakiza; Ngw’ abakire n’ abakene bose barinyuremo.
3. Nshuti komez’ utwaran’ irembo ricyuguruwe. Ikorer’ umusaraba; Nibw’ uzahabw’ ikamba.
4. Tumaze kwambuk’ uruzi, Dute wa musaraba; Twambikw’ amakamba meza, Twitahire mw’ ijuru.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mbeg’ ineza n’ imbabazi byatumye nugururirwa! Nugururiwe, Iman’ ihimbazwe!

title: Umukiz’ Ageze Hafi
verses: 1. Umukiz’ ageze hafi, Yes’ Umukunzi wanjye. Yazanywe no guhembura; Mwese nimumwumvire.
2. Icyubahiro kib’ icye; Mutyo twizere Yesu. Nkund’ izina ry’ Umukiza; Nkund’ izina rya Yesu.
3. Izina rye rirankiza, Rikamar’ agahinda. Nta kinezeza nko kumva, Iryo zina rya Yesu.
4. Naz’ azatugororera, Ikamba ry’ ubugingo. Ubwo nibwo tuzicara, Tuvug’ iby’ agakiza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nta wuhwany’ izina na we, Rirut’ amazina yose. Nta wusingizwa nka we; Yesu mwiza rwose.

title: Ntacyo Wasigiye Yesu
verses: 1. Dor’ umutima wawe, Wuzuyemw’ amaganya. Nta mwanya wasigiye Yesu ngo yinjiremo? Ub’ ahagaze ku rugi, Arakomanga yinginga. Nta mwanya wasigiye Yesu ngo yinjiremo?
2. Upfush’ igih’ ubusa, Kand’ ar’ ingenzi rwose. Mbese nta mwany’ ufite wo gukorera Yesu? Nturarushy’ ugerageza gutarur’ abazimiye; Mbese nta mwany’ ufite wo gukorera Yesu?
3. Mbese k’ umaranira kwishakir’ ubutunzi, Nta gih’ ufite washishikarir’ ibya Yesu? Dor’ uharanira kwikubir’ ibinezeza by’ isi; Nta gih’ ufite washishikarir’ ibya Yesu?
4. Wabay’ ingumba nk’ igiti cy’ ibibabi gusa. Mbese ntabwo wazerer’ Umwami Yes’ imbuto? Ntacy’ ufite cyo kuzamumurikira nagaruka; Mbese ntabwo wazerer’ Umwami Yes’ imbuto?

title: Mwami Ndumv’ Ijwi Ryawe
verses: 1. Mwami ndumv’ ijwi ryawe, Rindarika ngo nze, Nuhagizwe ya maraso, Wamviriye kera.
2. N’ ubwo nje nahindanye, Ntunyirengagize; Ahubw’ umboneze rwose, Mb’ umweru waka de.
3. Yesu niw’ unkomeza, Niw’ umpa gutsinda; Ng’ urukundo n’ amahoro, Binsabemo rwose.
4. Mwese nimwishimire! Ya maras’ akiza, Yatwujuje na Rurema, Ngo tub’ abana be.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mukiza ndaje, Ubu nj’ ah’ uri! Nyejesha ya maraso, Wamviriye kera.

title: Ndumv’ Umukiz’ Ambwira
verses: 1. Ndumv’ Umukiz’ ambwira, Ko mbuz’ imbaraga; Ngo: Njye museng’ iteka, Ntacyo nzamuburana.
2. Niw’ ufit’ imbaraga, Zihagije rwose; Zo gukiz’ ababembe, Zikoroshy’ umutima.
3. Ubwo  nta cyiza nkora, Nibesherejweho; N’ ubuntu bwawe gusa, Ni wowe nkesha byose.
4. Imbere ya ya ntebe, Nzahahagarara; Nzaba njyany’ iminyago, Nyishyikirize Yesu.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yanndihiriye imyenda yose; Yambabariy’ ibyaha, Bihinduk’ umweru.

title: Harihw’ Isokw’ Itukura

metadata.composer: Mrs. Jos. F. Knapp. By Per

verses: 1. Harihw’ isokw’ itukura, Ivamw’ amaraso; Ni y’ Umwami yamviriye, Ngw’ ayandokoreshe.
2. Mpinduts’ icyaremwe gishya, Mbyaw’ ubwa kabiri. Ntsinze kamere ya kera, Nzahora ndi mushya.
3. Nsigaye mvirwa n’ umucyo, Sinkirindagira; Nshitse ku ngoyi z’ umwanzi, Mbatuwe na Yesu.
4. Mbeg’ ubuntu butangaje! Kwejeshw’ amaraso! Byanyujuje n’ Umukiza, Yesu wambambiwe.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nduz’ umuvu w’ amaraso; Ndayogamo nere rwose! Haleluya! Aranyeza, Aranyeza, Aranyeza!

title: Data Ndambuy’ Amaboko
verses: 1. Data, ndambuy’ amaboko; Nta wundi wamfasha; Iy’ unyivumburiy’ ukamvaho, Mbes’ ahandi najya ni he?
2. Nizey’ Umwana waw’ ubu, Undem’ umutima; Ujy’ unkenur’ umar’ ubukene, Nkomeze nemerwe nawe.
3. Nyir’ ukwizera ni wowe, Nuburiy’ amaso; Icyamp’ ukangwiriza kwizera, Kuko ntagufite napfa.
4. Ntuzantererane ngo mpfe, Ahubw’ umbesheho; Nibwo nzacika ku kinyoma, Mbishobojwe n’ Umwuka wawe.
5. Nakwishima cyane rwose, Nibaniye nawe; Maze nkakumv’ umpumuriz’ umbwira ko nagiriw’ ubuntu.
6. Nizeye rwos’ ubu yuko, Yesu yampfiriye; Kandi kubw’ amaraso ye yeza, Nzabaturwa mve mu byaha.

title: Nzasingiz’ Urukundo Rwa Yesu
verses: 1. Nzasingiz’ urukundo rwa Yesu, Wambambiwe; Yemeye kumanuka, Azanywe no kumpfira.
2. Yesu yambabarijwe, Ntararushya mbabara; Yahoze ansabira, Ntarameny’ iyo bijya.
3. Urukundo rw’ Imana, Mbega ngo rurankiza! Ibyaha byanjye byose, Bikantamururwaho!
4. Nta cyiza nakoreye, Umwami wankunz’ atyo; None maze kwemezwa, Mwami nguhaye byose.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nzasingiz’ urukundo rwe; Mpimbaze, Yaramfiriye, Ashaka kumbeshaho; Nzahora muhimbaza.

title: Nyigiza Hafi
verses: 1. Nyigiza hafi, mbane nawe; Nta cyandutira kubana nawe. Ngumisha mu gituza cyawe; Mpisha nibere mu buhungiro; Mpisha nibere mu buhungiro.
2. Nyigiza hafi, ntacyo mfite; Ntacyo nzanyehw’ ituro ry’ Umwami, Kerets’ umutim’ ushavuye; Mpa kuhagizw’ amaraso yawe; Mpa kuhagizw’ amaraso yawe.
3. Nyigiza hafi, Mwami wanjye; Nishimiye gucika ku byaha. Ndeke kwikuza n’ ubwibone; Umpe Yes’ Umwami wambambiwe; Umpe Yes’ Umwami wambambiwe.
4. Nyigiza hafi, ngihumeka; Kugez’ ubwo nzager’ ibudapfa; Maze mu bihe bidashira, Nzibere hafi y’ Umwami wanjye; Nzibere hafi y’ Umwami wanjye.

title: Har’ Izina Rihebuje
verses: 1. Har’ izina rihebuje, Rirut’ ayandi yose nzi; Niry’ Imana yaturemye yis’ Umwana way’ ikunda.
2. Niryo rimpesh’ umugisha; Nkunda kuryogez’ iteka. Simpwema kuriririmba, Mvug’ ukuntu rihebuje.
3. Icyampa nkaririmbana n’ abamarayika bera, Nkajya nsingiza rya zina rihebuj’ ayandi yose!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Niryo zina ryera ( izina ); Niryo zina ryera ( ryera de )! Ryakomotse ku Mana, Riza mw’ isi, Maze riririmbwa ( izina ) n’ abamarayika ( ryera de ). Iryo zina n’ irya Yesu.

title: Yesu Gusa
verses: 1. Yesu gusa, ni w’ ukwiriy’ ikuzo; Naho jyewe, ntacyo ndi cyo rwose; Sinkwiriye kub’ ari jyew’ uratwa; Yesu gusa, ni w’ uzajy’ uvugwa.
2. Yesu gusa, ni w’ umar’ agahinda; Naho jyewe nd’ uwo gushavura. Sinshobora kwikorer’ ibindushya; Naho Yesu nta kimushengura.
3. Yesu gusa, ab’ ari we wogezwa; Sinkwiriye kwiratan’ ibyanjye. Yesu gusa, ni w’ uzambonekamo; Kugez’ ubwo nzahinduka nka we.
4. Yesu gusa ni w’ umar’ ubukene; Ni we gusa nkesh’ ibyanjye byose. Yesu gusa, ni w’ undutira byose; Yesu Mwami twibanir’ iteka.

title: Nk’ Ukw’ Izuba Rituvira

metadata.composer: Melody By M. T. Haughey Arr

verses: 1. Nk’ukw’ izuba rituvira, Rikarabagirana, Ni k’ umucyo wo mw’ ijuru wansabye mu mutima, Wawukuyemw’ iby’ amanjwe, Utangaz’ ibihishwe; Kuko mu mutima wanjye, Nahatuj’ Umukiza.
2. Natay’ agahinda kose; Ntabwo nkikitayeho; Kuk’ unyambik’ amahoro, Ameze nk’ umwitero, Nkwerekejeh’ umutima, Ndakwishimiye cyane. Nzagezw’ iwawe mw’ ijuru, Na rwa rukundo rwawe.
3. Mukiza warancunguye; Nd’ uwaw’ uko ndi kose. Nyemerera nguhimbaze, Nkuber’ umucyo waka. Nkwerekejeh’ umutima, Ndakwishimiye cyane. Nzagezw’ iwawe mw’ ijuru, Na rwa rukundo rwawe.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mbeg’ umucyo w’ agatangaza, Wansabye mu mutima! Ineza y’ Umwami Yesu, Yambereye nk’ umucyo.

title: Njya Nkunda Kuririmb’ Indirimbo
verses: 1. Njya nkunda kuririmb’ indirimbo, Ngo yarancunguye. Ni we waciy’ ingoyi z’ umwanzi, Maz’ arambatura.
2. Mfit’ Umukiz’ unogeye rwose, Ni we wancunguye. Mpimbazwa no gukor’ iby’ ashaka, Kuko yancunguye.
3. Nzahora mpamya ntacyo nikenga, Y’uko yancunguye. Sinzashidikanya ngo ncogore, Kuko yancunguye.
4. Mfit’ aho yanteguriye heza, Kuko yancunguye. Ni ho nzibanira na w’ iteka, Kuko yancunguye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Kuk’ ubwe yancunguye; Kuk’ ubwe yancunguye, Nzahimbaz’ izina rye. Kuk’ ubwe yancunguye, Nzaririmbir’ uwandokoye. A. T. B.: Kuk’ ubwe yancunguye; Kuk’ ubwe yancunguye; Kuk’ ubwe yancunguye, Nzahimbaz’ izina rye. Kuk’ ubwe yancunguye, Kuk’ ubwe yancunguye; Nzaririmbir’ uwandokoye.

title: Iman’ Ikund’ Utunyoni
verses: 1. Iman’ ikund’ utunyoni, Tuba mur’ iyi si; Ubwo yita ku tunyoni, Nzi ko nanjy’ inkunda.
2. Ni y’ irimbish’ uburabyo, Buhumura neza; Ubw’ ikund’ uburaby’ ityo, Nzi ko nanjy’ inkunda.
3. Imana yaremye byose, Ntigir’ icy’ isobwa. Nzi kw’ ikund’ abana bose, Nzi ko nanjy’ inkunda.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Irankunda, irankunda; Nzi ko nanjy’ inkunda; Kukw’ ikund’ utuntu duto, Nzi ko nanjy’ inkunda.

title: N’ Igihe Cyo Gusenga
verses: 1. N’ igihe cyo gusenga, Twicishe bugufi, Duteraniye hamwe turamya Yesu, Nituza tumwizeye, Azajy’ aturinda; Mbeg’ ihumure ryiza, ryo kwibanira na we!
2. N’ igihe cyo gusenga, Umwam’ ari hafi, Kand’ adufitiy’ ibambe rya kibyeyi. Tumuganyir’ ibyacu, Dushir’ agahinda; Mbeg’ ihumure ryiza, ryo kumvikana na we!
3. N’ igihe cyo gusenga, no gushyikirana, N’ Imana yac’ ihor’ ituzirikana, Iturem’ agatima, tub’ indahangarwa; Mbeg’ ihumure ryiza, ryo kumvikana na we!
4. N’ igihe cyo gusenga, twiringiye Yesu. Twizeye kw‘ azaduh’ ibyo, tumusaba, Kukw’ atangan’ ubuntu, ataziganije. Mbeg’ ihumure ryiza, ryo gutabarwa nawe!
chorus: Gusubiramo: N’ igihe cyiza cyo kuramy’ Umwami, Mbeg’ ihumure ryiza, ryo kwibanira na we!

title: Yesu Waduhay’ Isezerano
verses: 1. Yesu waduhaye isezerano, K’ uzabana natwe, niduterana, Naho twaba babiri, Cyangwa batatu, Uzab’ uri kumwe n’ abana bawe.
2. Wateranye natwe, mu bindi bihe, Ariko na n’ ubu turakwifuza. Ngwino, Mubyeyi mwiza, Turakwinginze; Twumvir’ utwemere, Duhirwe nawe.
3. Wakir’ indirimbo z’ ishimwe ryacu, Uduhe gusenga tubyitayeho. Twongerere kwizera, No kwiringira; Dukundane rwose, Dushyire hamwe.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yesu, ngwin’ uduhire, Tutarava hano; Yesu ngwin’ uduhire ubu, Tuban’ iteka.

title: Nd’ Uwawe, Mwami
verses: 1. Nd’ uwawe Mwami, Ubu nditanze; Numvis’ ubury’ udukunda. Nsingiriz’ amabok’ untabare, Njye nibanire nawe.
2. Nkwiyeguriye namaramaje, Nkoresh’ umurimo wawe; Nkwerekejeh’ umutima wanjye, Ng’ uhor’ ugengwa nawe.
3. Kubana nawe birahebuje, Ni byo bindutira byose. Iyo mpfukamye, nkakuganyira, Dusabana nk’ inshuti.
4. Sinashobora kukurondora, Ngo meny’ urukundo rwawe. Ruzahishurwa turi mw’ ijuru, Aho twateguriwe.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. A.: Hafi yawe, Ni byo nifuza, Ku musaraba wawe. Hafi yawe, Mwami, tuban’ iteka, Njye nibanira nawe. T. B.: Hafi yawe cyane, ni byo nifuza, Ku musaraba wawe. Hafi yawe, Mwami, tuban’ iteka, Njye nibanira nawe.

title: Ndusheho Gusa Nawe
verses: 1. Ndusheho gusa nawe, Yesu Mukiza wanjye; Nyuzuz’ ubugwaneza, Mp’ urukundo ruhebuje. Ndusheho kumera nkawe, Aho ngenda hose, Mwami; Ndiyoroheje rwose, Mwami njye ngukurikiza.
2. Nib’ irind’ icyanira, Ikamenya n’ igishwi; Sinshidikanya rwose, Nanjy’ ihor’ inyitayeho. Izanyigisha kwitonda, Imbabarir’ amafuti; Ndiyoroheje rwose, Mwami njye ngukurikiza.
3. Ndusheho gusa nawe, Ndusheh’ uko bukeye; Nyigiza hafi yawe, Ahw’ amahor’ adashira. Uhor’ umpindura mushya, Kubw’ urukund’ ungirira; Ndiyoroheje rwose, Mwami njye ngukurikiza.

title: Yesu, Unkomereze Ku Musaraba
verses: 1. Yes’ unkomereze, Ku musaraba wawe; Har’ isokw’ ibeshaho, Itemb’ i Kal’vari.
2. Hafi y’ umusaraba, Mpaboner’ iteka, Imbabazi n’ impuhwe, Bitarondoreka.
3. Hafi y’ umusaraba, Intama y’ Imana, Ni yo yahangejeje, Ntsind’ ibimbabaza.
4. Hafi y’ umusaraba, Ni ho ntegereje; Niringiye kugera, Mu bwami bw’ Imana.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Umusaraba wa Yesu nzawirata, Kugez’ ubwo nzabona uburuhukiro.

title: Nyemerera Ngendane Nawe
verses: 1. Nyemerera ngendane nawe, Mana, Nk’ ukw’ Enoki yagenje. Nyoboresh’ ukuboko kwawe, Unyerekez’ ah’ ushaka hose. Nubw’ inzir’ itagaragara, Nkomeze njyane nawe, Mwami.
2. Ntabwo nahangara kugenda, Ntari kumwe nawe, Mukiza; Nagoswe n’ abanz’ igihumbi; Dor’ imitegw’ intaye hagati. Burije rwose, ntihabona, Nkomeze njyane nawe, Mwami.
3. Ninguma mu maboko yawe, Sinzaba ncyitaye ku by’ isi; Nta kindi nziratana rwose, Keretse wa musaraba wawe, Ngez’ ubwo nzager’ i Siyoni, Nkomeze njyane nawe, Mwami.

title: Icyampa Nkarangurura
verses: 1. Icyampa nkarangurura, Ngahimbaz’ Umwami wanjye, Ariko ni nde wabasha kuririmb’ ishimwe rya Yesu?
2. Ni we munezero wanjye, Ni na w’ umpesh’ amahoro. Mu makuba no mu byago, Yesu ni w’ umber’ ihumure.
3. Ni we byiringiro byanjye, Byo kuzahabw’ ubugingo. Mu mwijim’ amber’ umucyo, Yesu ni w’ umber’ ihumure.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Urukundo ruhebuje! Urukundo rwa Yesu! Urukundo ruhebuje! Urukundo rwa Yesu!

title: Mwami Nzi Kw’ Ari We Nkunda
verses: 1. Mwami, nzi kw’ ari We nkunda, Kurut’ iby’ iyi si; Kuko wampay’ amahoro, Atagir’ impinduka.
2. Nzi k’ uhor’ unzirikana, Undutira byose, Mwami, kugutekereza bindutir’ ibyiratwa.
3. Wanyujuj’ umunezero, Natay’ umuruho. Kumenya k’ unkunda cyane, Ni byo bimpumuriza.
4. Mucunguzi wanjye mwiza, Icyakunyereka! Ngo tuzabane mw’ ijuru, Ahatab’ agahinda.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Urukundo rwankijije (ngakira), Ntirurondoreka. Ntitwarusobanukirwa (na hato), Kuko ruhebuje (ruhebuje).

title: Ahw’ Azanyobora Hose
verses: 1. Ahw’ azanyobora hose, Ni ho nzishimira kujya; Kukw’ ari jye yapfiriye, Akanzir’ atacumuye.
2. Nishimira kw’ antegeka, Nishimira kw’ anyobora. Nishimira kumwumvira, Kukw’ ari jye yapfiriye.
3. Singishidikanya rwose, Kuko ndi kumwe na Yesu. Nizigiye ko vub’ aha, Nzamureba duhanganye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yes’ azanyobor’ iteka, Maz’ angez’ iw’ amahoro; Kukw’ ar’ inshuti y’ ukuri, Itigeze guhemuka.

title: Isi Ndayihararutse, Mpisemo Yesu
verses: 1. Isi ndayihararutse, Mpisemo Yesu gusa. Mpaz’ umunezero wayo, Uzashirana na yo.
2. Isi ndayihararutse, Mpisemo Yesu gusa. Mu kaga ni we humure; Nzahora nezerewe.
3. Isi ndayihararutse, Mpisemo Yesu gusa. Icyamp’ akamwenyurira, Nkamurikirwa na we.
4. Isi ndayihararutse, Mpisemo Yesu gusa. Nzirat’ umusaraba we, Yatangiyeho kera.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Imbabazi zidashira, N’ urukundo rw’ iteka, Ni byo bijya binyemeza, Ko nzaramishwa na we.

title: Mwami Wanjye, Nyakira
verses: 1. Mwami wanjye nyakira, Ndakwiyeguriy’ ubu; Ngay’ amaboko yanjye, Yakoresh’ uk’ ushaka.
2. Ngib’ ibirenge byanjye, Byerekez’ ah’ ushaka. Ngir’ ijwi ryanjye na ryo, Rijye riguhimbaza.
3. Nguhay’ akanwa kanjye; Mwami, kakuvugire. Ngub’ ubutunzi bwanjye, Sinzagir’ icyo nkwima.
4. Nguhay’ igihe cyanjye, Sinzakiguteraho; Nguhay’ ubwenge bwanjye, Bukoresh’ uk’ ushaka.
5. Ngiy’ imigambi yanjye; Igengwe nawe, Mwami. Nguy’ umutima wanjye, Ube uwawe rwose.
6. Mwam’ urukundo rwanjye, Ni wowe nzarukunda; Nkwihaye nimazeyo, None n’ iteka ryose.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nyuhagiz’ amaraso yawe ( nere rwose ); Maz’ anyezehw’ inenge yose ( nere rwose ); Ibyanjye byose ndabikweguriye, None n’ iteka ryose.

title: Nabony’ Inshut’ Ihebuje
verses: 1. Nabony’ inshut’ ihebuje! Yankunze ntarabaho; Yanyiyegereshej’ ineza, N’ urukundo rw’ iteka, Bituma dushyikirana, Ubudatandukana; Kuko nd’ uwe na we n’ uwanjye, Ibihe bidashira.
2. Nabony’ inshut’ ihebuje! Yamberey’ impongano. Urets’ ibyo kump’ ubugingo, Yaranyitangiriye. Ntacyo mfite nit’ icyanjye, Kuko tubisangiye. Ndamwiyeguriye burundu; Ibihe bidashira.
3. Nabony’ inshut’ ihebuje! Nyir’ ubutware bwose! Ni bw’ indindish’ uko bukeye; Izangeza mw’ ijuru. Ibyiza byanshyizw’ imbere, Binsubizamw’ intege; Reka nkore, noye kwiganda, Ngez’ ubw’ izanduhura.

4. Nabony’ inshut’ ihebuje! Y’ impuhwe n’ urukundo. Ni y’ indind’ ikanyunganira; Ni y’ indenger’ iteka. Mbese n’ iki cyadutanya, Ko dukundana rwose? N’ iby’ iyi si, cyangwa s’ urupfu? Oya nzab’ uw’ iteka.

title: Numvise Yesu Ambwira Ati
verses: 1. Numvise Yes’ ambwir’ ati: Ngwino nkuruhure. Zan’ ibikurushya byose, Mbikwikorerere. Musanga, mez’ uko nari ndi, Ndushye, mfite n’ ishavu; Amber’ uburuhukiro, Maz’ aranezeza.
2. Numvise Yes’ ambwir’ ati: Ndaguher’ ubuntu, Amaz’ azakubeshaho, Unyw’ uram’ iteka. Nuko nsanga Yesu maz’ ampa ya mazi y’ ubugingo, Nshir’ inyota, Ndahembuka; Nzahorana na we.
3. Numvise Yes’ ambwir’ ati: Ni jye Mucyo w’ isi. N’ undeb’ uramurikirwa, Ntuzarindagira. Maze muhanz’ amaso koko, Mbon’ ar’ izuba ryanjye; Rizamvir’ iminsi yose y’ ubugingo bwanjye.

title: Mwami Mb’ Uwawe Maramaje
verses: 1. Mwami, mb’ uwawe maramaje, Nyigisha, nyigisha. Nkor’ iby’ ukunda, Mwami wanjye; Komez’ umfashe.
2. Iby’ iyi si byamarir’ iki, Ntari kumwe nawe? Byose nzabihara kubwawe, Ntungishwe nawe.
3. Ndets’ umunezero w’ iyi si, Ngwino twibanire; Nibyo bizajya binogera, Bimpumurize.
