chorus: Gusubiramo: Mb’ uwawe ( Mwami ) ; Mb’ uwawe ( Mwami ) ; Ni yo migambi yanjye ; Mb’ uwawe ( Mwami ) ; Mb’ uwawe ( Mwami ) ; Mb’ uwawe Mwami, None.

title: Mbeg’ Umuns’ Urush’ Indi Kwera
verses: 1. Mbeg’ umuns’ urush’ indi kwera; Ni wo wa karindwi! Ng’ uratuma ndek’ iby’ isi, Nkibwir’ iby’ ijuru!
2. Mbeg’ uyu munsi wa karindwi, Turuhukiramo, Ng’ uradutera kuramya Data, Wo mw’ ijuru!
3. Ni mutyo turamy’ Uhoraho, Watuzirikanye, Agaherakw’ akaduha, Uyu munsi wera.
4. Ni w’ utugobotor’ ibyaha, Bikaducikaho, Kukw’ atugirir’ ubuntu, Buvuye mw’ ijuru.

title: Udusezeresh’ Umugisha Wawe
verses: 1. Udusezeresh’ umugisha wawe; Mwam’ utwuzuz’ amahoro; Urukundo rwawe rudusabemo, Tubone kunesha rwose. Ngwin’ uduhembure, Ngwin’ uduhembure; Tukiri mur’ iyi si y’ igomero.
2. Tuguhay’ ishimwe no kukuramya, Kubw’ ubutumwa bw’ imvaho, Bwagukomotseho bukadukiza, Bunyur’ imitima yacu; Tubushikamemo, Tubushikamemo; Tugundir’ ukuri, Tudacogora.
3. Mbeshwaho n’ imbabazi zawe nyinshi, None ndakwiyeguriye. Ngwin’ uduhumurish’ impuhwe zawe, Duhore turwan’ ishyaka; Tuzager’ i wawe, Tuzager’ iwawe; Tukubone nta kidukingirije.

title: Mukiza, Ndamaramaje
verses: 1. Mukiza, ndamaramaje, Ndatwaranira kugera, Ku rugero runkwiriye; Mwami mfasha ngo ndusheho.
2. Ntabwo ngifit’ umutima, Wo kuguma mu by’ iyi si; N’ubwo bamwe babikunda, Ngambiriye kujya mbere.
3. Ndashaka gusumb’ iby’ isi, N’ubw’ umwanz’ anyibasiye; Kuko namaze kwizera, Yukw’ Iman’ izandengera.
4. Ndashaka kumaranira, Kurabukw’ ubwiza bwawe; Ariko nkomeze nsenge, Ngez’ ubwo nzager’ iwawe.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nzamura maze nger’ aho wangeneye, Mwami  wanjye; Ku rugero rusumbyeho; Mwami  mfasha ngo ndusheho.

title: Ntushak’ Urwitwazo
verses: 1. Ntushak’ urwitwazo, Harihw’ imirimo, Ahubw’ itegure gukorer’ Imana. Yakwinginze kenshi, Kand’ ikurarika; Witinda kwemera, Bizakunezeza.
2. Ntushak’ urwitwazo urahamagawe; Dor’ aho wangiye, Noneho witabe. Imirim’ ireze, Hagumy’ abakozi; Ngwin’ umukorere; Uzagororerwa.
3. Ntushak’ urwitwazo, Kuko nib’ utinze, Bizagukoraho, Izakwivumbura. Imbabazi zayo, Ntabwo zirashira; Haguruka bwangu, Ubibabarirwe.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Itaba! ( none ); Ntushak’ urwitwazo; Itaba! ( none ); Wigingimiranya. Ntushak’ urwitwazo, Udasubizwa ngo: Hoshi wampinyuye; Nkuvukij’ ubwami.

title: Yesu Mwami W’Abami
verses: 1. Yesu Mwami w’ abami, Ngwin’ ube muri jye! He kub’ ari jy’ uvuga, Ujy’ umvugiramo. Unsabe mu mutima, Ngengwe nawe rwose, Maz’ abajya bandeba, Bajye bakubona.
2. Ndakwiyeguriy’ ubu, Ez’ ibyaha byanjye; Ngaragareh’ ubwiza bwawe buhebuje. Ngir’ umutim’ utuje, Ne guteraganwa; Niyoroshye nganduke, Ngo nkoreshwe nawe.
3. Ingingo zanjye zose, Zijye zikumvira; Uzikoreshereze, Zikubahirize. Ne kujya nivovota, Ngo mpore ku nkeke. Y’ ibimbaho nishama, Nta mahoro mfite.
4. Ni wowe ntegereje, Ungenz’ uk’ ushaka. Ubwanjye nditeguye, Simfit’ ikinziga. Yesu Mwami w’ abami, Ngwin’ ube muri jye! Maz’ ibyo nkora byose, Mbikoreshwe nawe.

title: Data Mwiza, Nyigiza Hafi
verses: 1. Data mwiza, nyigiza hafi; Nkube mu gituza; Ni wowe buhungiro bwanjye, N’ uburuhukiro.
2. Data mwiza, nyigiza hafi; Nkomeza ntundeke; Nakwishimira ko tubana, Ne kuraragira.
3. Data mwiza, nyigiza hafi; Ngez’ ubwo nsa nawe; Mpembur’ unyuhagir’ unyeze, Mb’ umuziranenge.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A: Data, nyigiza hafi, Ndifuza ko tubana; Data, ndifuza ko tubana. T. na B: Data, Data, nyigiza hafi, Ndifuza cyane ko tubana; Data, nyigiza hafi; ndifuza ko tubana, Ndifuza ko tubana.

title: Aho Njyanye Na Yesu
verses: 1. Aho njyanye na Yesu mb’ amahoro, Ahw’ anyobora hose mur’ iyi si. Aho njya tutajyanye nta kinyura, Iyo njyanye na Yesu ntacyo ntinya.
2. Aho njyanye na Yesu sinigunga, Nubw’ izindi nshuti zampemukira; Nubw’ anyobora mu nzir’ iruhije, Aho njyanye na Yesu ndanezerwa.
3. Njyanye na Yesu sinatiny’ urupfu, N’ iyo ngoswe n’ umwijima w’ icyago, Nzi ko nzakanguk’ ubutazongera, Kujarajarira mur’ iy’ isi mbi.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Aho njyanye na we, nta kintinyisha, Aho njyanye na Yesu mb’ amahoro.

title: Nshuti Jy’ Ugendera Mu Mucyo
verses: 1. Nshuti jy’ ugendera mu mucyo, Woye kurindagira; Umwuka  Wera wo mw’ ijuru, Ajy’ akuyobora.
2. Gendera mu mucyo w’ ukuri, Ko mw’ Ijambo ry’ Imana; Uzajy’ ukuyobor’ iteka, Ukwizez’ Imana.
3. Jy’ ugendera mu mucy’ iteka, Ujy’ ukumurikira; Maz’ utamurur’ umwijima, Hose hatangaze.
4. Gendera mu mucyo ng’ umenye, Urukundo rw’ Imana, N’ uburyo yakunze ab’ isi, Ikabarokora.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A: Gendera mu mucyo, Gendera mu mucyo; Gendera mu mucyo, Mu mucyo waka w’ Imana. T. na B.: Gendera mu mucy’ utangaje w‘ Imana; Gendera mu mucy’ utangaje w‘ Imana; Gendera mu mucy’ utangaje w‘ Imana; Mu mucyo waka w‘ Imana;

title: Mbes’ Abasaruzi Bari He?
verses: 1. Mbes’ abasaruzi bari hehe, Bo gusarur’ abakiranutsi? Bakomeye ku kuri kw’ Imana; Kandi ntibab’ ar’ abanyabute.
2. Mushakire mu mihana yose; N’ubw’ urwiri rwarenga ku ngano; Muzishake kuko zirurimo, Zose muzisarurir’ Imana.
3. Dor’ imirima yereye rimwe, Kandi bose bitez’ isarura; Arikw’ abasaruzi ni bake, Umurimo wab’ urabasaze.
4. Mwitwaj’ intwaro z’ Umwuka Wera; Musarur’ igihe kirageze! Mushishikare Umwam’ araje; Dor’ abazaniy’ ingororano!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Abasaruzi se bari he? Ngo bafatanye natwe gusarura, Maze twishime, Turi kumwe, Isarura nirirangira.

title: Ngamij’ Iby’ Igihugu Cy’ Igikundiro
verses: 1. Ngamij’ iby’ igihugu cy’ igikundiro; Nzageray’ izuba rirenze. Ariko s’ ikamba Yes’ azamperayo, Azaritakahw’ inyenyeri?
2. Reka nkore, nsenge, mbiheshejwe nawe, Mugarurir’ abazimiye. Nagaruka kuri wa munsi w’ ubwiza, Nzatakwehw’ inyenyeri nyinshi.
3. Mbeg’ umunezer’ uhebuje nzagira, Nimwerek’ abo nakijije, Mfite n’ ibyishimo bitavugwa, Mbonye inyenyeri kw’ ikamba ryanjye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mbes’ ikamba ryanjye Yes’ azamperayo, Azaritakahw’ inyenyeri (inyenyeri)? Ningir’ amahirwe, Nkabana na Yesu, Azaritakahw’ inyenyeri (inyenyeri)?

title: Ngwino Yesu
verses: 1. Ngwino Yes’ uvugane, N’ umutima wanjye: Maz’ umpumuriz’ uti: Ntabwo nagusize. Nyugurur’ umutima, Nihutire kumva, Ijwi ryawe ry’ impuhwe, Nyuzuz’ ibyishimo.
2. Yobora abana bawe, Uvugane na bo; Ubuzuz’ ibyishimo, Bige kugusenga. Mwami, Bitange rwose, Bakwiyegurire; Tebuts’ ubwami bwawe, Twibanire nawe.
3. Ngwin’ uvugane natwe, Uduhishurire, Iby’ imigambi yawe, N’ inshingano yacu, Duhe kuguhimbaza, Tukubahirize, Tujye tunezererwa gukor’ iby’ ushaka.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mbwiz’ ijwi ryongorera, Mbwiran’ urukundo; Ut’ uzanesh’ iteka, Ub’ umudendezo. Vugana nanjy’ iteka, Mbwir’ ubudahwema, Reka numv’ uk’ umbwira ngo: Sinaguhanye.

title: Mwami, Sinsabir’ Iby’ Ejo
verses: 1. Mwami, sinsabir’ iby’ ejo, Mfasha none, Ndind’ urukongi rw’ ibyaha, Uyu munsi. Ne gucumuz’ ururimi, Mputiyeho; Mwami, rind’ iminwa yanjye, Uyu munsi.
2. Njye nshunguz’ ubury’ umwete, No gusenga; Ngwe neza mu buryo bwose, Uyu munsi. Nkomeze nkor’ iby’ ushaka, Ngire bwangu; Mwami, nemere kwitanga, Uyu munsi.
3. Urupfu niruntungura, Mbe ntunganye; Amasezerano yawe, Ndayiteze; Mwami, sinsabir’ iby’ ejo, Mfasha none; Ndind’ unkomez’ undagire, Uyu munsi; Amen.

title: Murinzi We, Ngaho Mbwira
verses: 1. Murinzi we, ngaho mbwira, Mbese bugiye gucya? Nta bimenyets’ urabona, K’ Umwami yegereje? Mugenzi we haguruka! Umusek’ uratambitse; Tyo kenyera, maz’ ukeshe, Haguruka; bwakeye!
2. Murinzi we, dor’ umucyo, Ukomeje gukwira! Reba naw’ ibimenyetso, Bitangaza kuza kwe. Ubw’ impanda zizavuga, Abapfuye bazazuka. Ubutazongera gupfa, Bibanire n’ Umwami.
3. Murinzi we, vuz’ impundu, Igihe kirageze! Mwese nimurangurure, Mubyamamaze hose. Mugenzi we, nawe reba; Ubwami bugeze hafi; Ngiriya Yerusalemu, Irarabagirana.
4. Murinzi, mur’ uwo murwa, W ’ igikundiro rwose, Nih’ Umwami w’ i Siyoni, Adutegerereje. Ubwami  bwe buragutse, Buhetuy’ iyi si yose; N’ ubwami budahanguka; Hahirw’ ababujyamo.
5. Murinzi dor’ igihugu, Cy’ uburumbuke cyane, Gihora kimeze neza, Nka Edeni ya kera. Gira bwangu ntuzarire, Hasigay’ igihe gito, Abacungujw’ amaraso bakagerayo vuba.

title: Aho Nzahamagarwa Hose
verses: 1. Aho nzahamagarwa hose, Ari no mu misozi, Cyangwa ku rugamba rukaze, Mubyeyi, nunkenera, Ukambwiz’ ijwi ryawe ritoya, Ukanyuz’ inzira ntazi, Nzakwishyira mu maboko, mvuge nti: Nzajy’ ah’ unshakira hose.
2. Ahari Yes’ ashaka yuko muvugir’ uyu munsi; Ahari habonek’ impabe, Nkwiriye guhabura; Murokozi wanjye, nunyobora, N’ ahar’ ibihanamanga; Sinzareka kogez’ inkuru yawe; Nzajy’ ah’ unshakira hose.

3. Ntabwo nshidikanya, Har’ aho Mwam’ ushaka ko nkora, Mu kubaho kwanjye kugufi, Nkorer’ Uwambambiwe. Mwami, nkubikij’ ibyanjye byose, Nzi k’ unkunda bitangaje. Nzakor’ iby’ ushaka, mbikunze cyane; Nzajy’ ah’ unshakira hose.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nzajy’ ah’ unshakira hose, Mwami; Mu  misozi no mu bibaya. Nzavug’ iby’ ushaka ko mvuga Mwami, Kandi nzaba nk’ uk’ ushaka.

title: Amagambo Y’ Umujinya
verses: 1. Amagambo y’ umujinya, Ntakabave mu kanwa! Ahubw’ umutim’ uyacuby’ atararushy’ asohoka.
2. Urukundo n’ imbonera, N’ ubucuti, birera; Byab’ ishyano kubyicisha, Ubupfu bw’ akanya gato.
3. Amagambo y’ intonganya, Ntaregama mu kanwa, Ijambo rimwe ry’ intonganya, Ritandukany’ inshuti.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Mukundane rwose; Yes’ aravug’ ati: Ngir’ itegeko ryanjye mbahaye: Mukundane rwose, Yes’ aravug’ ati: Bana banjye, mukundane. T. na B.: Mukundane, Mukundane; Ngir’ itegeko ryanjye : Mukundane, Mukundane; n’ itegeko rye.

title: N’ Igihe Cy’ Isarura
verses: 1. Nib’ umunt’ agend’ arira, Asohoy’ imbuto nziza, Ntacogora ngw’ agw’ isari, Ahirwa n’ Uwiteka.
2. Ikime kiva mw’ ijuru, N’ umucy’ urabagirana. Bizatum’ imbuto zera, Kubw’ ubuntu bw’ Imana.
3. Bib’ imbuto wicogora, Woye gukuk’ umutima, N’ ubw’ iby’ ubon’ ar’ umwaku, Uzasarur’ ishimwe.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yemwe ga ngo zirakura! Reba uko zingana! Imirima yos’ ireze, N’ igihe cy’ isarura.

title: Isarura Ry’ Isi Riregereje
verses: 1. Isarura ry’ isi riregereje, Yes’ arahamagar’ abasaruzi. Dor’ imirim’ irez’ ahantu hose, Nimuzan’ imihoro musarure!
2. Uwo muns’ utazabamw’ amarira, Uhora wegerej’ uko bukeye. Imyaka yararitswe n’ umuyaga, Nimugire bwangw’ imvur’ itaragwa.
3. Urukundo ni nk’ isokw’ idakama, Ituruka mw’ ijuru ku Muremyi; Ni rwo ruturarikira gukora, Rukadukomeza ntitugw’ isari.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. : Mugire bwangu, muhunik’ imiba; Mugire bwangu, nimuze. A. T. B.: Mugire bwangu mwese, Nimuze; Muhunik’ imiba ye, Nimuze. Mugire bwangu mwese; Nimuze mwese nimuze.

title: Nyabun’ Uburyo Ngukennye!
verses: 1. Nyabun’ uburyo ngukennye! Nd’ umukene n’ impumyi; Mfat’ ukubok’ unyobore, Ni wow’ ump’ imbaraga.
2. Nyambik’ urukundo rwawe, Nahindanye nd’ intebyi. Ubu mfit’ intege nkeya, Nyongeramw’ imbaraga.
3. Nzab’ amahor’ unyoboye, Sinakwiyiringira. Yes’ ujy’ ungend’ iruhande, Kuk’ undutira byose.
4. Nubw’ ibind’ imbere byose, Byankoma mu nkokora, Nzakomeza komatana nawe, Mwana w’ Imana.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ku manywa na nijoro; Mwami ndagushak’ iteka; Ku manywa na nijoro; Mwam’ unyikomereze.

title: Icyampa Nkab’ Uwawe
verses: 1. Icyampa nkab’ uwawe, Yesu Mwami wanjye; Ne kononwa n’ iby’ isi, Nkwikurikirire.
2. Icyampa nkab’ uwawe, Yesu Mwami wanjye. Unkoresh’ uk’ ushaka, Njye nkubahiriza.
3. Icyampa nkab’ uwawe, Yesu Mwami wanjye; Ntandukanya n’ iby’ isi, Umboneze rwose.
4. Icyampa nkab’ uwawe, Yesu Mwami wanjye; Mb’ uwaw’ uko ndi kose, Nta kintu kinziga.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Icyampa nkab’ uwawe, Nitanze maramaje. Jye ntacyo maze, Ntacyo, Ntacyo; Ni we mpay’ ikuzo.

title: Mfit’ Inshuti Y’ Ukuri
verses: 1. Mfit’ inshuti y’ ukuri y’ inkoramutima, Irankunda bihebuje, Nzi kw’ itazampāna. Ntabwo nayiv’ iruhande, Nkunda ko tubana, Iyo nshuti ni Yesu, Umukiza.
2. Iyo nguy’ agacuho, Ameny’ uko meze; Ntanyirengagiza rwose: Aransindagiza, Akanyobora mu nzira, Yo gukiranuka; N’ inshuti nkunda cyane, Yes’ Umwami.
3. Mutur’ umubabaro, Mubwir’ ibyishimo; Mubwir’ ibinyura na byo, N’ ibindushya byose. Angaragariz’ uburyo, Nkwiriye kwifata; Nkunda kwiganirira, Na w’ iteka.
4. Az’ imigambi yanjye, Yo gukiz’ abandi; Niko kunshing’ umurimo, Wo kumuvugira, No kwamamaz’ urukundo, Rwatumy’ adupfira; Yewe, mukunda rwose, Bihebuje!

title: Umukiz’ Aranyobora
verses: 1. Umukiz’ aranyobora, Birampagije rwose. Sinshidikany’ impuhwe ze, Kuko njya nzibonaho. Amahoro yo mw’ ijuru, Yanyuzuy’ umutima; Sinzatinya na hatoya, Kuko Yes’ anyobora; Sinzatinya na hatoya, Kuko Yes’ anyobora.

2. Umukiz’ aranyobora, Akanampumuriza; Iyo ngeze mu makuba, Ntamvirira na hato; Bona nubwo nateguza, Yandamir’ akamfasha; Ahor’ anyitahw’ iteka, Ntacyo nzamuburana; Ahor’ anyitahw ‘ iteka, Ntacyo nzamuburana.

3. Umukiz’ aranyobora, Niryo humure ryanjye! Niw’ uzampaz’ uburame, Njye mpora musingiza. Nta cyatuma ntiny’ urupfu, Mfit’ iryo sezerano; Nzajya ndirimb’ iteka, Nti: Yesu niw’ unyobora; Nzajya ndirimb’ iteka, Nti: Yesu niw’ unyobora.

title: Yes’ Arahamagar’ Ati:
verses: 1. Yes’ arahamagar’ ati: Nind’ unkorera none? Isarura rirageze, Nind’ uri busarure? Umv’ ukw’ aduhamagara; Kand’ azagororera. Umusubiza wes’ ati: Ndi hano Mwami ntuma.
2. Nutabasha kujya kure, Ngo wambuke n’ inyanja; N’ ino har’ abapagani, Wagarurira Yesu. Nutabasha gushyanuka, Ngo wigishe nka Paulo, Wakogez’ iby’ urukundo rw’ Umukiza wabambwe.
3. Wabura kub’ umurinzi, Ku nkike z’i Siyoni, Wafashish’ amasengesho, No gutur’ amaturo; Ukayobora n’ abandi, Mu nzir’ ijya mw’ ijuru, Nk’ ukw’ Aroni yakomeje amaboko ya Mose.
4. Abantu bari mu kaga; Yes’ aragutabaza. Ntukagir’ ubw’ uvug’ uti: Ntacyo nakora rwose. Ishimire gukoreshwa, Hitam’ umurimo we; Maz’ usubize bwang’ uti: Ndi hano, Mwami ntuma.

title: Nicay’ Imbere Ya Yesu
verses: 1. Nicay’ imbere ya Yesu, Mpaboner’ ihumure; N’ ahantu h’ igikundiro; Icyampa nkahibera. Iyo nicay’ imbere ye, Nimenyah’ ubugoryi; Kumuhang’ amaso nibyo, Bimpa gukiranuka.
2. Kwicar’ imbere ya Yesu, Nta mahirw’ arut’ ayo; Ni ho nsig’ ibimbabaza, Nkumva nduhutse rwose. Iyo nicay’ imbere ye, Nkunda kumuganyira; Na w’ ababarana nanjye, Maz’ akampumuriza.
3. Yesu mp’ umugisha wawe; Dore, Ndategereje; Ndeban’ imbabazi zawe, Menye k’ unyitayeho. Mp’ umutima wawe, Yesu; Nyeza nkubonerere; Bigaragarir’ abandi, Yuko mporana nawe.

title: Ndagukunda, Mwami
verses: 1. Ndagukunda, Mwami; Uzi ko ngukunda; Ndagukunda Yesu, Bihebuje rwose. Ndagukunda Yesu, Naw’ urabizi; Imirimo yanjy’ izabyerekana.
2. Nishimye, nishimye; Rwose bitavugwa. Ibyishimo byanjye, Nta wabirondora. Ndareb’ ubutunzi buri mw’ ijuru, Nzagabirwa nawe kubw’ ubuntu bwawe.
3. Yesu Mwami wanjye, Ni we nkesha byose; Ar’ ugucungurwa, Ari n’ ubugingo. Nzakogez’ iteka, Nkuririmbire, Kuk’ Ubuntu bwawe bwandemy’ umutima.
4. Naguhwanya nande, Mucunguzi wanjye? Uhoran’ ineza, Ntugir’ impinduka. Nzajya nguhimbaza, Nkubahirize; Umutima wanjye, Wuzuy’ ibyishimo.

title: Ayi Rutare Rw’ Imana
verses: 1. Ayi Rutare rw’ Imana, Reka nguhungireho! Kubw’ imbabazi zawe, Kera waramenewe, Non’ ubu nkwihishemo, Umujinya w’ Imana.
2. Ibyo twakora byose, N’ umwete wacu wose, N’ agahinda gasāze, N’ amarir’ adashira, Byose ntibyashobora, Kudukurahw’ ibyaha.
3. Yes’ ibyo mfite byose, Nta mumaro bigira. Sinabasha kwikiza, Ndagushakah’ ubuntu, Unyuhagir’ imbyiro, Mutabazi ne gupfa.
4. Nuko nkiri muzima, Mwami nguhungireho. No ku munsi w’ imanza, Ninger’ imbere yawe, Ayi Rutare rw’ Imana, Uzandeke nkwisunge!

title: Mwa Bera B’ Umwami
verses: 1. Mwa bera b’ Umwami, Mwishimir’ Ijambo rye; Ni ryo rufatiro rwo kwizera kwanyu. Dore yababwiye byose, Ntacyo yabahishe. Ntitwabasha kongera kur’ iryo jambo ryiza, Cyangwa kuritubya, Kukw’ ar’ iry’ Imana.
2. Nugera mu kaga, Yesu yasezeranye, Kw’ azakugoboka, Akakurengera; Amakuba yawe yos’ akuber’ umugisha; Ni y’ azakweza rwose, Maz’ atum’ ushikama; Ni y’ azakweza rwose, Agukomeze.
3. Ibigeragezo nibikugwa gitumo, Ubuntu bwanjye buzaba buhagije. Ibirimi by’ umuriro, Ntibigutinyishe; Bizakongor’ ibyaha, Usigar’ utunganye; Bizakongor’ ibyaha, Bikuboneze.
4. Unamba ku Mana, Ntizamuhemukira; Ntizamuharir’ umubisha na hato. N’ubw’ ingabo zose z’ umwanzi zamusatira, Ntizamuhemukira, Ntizamuhemukira, Ntizamuhemukira, Haba na gato.

title: Uwiteka Ni We Mwungeri Wanjye
verses: 1. Uwiteka ni we Mwungeri wanjye, Sinzakena; Andyamisha mu cyanya cy’ ubwatsi butoshye cyane; Anyobor’ iruhande rw’ amaz’ adasuma; Uwitek’ asubiz’ intege mu bugingo bwanjye.
2. Nanyura no mu gikombe cy’ igicucu cy’ urupfu, Sinatiny’ ikibi cyose, kuko ndi kumwe nawe; Inshyimbo yawe n’ inkoni, bimp’ ihumure; Nta kaga kazantungura, ndi kumwe nawe, Mwami.
3. Untunganiriz’ ameza mu gihe cy’ amakuba. Unshagijehw’ imbabazi, zimeze nk’ amavuta; Wanyujurij’ igikombe, cyuzur’ ubuntu. Mwami, ntacyo wisigiye, ng’ ubon’ uk’ ukingomwa.
4. Mana y’ ubuntu, n’ ukuri, Ineza wangiriye, N’ imbabazi bizanyomahw’ iminsi yanjye yose; Nzakomeza nkuyoboke, Sinzateshuka; Kandi nzaba mu nzu y’ Uwiteka iteka ryose.

title: Wa Muragwa We
verses: 1. Wa muragwa we, mbese k’ uhunikira? K’ ucogoy’ ugiye kugerayo? Kanguka bwangu, Shak’ intwaro zawe; Wizarira, dore byatinze rwose!
2. Amahanga yose yasubiranyemo; Bose baradagadwa bihebye. Umv’ ukw’ amagar’ ahindira hose; Wa muragwa we, Wigumya gutinda!
3. Ntugwabizwe n’ iby’ iyi si biguhenda; Reb’ ubwiza bwabyo burashira. C’ ingoy’ Umwanzi yakubohesheje; Wa muragwa we, Zicikeho bwangu!
4. Nyamuneka, ntugir’ imitim’ ibiri; Ba mas’ Umwam’ atagutungura; Dor’ umucy’ utangiye gutangaza; Muragwa we, vuz’ impundu, wishime!

title: Mwami Mana Yanjye
verses: 1. Mwami Mana  yanjye, Ni wow’ umbeshaho; Ubuntu bwawe n’ isoko nkesh’ ibyiza byose. Ubuntu bwawe n’ isoko nkesh’ amahirwe yose.
2. Ni wowe wandemye, Nta wakundutira; Ineza yawe ni nyinshi, Ntacyo nayinganya; Ineza yawe ni nyinshi ntacyo nayigeraho.
3. Mwami, Natur’ iki, Ko byos’ ar’ ibyawe? Kerets’ umutim’ ushima, Wo kuguhimbaza; Kerets’ umutim’ ushima, Wo kukuramya, Mwami.
4. Umpe gushikama, Kubw’ ubuntu bwawe; Nkweguriy’ ibyanjye byose, Mbay’ uwawe rwose; Nkweguriy’ ibyanjye byose, Mb’ uwaw’ akaramata.

title: Murinzi We W’ i Siyoni
verses: 1. Murinzi we, w’ i Siyoni, Ijoro rigeze he? Mbes’ umusek’ uri hafi? Ntiburatandukana? Ntacy’ ushishoz’ iburasira-zuba? Ntacy’ ushishoz’ iburasira-zuba?
2. Nyamuneka tumenyeshe, K’ urugendo rushize; Mbese tugeze ku cyambu, Tugiye kugerayo? Mbese koko, Ubwami buri hafi? Mbese koko, Ubwami buri hafi?
3. Burakey’ umuns’ uraje! Tubyamamaze hose; Dor’ izuba rirarashe, Mwese nimurirebe! Mwa bera mwe, Mugiye gucungurwa! Mwa bera mwe, Mugiye gucungurwa!
4. Tugeze ku rugabano, Rw’ igihugu tujyamo, Nimukabuze twihute, Icyambu kiri hafi. Nimurangurure ya majwi yanyu! Nimurangurure ya majwi yanyu!

title: Ngabo, Muhaguruke
verses: 1. Ngabo, muhaguruke! Murwanire Yesu; Murind’ ingabe yanyu, Mutazayinyagwa. Mu nzira yo kunesha, Tuyoborwa na Yesu, Tujyane na w’ iteka, Ni ho tuzanesha.
2. Impanda ziravuze, Muze mwebwe mwese. Ikamba ry’ ubugingo, N’ ibihembo byanyu. Nimwangwa n’ ababisha, Mukomere, murwane; Mwonger’ umwete mwinshi, Muganze Satani.
3. Mubyuke mutabare, Mudashidikanya. He kugir’ umw’ usiba, Murebe kwa Yesu. Kandi mujye mutwara, Intwaro zo kwizera. Muhabwe ukunesha, N’ ibyishimo byinshi.
4. Mubyuke vuba vuba, Murwane iteka, Mwizer’ izina ryera, Ni ho muzanesha; Maz’ izo ntwaro zose, Muzih’ Umwami Yesu, Muzabon’ amahoro y’ iteka mw’ ijuru.

title: Icyampa Nkizera Rwose
verses: 1. Icyampa nkizera rwose, Ubutadohoka; (Sintinyishwe) Sintinyishwe n’ ubukene, Cyangw’ ibyago byose, Cyangw’ ibyago byose.
2. Sinivovote, mbabajwe, N’ igihano cyawe; (Ahubwo ni…) Ahubwo nimba mu kaga, Nkunambeho Mwami, Nkunambeho Mwami.
3. Mpabwe gushikama cyane, Umugaru nugwa; (Ne guhindi…) Ne guhindishw’ umushitsi, N’ ibyago bitera, N’ ibyago bitera.
4. Ne gukangishwa n’ ab’ isi, N’ igitsure cyabo; (N’ ubwo bangi…) N’ ubwo bangir’ urw’ amenyo, Noye kubyitaho, Noye kubyitaho.
5. Mwami, ben’ uko kwizera, Ni ko ngutezeho; (Niringiye) Niringiye ko nzahabwa, kwibera mw‘ ijuru, kwibera mw‘ ijuru.

title: Hahirw’ Ufit’ Ibyiringiro
verses: 1. Hahirw’ ufit’ ibyiringiro bishyitse, Akiri mu miruho y’ iyi si. Bimukomez’ agatsind’ ibishuko by’ Umwanzi. Bimukomez’ agatsind’ ibishuko n’ amakuba menshi.
2. Nibyo bitwibuts’ iby’ uburuhukiro, Ahw’ abakiranutsi bazaba; Bakibanira n’ inshut’ ubudatandukana. Bakibanira n’ inshut’ iteka ntibazatandukane.
3. N’ igihugu kitazarangwamw’ icyaha. Ahw’ ibishuko bitazagera; Ni nahw’ ibyishimo bitazagir’ impinduka. Nihw’ ibyishimo bitazongera kugira kirogoya.
4. Nta n’ umw’ uzahabogorez’ amarira; Ntabw’ urupfu ruzahahangara; Abaturage baho baziberahw’ iteka. Abaturage baho bazamera nk’ abamarayika.
5. Icyaduh’ igihe kikihuta bwangu! Tukabon’ Umukiza wac’ aje! Akatujyana muri cya gihugu cy’ ibyiza. Akatugez’ aho tuzibanira n’ Umukiza wacu.

title: Nyagasani, Turakwiragije
verses: 1. Nyagasani, Turakwiragije, Turagukennye cyane; Turagire mu bwatsi butoshye, Turakwiyeguriye; Nyagasani, Nyagasani, Ni we waducunguye; Nyagasani, Nyagasani, Ni we waducunguye.
2. Ubu tur’ abawe rwose Mwami, Tureban’ imbabazi; Turinde tur’ umukumbi wawe, Twe guteshuk’ inzira; Nyagasani, Nyagasani, Nyamuneka twumvire; Nyagasani, Nyagasani, Nyamuneka twunvire.
3. Wasezeranye k’ uzatwakira, N’ubwo tur’ abangizi; Udufitiy’ imbabazi nyinshi, N’ ubuntu buhebuje; Nyagasani, Nyagasani, Turakugarukira; Nyagasani, Nyagasani, Turakugarukira.

title: Ibyiringiro Dufite
verses: 1. Ibyiringiro dufite bigir’ agaciro cyane; Kurut’ iby’ iyi si by’ imburamumaro, Bijya bishimisha benshi.
2. Twabony’ umucy’ utangaje, Utamurur’ umwijima, Wazanywe n’ uk’ urupfu rwiganzuy’ isi, None twaretse kwiheba.
3. Twumvis’ ijwi ry’ ihumure, Rinyur’ imitima yacu; Ridutinyura rwose, rikatwizeza, Yukw’ Iman’ ar’ urukundo.
4. Iryo jwi n’ irya Rurema, Uwo mucyo n’ Ijambo rye; Ibyo byiringiro n’ ukuragw’ ijuru, Ntitwongere gupf’ ukundi.

title: Mu Gihugu Cy’ Ibyiza
verses: 1. Mu gihugu cy’ ibyiza, Har’ umurwa wera; Uzahorahw’ iteka: Nta joro rihaba.
2. Inkike z’ uwo murwa, Zose n’ izahabu; N’ inzira na zo n’uko; Nta joro rihaba.
3. Kand’ amarembo yawo, Ntabwo yugarirwa; Uruzi rw’ ubugingo, Ruzawutembamo.
4. Ntuzagomba kuvirwa, N’ izuba n’ ukwezi; Kand’ Umwana w’ Intama, Ni we mucyo wawo.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S.: Nta marir’ azabayo, Nta rupfu cyangw’ ubwoba; Ibihe ntibibarwayo, Kuko ntabwo bwira. A., T. na B : Nta marir’ azabayo, Nta rupfu cyangw’ ubwoba; Ibihe ibihe ntibibarwayo, Kuko ntabwo bwira.

title: Ahar’ Azaza Umusek’ Utambitse
verses: 1. Ahar’ azaza, umusek’ utambitse, Igih’ umucy’ utamurur’ umwijima; Azany’ icyubahiro kitarondorwa, Aje kurokor’ intore ze.
2. Ahar’ azaza, nko ku manywa y’ ihangu; Cyangwa s’ azaza mu gicuku hagati; Umucy’ usab’ impande zose z’ iyi si, Aje kurokor’ intore ze.
3. Mbeg’ ibyishimo, Nasanga tukiriho! Tutarwaye, Tutaririwe twapfuye; Maz’ akadutumbagirana mu bicu, Aje kurokor’ intore ze.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Tuzageza ryari, Mwami tugutegereje? Urakaza, Haleluya, Haleluy’ amina! Haleluy’ amina!

title: Mbes’ Uzaba Witeguye?
verses: 1. Mbes’ uzaba witeguye, Yes’ aje, Yes’ aje? Mbes’ uzaba witeguye, Yes’ aje, Yes’ aje? Dore araje! Dore araje! Itegure, dor’ Umukw’ araje!
2. Muringaniz’ amatara, Araje, Araje! Muringaniz’ amatara, Araje, Araje! Dore araje! Dore araje! Itegure, Dor’ Umukw’ araje!
3. Mutyo, tumusanganire, Araje, Araje! Mutyo, tumusanganire, Araje, Araje! Araje koko! Araje koko! Itegure, Dor’ Umukw’ araje!
4. Turirimbe: Haleluya; Araje, Araje! Turirimbe: Haleluya; Araje, Araje! Araje koko! Araje koko! Turirimbe: Haleluy’ araje!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Dore Umukwe araje, Araje! Dore Umukwe araje, Araje! Dore araje! Dore araje! Itegure, Dor’ Umukw’ araje!

title: Ntituz’ Umunsi
verses: 1. Ntituz’ umunsi Yesu azagaruka, Arikw’ igihe, cyo kiri hafi cyane, Ibimenyetso byagaragaye byose, N’ umunsi tutazi.
2. Abitondera, igitabo cy’ Imana, Ukuri kwayo, nimwo bakubonera, Ibyahanuwe bitangaza kuza kwe, N’ umunsi tutazi.
3. Imuri zacu ntizigahweme kwaka, Tujye dukora, dutegerej’ Umwami, Tumuhimbaze, twe kujya turambirwa, N’ umunsi tutazi.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Azaza (azaza), duhore twiteguye. Azaza (azaza), Haleluya! Haleluya! Azaza ku bicu, Afit’ ubwiza bwa Se, N’ umunsi tutazi.

title: Ntituz’ Igihe Azazira
verses: 1. Ntituz’ igihe azazira, Ku manywa cyangwa nijoro; Ahar’ azaza bugorobye, Cyangw’ umusek’ utambitse. Aratwihanangiririza kuba mas’ iteka ryose; Kugira ng’ ubw’ azatunguka, Azasange twiteguye.
2. Ndibuk’ uburyo yadukunze, Akaduharira byose; Yasiz’ ubwiza bwe mw’ ijuru, Yitangira kudupfira. Azanezerwa nagaruka, Kujyan’ abo yacunguye, Nib’ azasanga bari maso, Bamaze kumwitegura.

3. Ayi Yesu Mwana w’ Imana, Dor’ uz’ ibyo ndangamiye; Nizigiye ko nzakubona, Nkurebesh’ amaso yanjye; N’ ubwo bamwe bazaguhunga, Babony’ igitsure cyawe, Jye, nzakuramutsa nk’ inshuti; N’ ubu ndagutegereje.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. : Tumwitegure, Tumwitegure, Tumwitegure; Dore, Turamwiteguye. A,. T. na B.: Tumwitegure, tumwitegure, Tumwitegure, tumwitegure, Tumwitegure, tumwitegure, Dore, Turamwiteguye.

title: Umunsi W’ Ihumur’ Uregereje
verses: 1. Umunsi w’ ihumur’ uregereje; Yes’ azazaho. Ni bw’ azajyan’ abana be bizeye, Bigir’ iwabo.
2. Ubutumwa bwiza nibuhetura iyi si yacu, Umwam’ azashok’ aza bidatinze, Atujyan’ iwe.
3. Naz’ ashagawe n’ abamarayika batabarika, Azatsembahw’ ibihumanya byose; Ntabw’ azasobwa.
4. Abazaba baratandukanijwe, Bazabonana; Be kongera kubogoz’ amarira, Bagubwe neza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Umusek’ utangiye gutambika, Weyuyeh’ umwijima! Umusek’ utangiye gutambika, Bugiye gucya!

title: Yesu Yadusezeraniy’ Ati:
verses: 1. Yesu yadusezeraniy’ ati: Dore ndaza vuba kujyan’ abanjye; Komez’ icy’ ufit’ utakinyagwa; Komeza wizere, we kurambirwa.
2. Tuzajye tuba maso dusenga, Kukw’ azaza nk’ umujura w’ ijoro; Ntituz’ umunsi, cyangwa s’ igihe; Icyo tuzi n’ uko ari bugufi.
3. Dufit’ ijambo ritwiringiza y’uko, Tuzaragw’ ubwami bw’ Imana; N’ isezerano ridakuka ngo: Dore ndaza vuba, we kurambirwa.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Komez’ icy’ ufit’ utakinyagwa; So yiteguye kuguh’ ubwami. Ngwino, Winjire mu munezero; Urahabw’ ikamba ritangirika.

title: Mwese, Nimuvuz’ Impundu
verses: 1. Mwese, nimuvuz’ impundu! Dor’ Umwam’ araje! Mwitegure mwiboneze, Musangwe mwinonosoye. Isi yos’ iririmbe ( isi yos’ iririmbe)! Isi yose niririmbe ( yose niririmbe)! Nawe juru, wishim’ uririmbe cyane!

2. Mwese, nimuvuz’ impundu! Dor’ Umwam’ araje! Azim’ ingom’ ihoraho, Ntabw’ izahanguka rwose. Muvuz’ ijwi ry’ impundu ( vuz’ ijwi ry’ impundu), Nimuvuz‘ ijwi ry‘ impundu ( vuz’ ijwi ry’ impundu), Nimwishime mwese muririmbe cyane.

3. Azanatsembahw’ icyaha, Is’ igubwe neza; Imibabar’ izashira, Habehw’ amahoro masa, Nta mivum’ izabayo ( Nta mivum’ izabayo), Ntabwo hazab’ imivumo ( Ntabwo hazab’ imivumo), Ntayo rwose, Nta mivum‘ izarangwayo.

4. Azategekesh’ ubuntu no gukiranuka; Ngw’ ab’ isi bose bamenye, K’ Uwitek’ agira neza, Urukundo rwe rwinshi ( urukundo rwe rwinshi), Urukundo rutangaje ( urukundo rutangaje ), Urukundo rwe rwinshi rurahebuje.

title: Mbese Ko Tujya Tuvuga
verses: 1. Mbese, Ko tujya tuvuga, Iby’ igihugu cy’ ihirwe; Tukogez’ ubwiza bwaho; Kubayo bizacur’ iki? Ko tuvug’ inzira zaho, Zasizw’ izahabu nziza; Ar’ ukugenekereza; Tugezeyo, hacur’ iki?
2. Ko tuvug’ uko hameze, Kw‘ ari nta byaha n’ urupfu, Cyangw’ ibishuko bibayo, Tugezeyo hacur’ iki? Ko tuvug’ iby’ urukundo, N’ ibishura bizambarwa, Tukabyishimira cyane; Kubayo bizacur’ iki?
3. Tuvuga n‘ iby‘ igitondo, Kizaba gitamanzuye, Tukazabona wa murwa, Umanuk‘ urimbishijwe. Umurw‘ urabagirana, Utarangwamw‘ agahinda, Ntubemo n‘ imibabaro, Har‘ umunezero gusa.
4. N’ ubwo ngoswe n’ ibishuko, Ntunganiriza kujyayo; Ngo nanjye njye niyumvamo, Uko kubayo byamera; Ni bwo tuzatambagira, Icyo gihugu cy’ ihirwe, Hamwe n’ abamarayika, Na Yes’ Umukiza wacu.

title: Data Mwiza Tugarutse Kugushengerera
verses: 1. Data mwiza, Tugarutse kugushengerera none; Twicishije bugufi, twiyoroheje, Twifuza kubabarirwa.
2. Twongeye kugushimira, Kuko waturinze twese; Ukatuzirikana ukaduhira, Ukatugarura hano.
3. Ayi, twagushij’ ishyano; Tur’ abo kwangw’ urunuka; Dore tujya duteshuk’ inzira yawe, Noneho turahabutse.
4. Mana y’ imigisha yose, Ni w’ utang’ utaziganya; Tureban’ imbabazi, turakwinginze; Uduhaz’ ijambo ryawe.

title: Mwam’ Ubwo Tukigushengereye
verses: 1. Mwam’ ubwo tukigushengereye, Tukuririmbirir’ icyarimwe Iyi ndirimbo yac’ iheruka, Twicishije bugufi, duhire.
2. Mwami dusezerer’ amahoro; Duherekeze, tujyane nawe; Turindir’ iminwa n’ imitima, Ngo yoye kujy’ igukoz’ isoni.
3. Amahoro yaw’ abane natwe; Ab’ ari y’ ajy’ aduh’ ihumure. Maze n’ uturuhur’ imiruho, Tuzongere kuyabon’ iwawe.

title: N’ Ubwo Nsazwe N’ Ibyaha
verses: 1. N’ ubwo nsazwe n’ ibyaha, Yesu yarankijije, Yamviriy’ amaraso, Angura n’ urupf’ atyo. Tuzab’ akaramata, Ak’ ishami n’ igiti.
2. Urukundo rwa Yesu, Rusaguts’ ikirere. Ntacyo twarugeraho, Ruzagumahw’ iteka; Ni we warumbwirije, Jye ntabwo nari nduzi.
3. N’ ubwo nsazwe n’ ibyaha, Yes’ andutira byose; Az’ ibyo nkennye byose, Ankiz’ umubabaro. Namuberey’ imbata, Nta cyago cyampangara.

title: Twabuze Gakondo Mur’ Iyi Si
verses: 1. Twabuze gakondo mur’ iyi si; Tuyirimo tur’ abasuhuke; Arikw’ ikitunezeza, N’uko dushaka gakondo, Irushaho kuba nziza.
2. Twabuze gakondo mur’ iyi si; Tugamij’ iy’ iwacu mw’ ijuru; Ni yo Siyon’ ihoraho, Ifit’ umucy’ udashira, Ihor’ irabagirana.
3. Mbeg’ uburyo tuzanezererwa; Ahw’ abagenzi bat’ umuruho. Icyamp’ amababa none, Nkaguruka, Nkigirayo, Nkibanira nawe, Mwami.
4. Mutima wanjye, reka kuganya! Dor’ igih’ Imana yangeneye, Ni cyo cyiza, ni cyo cyiza; Njye nkomeza kwiringira, Ngez’ ubw’ izampamagara.

title: Mw’ Ijuru No Mw’ Isi Yose
verses: 1. Mw’ ijuru no mw’ isi yose, Nta zina nk’ irya Yesu; Ntaryo nkunda ku mutima, Nk’ iry’ uwaducunguye.
2. Nihagir’ umunt’ ushimwa, Akarutishw’ abandi, N’ abarush’ icyubahiro, Yes’ aramuhebuza.
3. Abamarayika bose, Bitw’ amazina meza, Ariko nta zina ryabo, Ribasha kunnezeza.
4. Yes’ ankiz’ ibyago byose, Kandi ni w’ unkomeza; N’ iyo nagiz’ intege nke, Anyonger’ imbaraga.
chorus: Gusubiramo: N’ izina ( n’ izina ) rya Yesu ( rya Yesu ), Ni ryo ritwiringiza; N’ izina ( n’ izina ), Ry’ Umukiza, Riduhesh’ amahirwe.

title: Ngiz’ Amahirwe Nd’ Uwa Yesu

metadata.composer: Mrs. Jos. F. Knapp, by per.

verses: 1. Ngiz’ amahirwe, nd’ uwa Yesu; N’ ubu mfit’ umunezero mwinshi! Ndazw’ agakiza; ndacunguwe; Mbyawe n’ Umwuka, ndatunganye.
2. Nditanze, ndamwiyeguriye; Ndumv’ ibyishimo binsabye rwose. Narokotse kubw’ ubuntu bwe, None ntegerej’ iby’ ijuru.
3. Sinkir’ uwanjye, ndamwihaye, Ni we wambohoy’ arambatura. Mbe maso nsenge, ntegereze; Maz’ ubuntu bwe bunyuzure.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ni byo ndirimba, ni byo mvuga; Nshim’ Umukiz’ ubudasiba; Ni byo ndirimba, ni byo mvuga; Nshim’ Umukiz’ ubudasiba.

title: Reba Yesu Ku Musaraba
verses: 1. Reba Yesu ku musaraba, Reb’ uko twatumy’ agirirwa; Huguk’ araguhamagara, Ngwin’ umusange.
2. Yesu yambatuye mu byaha, Atura mu mutima wanjye; Ni w’ uwuzanamw’ ihumure; Yes’ ahimbazwe!
3. Ni we Sokw’ inyezahw’ ibyaha; Narayiyuhagije ndera; Nzi yukw’ ineza y’ izaramba; Yes’ ahimbazwe!
4. Muze kw’ Isoko y’ Agakiza; Maze muyiyuhagiremo; Irabezahw’ ibyaha byose; Yes’ ahimbazwe!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Duhimbaz’ izina rye, Duhimbaz’ izina rye; Yaducunguj’ amaraso ye; Yes’ ahimbazwe!

title: Mbes’ Urumv’ Ushaka Gutunganira Yesu?
verses: 1. Mbes’ urumv’ ushaka gutunganira Yesu? Ng’ ugendane na we mu nzira ntoya? Akwikorerer’ imitwaro yawe yose ? Emer’ ugengwe na we.
2. Mbes’ urashaka kw’ akubatura mu byaha? Ngw’ aguh’ amahoro yo mu mutima? Ajy’ akuramira, we guhor’ ugwaguza? Emer’ ugengwe na we.
3. Mbes’ urashaka kugabana ku bugingo? Ngo wibere mu bwami bwo mw‘ ijuru? Urashaka kumaramaza muri byose? Emer’ ugengwe na we.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Azagutungany’ akuboneze, Amaraso y’ akwezehw’ ibyaha, Akuzuz’ urukundo rwe rwinshi; Niwemera kujy’ ugengwa na we.

title: I Muhira Hahirwa

metadata.composer: Arr. From J. H. Mc Naughton

verses: 1. I muhira hahirwa, Har’ urukundo; Byose bib’ amahoro, Har’ urukundo. Ntihab’ impagarara, N’ urutoto n’ inkeke; Hab’ ibyishimo gusa, Har’ urukundo.
2. Ivundi ryanezeza, har’ urukundo; Ntihaba kirogoya, Har’ urukundo, Ibiri mu nzu byose byahinduk’ inyamibwa, Hab’ ibyishimo gusa, Har’ urukundo.
3. Yes’ akunda kuhaba, Har’ urukundo; Isi yos’ irishima, Har’ urukundo. Isanzure ry’ ijuru, Ryuzur’ umucyo waka, N’ Iman’ ikamwenyura, Har’ urukundo.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ineza mu rugo, Ni y’ izan’ ibyishimo, Har’ urukundo.

title: Icyamp’ Umuriro Waka
verses: 1. Icyamp’ umuriro waka, Wajyag’ urabagiranira. Mu bera ba kera bose, Ukabagir’ intwari z’ Imana.
2. Mwam’ icyampa wa mutima, Aburahamu yahoranye; Wari no muri Pawulo, Ukamutera kwiyumanganya.
3. Ntukiban’ intore zawe, Nk’ uko wabanye na Eliya? Ugahumuriza Yobu, Ageze mu kaga katavugwa.
4. Ibuka, Mwam’ aba kera, Uko wabagendereraga; Ab’ ari k’ ujy’ utugenza, Utwuzuz’ Umwuka wawe Wera.

title: Mbes’ Urashaka Kunesh’ Ibyaha?
verses: 1. Mbes’ urashaka kunesh’ ibyaha? Izer’ amaraso ya Yesu. Mbes’ urashaka kumeny’ intsinzi? N’ amaraso y’ Umukiza.
2. S’ urashaka gukir’ ubwibone? Izer’ amaraso ya Yesu; Ngwin’ umusange ku musaraba, Akwejesh’ amaraso ye.
3. Mbes’ urashaka kujya wera de? Izer’ amaraso ya Yesu. Icyakwez’ ibizinga by’ ibyaha, N’ amaraso y’ Umukiza.
4. Urashaka gukorera Yesu? Izer’ amaraso y’ akiza. Urashaka kujy’ umusingiza? Izere ya maraso ye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Har’ imbaraga mu maraso, Y’ Umwana w’ Intama; Har’ imbaraga mu maraso, Ya Yes’ Umwana w’ Imana . T. na B.: Koko har’ imbaraga mu maraso…; Y’ Umwana… w’ Intama; Koko har’ imbaraga mu maraso, Ya Yes’ Umwana w’ Imana.

title: Yesu Naz’ Umwijim’ Uzahunga
verses: 1. Yesu naz’ umwijim’ uzahunga, Yesu naz’ umwijim’ uzahunga, Impundu zizavuga Yes’ aje, Gukorany’ intore ze.
2. Imibabaro yos’ izashira, Imibabaro yos’ izashira; Ubw’ Umwami  Yes’ azagaruka, Gukorany’ intore ze.
3. Nta wuzongera kurir’ ukundi, Nta wuzongera kurir’ ukundi; Umwami  Yesu naza ku bicu, Gukorany’ intore ze.
4. Hazab’ indirimbo z’ indamutso, Hazab’ indirimbo z’ indamutso; Z’ abakijijwe Yes’ agarutse, Gukorany’ intore ze.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Gukorany’ abakunzi be ( bose ); Gukorany’ abakunzi be ( bose ); Impundu zizavuga Yes’ aje, Gukorany’ intore ze.

title: Yesu Ni We Nshut’ Ihebuje
verses: 1. Yesu ni we nshut’ ihebuje, Iy’ amagany’ agucogoje. Ni we womor’ inguma zo mu mutima wawe; Yesu ni we nshut’ ihebuje.
2. Nasanz’ ar’ inshut’ ihebuje, Kukw’ atampana mu makuba; Nindek’ akanyobora, Sinzagir’ icyo ntinya; Yesu ni we nshut’ ihebuje.
3. N’ ubwo natahirwa n’ ibyago, Bikantera byiyungikanya, Sinzakuk’ umutima, Kukw’ ampor’ iruhande; Yesu ni we nshut’ ihebuje.
4. Ubwo tuzagera mw’ ijuru, Tugahura n’ abo twatanye, Impundu zizavuga, Tumusingiz’ iteka: Yesu ni we nshut’ ihebuje.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yesu n’ inshut’ ihebuje (ihebuje); Yesu n’ inshut’ ihebuje (ihebuje); Nugw’ azakuramira, Nutak’ agutabare; Yesu ni we nshut’ ihebuje.

title: Imana Ihimbarizw’ Ibyo Yakoze
verses: 1. Iman’ ihimbarizw’ ibyo yakoze; Yakunz’ ab’ is’ itang’ Umwana wayo; Ni we Yesu waducunguye twese, Akaducir’ icyanzu ngo dukire.
2. Yesu yaducunguj’ amaraso ye, Maz’ aduca kuri kamere yacu; Ngo n’ ubwo twaba twarashayishije, Tube nk’ abatigeze gucumura.
3. Ibyo yadukoreye ntibigerwa, Twakiran’ Umwana w’ Imana ishimwe; Ariko tuzarushaho kwishima, Nitumurebesh’ aya maso yacu.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Dushime, dushime, Yes’ Umwami wacu; Dushime, dushime, Twese tumushime. Ni we watwujuje n’ Imana yacu; Tumuhimbariz’ iyo neza nyinshi.

title: Ur’ Uwera Wera
verses: 1. Ur’ Uwera wera, Man’ ikomeye! Mu  gitondo tujye tukuririmbira. N’ubw’ ukomey’ ute, Ugir’ imbabazi; Ingoma yawe ntizahanguka.
2. Ur’ Uwera wera, Abera bose, Baguhimbazanya n’ abamarayika! Ibyaremwe byose bikuramye, Mwami, Wahozeho, Kand’ uzahoraho.
3. Ur’ Uwera wera, Ubwiza bwawe, N’ ubwo butarebwa n’ inkozi z’ ibibi, Uhor’ ur’ Uwera, Nta wundi mwahwanya, Kugira neza, No gutungana.

title: Uhoraho Nyobora
verses: 1. Uhoraho nyobora, Kuko nd’ umugenzi mu butayu, Nd’ umunyantege nke, Ariko wowe ur’ umunyambaraga. Mutsima wo mw’ ijuru we, Nshaka guhazwa nawe (guhazwa nawe), Nshaka cyane guhazwa nawe.
2. Twifuza kumarw’ inyota nawe, Wowe sokw’ idakama, Tuyoboresh’ inkingi y’ igicu, Tuzarangiz’ urugendo. Ur’ umutabazi wacu, N’ ingab’ idukingira ( idukingira), Tuber’ ingab’ idukingira.
3. Ningera ku nkombe ya Yordani, Umutim’ uzatuza, Maz’ unyambuts’ amasumo yaho, Ngere hakury’ i Kanani. Nzaririmba, Nzaririmba, Nzagusingiz’ iteka (iteka), Nzagusingiz’ iteka ryose. Amen.

title: Urugo Runezerewe
verses: 1. Urugo runezerewe, Iman’ irubamo, Iyo bahuj’ imigambi yo kujya mw’ ijuru.
2. Urugo rurimo Yesu, Rugir’ amahoro, Abana biga kuvuga, Bahoh’ izina rye.
3. Urugo runezerewe, Bahora basenga, Ahw’ ababyeyi bakunda, Ijambo ry’ Imana.
4. Mukiza fash’ ingo zacu, Zigir’ amahoro, Uzuz’ imitima yacu, Urukundo rwawe.

title: Munsi Y’ Amababa Ye
verses: 1. Munsi y’ amababa ye ni hw’ ampisha, N’ ubw’ ijoro ryakwijima cyane, Ntacyo nzatinya nzi kw’ azankomeza, Ubu nd’ umwana we yacunguye.
2. Munsi y’ amababa ye nta gahinda, N’ uburuhukiro bw’ umutima, Mur’ iyi si ntiharimw’ agakiza, Mpirwa ndi mu mababa ye gusa.
3. Munsi y’ amababa ye ni ho heza, Nzajya mpihish’ ibishuko byose, Ni ho buhungiro nta cyampangara, ,Nzibanira na Yes’ amahoro.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Munsi y’ ayo mababa ye, Havuy’ urukundo rwinshi, Mu  mababa ni ho nzibera, Mu  mahor’ iteka ryose.

title: Mwami, Umurab’ Urakaze!
verses: 1. Mwam’  umurab’ urakaze, Urahorera cyane. Nta buhungiro nta bwugamo, Bw’ umuzajoro nk’uyu. Mbese ko tugiye gupfa, Nawe wiryamiye? Dor’ umuraba wabay’ icyago, Tugiye kurengerwa.
2. Mwami  mfit’ agahind’ ubu, N’ umubabaro mwinshi, Umuraba urandengeye, Mwami tebuk’ unkize. Isuri y’ ibyaha byanjye, Dor’ irantembanye, Ndarenganye, Ndarenganye rwose, Mwami tebuk’ unkize.
3. Mwam’  umurab’ uratuje, Ubu nta bwoba mfite. Hamaze no gutamuruka, Mfit’ ibyishimo byinshi. Nuko, Mwami ndakwinginze, Ntunsige njyenyine, Nduhukire mur’ iki cyambu, Kirimw’ amahoro masa.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Umurab’ uranyumvira rwose; Utuze. T. na B.: Umurab’ uranyumvira rwose. Utuze ...ze ...tuze Bose: Nib’ ar’ umurab’ usheg’ utyo, Cyangwa dayimoni cyangwa s’ abantu, Nta mazi yabasha kurengera Ubwat’ Umwami wa byos’ arimo. Dore byose biranyumvira; Bituze, Bituze. Dore byose biranyumvira, Biratuza.

title: Nkweguriy’ Ubugingo Bwanjye
verses: 1. Nkweguriy’ ubugingo bwanjye, Ng’ ubugenz’ uk’ ushaka Mukiza, Nkweguriy’ amaboko yanjye, Ng’ uyakoresh’ uk’ ushaka Mwami, Ng’ uyakoresh’ uk’ ushaka.
2. Nkweguriy’ ibirenge byanjye, Bijye bijyan’ ubutumwa bwiza, Nkweguriy’ ijwi ryanjye na ryo, Ngo rijye rigusingiz’ iteka, Ngo rijye rigusingiza.
3. Nkweguriye akanwa kanjye, Kuzuz’ ubutumwa bwawe Mwami, Nkweguriy’ ubutunzi bwanjye, Ntacyo nshaka kwisigaranira, Ntabwo nagir’ icyo nkwima.
4. Nkweguriy’ imigambi yanjye, Yikoresh’ uk’ ushaka Mukiza, Nkweguriy’ umutima wanjye, Maz’ uwimike mu Bwami bwawe, Wimike mu Bwami bwawe.
5. Nkweguriy’ urukundo rwanjye, Sinshaka kugir’ icyo nguhisha, Nguhay’ impagarike yanjye, Nkweguriy’ ibyanjye byose Mwami, Nkweguriy’ ibyanjye byose.

title: Abazacungurwa Bazaririmba
verses: 1. Abazacungurwa bazaririmba, Bazashyir’ amakamba yabo hasi, Imibabaro yab’ izab’ ishize, Bazahora banezerew’ iteka.
2. Indirimbo y’ urukund’ itangaje, Izab’ iririmbanyw’ umunezero, Tuzabanayo n’ Umukiza wacu, Tuzahora tunezerew’ iteka.
3. Abamesh’ ibishura byabo ni bo, Bazegera ya ntebe ye ya cyami, Ibyaha tuzabikizwa na Yesu, Tuzahora tunezerew’ iteka.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Bazaririmbir’ iyo Ntama y’ i Kalvari Baririmbire Yes’ Umwami Uhoraho. T. na B.: Bazaririmba, Bazaririmba, ...ma y’ i Kalvari Ntama y’ i Kalvari, Baririmbire, baririmbire ...mi, Uhoraho.

title: Ku Musozi Kure
verses: 1. Ku musozi kure har’ umusaraba, Ubabaj’ ukojej’ isoni, Ndawukunda cyane kuko wabambweho, Uwacunguy’ abanyabyaha.
2. Mbeg’ umusarab’ ab’ isi bahinyuye, Ng’ uranyur’ umutima wanjye! Umwana w’ Intama yarets’ ikuzo rye, Awikorer’ ajy’ i Kalvari.
3. Umusaraba wavushij’ amaraso, Ya Yesu Umwana w’ Imana, Kuri wo ni h’ Umukiza yatangiye, Maz’ ubwo mbabarirw’ ibyaha.
4. Kubw’ umusaraba, Nzab’ umunyakuri, Nihanganir’ isoni zawo, Kugez’ ubw’ uzanjyan’ iwacu mw’ ijuru, Tunezeranw’ iteka ryose.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nzogeza uwo musaraba (musaraba), Kugez’ ubwo nzat’ umuruho, Nzikomeza ku musaraba (musaraba), Kugez’ ubwo nzambikw’ ikamba.

title: Yes’ Umukiza Yari Mu Gituro!
verses: 1. Yes’ Umukiza yari mu gituro, Ahategerereje ko bucya.
2. Barindiy’ ubusa Yes’ Umukiza, Bakinz’ igituro ngw’ aheremo.
3. Umukiza Yesu, Ntiyaheranywe, N’ ingoyi z’ urupfu, Yarazutse.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mu gitond’ arazuka (arazuka), Atsinz’ umwanzi bitangaje (bitangaje), Yaneshej’ ubutware bw’ umwijima, Azabana n’ aber’ iteka ryose. Yazutse (yazutse), Yazutse (yazutse)! Umwami Yes’ ariho.

title: Ahar’ Uburuhukiro
verses: 1. Ahar’ uburuhukiro, Ni hafi y’ Imana, Ahw’ icyaha kitarangwa, Ni hafi y’ Imana.
2. Ahatab’ impagarara, Ni hafi y’ Imana, Ahw’ icyaha kitarangwa, Ni hafi y’ Imana.
3. Ahahor’ umudendezo, Ni hafi y’ Imana, Ahahor’ umunezero, Ni hafi y’ Imana.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mwami Yesu Mukiza watumwe n’ Imana, Dukomereze twese bugufi bw’ Imana.

title: Iteraniro Ry’ Abera
verses: 1. Iteraniro ry’ abera, Inzovu n’ ibihumbi, Ingabo z’ abacunguwe, Barabagirana nk’ umucyo, Barwany’ uko babasha, None baratsinze, Mwagurir’ amarembo, Kugira ngo binjire.
2. Ikobe ry’ indirimbo, Rirangira mu kirere, Urusobe rw’ amajwi y’ inanga, Zizacurangw’ urwunge, Mbeg’ umuns’ utangaje, Ni nk’ uwo kurema, Mbega ng’ umubabar’ uratsindwa bitavugwa!
3. Hanezerew’ abari mu mirenge y’ i Kanani, Igitey’ ubwuzu kandi, N’ uko batazatandukana, Ya maso yariraga uzasang’ akeye, Nta mpfubyi nta n’ impfusha bizarangw’ i Kanani.
4. Iteraniro ry’ abera, Batsinze wa mubisha, Nimwumv’ izo ndirimbo nziza, Ni nk’ iz’ abamarayika, Hehe n’ imibabaro, Bayisezeyeho, Ntibazongera gusuhuz’ imitim’ ukundi.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Haleluya, Haleluya, Dusingiz’ Umwana w’ Intama, Haleluya, Haleluya, Nimusingiz’ Uwazutse.

title: Nimwuname Imbere Ya Yehova

metadata.composer: John Hatton, Arr. by Melvin West

verses: 1. Nimwunam’ imbere ya Yehova, Yemwe mahanga yo mw’ isi, Mumenye yuk’ Uhorahw’ ari we Mana, Ni we soko y’ ubugingo.
2. Kand’ imbaraga ze zitangaje, Zaturemye mu butaka, Ndets’ igihe twazimiraga nk’ intama, Yatugaruye mu bushyo.
3. Tumusingirize mu ndirimbo, Duhanik’ amajwi yacu, Kand’ indim’ ibihumbi zo mw’ isi yose, Zizasingiz’ Uhoraho.
4. Amateka y’ ageng’ isi yose, Nta wager’ urukundo rwe, Ukuri kwe gushikamye nk’ urutare, Ukw’ ibihe bih’ ibindi.

title: Mb’ Uwawe, Mwami
verses: 1. Mb’ uwawe Mwami mbane nawe, Ni wow’ umbumba, Jye nd’ ibumba, Ngenz’ uk’ ushaka mere nkawe, Mwam’ ubu ndakwiyeguriye.
2. Mb’ uwawe Mwami mbane nawe, Ndondora Mwam’ ungerageze, Unyeze nere nk’ urubura, Njye ngusenga niyoroheje.
3. Mb’ uwawe Mwami mbane nawe, Ubu ndagusab’ untabare, Wowe Nyir’ imbaraga zose, Nkorah’ umvure we Mukiza.
4. Mb’ uwawe Mwami mbane nawe, Nkomeza kuko nteraganwa, Nyuzuz’ Umwuka wawe Wera, Ngo bose bambonemo Yesu.

title: Mutuze
verses: 1. Mutuze, Mutuze, Mwe guhwihwisa, Mwite kw’ ijambo ryose mwumvir’ aha.
2. Mutuze, Mutuze, Aha n’ ahera, Turahumvir’ ubutumwa bukiza.
3. Mutuze, Mutuze, Mwiyoroheje, Dusangir’ ibyiza byo mur’ Edeni.
4. Mutuze, Mutuze, Tubabarirwe, Mutuze, Turi kumwe n’ Uhoraho.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mwitonde (mwitonde), Mwitonde (mwitonde), Har’ Uhoraho, Muze (muze) hafi ye, v …….. Mumwubashye cyane.

title: Mbes’ Ushaka Guhirwa?
verses: 1. Mbes’ ushaka guhirwa? Tang’ unezerewe. Bizakwiz’ ubutumwa, Tang’ unezerewe. Ntukikanyize rwose, Tanga unezerewe. Fatanya n’ Imana, Tyo tang’ unezerewe.
2. Reka wikwikanyiza, Tang’ unezerewe. Rekur’ impano zawe, Tang’ unezerewe. Mbes’ utunze bikeya? Tanga unezerewe. Izaguh’ imigisha, Tang’ unezerewe.
3. Kwiza hos’ ubutumwa, Tang’ unezerewe. Maz’ umucyo wihute, Tang’ unezerewe. Mbes’ ushak’ imigisha wahabwa n’ Uhoraho? Nuko rero mwumvire, Tang’ unezerewe.

title: Rangurur’ Indirimbo
verses: 1. Rangurur’ indirimbo y’ ibyishimo n’ umunezero, Wikwiheba shir’ agahinda, Ririmban’ ibyishimo. Ririmbir’ Uwaturinze, Waduhuje n’ inshuti, Uwatuyoboy’ inzira, Itugeza mw’ ijuru.
2. Turirimbe dutway’ amabendera tunezerewe, Turirimba hoziana z’ umunezero w’ iteka. Turirimbir’ Umukiza, Turanguruy’ amajwi, Tuvug’ ibyabaye kera, By’ urukundo rw’ Imana.
3. Turagushima Data Wera, Kubw’ imbabazi zawe, Uko duteraniye hamwe, Turagushima cyane. Turagushima Mukiza, Kuko waducunguye, Uduhe Umwuka Wera, Atwegerez’ Imana.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ririmba (ririmba), Ririmba (ririmba), Ririmban’ ibyishimo, Ririmba (ririmba), Ririmba (ririmba), N’ ibyishimo byinshi.

title: Nshikamye Ku Masezerano
verses: 1. Nshikamye ku masezerano meza, Y’ Umukiza wanjye, Mpora nsingiza, Nzahora musingiza, Ndanguruye, Nshikamye ku masezerano.
2. Nshikamye ku masezerano meza, N’ ubwo naba mbuz’ epfo na ruguru, Ijambo ry’ Imana rimpa gutsinda, Nshikamye ku masezerano.
3. Nshikamye ku masezerano meza, Kuko nejeshejw’ amaras’ akiza, Niy’ atuma mpora mu mudendezo, Nshikamye ku masezerano.
4. Nshikamye ku masezerano meza, Nkomezwa n’ umurunga w’ urukundo, Mpora neshesh’ inkota y’ Umwuka We, Nshikamye ku masezerano.
5. Nshikamye ku masezerano meza, Numv’ Umwuka We Wer’ ampamagara, Ngo ngume mu Mukiza nkesha byose, Nshikamye ku masezerano.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S.: Nshikamye ku masezerano, Y’ Umucunguzi wanjye, Nshikamye ku masezerano, Y’ Umucunguzi. A.,T. na B.: Nshikamye ku masezerano, Masezerano y’ Umucunguzi wanjye, Nshikamye ku maserano, Y ’ Umucunguzi. Masezerano y’ Umucunguzi.

title: Niba Mvug’ Ijambo Rito
verses: 1. Niba mvug’ ijambo rito, Rihumuriz’ abandi, Niba ndirimb’ indirimbo, Ntibongere kwiheba.
2. Niba urukundo rwanjye, Rwahumuriz’ abandi, Niba nagir’ icyo nkora, Kikunganir’ abandi.
3. Niba nakor’ umurimo, Ukaruhur’ abandi, Mana mp’ urukundo rwinshi, Rutume mfash’ abandi.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mana mfasha mvuge neza, Mpa  n’ indirimbo nziza, Mbashisha kurangurura, Ngo byumvikane hose.

title: Umwami Yesu Yikorer’ Umusaraba?
verses: 1. Umwami  Yesu yikorer’ umusaraba wenyine? Umuntu wese yikorer’ uwe, Nanjye har’ uwanjye.
2. Nzawikorera ngeze igihe azawunduhura, Anjyan’ iwacu anyambik’ ikamba yanteguriye.
3. Nzarambik’ ikamba ryanjye iruhande rw’ Umukiza, Haba hashashe izahabu, Nzogeza izina rye.

title: Umwami Yesu Yazutse
verses: 1. Umwami  Yesu yazutse, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Abaremwe bamuramye, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Twese tumusingize, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Isi n’ ijuru bimusingize, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya.

2. Umukiza wac’ ariho, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Yaneshej’ urupfu rwose, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Ni we waducunguye, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Yatsinz’ imbaraga z’ igituro, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya.

3. Yaducunguj’ urukundo, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Yaturwaniy’ intambara, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Yiganzura n’ urupfu, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Yatwugururiye Paradizo, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya.

4. Twishimire kujy’ ahw’ ari, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Tuger’ ikirenge mu cye, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Azatuzura nka we, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Tubikeshej’ umusaraba we, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya.

title: Mbese Yesu Ajy’ Anyitaho?
verses: 1. Mbese Yesu ajy’ anyitaho, Mu byago no mu mahoro, Mu mibabaro no mu miruho, No mu rugendo rurushya?
2. Mbese Yesu ajy’ anyitaho, Iyo ngenda mu mwijima, N’ iy’ umwijima w’ akag’ ungose, Mbese Yes’ amba bugufi?
3. Mbese Yesu ajy’ anyitaho, Iyo nguye mu bishuko, Iyo mbabaye, N’ iyo mbogoza, Mbese Yes’ arantabara?
4. Mbese Yesu ajy’ anyitaho, Iyo nsezeye ku nshuti, Iyo mbabazwa, Simpumurizwe, Mbese Yes’ ab’ abireba?
chorus: Gusubiramo: Anyitaho, Arandinda, Mu  mibabaro yanjye, Mu  bihe merewe nabi, Umukiza wanjy’ anyitaho.

title: Hanga Amaso Umukiza
verses: 1. Iyo utewe n‘ ibyago bigatuma wiyunamira, Iyo kwiheba kukugezeh’ ubwoba bukagutaha.
2. Iy‘ usatiriwe n‘ umuraba byose bihungabanye, Iy‘ ibyawe byose byagushijeh‘ ubwoba bwagutashye.
3. Iy’ ur‘ arakazuyaz‘ ubuz‘ urukundo rwawe rwa mbere, Iy‘ icyaha wakoze kigutotez‘ ijoro n‘ umunsi.
4. Iyo ugiz‘ ibiguc‘ intege mu murimo wa Yesu. Iyo mu rugendo rwawe mw‘ isi utakimeny‘ inzira.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Hang’ amaso Umukiza, Ngwin’ arakureba neza, Uzumv’ uhumurijwe kandi, Azakwemera akwakire.

title: Mfasha Ngo Ndusheho
verses: 1. Mfasha ngo ndusheho kugukunda, Icyo ni cyo ngusaba mpfukamye. Mbigusabye cyane mfasha Mwami Yesu, Ngo ndusheho kugukunda.
2. Nashats’ iby’ iyi si ngo nezerwe, Ubu ndabiretse, Ng’ ump’ ibyiza. Icyo nsaba gusa, Mfasha Mwami Yesu, Ngo ndusheho kugukunda.
3. Mfit’ umubabaro n’ agahinda, Nzishimira cyan’ intumwa zawe. Iyo ndirimbana na zo biramfasha, Nkarushaho kugukunda.
4. Mu marembera y’ ubu bugingo, Nzagushima cyane ngusingize. Nzakuririmbira maze mvuge nsenga, Ngo ndusheho kugukunda.

title: Yes’ Aje Yasanga Twiteguye?
verses: 1. Yes’ aje yasanga twiteguye, Yasanga turi maso? Igihe cyose yagarukamo, Se twaba twiteguye?
2. Mbese naz’ umusek’ utambitse akaduhamagara, Umunt’ akabazw’ icyo yakoze, Mbes’ ahw’ azadushima?
3. Mbese tujya tub’ abanyakuri, cyangwa turinezeza? Niba tuboneye mu mitima, Tuzagera mw’ ijuru.
4. Hahirw’ ab’ Umwami azasanga bakimutegereje, Mbese nagaruka mu gicuku, Tuzaba turi maso?
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mbese mugenzi twavuga tuti: Ubu turiteguye? Mbes’ ah’ Umwam’ azasanga wowe nanjye, Tukimutegereje?

title: Izuba Nirirenga
verses: 1. Izuba nirirenga turangij’ imirimo, Ubwo tuzaba tunaniwe, Uhorah’ utwara byose ni w’ uzadukiza, Duhurire kuri Siyoni.
2. Tunyura mu gicucu, No mu mugaru mwinshi, Tugoswe n’ umwijim’ ukaze, Ariko Uhoraho, Ni w’ uzatuyobora, Ab’ ari w’ utugez’ iwacu.
3. N’ubw’ amaso yacu yuzuyemo amarira, Dufit’ ubwoba mu mitima, Ariko Umukiza agiye kutujyana, Aho tuzashir’ agahinda.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Tuzahurirayo, Koko tuzahurirayo, Tuzibanira na Yesu, Muri cya gihugu cyiza, Tuzahurirayo, Koko tuzahurirayo, Twibanire (twibanire), mw’ ikuzo rye.

title: Narebye Yesu
verses: 1. Narebye Yes’ igihe nari ndembejwe n’ ibyaha, Nari nabuz’ uko ngira, Maz’ arampumuriza.
2. Nabony’ Umwami Yes’ ambambiwe ku musaraba, Nizera yukw’ ibyaha byanjye bibambanywe na we.
3. Nabony’ Umwami Yesu, Azukany’ icyubahiro, Niringir’ imbabazi ze, N’ ibyahanuwe kera.
4. Yandebany’ impuhwe, Umutima wanjy’ uranyurwa, Maz’ anyiher’ ikimenyetso cy’ Umwuka We Wera.
5. Tuzabana n’ Umwami Yesu Krist’ ibihe byose, Mutezeho byose, Mbe nk’ umwana wiringira se.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S.: Ye, ni koko, Nareby’ Umwami Yesu; Arambona, Nzabana na w’ iteka. A., T. na B.: Ye n’ iby’ ukuri koko, Nanjye nareby’ Umwami Yesu, Maz’ arambona, Nanjye rwose, Nzabana na w’iteka.

title: Ntugire Icy’ Utinya
verses: 1. Ntugire icyo utinya, Ndi kumwe nawe, Ni isezerano ryo kwizera kwanjye. Umwijima ntuzigera unter’ ubwoba, Ndahumurijwe, Ngendana n’ Umukiza wanjye.
2. Umusek’ umurik’ iyo hakeye neza, Yes’ umucyo wanjy’ amurikir’ iteka, Iyo ncitse intege, Yes’ arandamira, Mucyo weyur’ ibicu, Azangeza mw’ ijuru.
3. Iyo ibyago bituruts’ impande zose, Iyo nugarijwe Yes’ amba bugufi, Ambwira ati: Komera, Humura “Nijye”, Ntutinye komera ndi kumwe nawe iteka.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ntabwo nzigunga, Sinzigera nigunga, Yesu arandinda, Ntabwo ajy’ ansiga jyenyine. Ntabwo nzigunga, Sinzigera nigunga, Yesu arandinda, Ntabwo ajy’ ansiga jyenyine.

title: Mbeg’ Inteko!
verses: 1. Umwana w’ umunt’ azaz’ igitondo gitangaje, Nibwo twese tuzabon’ ikuzo rye. Azakur’ abantu be mu moko yose yo mw’ isi, Iyo nteko nini iratangaje!
2. Abasinziriye muri Yesu bazakanguka, N’ ubwo bab’ ikuzimu no mu nyanja, Bahabw’ imibiri imeze nk’ iy’ abo mw’ ijuru, Iyo nteko nini izatangaza!
3. Tuzabon’ umudugud’ urimw’ amazu yera de, N’ uruzi rwa ya mazi y’ ubugingo. Abazaba baratandukanye bazabonana, Izab’ ar’ inteko nin’ itangaje!
4. N’ ukuri Yes’ agiye kugaruka bidatinze, Uwo muns’ uzab’ umuns’ uhiriwe, Twese tuzahindurwa mu kanya nk’ ako guhumbya! Iyo nteko nin’ izab’ itangaje!
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Mbeg’ inteko nini nziza! Inteko nini y’ abacunguwe na Yesu ubwe! Mbeg’ inteko nini y’ abantu! Bazahora banezerew’ iteka! T. na B.: Mbeg’ inteko, mbeg’ inteko! Nini nziza, nini nziza! Inteko nini y’ abacunguwe na Yesu ubwe! Mbeg’ inteko, mbeg’ inteko! nini y’ abantu! Bazahora banezerew’ iteka!

title: Umutima Wanjye Wari Wihebye
verses: 1. Umutima wanjye wari wihebye, Ibyaha byanjye byantaye mu rwobo, Ntakambir’ Uhoraho ndi mw’ isayo, Maz’ araz’ ankuramo, None ndiho.
2. Yanyigije hafi ye ku Rutare, Nimpaguma ntabwo nzongera kugwa, Byatumy’ intambwe zanjye zishikama, Nzahaguma nzahambikirw’ ikamba.
3. Ni we wanyigishij’ indirimbo nshya, Nyiririmba ku manywa na nijoro, Ubu nibereye mu mudendezo, Nzakomeza nsingiz’ Uwankijije.
4. Nzaririmb’ ibitangaza bya Yesu, Nzamusingiza bose babimenye, Nzajya ndirimb’ agakiza k’ iteka, Kugez’ ubwo bose bameny’ Imana.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yankuyemo yaransayuye, Maz’ ampagarika ku Rutare, Kand’ anyigisha kuririmba, Ndamwogeza, Haleluya.

title: Ibihe By’ Imibabaro
verses: 1. Ibihe by’ imibabaro bitey’ agahinda, Byose nabituy’ i Kalvari, Yes’ ari bugufi.
2. Muture Yes’ amaganya yanyu uyu munsi, Byose nabituy’ i Kalvari, Yes’ ari bugufi.
3. Mutim’ ubabaye cyane, Humura witinya, Byose nabituy’ i Kalvari, Yes’ ari bugufi.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Byose nabituy’ i Kalvari, Kalvari, Kalvari, Byose nabituy’ i Kalvari , Yes’ ari bugufi.

title: Wibuk’ Imigisha Wahawe
verses: 1. N’ ubwo waterway n’ amakuba menshi, Maz’ akagutera kwiheba cyane, Ibuk’ imigisha yose wahawe, Ibyo yakoze biragutangaza.
2. Uhor’ uremerewe n’ amaganya, Umusarab’ urakuremereye, Ibuk’ imigisha yose wahawe, Uhor’ ubiririmb’ uko bukeye.
3. Nubon’ abandi bafit’ ubutunzi, Wibuk’ ubwo Yesu yasezeranye, Wibuk’ imigisha yos’ utagura, Ingororano yaw’ iri mw’ ijuru.
4. N’ ubwo wab’ utewe n’ impagarara, Ntizizaguhagarik’ umutima, Wibuke k’ ufit’ abamarayika, Bazakurinda baguhumurize.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Wibuk’ imigisha wahawe, Wibuk’ imigisha y’ Imana, Imigisha Iman’ iguha, Ibyo yakoze biragutangaza. T. na B.: Wibuk’ imigisha, …gisha wahawe, Wibuk’ imigisha, …gisha y’ Imana, Imigisha yose Iman’ iguha, Ibyo yakoze biragutangaza.

title: Mana Data, Ushobora Byose
verses: 1. Mana Data, Ushobora byose, Duhe Mwami, Kurabagirana, Tukuririmbire tugushima, Kukw’ ari w‘ ushobora byose.
2. Watuyoboy‘ ibihe byashize, Tuyobore no mur‘ iki gihe, Dukingire imyambi y‘ umwanzi, Tuyoboreshe ijambo ryawe.
3. Intambara ziraduc‘ intege, Tuber‘ ingabo idukingira, Duhe kwizer‘ imbaraga yawe, Dukeney‘ ubuntu bwawe Mwami.
4. Duhembure mur‘ urugendo, Tuyobore amanywa n‘ ijoro, Duhe kuguma bugufi bwawe, Guhimbazwa n‘ ibyawe iteka.

title: Urukundo Rw’ Umukiza
verses: 1. Ubu mpagaz’ imbere ya Yesu w’ i Nazareti, Ntangazwa n’ ukw’ ankunda, Kandi nandujwe n’ ibyaha!
2. Ari mu gashyamb’ asenga, Ni jye yagiriraga, Bya byuya by’ amaraso, Yabibize kukw’ ankunda.
3. Maz’ abamarayika baza kumuhumuriza, Kuko yar’ ababajwe n’ imibabaro y’ abantu.
4. Tuzamureb’ iteka, Abazaba bacunguwe, Duhore turirimba Urukundo yadukunze.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Urukundo rw’ Umukiza Nzahora nduririmba, Urukundo Yes’ ankunda, Ruhebuj’ ibintu byose.

title: Amarembo Niyugururwa
verses: 1. Ntituzongera kuba mu mwijima, Amarembo niyugururwa. Ahubwo tuzaba muri rwa rurembo, Rumurikirwa n’ Imana.
2. Inshuti zizandindira ku cyambu, Amarembo niyugururwa. Nzajya kwiber’ ahatazarangw’ icyaha, Amarembo yuguruwe.
3. Nta ndwara no kuribwa bizabayo, Amarembo niyugururwa. Tuziganirira n’ abakunzi bacu, Amarembo yuguruwe.
4. Nzagir’ umunezer’ utarondorwa, Amarembo niyugururwa. Nzahora nirebera Yesu mu maso, Amarembo yuguruwe.
5. Tuzagendera mu mucyo w’ Imana, Amarembo niyugururwa. Tuzaba turirimban’ umunezero, Amarembo yuguruwe.
6. Ntabwo nzongera kuvunwa n’ ishavu, Amarembo niyugururwa. Nzabana n’ Umwami Yes’ iteka ryose, Amarembo yuguruwe.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Amarembo niyugururwa, Amarembo niyugururwa. Mbeg’ umunezero tuzahagirira, Amarembo yuguruwe! T. na B.: Amarembo niyu...ru... ...gururwa, Amarembo Niyu... ru... gururwa, Mbeg’ umunezero tuzahagirira, Amarembo yuguruwe!

title: Nind’ Uzagera Mu Rurembo?
verses: 1. Nind’ uzagera mu rurembo, Ruhorahw’ ibihe byose, Akabon’ ibyiza bihari, Mbese ni jye, Cyangwa wowe? Akahabon’ inzira zose zisizemw’ izahabu nziza, Agahora mu munezero, Mbese ni jye, Cyangwa wowe?

2. Nind’ uzatur’ umusaraba, Ngw’ aruhuk’ iteka ryose, Umwizer’ azahabw’ ikamba, Mbese ni jye, Cyangwa wowe? Azareb’ Umwami mu maso, Akiz’ imibabaro yose, Abane na w’ iteka ryose, Mbese ni jye, Cyangwa wowe?
3. Kandi har’ uzakingiranwa, Ubutazakingurirwa, Azabwirwa ngo ntabwo nkuzi, Mbese ni jye, Cyangwa wowe? Azahamagarir’ ubusa, Urugi ruzaba rwakinzwe, Bazagororerw’ asigare, Mbese ni jye cyangwa wowe?

4. Harih’ uzishimir’ intsinzi, Anesheje, Anesheje, Ari hamwe n’ abacunguwe, Mbese ni jye, Cyangwa wowe? Har’ uzaramukanya n’ abe, Batandukanijwe n’ ibyago, Be kongera gutandukana, Mbese ni jye, Cyangwa wowe?

title: Ngufitiy’ Ubutumwa
verses: 1. Ngufitiy’ ubutumwa, Haleluya, N’ ubutumwa bw’ Umukiza, Bwanditse mw‘ Ijambo rye, Haleluya, Muhugukire urakizwa.
2. Ngufitiy’ ubutumwa bw’ urukundo, Mwene Data, Haleluya, Buturutse mw’ ijuru, Haleluya, Bwatanzwe n’ Umukiza Yesu.
3. Weguriw’ ubugingo, Haleluya, Buhorahw’ iteka ryose, N’ uhanga Yes’ amaso, Haleluya, Ni we wenyine ugukiza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Tyo reba ( tyo reba),maz’ ukire ( maz’ ukire ), Reba Yes’ Urakizwa. Byanditswe mw’ Ijambo rye, Haleluya, Muhugukire urakizwa.

title: Ndi Mu Murima Njyenyine
verses: 1. Ndi mu  murima njyenyine, Ikime gitonze ku byatsi, Numv’  ijwi rivuga riti: Umwana w’ Iman’ aratungutse.
2. Aravuga maz’ ijwi rye, ryiza ryikirizwa n’ inyoni, Indirimbo nziza namwumvanye, Ntabw’ izamva ku mutima.
3. Tugumana  mu murima, Kuk’ ubwire bwari bukubye, Maze anyoherez’ ankangara, Arikw’ ar’ ukumpwitura.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Turakomeza turagendana, Maz’ ambwira ko yantoye, Mbeg’ ibyishimo twari dufite, Bitigeze bibaho!

title: Ntabwo Ndamenya
verses: 1. Ntabwo ndamenya nez’ icyatumye Iman’ ingirir’ ubuntu, Bigatum’ ingir’ uwo mu muryango w’ abana bayikunda!
2. Ntabwo nzi nez’ uburyo yampaye, Uko kwizera gukiza, N’ ubury’ Ijambo rye ryampaye amahoro yo mu mutima!
3. Sinzi ubury’ Umwuka yihanisha abanyabyaha nkanjye, Kumenyesh’ abandi ibya Yesu, Bidutera kumwizera.
4. Ntabwo nz’ icyo nateganirijwe, Ar’ icyiza cyangw’ ikibi, Imibabaro n’ iminsi myiza, Byose bir’ imbere yawe.
5. Sinzi igih’ Umwam’ azazira, Ndetse n’ ahw’ azaturuka, Niba mbana na Yesu mur’ iki gihe, Nzamusanganira.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Kuko nzi nez’ uwo nizeye, Kand’ ari we ushobora byose, Ni we undindir’ ubugingo, Kugeza urya munsi.

title: Nguhay’ Umwanya
verses: 1. Wavuye mw’ ijuru usig’ ubwami bwawe, Uza mur’ iyi si ku bwanjye, I Betelehemu, Ntiwabonay’ icumbi, Kand’ ur’ Umwami w’ abami.
2. Abamarayika bakuririmbiraga, Bogez’ icyubahiro cyawe, Maz’ ugeze mw’ isi uvuk’ ur’ umukene, Wicisha bugufi cyane.
3. Ingunzu zitahiraga mu myobo yazo, Inyoni zirara mu byari, Ariko woweho wararaga butunda, Mw’ ishyamba ry’ i Galilaya.
4. Wazaniy’ abantu Ijambo rihoraho, Ngo rizabah’ umudendezo, Maze barakwanga bakujyan’ i Kalvari, Bakwambikiray’ amahwa.
5. Ubw’ uzagaruka mw’ ikobe ry’ indirimbo, Uje mu cyubahiro cyawe, Ndifuza cyane yuko wazampamagara, Ut’ icar’ iburyo bwanjye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nguhay’ umwanya mu mutima, Uwiberemw’ ibihe byose, Ndawukweguriye Mwami wanjye, Uwiberemw’ ibihe byose.

title: Mucunguzi Wanjye
verses: 1. Mukiza wanjye nshaka kub’ uwawe, Ngwin’ uture mu mutima wanjy’ iteka. Uwukuremo ibigirwamana, Uwubonez’ ushiremo inenge.
2. Mwami  Yesu ntiwemere na gato, Yukw’ icyaha cyabon’ akanya na gato; Ko kunyuramo cyiza mu mutima, Ntama w’ Imana, nyejesh’ amaraso.
3. Data nubwo ntagira kivurira, Unyitaho ugatuma Mwuka Wera; Akanyobora agatuma ntsinda, Maz’ umutima wanjye ukabonera.
4. Mwami  dore ntegereje nizeye, Ndeger’ umusaraba wambambiweho. Ngo mpumurizwe, mbyarw’ ubwa kabiri, Nzishimir’ iteka kwiber’ iwawe.
5. Haleluya! Kwizera kunsubiza ishusho iboneye waturemanye. Shimirw’ imirimo yaw’ itangaje, Warandemye, untaka icyubahiro.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Amaraso yawe Mwami, Niy’ abonez’ umutima wanjye.

title: Uko Ndushaho Kumukorera
verses: 1. Aho menyey’ Umukiza, Nkanagengwa na we, Uko ndushaho kumukorera, Nikw’ arushaho kunyuzuramo.
2. Angirir’ ubuntu bwinshi, Nkamererwa neza, Uko ndushaho kumuyoboka, Nikw’ arushaho kunyuzuramo.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Uko njya ndushaho kumukorera, Na we, nikw’ arushaho kunyuzura, Kandi uko ndushaho kumukunda, Na we nikw’ arushaho kunyuzuramo.

title: Nabonye Kuza Kwa Yesu
verses: 1. Nabonye kuza kwa Yesu afit’ icyubahiro, Amaze gusenya rwos’ ububiko bw’ umujinya, Yadukijije n’ ubugi bw’ inkot’ ityaye cyane, Ni w’ utuyobora.
2. Namubonye no mu mazu y’ abantu benshi cyane, Bamwubakiramw’ ibicaniro nimugoroba, Nongera kumubon’ ac’ imanza zitarenganya, Ni w’ utuyobora.
3. Akomeje guhamagaz’ abant’ ijwi ry’ impanda, Arateguriz’ abantu bose gucirw’ imanza. Mutima wanjye mwitabe vuba unezerewe, Ni w’ utuyobora.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nasingizwe, Haleluya, Nasingizwe, Haleluya, Nasingizwe, Haleluya, Ni w’ utuyobora.

title: Mbeg’ Umunsi Mwiza!
verses: 1. Yemw’ umuns’ abacunguwe, Bazahagarar’ imbere y’ Imana! Baririmb’ indirimbo z’ urwunge, Kubw’ ikuzo n’ ubuntu bwayo.
2. Ndareb’ ingabo zitabarika, Zerekan’ umucyo w’ ijuru, Zifit’ amahoro atangaje, Ku maremb’ arabagirana.
3. Numv’ ijwi ryiza ry’ Umucunguzi, Riva ku ntebe ye y’ ubwami, Nimuz’ abahiriwe na Data. Mwambikw’ ikamba ryo kunesha.
4. Abera bazaririmba n’ abamarayika batabarika, Isi izahind’ umushyitsi, Kand’ ibyago bizaba bishize.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Inteko zingana n’ umusenyi, Zingana n’ umusenyi mwinshi, Abacunguwe bazangana n’ umusenyi, Umusenyi bangana n’ umusenyi.

title: Nimutyo Turirimban’ Umunezero
verses: 1. Nimutyo turirimban’ umunezero, Twegereje kuger’ iwacu, Aho ni ho tuzaban’ iteka ryose, Ubu tugiye kugerayo.
2. Mutyo dushishikare dukore neza, Twegereje kuger’ iwacu, Kand’ Imana yiteguye kutwakira. Ubu tugiye kugerayo.
3. Dukomez’ urugendo twe gucogora, Twegereje kuger’ iwacu, Nimutyo twamamaz’ iyo nkuru nziza, Ubu tugiye kugerayo.
4. Mbeg’ umunezero tuzagirirayo! Twegereje kuger’ iwacu, Ntituzongera kubogoz’ amarira, Ubu tugiye kugerayo.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na T.: Mu gihe gito, Mu gihe gito, Tuzaba tugezeyo, Tugiye kuban’ ubudatandukana, Ubu tugiye kugerayo. A. na B.: Mu gihe gito, Mu gihe gito, Tuzaba tugezeyo, Tugiye kuban’ ubudatandukana, Ubu tugiye kugerayo.

title: Muze Dusingiz’ Umwami
verses: 1. Muze dusingiz’ Umwami, Abera muz’ imbere ye, Abahora mumuramya, Mwamamaz’ ububasha bwe.
2. Mumusingiriz’ ahera, Muririmbe mwisanzuye, Nimumuramye mwunamye, Mumwubahe  kukw’ abumva.
3. Murahoran’ ubuntu bwe butemba buv’ i Siyoni, N’ Umuremyi, N’ Uhoraho, Bose nibamusingize.

title: Ahw’ Umukiza Anyobora
verses: 1. Ahw’ Umukiza anyobora, Nzemera mukurikire, Nzamukurikir’ iteka, Sinzakorwa n’ isoni.
2. N’ ubwo haba mu mwijima, Nkagenda nyobagurika, Nzumv’ ijwi ry’ uwo Mukiza rinsubizemw’ intege.
3. N’ ubw’ isi yambushabusha, Nkabur’ epfo na ruguru, Mukiza uzandamira, Ntabwo nzarambarara.
4. Ibi byago nibishira, Azanyijyanir’ iwacu, Ntihabay’ umubabaro, Nzaba ntanye n’ ibyaha.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ahw’ Umukiza anyobora, Nzemera mukurikire, Ahw’ azanyobora hose, Nzajya mukurikira.

title: Twumvire Mwami
verses: 1. Twumvire Mwami, Turakuramya, Uduteg’ amatwi, Duh’ amahoro. Amen.

title: Nzinutsw’ Ibyo Mw’ Isi
verses: 1. Nzinutsw’ ibyo mw’ isi, Mpisemo Yesu! Sinzifatanya na byo, Mpisemo Yesu! N’ isi y’ umwijima, Nta buruhukiro, Yesu ni we mugisha, Mpisemo Yesu!
2. Wa si we, winshuka, Mpisemo Yesu! Nzabana na w’ iteka, Namuhisemo, Ibyo mw’ isi byose, n’ iby’ igihe gito, Bimeneka nk’ ibumba, Mpisemo Yesu!
3. Iby’ isi n’ inzozi, Mpisemo Yesu! Ni we umber’ umucyo, Mpisemo Yesu! Nashatse kwikiza, Binsubiz’ inyuma, Yesu ni we wanyuze, Ni we mpisemo!
4. Ntabwo ntiny’ urupfu, Mpisemo Yesu! Nshaka kubahw’ iteka, Mpisemo Yesu! Ndashaka kugera, Aho nzab’ iteka, Nzaba mu gituza cye, Mpisemo Yesu.

title: Mutima Wanjye Ucururuke
verses: 1. Mutima wanjye ucururuke, Nugir’ ibiguter’ impagarara, Wiringire Ishobora byose, N’ imigambi yayo myiza.
2. Mutima wanjy’ iby’ ari byo byose, N’ ubw‘ibihe byagenda bihinduka, Imbabazi, zayo ntizishira, Zihorahw’ ibihe byose.
3. Mutima wanjye uremerewe, N’ ubwo wab’ utew’ ubwoba n’ urupfu, Ni wiheba wisung’ Uwiteka, Agukingurir’ ijuru.
4. Mutima wanjy’ uhereye kera, Ntiwigeze ubur’ umudendezo, Isung’ Imana izakwakira, Wemere kugengwa na yo.
5. Ubugingo bwiza buboneye, Bushishikarira gukor’ ibyiza, Mukiza mfasha ngo mbugereho, Ump’ umutim’ utunganye.

title: Ikuzo Ni Iryawe!
verses: 1. Ikuzo n’ iryawe Data wa Twese, Nari nahabiye kure yawe, Wangejeje mu mucyo w’ itangaza, Umvana mu bubata ndakira.
2. Mbeg’ urukundo rutarondoreka! Rwatumye Yesu aza kunshaka. Nar’ umuhanya sinari nkwiriye, Gukira ngukesha Yesu gusa.
3. Akir’ uyu mutima wanjye Mwami, Nkweguriy’ imibereho yanjye, Wowe wanyitangiye ukankiza, Wanyejeshej’ amaraso yawe.
4. Mana yanjye nkingira ndakwinginze, Sinashobora kwirwanirira, Kugira ngo nzanezererw’ iteka, Twishimye, Dusingiza Umwami.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mbeg’ urukundo ruhebuje! Nababariwe, N’ inkuru nziza kuri twe.

title: Umukiza Ni W’ Unyobora
verses: 1. Umukiza ni w’ unyobor’ iyo ndi mu bishuko, N’ iy’ amakub’ angose, Amber’ ubuhungiro, Ni w’ unkingir’ ibishuko, Yesu nyiyoborera.
2. Uhosh’ umuraba nk’ umubyey’ uhoz’ umwana we, Ndets’ uranawutegek’ ubwaw’ ukakumvira, Mwami wanjye Yesu nkunda, Ujy’ Unyiyoborera.
3. Iyo negerey’ inkengero ngashy’ ubwoba, Nkakwihishamo, Ndaruhuka; Nkumv’ umpumuriz’ uti: Witinya ntacy’ uteze kuba, Nzajya nkuyobora.

title: Yesu Araduhamagara!
verses: 1. Yes’ araduhamagara, Ashaka kudukiza, Atubwiz’ ijwi rye ati: Mukristo nkurikira.
2. Yes’ araduhamagara, Ngo tuve mu by’ iyi si, Araduhamagar’ ati: Mukristo nkunda cyane.
3. Iyo tumerewe neza, Cyangwa se tubabaye, Araduhamagar’ ati: Mukristo nkunda rwose.
4. Yes’ araduhamagara, Mwami turakwitabye, Duhe kukumvira, Tugukunde kuruta byose.

title: Nimucane Amatabaza
verses: 1. Nimucan’ amatabaza, Umwijim’ ubay’ icyago, Hazab’ umwijim’ ukaze, Umwam’ ataragaruka.
2. Abant’ ibihumbi byinshi, Bahinyur’ ubu butumwa, Natwe tubushikamyemo, Dutegerez’ Umukiza.
3. Ijambo rye n’ itabaza, Ntituzigera tuyoba, N’ ubw’ amakub’ ari hose, Ntabw’ Iman’ izaduhana.
4. Dukor’ imirimo myiza, Twe guh’ ab’ iy’ is’ urwaho, Tuzabiherw’ imigisha, Nidukomeza kwizera.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mubonez’ amatabaza, Kandi nimwubah’ Imana, Kuza kw’ Umwami kuri hafi, Mubonez’ amatabaza.

title: Ujy’ Uvug’ Ibya Yesu
verses: 1. Ujy’ uvug’ ibya Yesu, Inshuti y’ ukuri, Ngwin’ uduhumurish’ ibyo yagukoreye.
2. Ujy’ uvug’ ibya Yes’ uzumv’ ubabariwe, No kubw’ ubuntu bwe tuzagera mw’ ijuru.
3. Sinabura kuvug’ iby’ umusaraba we, Nkund’ uwo Mukiza, Kuko yanyitangiye.
4. Uvug’ ibya Yesu, Ntupfush’ igih’ ubusa, Kutita ku nshingano, Bitesh’ agaciro.
5. Ujy’ uvug’ ibya Yesu, N’ ubwo wacogora, Va mu ntege nke zawe, Umwiyegurire.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Vuga Yesu gusa, Bizakuyobor’ iteka, Jy’ ubivug’ uririmba, Kandi unasenga.

title: Ushimirw’ Ibyiza Byose
verses: 1. Ushimirwe ibyiza byose, Siyoni murwa w’ Imana, Itavuguruzwa yakugiz’ ubuturo bwayo bwite, Wubatswe ku Rutare rw’ iteka, N’ iki cyaguhangara? Ugoteshejw’ inkike z’ agakiza, Reka gutiny’ abanzi bawe.

2. Dore amazi y’ ubugingo, Atemb’ ava mu rukundo, Ni y’ abeshahw’ abana bawe, Imibabar’ igashira. Ninde se wacogora, Har’ uwo mugez’ umar’ inyota? Ubuntu bw’ uwo Mutanga-bugingo, Ntabwo buzagir’ iherezo.

3. Ahazenguruts’ uwo murwa, Har’ ibicu n’ umuriro, Byerekana ko kugaruka kw’ Umwami kuri bugufi, Hahirw’ abazatur’ i Siyoni, Bejeshejw’ amaraso, Biyeguriye Yes’ abahindur’ abami, N’ abatambyi b’ Imana.

4. Ndi mu muryango w’ i Siyoni, Kubw’ ubuntu bwawe Mwami, N’ ubwo bampindur’ urw’ amenyo, Nzasingiz’ izina ryawe, Ibinezeza byo mur’ iyi si, Bihita nk’ umuyaga, Umunezero uhoraho, Wateguriw’ abana b’ i Siyoni.

title: Mbes’ Aho Tuzahurira Ku Cyambu?
verses: 1. Mbes’ aho tuzahurira ku cyambu cya rwa ruzi, Ahahor’ umucy’ iteka, Ntihab’ umubabaro?
2. Tuzahurira ku cyamb’ urugendo rurangiye? Mbes’ aho tuzahurirayo, Maze twiruhutse?
3. Mbes’ aho twese tuzahurira mu mudugudu, Wubatswe n’ Uhoraho, Urimbishijwe yasipi?
4. Abacunguwe bose, Bazaririmb’ indirimbo, Kand’ ibiremwa byose bizasingiz’ Uhoraho.
5. Mbes’ aho tuzabonana n’ abo twakundanaga, Maze twumv’ amajwi yabo tubareba mu maso?
6. Mbese tuzabonana na Krist’ Umukiza wacu, Aje kujyan’ intore ze, Mu bwami buhoraho?
chorus: Gusubiramo: Se koko tuzahurira hakurya y’uruzi? Tuzabonanirayo tuhanezererw’ iteka?

title: Abatuye Mw’ Isi Mwese
verses: 1. Abatuye mw’ isi mwese, Muririmbir’ Uhoraho, Mumukorere mwishima, Mwogez’ icyubahiro cye.
2. Mumenye kw’ ari we Mana, Kukw’ ari we waturemye, Twese tur’ umukumbi we, Turagiwe n’ Uhoraho.
3. Muze mwese mu rugo rwe, Muze mwese mumushima, Muhanik’ amajwi yanyu, Kukw’ ari byo bikwiriye.
4. Mwabaza muti: ni kuki? Nuk’ Uhoraho ari mwiza, N’ impuhwe ze zikaramba, Nta n’ ubwo zizashiraho.

title: Yesu Mucunguzi Wanjye
verses: 1. Yesu Mucunguzi wanjye, Ni we byishimo byanjye, Ni wowe ujy’ ungoboka, Mu bihe by’ amakuba.
2. Wagumye kumpumuriza, Mu bihe bibi byose, Ubwo nari nshumbirijwe, Ngoswe n’ imibabaro.
3. Ur’ ibyiringiro byanjye, Ndayob’ ukanyobora, Ni wowe nshuti y’ ukuri, Undutir’ abo mw’ isi.
4. Ni wow’ undem’ umutima, Mur’ iyi si y’ ibyaha, Nzakomeza ngusingize, Ngez’ ubwo nzaz’ iwawe.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yesu Mucunguzi wanjye, Ni we ndirimbo yanjye, Nta yindi nshuti nabona, Nagereranya na we.

title: Yasezeranye Kuduh’ Imvura
verses: 1. Yasezeranye kuduha, Imvura y’ umugisha, Iri sezerano ryayo, Ryaturutse mw’ ijuru.
2. Yasezeranye kuduha, Imvura y’ umugisha, Yitugoborer’ uyu muns’ ikwir’ impande zose.
3. Yasezeranye kuduha, Imvura y’ umugisha, Turayifuz’ uy’ umunsi, Sohoz’ ibyo wavuze.
4. Yasezeranye kuduha, Imvura y’ umugisha, Icyayiduh’ uyu munsi, Mana tubabarire.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Duh’ umugisha, Turifuz’ umugisha, Uvuy’ iwawe mw’ ijuru, Nyabuneka wuduhe.

title: Inkomangiro Yawe Yafata?
verses: 1. Inkomangiro yawe yafata, Umuraba w’ ibyag’ uguteye? Ukagukanagira nk’ ingoyi, Inkomangiro yaw’ izashikama?
2. Nib’ itsitse ntizateraganwa, Ifashwe n’ ukuboko k’ Umwami, Imirunga ye iraduhuza, Bitewe n’ imbaraga y’ ikomeye.
3. Izashikama mu gihe kibi, Ubw’ imivumb’ izab’ ihurura, Umuyaga w’ ishuher’ usheze, Ntabwo bizarenga ku bwato bwacu.
4. Ndetse no mu gihe kibi cyane, Twifuz’ amazi yaduhembura, Tuzatsika ku nkombe z’ ijuru, Umugar’ ushire buheriheri.
5. Ubw’ igitondo kizatangaza, N’ amarembo arabagirana, Tuzatsika ku nkombe z’ ijuru, Umugar’ ushire buheriheri.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Dufit’ inkomangir’ itsika, Imiraba yiyungikanya, Ikomangiye ku Rutare, Rushikamye, Umukiza wacu.

title: Nta Rindi Zina Nka Yesu
verses: 1. Nta rindi zina nka Yesu, N’ izina rihebuje, Rihimbar’ abo mw’ ijuru, N’ abakristo bo mw’ isi.
2. Nta rindi zina nka Yesu, Rimar’ imibabaro, Nta zina ryahwana n’ irye, Ndetse no mu mahoro.
3. Mfit’ ibyiringiro byo kuzamubon’ agarutse, Nizeye kw’ azanyakira, Maz’ akampumuriza.
4. Nib’ ashaka ko mukorera mu ruzabibu rwe, Azampira mu byo nkora, Kand’ ahir’ ibyo mvuga.
5. Nah’ urupfu rwanyegura, Kuko nd’ umukungugu, Ntacyo bizaba bintwaye, Niringiy’ Umukiza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Zina (zina) ryiza (ryiza), Nta rihwanye n’ irya Yesu, Zina (zina) ryiza (ryiza), Nta rihwanye n’ irya Yesu.

title: Singizwa Yesu
verses: 1. Singizwa Yesu, Umukiza Yazutse, Yesu yaneshej’ urupfu, Iteka ryose, Marayik’ ufit’ umucyo, Aramanuka, Yakinguye igituro, Yesu aranesha, Singizwa Yesu, Umukiza Yazutse, Yesu yaneshej’ urupfu, Iteka ryose.

2. Itegereze: Ni Yesu Umukiza, Umucunguzi w’ abantu, Ntushidikanye, Ishime kand’ uririmbe! Yesu ariho! Ongera ubyamamaze, Yesu ni muzima. Itegereze: Ni Yesu Umukiza, Umucunguzi w’ abantu, Ntushidikanye.

3. Nta bwoba mfite! Yesu ni muzima pe! Nzajya musingiz’ iteka, Mahoro yanjye. Yesu yaraneshereje ni we nizeye. Ni Yesu umbeshejeho, Sinzigera ntinya, Nta bwoba mfite! Yesu ni muzima pe! Nzajya musingiz’ iteka, Mahoro yanjye.

title: Nyir’ Impuhwe Nyinshi
verses: 1. Nyir‘ impuhwe nyinshi cyane, Iman‘ ibabarira, Kwibagirw‘ ibyaha ikababarir‘ uwagomye.
2. Nari kure y‘ uwo nkunda, Mbabaj‘ umutima we, Kuko namwimag’ ahw‘ aba, N‘ uwanjye yampfiriye.
3. Yesu ndakwiyeguriye, Ndashaka kubaturwa, Icyaha cyose cyambase, Maze ngikire rwose.
4. Haleluya yanduhuye, Ubu sinshidikanya, Nderekez‘ iyo mw‘ ijuru, Nejejwe no kubayo.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Ndaje Yesu, Ndakwitabye, Uko ndi kos‘ unyemere, Ndaje Yesu ndakwitabye, Mukiz‘ unyakire. T. na B.: Ndaje Yesu, Ndakwitabye, Uko ndi ko… unyemere, Ndaje Yesu, Ndakwitabye, Mukiz‘ unyakire.

title: Bazany’ Amaturo Yabo
verses: 1. Bazany’ amaturo yabo, Kuyatur’ Umwami Yesu, Kuko bari bamukunze, Maze barayamutura. Iyo neza n’ urukundo, Byafashij’ umukene, N’ amaturo yose batuye, Yar’ ay’ agaciro.
2. Umukene yar’ ahagaze, Kure y’ abaturaga, Maz’ abony’ uburyo batura, Agir’ umunezero. Yuzurwa n’ ibyishimo, By’ ayo maturo batuye, We, yar’ afit’ ituro rito, Imbere y’ Umwami.
3. Abwiran’ Umwam’ agahinda, Ati: Nz’ ineza yawe, Akir’ iri turo ngutuye, Ni ryo mutima wanjye, Yes’ asubiza yitonze, Ati: S’ ituro rito, N’ ubw’ abandi batuye menshi, Urabarengeje.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Muture Yes’ amaturo, Biramunezeza rwose, Muhay’ umutima wanjye, Ndamwiyeguriye.

title: Ari Hafi Kuza
verses: 1. Ari hafi kuza, Nahimbazwe Yesu, Azakorany’ abatoni be, Bajyane mw’ ijuru; Turebe mw’ ijuru, Twishime araje! Aje mu cyubahiro cye, Mucunguzi wacu.
2. Ari hafi kuza, Nahimbazwe Yesu, Imibabaro yacu yose, Ntizibukw’ ukundi, Yes’ azakuraho, Urupfu burundu, Azaza tuban’ iteka, Mucunguzi wacu.
3. Ari hafi kuza, Nahimbazwe Yesu, Azaz’ atungutse ku bicu, Ntidutinye rwose, Twubure amaso, Nguriya araje! Aje kujyana njye nawe, Mucunguzi wacu.

title: Ndakwifuza Yesu Mwiza
verses: 1. Ndifuza Yesu Mwiza, Ndagukennye cyane, Nd’ umushyitsi n’ umwimukira, Singira gakondo, Ndifuz’ urukundo, Rwawe rumpumuriza, Runyobora ngakomera cyane, Sintezuke.
2. Ndifuz’ umutima wa Yesu ngo nduhuke, Ng’ untere kumutur’ imibabaro yanjye yose, Ndifuz’ Umwuka Wera, Ngw’ ambwir’ icyo ndi cyo, Arusheho kunyereka Umwana w’ Intama.
3. Ndakwifuza Yesu, Nshaka kuzakubona, Ugoswe n’ umukororombya ku ntebe ya cyami, Nzahora nezeranywe n’ abo wacunguye, Nzahora ngusingiz’ iteka, Ndi kumwe nawe.

title: Iby’ Ushaka Nibibeho
verses: 1. Mukiza naraguhemukiye, Ndanakwimura ku mpamvu nkeya, Utungany’ umutima wanjy’ iby’ ushaka bibe.
2. Nari mfit’ imibabaro myinshi, Ntakir’ inshuti nahemukiye, N’ ubu ngubu ndacyavuga, Nt’ iby’ ushaka bibe.
3. Umwuka  waw’ utangir’ ubuntu, Agenderer’ umutima wanjye, Humuriz’ umutima wanjy’ ibyushaka bibe.
4. Hindur’ ubugingo bwanjye bushya, Ubutegeke bub’ uk’ ushaka, Ndind’ ibimbuza kuvuga, Iby’ ushaka bibe.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Iby’ ushaka (ushaka), nibibeho (bibeho), Utungany’ umutima wanjye, Iby’ ushaka bibe.

title: Haba Ubwo Umwijima Ubudika
verses: 1. Hab’ ubw’ umwijim’ ubudika, Maze nkabur’ inzira pe, Ibyago bikiyongeranya, Bikantera no kwiheba.
2. Hab’ umunsi umbera mubi, Natambuka ngateguza, Nuko nkumva nguy’ agacuho, Maze nkisunga Rutare.
3. Nzanikomeza ku Rutare, Nibwo nzashir’ agahinda, Ni rwo ruzanshoboz’ inzira, Zirimw’ ibihanamanga.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nzahungira kuri Yesu (kuri Yesu), Kukw’ ari w’ undush’ imbaraga (imbaragaa), Nzahungira kuri Yesu (kuri Yesu), Kukw’ ari w’ undush’ imbaraga.

title: Nimusingize Umukiza
verses: 1. Nimusingiz’ Umukiza, Mumurebe mukire, Ni w’ ukiz’ inzimizi zazimiriye mu byaha; Abacits’ intege bose, Abonger’ imbaraga, Abah’ amazi y’ ubugingo mez’ amar’ inyota.
2. Nimusingiz’ uwo Mukiza, Mwese mumuramye, Abamushakan’ umwete, Na bo azabakira, Bavuy’ impande zose, Bihuta banezerewe, Batwaye umusaraba wa Yesu, Abakize.
3. Nimumuh’ icyubahiro, Niwe Mwana w’ Imana, Ndetse n’ abatamwitaho, Arabiyegereza, Ngo bajye bibuk’ umusaraba yatangiyeho, Bib’ uruhererekane mu bantu, Bamuramye.
4. Mumusingize mu ndirimbo, No mu masengesho, Umucunguzi wikoreye ibyaha by’ abantu, Abato n’ abakuru bamwubahe, Bamuramye, Abafit’ ubumuga bazakizwa kubwa Yesu.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Abantu bose basingiz’ Umukiza wazutse, Musingiz’ uwo Mukiza, Ubavana mu byaha.

title: Hari Igihugu Kibamo Umucyo
verses: 1. Har’ igihugu kibamw’ umucyo urabagirana, Ntabwo habayo umwijima, Yesu n’ umucyo waho.
2. Ibihe byaho ni byiza rwose, Nta mpinduk’ ibayo, Ntabwo habay’ impagarara, Tuhabik’ ubutunzi.
3. Mw’ ijuru hariy’ amazu meza arabagirana, Tuzahahurira n’ inshuti, Twakiranw’ ibyishimo.
4. Twifuza cyane kwimuka vuba, Mur’ iyi s’ ishaje, Tujye guturana n’ abera, Maze dut’ umuruho.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Twemer’ umusaraba, Tuzambikw’ ikamba, Dukomez’ iby’ ukuri, Nibwo tuzagerayo. T. na B.: Twemer’ u ... sa - saraba, Tuzambikw’ ika... ikamba, Dukome... by’ u... by’ ukuri, Ni bwo tuzagerayo.

title: Nyobora Mwami Wanjye
verses: 1. Nyobora Mwami wanjye (Mwami wanjye), Ne kurorongotana (mbane nawe), Mb’ amahor’ unyoboye (unyoboye), Iyo nkuri bugufi (nkuri bugufi).
2. Iyo ngeze mu kaga (ncits’ intege) Umber’ ubuhungiro (buhungiro), Nyakiran’ imbabazi (imbabazi), Nezerwa turi kumwe (turi kumwe).
3. Ntabara Mwami mwiza (Mwami mwiza), Mu mibabaro yanjye (yanjye yose ), Kugez’ ubwo nzager’ aho (nzager’ aho ), Ntazarir’ ukundi (ntazarir’ ukundi).
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mukiza we, Mpabura nahabiye kure, Unyambutse mw’ isumo (mw’ isumo), Mwami  ngendane nawe (nawe ).

title: Mbese Ngend’ Imbokoboko?
verses: 1. Mbese ngend’ imbokoboko, Nsanganiy’ Umukiza wanjye? Nta cyiza namukoreye, Mbese ngend’ imbokoboko?
2. Sinterw’ ubwoba n’ urupfu, Umukiza yarankijije. Ku musanga ntacyo mfite, Numva binkojej’ isoni.
3. Napfushij’ igih’ ubusa, Nakoz’ ibyangwa n’ Umukiza, Ubu ndamutakambira, Musaba kumbabarira.
4. Mwebw’ abera mushishikare, Mukore hakiri kare, Dor’ ijoro riraguye, Mutarakiz’ imitima.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mbese ngende ntacyo mfite, Nsanganir’ uwo Mwami wanjye, Nta n’ umwe namukirije, Mbese ngende ntacyo mfite?

title: Umwana W’ Imana
verses: 1. Umwana w’ Imana yaje mw’ isi kumpfira kukw’ ankunda; Ese s’ igitangaza gihebuj’ urukundo rwe rwinshi?
2. Iteka ryos’ amaraso atunganye niy’ anyejesha; Kubw’ impuhwe za Yesu, Yangiz’ umwana w’ iteka ryose.
3. Uzi kamere yanjye yose, Unyobora buri munsi. Ngendera mu mucyo waw’ iteka, Kubw’ urukundo rwawe.
4. Yesu Kristo ntahinduka, Aragukiz’ uk’ uri kose. Zan’ umutim’ umenetse, Arakwakir’ uk’ uri kose.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yesu yarankunze bihebuje rwose: Yabambwe ku musaraba, Yesu yarankunze. Yarazutse ku bwanjye, Koko Yes’ arankunda. Yampeshej’ icyubahiro, Yesu yarankunze. Yabambwe ku musaraba, Yesu yarankunze.

title: Yesu Ntabwo Yakwanga
verses: 1. Yesu ntabwo yakwanga, N’ ubw’ ur’ umunyabyaha, Ni we nshut’ ihebuje, Ntazanga kukwakira, Imana yatanze Yesu, Kugira ngo ducungurwe, N’ ubwo wamuhemukiye, Ntazanga kukwakira.
2. N’ ubw’ ujy’ umugayisha, Ntazakwirengagiza, Ni we nzira n’ umucyo, Ntazanga kukwakira, Azagusendahw’ ibyaha, maz’ usigar’ utunganye, Azagukiz’ urupfu, Ntabw’ azakwirengagiza.
3. Ngaho ngwin’ utiganda, Ntazanga kukwakira, Gana ku musaraba, Ntazanga kukwakira, Numara gusanga Yesu, Ntuzasubira mu byaha, Ngwino uhabw’ ubugingo, Butagir’ iherezo.

title: Uhoraho Iyo Nitegereje
verses: 1. Uhoraho, Iyo nite gereje, Ibitangaza by’ ibyo wakoze, Ar’ izuba, ukwezi n’ inyenyeri, N’ ibindi bintu byose waremye.
2. Mana nkunda, Iyo nitegereje, Igiti cyose mu byo waremye, Binyibutsa igiti cy’ i Kalvari, Umwana wawe yambambiweho.
3. Iyo numva inyoni ziririmba mu biti byiza yaturemeye, Urusobe rw’ amajwi yazo meza n’ urw’ amasumo biranezeza.
4. Igih’ ibyago bizaba bishize, Abera bose bagukikije, Tuzagusingiza iteka ryose, Kandi turamy’ Uwatwitangiye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nishimira kukuririmbira, Mana  nkuru y’ urukundo; Nishimira kukuririmbira, Mana  nkuru, y’ urukundo.

title: Nzasa Na Yesu
verses: 1. N’ ubw’ ibyiza by’ isi byanshuka, Nzasa na Yesu, Ntacyo mw’ isi kizampindura, Nzasa na Yesu.
2. Nabohow’ ingoyi z’ umwanzi, Nzasa na Yesu, Nzarushaho kumukorera, Nzasa na Yesu.
3. Naba mw’ isi cyangwa mw’ ijuru, Nzasa na Yesu, Nzahora mbyamamaz’ iteka, Nzasa na Yesu.
4. Kugira ngo nzajye mw’ ijuru, Nzasa na Yesu, Kuko nifuza kuzashimwa, Nzasa na Yesu.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nzasa na Yesu rwose, Ni yo ndirimbo yanjye, Ndi hanze n’ imuhira, Nzajya nsa na Yesu.

title: Iyi Si Ni Iya Data
verses: 1. Iyi si n’ iya Data, Kand’ iyo ntez’ amatwi, Numv’ ibiremwa bisingiza izina rye mu ndirimbo, Isi n’ iya Data, Mpora mbitekereza, Iby’ Uhoraho yaremye byose, Ni byiza bitangaje.
