2. Iyi si n’ iya Data, Inyoni ziririmba, Umuseke wa mu gitondo, N’ impumuro y’ uburabyo, Ibimera byose, Hamwe n’ ibyo mw’ ijuru, Byose bigaragaz’ ububasha, N’ imbaraga ze nyinshi.
3. Iyi si n’ iya Data, N’ ubwo yuzuy’ ibyaha, Nta kizaganz’ imbaraga ze, Azahor’ ari ku ngoma, Isi n’ iya Data, Mbese nakwiganyira? Imana yac’ izahora ku ngom’ ibihe bidashira.
4. Iyi si n’ iya Data, Ntabwo nzabyibagirwa, N’ ubw’ ibyaha biyuzuyemo, Imana n’ umuyobozi, Isi n’ iya Data, Ni kuki nababara? Data ni we uri ku ngoma, Ijuru n’ isi byishime.

title: Duhaguruke
verses: 1. Nimuhaguruke mwa bantu mwe, Yes’ arabayobora (nimuze)! Rangurura bwoko bukomeye, I Siyoni hadaterwa (Siyoni heza hadaterwa).
2. Abera n’ intwari baririmbe, Baranesheje cyane (nk’ intwari). Dor’ ibendera ritur’ imbere, Banesheje muri Yesu ( ry’ abanesheje muri Yesu).
3. Benshi bayobejwe na Satani, Babuz’ ubatabara (nimuze)! Nimwambar’ intwari mutabare, Muyobowe n’ Umukiza (Muyobowe n’ uwo Mukiza).
4. Nimurangurur’ amajwi yanyu, Ko Yesu yanesheje (Satani). Mutarur’ izo nzimizi zose, Zirebe ku musaraba (Zize zireb’ umusaraba).
chorus: Gusubiramo: (Nimuririmb’ indirimbo); Nimuririmb’ indirimbo, Nk’ inkubi yo mu nyanja; Ko twakijijwe na Yesu, Uturusha kunesha. Aturusha kunesha (n’ umuneshi), Aturusha kunesha (kunesha n’ umuneshi). Ko twakijijwe na Yesu, Uturusha kunesha.

title: Bona N’ Ubwo Ngoswe N’ Ibicu
verses: 1. Bona n’ ubwo ngoswe n’ ibicu, Kandi nkab’ inkehwe, Kandi nkaba ndembejwe n’ amaganya menshi cyane. Gubiramo: Nagira Yesu wenyine, Byose byatamuruka, Ni we zuba ryaka nk’ inyenyeri y’ i Betelehemu.
2. N’ ubw’ urugendo rwo mw’ isi rwantera gucogora, Najya gusingir’ uburabyo, Ngasingir’ amahwa.
3. N’ ubw’ umutima wanjye, Wazirikan’ Uwankunze, Bigatuma ngir’ agahinda, Kenshi nkababara.
4. Nzirikany’ icyubahiro, Ntegereje kwinjira, Navuga Yesu wenyine, Byose byatamuruka.

title: Intama Mirongo Cyenda N’ Icyenda
verses: 1. Intama mirongo cyenda n’ icyenda, Zari mu kiraro cyazo, Imwe yazimiye yararagiye, Yagiye mu bihanamanga, Dor’ irazerera mu kidaturwa, Yasiz’ Umwungeri w’ impuhwe nyinshi, Yasiz’ Umwungeri w’ impuhwe nyinshi.

2. Ufite mirongo cyenda n’ icyenda, Mbese warets’ iyo Mwami, Aransubiz’ ati : Na yo n’ iyanjye, Ibarirwa mu ntama zanjye, Bona nahw’ inzira yakukumuka, Ndayikurikira mu kidaturwa, Ndebe ko nabasha kuyibonayo.

3. Nta muntu wamenya uko yarushye, N’ uko yambuts’ imigezi, Ryar’ ijoro ribi kandi ntaw’ uzi, Uko yataruy’ iyo ntama, Yumvis’ ijwi ryayo mu kidaturwa, Ntabwo yagirag’ uwayitabara, Rwose yar’ isigaje hat’ igapfa.

4. Mwami nyerek’ inzira wanyuzemo, Mbonemw’ amaraso yawe, Yavuye ku bwacu twarazimiye, Maz’ utugarura mu bushyo, Nyereka za nkovu zo mu biganza, Wakomerekejwe mur’ iryo joro, N’ igihe bakwambikaga ya mahwa.

5. Ku misozi hose no mu bikombe, No ku bitare ku manga, Har’ ijwi rirenga ngo nimwishime, Intama yanjye yabonetse, Abamarayika bavuga bati: Nimwishim’ Umwam’ abony’ intama ye, Nimwishim’ Umwam’ abony’ intama ye.

title: Mu Gihugu Cyiza Twasezeraniwe
verses: 1. Mu gihugu cyiza twasezeraniwe, Hariy’ ururembo rwera rw’ Imana, Tuzamuk’ imisozi tunaniwe, Tukarabukw’ aho tuzab’ iteka.
2. Mu bitabo by’ abahanuzi tubwirwa, Iby’ umudugudu wera w’ Imana, N’ inzira zaho zisizwe zahabu, Amazu yahw’ ararabagirana.
3. Abazajyayo n’ abizera bakeya, Bakomez’ amategeko y’ Imana, Tuzahora turangurur’ amajwi, Turirimb’ indirimbo z’ ibyishimo.
4. Mbese tuzahurirayo bene Data, Mu gihugu kirasirwa n’ izuba? Nimwemera ubutumwa bw’ Imana, Yesu naza azabahamagara.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Tugeze hafi, Hafi y’ iwacu, Dore hararabagirana cyane, Har’ umucy’ uturuka mu marembo, Aho ni ho tuzab’ iteka ryose, Turirimbana n’ abamarayika, Turi hafi yaho. T. na B.: Tuge… tugeze y’ iwacu, Hafi y’ iwacu, Dore hararabagirana cyane, Har’ umucy’ uturuka mu marembo, Aho ni ho tuzab’ iteka ryose, Turirimbana n’ abamarayika, Turi, turi hafi …ho.

title: Wiringir’ Umwam’ Imana
verses: 1. Wiringir’ Umwam’ Imana, Kukw’ ari y’ izakuyobora, Izere Nyir’ imigisha, Ni w’ uzagukenura.
2. Wiringir’ Umwam’ Imana, Umushukanyi nakwegera, Wiringir’ Umwam’ Imana, Ujy’ uyihungiraho.
3. Wiringir’ Umwam’ Imana, Mu birushya no mu makuba, Wiringir’ Umwam’ Imana, Yih’ umutwaro wawe.
4. Wiringir’ Umwam’ Imana, Mu mibereho yawe yose, Wiringir’ Umwam’ Imana, Kugez’ ahw’ azazira.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Izer’ uko yakubwiye, Yihang’ amas’ iteka ryose, Uyiringire ibihe byose, Ni yo Mwungeri wawe.

title: Habuka Wa Mpabe We
verses: 1. Habuka wa mpabe we, Urahamagarwa, Rek’ ibyaha byawe ngwino, Wikwinangira.
2. Umukiz’ arakwinginga, Ntiwinangire, Umv’ araguhamagara, Mukingurire.
3. Uraritswe n’ ubutumwa, We kwinangira, Bukuzaniy’ agakiza, Bukingurire.
4. We kwigomw’ umunezero, Ngo winangire, Nibw’ uzagir’ amahoro, Mukingurire.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ngwino hakirih’ umucyo, Yes’ aragutegereje, Aramburiy’ amaboko, Abe bahabye.

title: Yesu Ndagutakambiye
verses: 1. Yesu ndagutakambiye, Kuk’ utantabaye napfa, Ungeze ku gakiza kawe, Unyakir’ uko ndi.
2. Ntabwo ngira kivurira, Arikw’ amaraso yawe, Ni yo yangize uk’ ushaka, Unyakir’ uko ndi.
3. Sinabasha kwitegura, Nguhay’ imigambi yanjye, Unkize kubw’ izina ryawe, Unyakir’ uko ndi.
4. Dore Mwami nje ku birenge byaw’ ungir’ uk’ ushaka, Utungany’ umurimo wawe, Unyakir’ uko ndi.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Unyakir’ uko ndi, Unyakir’ uko ndi, Mwami  wanjye warampfiriye, Unyakir’ uko ndi.

title: Yesu Ni Umukiza Wanjye
verses: 1. Yesu n’ Umukiza wanjy’ utangaje, Kuko andutira byose, Ni we wampagaritse ku Rutare, Mpaboner’ umunezero.
2. Yesu n’ Umukiza wanjy’ utangaje, Antur’ imitwaro yose, Arankomeza sinzanyeganyega, Kukw’ ahor’ ambumbatiye.
3. Ansesurahw’ imigisha nk’ ikamba, Anyuzuz’ ubugwaneza, Ndirimba ntikenga nsingiz’ Imana, Ni yo Mucunguzi wanjye.
4. Ninambara kurabagirana kwe, Nibwo nzamusanganira, Nzajya ndirimbana n’ abacunguwe, Indirimbo y’ agakiza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ni we wampagaritse ku Rutare, Mu gihugu cy’ umutarwe, Kand’ ampisha mu rukundo rwe rwinshi, Andindish’ ukuboko kwe, Andindish’ ukuboko kwe.

title: Isi Ni Iy’ Uhoraho
verses: 1. Isi n’ iy’ Uwiteka, Tumusingize twese, Imisozi n’ inyanja n’ ibirimo byose, Isi n’ iy’ Uwiteka, Bose bamuramye, Imidugudu n’ ibiyaga byose n’ ibye.
2. Isi n’ iy’ Uwiteka tuyibimenyeraho, Mpabe nimuhabuke mwe kuyob’ inzira, Isi n’ iy’ Uwiteka ntimugacogore, Umusaraba ni wo watuneshereje.
3. Isi n’ iy’ Uwiteka, Itegeko n’ iri ngo: Mugende, Mwamamaze ubutumwa bwiza, Isi n’ iy’ Uwiteka, Ganz’ iteka Mwami, Amahanga yose ahor’ agusingiza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Isi yose, Isi yose, Yamamaz’ ubutumwa bwiza bwa Yesu, Mutwar’ umusaraba, Mushing’ ibendera, Kugez’ ubw’ abantu bose bazihana. Amen. (Ku gice cya 3).

title: Yesu Arakomang’ Ubu
verses: 1. Yesu arakomang’ ubu, Mukingurire? Aringing’ umutima wanjye, Se mukingurire? Muri wo harimw’ ibyaha, N’ umwijima n’ agahinda. Kristo ashaka ko musanga, Se mukingurire?
2. Se mubwiran’ urukundo, Mukingurire? Nakir’ uwo Mwami w’ ubuntu, Se mukingurire? Ntantererana na hato, Ambabarir’ ubugome. Mbese namwimura burundu, Cyangwa munambeho?
3. Umutima w’ ubwibone, Ndawukinguye. Mwakirany’ ibyishimo byinshi, Ndamukinguriye. Mukiza mwiza tubane, Undind’ ibishuko byose, Mb’ amahor’ iyo turi kumwe, Ngwino Mwami Yesu.

title: Nimushimir’ Imbabazi Za Yesu
verses: 1. Nimwishimir’ imbabazi za Yesu, Kuko yatwicunguriye, Ntacyo twatinya Yes’ ashobora byose, Ni we Mukiza wacu.
2. Mukomerere mu Mwami  wacu Yesu mub’ abakiranutsi, Mu kaga kose muhagarare mushikamy’ azabakomeza.
3. Nimwiringire Yesu mukomez’ amategeko ye by’ ukuri, Is’ izashira arikw’ amategeko y’ azahorahw’ iteka.
4. Tuzibanira n’ Umwami wacu Yesu azaduh’ ubugingo, Kandi nta muntu wabasha kudutesh’ uwo Mukiz’ umez’ atyo.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Sop.: Mbese ubw’ Imana, Iri mu ruhande rwacu, Umubisha wacu ninde! Ninde? Umubisha wacu Se ninde? Alto: Mbese ubw’ Imana, Iri mu ruhande rwacu, Umubisha wacu ninde! Ninde? Yaba nde koko? Umubisha wacu Se ninde? T. na B.: Mbes’ ubw’ Imana yac’ iri mu ruhande rwacu, Umubisha wacu ni - se! Ninde? Yaba nde koko? Umubisha wacu Se ninde?

title: Har’ Ijwi Rihamagara
verses: 1. Har’ ijwi rihamagar’ abarushye, Mubamurikire (Mubamu-rikire), Harihw’ abatabaza ngo bakizwe, Mubamurikire (Mubamu-rikire)
2. Harihw’ abatabariza gukizwa, Mubamurikire (Mubamu-rikire), Tuzan’ amaturo ku musaraba, Ngo bamurikirwe (Ngo bamu-rikirwe).
3. Ubuntu bwa Yesu bugwire hose, Mubamurikire (Mubamu-rikire), Kand’ Umwuka wa Yes’ ukwire hose, Mubamurikire (Mubamu-rikire).
4. Twe gucogorera gukora neza, Tubamurikire (Tubamu-rikire), Twitegurire kuzahabw’ ikamba, Tubamurikire (Tubamu-rikire).
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Nimubamurikishirize umucyo w’ ubutumwa, Bamenyeshe ko Yes’ ari we wabapfiriye bose. T. na B.: Nimubamurikishirize ...cyo w’ ubutumwa, Bamenyeshe ko Yes’ ari we, ....pfiriye bose.

title: Mutim’ Ufit’ Intege Nke
verses: 1. Mutim’ ufit’ intege nke, Harih’ uburuhukiro, N’ iwacu hadahinduka, Se ntiwifuza kubayo?
2. Ubw’ uzatur’ umutwaro, Ibyo mw’ isi birangiye, Uzashyikir’ agakiza, Tegerez’ utivovota.
3. Nib’ amahw’ ari mu nzira, Tekerez’ uwayambitswe, N’ ubabara wibuke k’ Uwera, Nawe yababajwe.
4. Ujy’ uhora wihanganye, Ntukibagirwe gusenga, Harih’ ubw’ uzaruhuka, Tegerez’ utivovota.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Wa munyantege nke we, Tegereza, Kandi nturambirwe, B’ uretse, Tegereza, Ntukivovote (Alto: Ntukivo… Ntukivovote). T. na B.: Wa mu…, Wowe munyantege nke we, Tegereza n’ ukuri; Kandi nturambirwe, B’ uretse, B’ uretse, Tege – Utege - reza, Tenor: Ntukivo - Ntukivovote. Bass: Ntuki - vote.

title: Ubugingo Bw’ Abantu
verses: 1. Ubugingo bw’ abantu, Buhita nk’ igicucu, Imbere yawe Mwami Mana, Buhita n’ ingoga.
2. Umunt’ ab’ afit’ izina rimutey’ ishema, Imyaka yamara guhita, Rikibagirana.
3. Ya nyenyeri y’ Umukiza y’ i Betelehemu, Natw’ ibasha kutuyobora, Tukamugeraho.
4. Mwami  Mana komez’ iyo nyenyer’ imurike, Umucyo way’ ukwire hose, Umwijim’ uhunge.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ye ni koko, Burihuta, Rwose bwihuta nk’ igicucu, N’ iby’ ukuri nta mumaro, Ubugingo bwacu n’ ubusa.

title: Ndabatuwe Sinkibabaye
verses: 1. Ndabatuwe sinkibabaye, Yesu ndaje, Yesu ndaje, Nje mu munezero iwawe, Ubu Yesu ndaje, Nje nifuza gufashwa nawe, Ngutuy’ intege nke zanjy’ unkize, Mvuye mu byaha nje nkugana, Ubu Yesu ndaje.
2. Nkijijw’ isoni sinihebye, Yesu ndaje, Yesu ndaje, Nemey’ umusaraba wawe, Ubu Yesu ndaje, Mvuye mu mibabaro y’ isi, Ubu ngeze mu mahoro yawe, Simbabaye ndanezerewe, Ubu Yesu ndaje.
3. Nkiz’ imiruho n’ ubwibone, Yesu ndaje, Yesu ndaje, Nje kuba mu mahoro yawe, Ubu Yesu ndaje, Nje kuba mu rukundo iwawe, Sinkihebye nje mu munezero, Nj’ ah’ uri nguruka nk’ inuma, Ubu Yesu ndaje.
4. Wamaz’ ubwoba bw’ igituro, Yesu ndaje, Yesu ndaje, Nje mu munezero w’ iwawe, Ubu Yesu ndaje, Wanyaruye mw’ irimbukiro, Ungeza mu mahor’ adashira, Ngo mpore nkureba mu maso, Ubu Yesu ndaje.

title: Ni Wowe Gusa
verses: 1. Ni wowe gusa nkeneye, Nta wundi Mwami. Har’ undi mfite mw’ ijuru, Mwam’ atari wowe?
2. N’ ubwo mfit’ inshuti nyinshi, N’ ibyiza byinshi, Utabirimo Mukiza, Nta mumaro wabyo.
3. Mbese harih’ umutima wuzuy’ ineza? Cyangw’ ijwi ryiza nakumva rikampumuriza?
4. Iby’ isi ntabwo byantanya nawe Mukiza, Ibyo mur’ iyi si byose, Nta mumaro wabyo.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ni wowe (ni wowe), Ni wowe (ni wowe), Wanyerets’ urukundo, Ni wowe (ni wowe), Ni wowe (ni wowe), Ntaw’ uhwanye nawe.

title: Munsi Mwiza Wejejwe
verses: 1. Munsi mwiza wejejwe, W’ icyumweru cyo kurema, Wagizw’ uwa karindwi, Wahiriwe n’ Imana.
2. Irangije kurema, Ishyiraho n’ Isabato, Iman’ irayihira, Natwe tuyiruhuke.
3. Benshi barwany’ Imana, Baruhuka kuwa mbere. Shaka mu Byanditsw’ urasanga nta habihamya.
4. Abanyakuri bazi ko wahinduwe n’ umuntu, Ntabw’ Ijambo ry’ Imana rikwiye guhinduka.
5. Nashatse mu Byanditswe, Nsang’ ari yo yategetswe. Mpera ko nyiruhuka, Kukw’ ari yo y’ ukuri.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ngwino Sabato, Sabato nziza, Tuboner’ imigisha, Mu munsi w’ Uhoraho.

title: Gitare Kirekire
verses: 1. Gitare kirekire njya mpungiraho, Ni wow’ umutima wanjye wifuza, Nd’ umunyantege nke nshaka kukwisunga, Wowe Gitare cyanjye, Nkwihishemo.
2. Ngiz’ imibabaro ku manywa y’ ihangu, Nizingiweho n’ ibigeragezo, Ndengewe n’ imiraba yiyungikanya, Wowe Gitare cyanjye, Nkwihishemo.
3. Umwanz’ anyibasiye ndi ku rugamba, Ni wowe mpungiraho nkaruhuka, Iyo nibasiwe n’ ibigeragezo, Niwe nihishamo, Gitare cyanjye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nkwihishemo, Nkwihishemo, Wowe Gitare cyanjye, Nkwihishemo.

title: Mpisemo Umukiza Yesu
verses: 1. Mpisem’ Umukiza Yesu gusa, Kurut’ ubutunzi bwo mur’ iyi si, Andutir’ ifeza n’ izahabu, Ikiganza cye cyarambambiwe.
2. Mpisemo Yesu kurut’ ikuzo, No kumukorera nivuy’ inyuma, Andutir’ icyubahiro cy’ isi, Nkunda kwitirirwa izina Rye.
3. Arush’ ibiremwa byos’ ubwiza, Anyur’ umutima kuruta byose, Azah’ umutima wanjy’ ibyiza, Nimwemerera akanyobora.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Rwos’ aho kwitw’ umunt’ ukomeye, Kandi nd’ umunyabyaha; Nahitamo kub’ uworoheje, Ariko nd’ uwa Yesu.

title: Amahoro masa
verses: 1. Umutima wanjy’ urasingiz’ Imana, Mu ndirimbo y’ umunezero, Nifitiy’ amahoro ava mw’ ijuru, Yuzuye mu mutima wanjye.
2. Nifitiy’ amahor’ arut’ ubutunzi, Yuzuye mu mutima wanjye, Kandi nta muntu wabasha kuyanyaga, Ntawe n’ aho yakwigir’ ate!
3. Yambereye ubuhungiro nijoro, Bituma mb’ uwa Yesu gusa, Nta cyampangara ku manywa na nijoro, Ntacyo rwose haba na gito!
4. Reka mvug’ ibya wa mudugudu mwiza, Uwo nzabona nkanezerwa, Mu ndirimb’ abera bazaharirimbir’ imwe n’ iyi ngiyi wumva ngo:
5. N’ ubwo nanyuraga mu makuba y’ isi, Nkabur’ umunt’ umpumuriza, Umukiza wanjye n’ inshuti y’ ukuri, Yangoteshej’ amaboko ye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Amahoro masa, Aturuka ku Mana gusa, Nyamuneka tungany’ ubugingo bwanjye, N’ urukundo rutarondorwa.

title: Yesu Ni We Niringira
verses: 1. Yesu ni we niringira, Ni we butunzi bwanjye, Nzakwishingikirizaho, Kugez’ igihe nzapfa, Ni wowe umbeshejeho kuko ump’ amahoro, Ni wow’ ump’ umunezero, Ur’ ubuzima bwanjye.
2. Niba bikwiriye kureb’ umusaraba wawe, Ngira intungane nkunde amategeko yawe, Ntawe unaniza ngw’ akor’ ibyo adashoboye, Ntacyo wasaba ng’ umuntu abon’ icyakwitura.
3. Njye ndashaka kugendera mu mucyo wawe Yesu, Ngo nzazuke nigira iwawe mw’ ijuru heza. Aho ni ho hari igihugu nzabamw’ iteka, Ni ho Yesu azanyakira ari mu ngoro ye.

title: Igitekerezo Cyiza
verses: 1. Igitekerezo cyiza cya Yesu Mukiza, Kivug’ uburyo yahoranye n’ abantu, N’ uko yahamagarag’ abana nk’ intama ze, Maze bigatuma nkumbura Yesu, Numva nifuza kw’aba yaranshyizehw’ ibiganza, Ngw’abe yaranzengurukij’ amaboko, Yemwe mba narahiriw’ iyo numv’ avug’ ati: Nimurek’ abana bato bansange!

2. Nzeger’ intebe ye ngo mutur’ amasengesho, Maze musabe kuba mu rukundo rwe, Kand’ uko ndushaho kumushaka mur’ iyi si, Nizeye ko nzamubona mw’ ijuru. Yagiye mw’ ijuru guteguray’ amazu meza, Azaturwamo n’ abacunguwe gusa. Abana benshi bazaba bateraniyeyo, Kuk’ ubwami bwo mw’ ijuru ar’ ubwabo.

3. Abantu benshi bazimiriye mur’ iyi si, Ntabwo barumv’ inkuru y’ iwacu heza, Ndifuza ko bamenya ko har’ umwanya wabo, Kandi Yesu ni w’ ubahamagara. Ndifuza kuzishima kur’ uwo munsi mukuru, Uzab’ ar’ umuns’ urut’ iyindi yose. Ubw’ abana bo mw’ isi yose bazaterana, Akabaher’ umugish’ icyarimwe.

title: Urukundo Yes’ Ankunda
verses: 1. Urukundo Yes’ ankunda, Rwatumy’ abambwa ku giti, Kugira ngo nkomeze kubaho, Ntawarurondora.
2. Uburyo yambabarijwe, Yambitsw’ ikamba ry’ amahwa, Kugira ngo nkomeze kubaho, Nta wabirondora.
3. Mfit’ amahoro muri we, Kukw’ ansabira kuri Se, Uko yankirishij’ amaraso, Nta wabirondora.
4. Iyo ndi kumwe na Yesu, Amber’ uburuhukiro, Ibyiringiro mfite muri We, Nta wabirondora.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yankunz’ urukundo rwinshi (urukundo rwinshi), Yankunz’ urukundo rwinshi (urukundo rwinshi), Urukundo Umukiz’ ankunda, Nta warurondora.

title: Umwami Arakomanga
verses: 1. Umwam‘ arakomanga, Ashaka kubana nawe, Mbeg‘ ibyishimo kubana na we! Kingurira uwo Mwami.
2. Witinya kumusanga! Araguh‘ ibyiringiro, N‘ ibyishimo mu mutima wawe. Ese ntubona umucyo?
3. Kumwakira ni byiza, N‘ ukubabarirwa na we, N‘ ijuru Imana iguhaye, Araguha amahoro.
4. Ahagaze ku rugi, Ashak‘ umutima wawe. Mbeg‘ ibyishimo umwakiriye, Akakubera Umwami.

title: Reka Yesu Yinjire Mu Mutima Wawe
verses: 1. Reka Yesu yinjire mu mutima wawe maz’ akuruhure, Niba wifuz’ ubugingo bushya, Umwakire mu mutima.
2. Nib’ ushaka kumutunganira, Umwemerere akuzemo, Hafi yawe har’ isoko yeza, Sanga Yes’ agutunganye.
3. Nushaka kuzamuririmbira, Umwemerere akuzemo, Nib’ ushaka kuzabana na we, Umwakire mu mutima.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ubu wishidikanya, Reka kumwihakana, Muh’ umutima wawe, Wumwegurire burundu.

title: Umunsi W’ Umuzuko
verses: 1. Umunsi w‘ umuzuko, Umuns‘ utangaje, Hazab‘ umunezero, Tuzabon‘ Imana, Abera bazakangurwa, Bazamurwe mu bicu, Baririmb‘ indirimbo, Nziza yo kunesha.
2. Tuzezwa imitima, Tuzabona Yesu, Tuzabana n‘ Imana mu mucy‘ utazima, Tuzahora duhimbaza, Dushim‘ Imana yacu, Yo yatuneshereje, Iduh‘ agakiza.
3. Wa juru we ishime, Wa si we ririmba, Abanambye ku Mana, Baranesherejwe, Ibindi biremwa na byo, Byishime binezerwe, Umwami  wacu Yesu, Nasingizw‘ iteka.

title: Ntukumvir’ Umubi
verses: 1. Ntukumvir’ umubi ujy’ agushuka, Umwumviye wese ab’ acumuye, Wamutsinda none kubw’ Umukiza, Byagufash’ ubundi kujy’ umunesha.
2. Wirind’ ubucuti bw’ abantu babi, Bakunda kukoshya gukor’ ibibi. Ntukavug’ ijambo ritey’ isoni, Ujye wubaha izina ry’ Imana.
3. Ujy’ ugira neza, Ufash’ abandi, Wirinde kubeshya, Ahubw’ ujy’ uba, Inyangamugayo kukw’ iby’ aribyo, Bikundwa na Yesu, Uzagufasha.
4. Unesha Satani yandikiwe ko, Azahabw’ ikamba n’ Umukiza we, Tugir’ intege nke, Ariko Yesu, Ni we Mutabazi, Udushoboza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Saba Yes’ agufashe, Kand’ aguhumurize, Yemeye kukurinda, Azatum’ utsinda.

title: Nzabana N’ Umwami
verses: 1. Nzabana n’ Umwam’ ibihe bidashira, Iryo jambo rivuga ngo: Nzatur’ ibudapfa, N’ ubwo nkingiranywe mur’ uyu mubiri, Buzacya negereje gutah’ iwacu heza.
2. Mu rugo rw’ Umwami ndahararikira, Kwizera ni ko kunyerek’ amarembo yaho, N’ ubwo njya ncogora s’ ukutahashaka, Iyo gakondo y’ abera ni Yerusalemu.
3. Njya ngotwa n’ ibyaha, Nkumva ndacogoye, Nkabur’ aho mfata nka ya numa yo mu nkuge, Ibicu byeyutse, Umukororombya, W’ ihumure urasira mu mutima wanjye.
4. Nkund’ izo ndirimbo zihora mw’ ijuru, Izo mw’ isi yacu ni nk’ indimi z’ i Babeli, Harihw’ icyo nkunda, Nukw’ abazazuka, Bazongera kubana na Yesu, Yee, Amina.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Iwacu, Iwacu, Ngeze hafi yaho.

title: Mwami Yesu Mugenga
verses: 1. Mwami  Yesu Mugenga w’ ibi bintu byose, Wambay’ ubumuntu ku bwacu. Ndakwiyeguriye, nzakubaha; Kuk’ ur’ ikuzo n’ ikamba ryanjye.
2. Icyanya ni cyiza, n’ amashyamba ni meza, N’ ibimera na byo ni byiza; Yes’ urabirusha, kand’ uraboneye; Uturuhur’ imitima.
3. Umucyo ni mwiza, Umwez’ ukawurusha, N’ umucyo w’ inyenyeri n’uko. Yes’ urabirusha, kand’ uraboneye, Kurush’ abamarayika.

title: Umwami Arahamagara
verses: 1. Umwam’ arahamagara abasaruzi bitanze, Ibisarurwa bireze abasaruzi ni bake.
2. Nimwihute mutabare abari mu byaha bose, Mubatabaz’ amaboko muc’ ingoyi zibaboshye.
3. Nimumenyesh’ abakene na bo baze mu birori, Yes’ umutsim’ uhoraho yiteguye kubakira.
4. Nimwihute dor’ igihe cy’ isarura kirashize, Hagiye kuzab’ igihe tutazabasha gukora.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nimuhaguruke mushikame, Mw’ izina ry’ uwo Mwami, Muvuge inkuru y’ agakiza, Muyamamaze  hose.

title: Urukundo Rw’ Imana Yacu
verses: 1. Urukundo rw’ Imana yacu, Nta muntu warurondora, Rusaguts’ ikirere cyose, Rugera no munsi y’ isi. Abantu bose bacumuye, Bacunguwe na Yesu, Umwana  we wese wahabye, Yaramwicunguriye.
2. Ubw’ ibihe bizah’ ibindi, N’ ubwami bw’ isi bwashize, Abantu bakanga gusenga, Amabuy’ azaririmba. Urukundo rw’ Imana yacu, Ntabwo rurondoreka, Rwacunguy’ abo mw’ isi bose, Ruzaririmbw’ iteka.
3. Inyanja zose zaba wino, N’ ijuru ryab’ impapuro, Tukandikisha agati kose, Umuntu wes’ akandika, Urukundo rw’ Imana yacu, Rwakamy’ inyanja zose, Ntabwo rwabon’ aho rukwirwa, Rusaguts’ ikirere.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mbeg’ urukundo rutangaje, Rutagir’ urugero, Abera bazaruririmba, Ibihe bidashira.

title: Umukiza Aragutegereje
verses: 1. Umukiza aragutegereje, Ntiwamusanga none? Ntaby’ isi bigomba kumukuvutsa, Mbes’ ub’ uribaz’ iki ?
2. Nshuti ter’ intambw’ ugan’ Umukiza, Agutez’ ibiganza, Numwemerera arakuruhura, Muban’ iteka ryose.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Umukiz’ aragutegereje, Aracyagutegereje, Ngw’ arebe ko wemera gukingura, Mbeg’ ubury’ abyifuza.

title: Ubutumwa Bw’ Ubuntu
verses: 1. Ubutumwa bw’ ubuntu bwanyuz’ umutima, Imana yadutangiy’ Umwana wayo.
2. Nk’ uko Mose yamanits’ inzoka ku giti, Niko Yesu yamanitswe ngo tubeho.
3. Numvise yuk’ ukor’ ibyaha wes’ azapfa, None ndahabutse kubw’ Ijambo ryawe.
4. Yesu ntabwo yaje kuducirahw’ iteka, Ahubwo yaj’ atuzaniy’ agakiza.
5. Mwami ndakwinginz’ ongera kwizera kwanjye, Nakir’ iby’ ubutumwa bwawe bumbwira.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ng’ umwizera wes’ adapf’ Ahubw’ ahabw’ ubugingo, Ahubw’ ahabw’ ubugingo bw’ iteka.

title: Hariho Uburuhukiro Muri Paradizo
verses: 1. Hariho uburuhukiro muri paradizo, Ahatazab’ umubabar’ ukundi, Tuzahurirayo.
2. Hariy’ umudugudu mwiza utatswem’ umucyo, Aho ni hw’ abakiranutsi bazibanira n’ Umwami.
3. Hariyo amakamba meza, Ayo tuzambikwa, Kristo yateguriy’ abamutegereje bihanganye.
4. Jy’ ukiranuk’ ibihe byose, N’ubwo wabizira, Yesu yasezeranye kw’ azaguh’ ikamba ry’ ubugingo.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. : Tuzateranirayo, Tuzahurirayo Kuri rwa ruzi, Tuzateranirayo, Mu musek’ igitondo gitangaje. A., T. na B.: Tuzate..., nirayo, Tuzahurirayo Kuri rwa ruzi, Tuzate… nirayo, Mu musek’ igitondo gitangaje.

title: Mukristo Ube Maso
verses: 1. Mukristo ube maso, Nturuhuke na hato, Akaga kari hafi, Usenge!
2. Ababisha b’ Imana bajya bakubikira, Baguciriy’ ibico, Usenge!
3. Kenyer’ intwaro zawe ku manywa na nijoro, Dor’ umwanz’ arakaze, Ba maso!
4. Umv’ abatsinze kera iyo ntambar’ urwana, Barakubwira bati: Usenge!
5. Umva Umwami  wawe, Yesu wagupfiriye, Ni we wategets’ ati: Wirinde!
6. Bik’ iryo jambo ryiza, Mu mutima wemera, Kandi unabikore usenga.

title: Mbese Wahereye Ryari?
verses: 1. Mbese wahereye ryari uvugana n’ Umwam’ umutakambira? Mbese wahereye ryar’ usenga, Ugez’ ubw’ ukesh’ ijoro? Mbese wamaz’ igihe kingan’ iki wumva yuk’ utay’ umuruho? Se wamwit’ inshuti, Wamenye ryari, Kw’ akurind’ akakwitaho?

2. Mbese wahereye ryar’ upfukam’ useng’ Uhorah’ uri mw’ ijuru? Se wameny’ ute ko wasubijwe, Akakurinda bugacya? Ukamenya ko wiriz’ uwo munsi, Mbese wamwit’ inshuti yawe? Mbese wamenye ryari kw’ akwitaho, Kandi akanakurinda?

title: Igihe Cyo Kugaruka K’ Umwami
verses: 1. Igihe cyo kugaruka k’ Umwami kiregereje rwose, Inyenyeri zicwekereye, Kubw’ umucyo w’ igitondo gitangaje.
2. Ibimenyetso byose byahanuwe ku zuba no ku kwezi, Birahamiriz’ umuntu wese ko kuza k’ Umwami kutwegereye.
3. Iki n’ igihe rwos’ itorero rikwiye guhaguruka, Kandi rikwiriye kuba maso, Kuko bidatinze bugiye gucya.
4. Nimusohoke mujye mu nzira ngari no mu nzira ntoya, Nimubwir’ ibirema n’ impumyi ko kuza kw’ Umwami kutwegereye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mbes’ aho ntiburi hafi gucya! Mbes’ aho ntiburi hafi gucya! Mbese ntabw’ ubona k’ umusek’ utambitse! Mbese k’ ubanza bugiye gucya!

title: Ye Byose Biba Byiza
verses: 1. Ye byose biba byiza sinzatinya, Nkeney’ urukundo ruhebuje, Imiyaga n’ imigaru biratuza. Imana yacu y’ impuhwe nyinshi itwitaho.
2. Byose biba byiz’ Iman’ inyitaho, Munsi y’ amababa ye sintinya. Nta cyago cyankuraho amahoro ye. Iyo niringiy’ Imana mu mutima wanjye.
3. Biba byiza Yesu, Yabibwiy’ abe. Mukumbi wanjye muto ntutinye. Iman’ iri ku ngoma is’ irabizi. Isi n’ ijuru bizuzura ikuzo ryayo.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mu mibabar’ idusagiriz’ ibyiza, Iradukunda, Iraturinda; Mu makuba, Iradukomeza; Kukw’ Imana yacu yumva gutaka kwacu, Irindira igihe cyayo kuzagez’ imperuka.

title: Harih’ Umunt’ Umwe
verses: 1. Harih’ umunt’ umwe wapfuye ku bwanjye, Kandi ntibyari bikwiriye, Yemeye kujyanw’ ajya ku musaraba, Kubwo kumbabarir’ ibyaha.
2. N’ umugwaneza kand’ arankunda cyane, Yez’ umutima wanjy’ ibyaha, Sincirw’ urubanza, Mfit’ umudendezo, Kuko yambabariy’ ibyaha.
3. Nzabana n’ Umukiza akaramata, Nzajya ngendana na w’ iteka, Ndirimbish’ umunwa n’ umutima wanjye, Kuko nababariw’ ibyaha.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Byarabambwe byose, Byarabambwe byose, Yemw’ uko yabyikorey’ ubwe! Yemwe ngo arababara cyan’ ajyayo! Ajyanyweyo n’ ibyaha byanjye.

title: Yesu Araje
verses: 1. Yes’ araje nimubyamamaze, Aje kujyan’ abo yacunguye, Azanywe no kwimik’ ingoma ye, Yesu agiye kuza.
2. Yes’ araj’ abapfuye bazuke, Maz’ abatoni be baterane, Bahurire na we mu kirere, Yesu agiye kuza.
3. Yes’ azanywe no gukiz’ abera, Azanywe no gutang’ amahoro, Imibabaro yos’ izashira, Yesu agiye kuza.
4. Yes’ araje nk’ uko yabivuze, Ni bande batowe bamwizeye, Bamutegereje bari maso? Yesu agiye kuza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yes’ agiye kugaruka vuba, Yesu agiye kuza ( agiye kuza ), Nimubyamamaz’ ahantu hose, Agiye kugaruka.

title: Mfite Umukiza
verses: 1. Mfit’ Umukiz’ ukomey’ undind’ iteka? Unyobor’ intambwe ngo ntayob’ inzira, Ni w’ uyobora buri ntambwe y’ uhabye, Mbes’ ufit’ Umukiza nk’ uwo?
2. N’ Umukiza niringir’ ibihe byose, Mu byago n’ amakub’ ampor’ iruhande, No mu bishukw’ arandinda bitangaje, Mbes’ ufit’ Umufasha nk’ uwo?
3. Mfit’ Umwungeri mwiz’ ukund’ intama ze, Azihamagara mu mazina yazo, Azih’ ubwatsi bwiza n’ amazi meza, Mbes’ ufit’ Umwungeri nk’ uwo?
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mfit’ Umukiza umez’ atyo (atyo)! Se nawe n’ Umukiza wawe ( ...kiza wawe)? Yanyinjiyemo, Ntabwo ateze kumvamo, Se nawe n’ Umukiza wawe ( ...kiza wawe)?

title: Ngwin’ Umukiz’ Aragushaka
verses: 1. Ngwin’ ub’ Umukiz’ aragushaka, N’ inshuti nziza y’ ukuri, Ubu ngub’ aragutegereje, Arakwinginga ngwino.
2. Umv’ amagambo ye y’ ihumure, Yesu n’ inshuti y’ ukuri, Musange n’ isoko y’ ubugingo, Ntabw’ uzabur’ umwanya.
3. Umvir’ uwo Mwuk’ ukongorera, Wisuzugur’ uwo Mwami, Mwakire vuba witindiganya, Hahirw’ umwakiriye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Umukiz’ ahagaze ku rugi, Gira bwang’ umusab’ imbabazi, Witindigany’ arategereje, Gira n’ ingoga ngwino.

title: Isengesho Ryanjye
verses: 1. Isengesho ryanjye Mwami nyumvira, Nyobora mu nzira, Mu birushya byo mur’ ubu buzima, Jy’ umpor’ iruhande.
2. Har’ ibigeragezo byinshi mpura na by’ aho njya hose, Mfash’ umpe kub’ umunyakuri, Kandi mb’ umukiranutsi.
3. Igih’ ub’ ubuzima buzaba bugeze kw’ iherezo, Ndagusaby’ uzampe kubana nawe mu bwami bw’ ijuru.

title: Bibiliya Ibumburiw’ Isi
verses: 1. Bibliy’ ibumburiw’ isi, Iyo ni yo ntego yayo; Tumenyesh’ abant’ ukuri, Twamamaz’ inkuru nziza.
2. Ahw’ igeze hak’ umucyo, Hab’ amazi y’ ubugingo. Nta mwijim’ uyihangara, Ihishur’ ibyaha byose.
3. Iyobor’ abantu bose, Mu bwiza bw’ Imana yacu. Ibyuts’ abaguye bose, Ni y’ ivug’ iby’ agakiza.
4. Ni y’ iruhur’ imitima, Igahoz’ abahogoye. Igobok’ abacogoye, Bakagir’ ibyiringiro.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Jambo ry’ Imana murika, Hos’ imusozi no mu nyanja; Maz’ abahabye bahabuke, Basang’ Imana Rurema.

title: Reb’ Ibimenyetso
verses: 1. Reb’ ibimenyetso by’ urugendo, Reb’ ibimenyetso birashira, By’ imyak’ ishize by’ ubwami bune, Twe turi hehe? Reb’ urugendo.
2. Banyababloni bategets’ isi, Haz’ Abamedi n’ Abaperesi, Abagiriki batway’ iyi si, Haz’ Abaroma, Twe turi hehe?
3. Ko turi mu bihe by’ intege nke, Iby’ ibumba n’ icyuma byavanzwe; Nuko tuzareb’ uko bizaba Yes’ agarutse, Kwim’ ingoma ye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Reba ibimenyetso by’ ubuhanuzi, By’ ibihe byashize by’ ubwami bune, Reba ibimenyetso by’ ubuhanuzi, Byose byarangiye.

title: Uwiteka N’ Umwungeri Wanjye
verses: 1. Uwiteka n’ Umwungeri wanjye, Sinzakena na hato, Andyamisha mu cyanya cy’ iruhande rw’ amaz’ adasuma.
2. Asubiz’ intege mu bugingo bwanjye mu gihe ntebye, Anyobor’ inzira yo gukiranuka kubw’ izina rye.
3. N’ aho nanyura no mu gikombe cy’ igicucu cy’ urupfu, Sinzatiny’ ikibi cyose Mwami kuko ndi kumwe nawe.
4. Untunganiriza ameza mu maso y’ abanzi banjye, Unsize amavuta mu mutwe maze aratonyanga.
5. Kugirirwa neza n’ imbabazi bizanyomahw’ iteka, Nanjye nzaba mu nzu y’ Uwiteka ibihe bidashira.

title: Nari Nararohamye Mu Byaha
verses: 1. Nari nararohamye mu Nyanja y’ ibyaha, Nta byiringiro nari mfite byo kuvamo, Maz’ Umukiza yumva gutabaza kwanjye, Ab’ ari w’ unkuramo none ndiho.
2. Muhay’ umutima wanjye mushikamyeho, Nzajya ndirimb’ iteka icyubahiro cye, Urukundo nyakuri nzajya nduririmba, Ni we nkesha kwizera n’ urukundo.
3. Mutim’ ubabaye reba Yes’ agukize, Ni w’ uzakurokora, Mu murab’ ukaze, Ategek’ inyanja zose zikamwumvira, Arashaka kugukiz’ uyu munsi.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Urukundo rwankuyemo, Ubwo nari nabuze uwamfasha, Urukundo rwankuyemo, Nari nabuz’ umfasha, Mbona Yesu.

title: Mbega Igitambo!
verses: 1. Mbega igitambo cy’ amaraso, Y’ Umukiza wapfuy’ ari njy’ azira! Yambambiwe ku musaraba, Abitewe n’ ukw’ ankunda cyane, N’ urukundo rutangaje Mwami wanjye, Kugira ngo wemere kubabara no kumpfira.
2. Yasiz’ intebe y’ ubwami ya Se, Yemera kunyitangira ngo nkire, Nari mbuz’ epfo na ruguru, Imbabazi ze zirangoboka, Maz’ urukundo rwe runter’ umunezero, Mperako mererwa neza mu mutima wanjye.
3. Nari maz’ igihe kirekire, Mboshywe n’ umwijima w’ ibyaha byanjye, Maze kumeny’ ineza yawe, Ngukurikira mfit’ ibyishimo, Kuko nari mbohowe ingoyi z’ ibyaha, Mperako ndahaguruka, Ndagukurikira.

4. Nta teka ncirwaho kuko ndi muri Yesu, Na w’ akab’ ari muri jye, Ni we nkesha kubaho kwanjye, Nkeger’ intebe ye ntacyo ntinya, Nkambikw’ ikamba mbikesha uwancunguye, Ntabwo nzahwema kumusingiz’ iteka ryose.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. : Urukundo ruhebuje, Ni rwo rwamuteye kumpfira, Mbeg’ urukundo rutangaje, Ngo ruratum’ ancungura! A., T. na B. : Urukundo ruhebuje, Ni rwo rwamute… kumpfira, Mbeg’ uruku…rutangaje, Ngo ruratum’ ancungura.

title: Impanda Iravuze
verses: 1. Impanda iravuze, Nimwumve, Nimwumve; Ivugira mw’ ijuru, Yesu araje! Wow’ uhunikira, Ngah’ umva, Ngah’ umva; Kanguka, Ubyuke, Umwam’ araje!
2. Ese ntimwumv’ impanda, Nimwumve, Nimwumve; Umugen’ arayumva, Yes’ ari hafi. N’ ibyishimo byinshi, Nimwumve, Nimwumve; Araririmb’ ati: Yes’ ari hafi.
3. Impanda iravuze, Nimwumve, Nimwumve; Nimubyuke bwakeye, Umukw’ araje! N’ ibyishimo byinshi, Nimwumve, Nimwumve Ngaho itegure, Dore araje!

title: Dufit’ Ibyiringiro
verses: 1. Dufit’ ibyiringiro by’ ukuri, Ko Yesu azagaruka, Twizezwa n’ uk’ ubwe yabivuze, Twizer’ isezerano rye, Ubw’ amoko yo mw’ isi, Azarangurur’ ati: Haleluya, Yesu Kristo n’ Umwami w’ Abami, Twiringiye yuk’ Umwami wacu, Ari hafi kugaruka.

2. Duhuriye muri Yesu Kristo, Duhujwe n’ urukundo rwe, Abantu bifuz’ urukundo rwe, Rwatumy’ acungur’ abantu, Ijuru rizakinguka Kristo agaruke, Abantu baririmbe, Haleluya, Araje! Dufit’ ibyiringiro mu Mana, Twibumbiye muri Kristo.

title: Nkunda Igitabo Cyera
verses: 1. Nkund’ igitabo cyera cy’ Imana, Ni cyo kindutir’ ibindi byose, Kinyigish’ ibyiza byo mw’ ijuru, Nkameny’ inzira y’ agakiza.
2. Gitabo cy’ ingenzi, muri wowe, Mpabon’ ubwiza bw’ Umwami wanjye, Ibyanditswe byawe binyigisha, Iby’ umunezero nzagira.
3. Ariko igihe nkiri mw’ isi, Umbwir’ iby’ urukundo rw’ Imana, Nkarushaho gusobanukirwa, N’ umunezero wo mw’ ijuru.
4. Ni wowe werekan’ imigambi, Yose ya Yes’ Umukiza wanjye, Muri wowe ni ho har’ ubwenge, N’ ubuhanga butarondorwa.
5. Ur’ umucy’ umurikir’ ab’ isi, Ngo bave mu mwijima w’ ibyaha, Ni wow’ umurikir’ imitima, Y’ abahabye bagahabuka.

title: Ku Musaraba
verses: 1. Imbere y’ Uhoraho ntabwo nkorwa n’ isoni, Kand’ ijambo ryawe rinshimish’ ibihe byose.
2. Yesu Mana yanjye nzi yukw’ ari ryo zina rye, Ntazemerer’ umutima wanjye kuzimira.
3. Yasezeranye yukw’ intebe y’ izahoraho, Biragaragara kw’ ibyo yavuz’ ar’ ukuri.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ku musaraba ni ho naboney’ umucyo, Mbona gutur’ umutwaro wanjye, Mbiboneshwa no kwizera, Uherey’ ubu nzahora nezerewe.

title: Mana Yac’ Ur’ Umufasha
verses: 1. Mana yac’ ur’ umufasha, Byiringiro byacu, Bwugamo bw’ umugaru, Ni we buturo bwacu.
2. Ku ntebe yawe y’ ubwami, Tubon’ amahoro, Iyo dutabawe nawe, Tugir’ ihumure.
3. Imisoz’ itarabaho, Is’ itarabumbwa, Kuva kera kose Mana, Ur’ uko wahoze.
4. Imyak’ igihumbi uyibona nk’ umuns’ umwe, Ni migufi nk’ isah’ imwe, Ihita n’ ingoga.
5. Man’ ur’ umufasha wacu, Byiringiro byacu, Utuber’ umuyoboz’ uzatugez’ iwacu.

title: Ntabaza Yesu Iyo Mbabaye
verses: 1. Ntabaza Yesu iyo mbabaye, Ankiz’ imibabaro yanjye, Mur’ iyo mibabaro ntampāna, Ahubw’ arantabara rwose.
2. Mu makuba yanjy’ arantabara, Kukw’ ari we nshuti y’ ukuri, Iyo mutabaj’ arantabara, Ankiz’ imibabaro yanjye.
3. Mbeg’ ukuntu iby’ isi binshuka, Bikanyoshya gukor’ ibyaha, Mbibwire Yesu kand’ azamfasha, Ni w’ uzampa gutsind’ iby’ isi.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ntabaza Yesu, Ntabaza Yesu, Kuko ntacyo nakwishoboza, Ntabaza Yesu, Ntabaza Yesu, Yesu gusa ni we wamfasha

title: Mwuka Wera
verses: 1. Aha hantu har’ amahoro, Kandi hari n’ Umwuka Wera w’ Uhoraho, Kandi n’ umuntu wese uhari, Afit’ umunezero mwinshi bihebuje.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mwuka Wera We, We numa nziza, Ubane natwe, Utwuzuz’ urukundo, Turaguhimbaza kuk’ uduhira, Turataha tudashidikanya yuko duhiriwe twese.

title: Nzabon’ Umwami
verses: 1. Nzabon’ Umwami wanjy’ aririmbirwa n’ abamarayika, Tuzabana na w’ iteka ryose, mu gihugu cy’ ibyiza.
2. Mur’ icyo gihugu cyiza nta joro rizabay’ ukundi. Nzabana n’ Umwami wancunguje amaraso y’ akiza.
3. Nzabana n’ Umwami wanjye nkunda, nzamureba mu maso, Nzamuririmbira mushimira Ubuntu yangiriye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Tuzahorana ibihe byose, Yankirije i Kalvari. Amaherezo nzabon’ Umwami, Wanyitangiye kera.

title: Icyampa Kugendana N’ Imana
verses: 1. Icyampa kugendana n’ Imana, Mu nzir’ ijya mw’ ijuru, Ni byo byamber’ umucy’ ungeza, Ku Mwana w’ Intama.
2. Garuka, Mukunzi garuka, Ntumwa nziza y’ amahoro, Nang’ ibyaha byakubabaje, Bikantanya nawe.
3. Mbega ngo ndagir’ amahoro, Ntazigera nibagirwa! Ariko byansizemw’ imvun’ itakungwa n’ ab’ isi.
4. Icyo nagusimbuje cyose, Uko cyaba kiri kose, Mfasha nitandukanye na cyo, Ngusenge wenyine.

title: Nimumenyesh’ Abantu Bose
verses: 1. Nimumenyesh’ abantu bose ko Yes’ ari hafi, Is’ imurikirwe n’ umucyo, Maze Yes’ agaruke.
2. Amahanga yasubiranyemo, Muyaburire, Is’ imurikirwe n’ umucyo, Maze Yes’ agaruke.
3. Bana b’ Imana, Nimuririmbe, Muyih’ ikuzo, Hahirw’ ababa maso, Bukarinda butandukana.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nimusingiz’ uwo Mwana w’ Intama watambwe, Nimwamamaze ko Yes’ agiye kwima.

title: Nejejwe N’ Iri Turo
verses: 1. Nejejwe n’ iri turo ntuy’ Umwami Yesu, Igitambo kizima ni cyo jyew’ ubwanjye.
2. Mpaz’ ubugingo bwanjye, Nticuza, ntatinya, Kubw’ ubuntu bwawe warancunguye Mwami.
3. Yesu ngwin’ unyigishe wowe wancunguye, Nshaka kubana naw’ ibihe bidashira.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Akir’ ituro ryanjye We Mwana w’ Imana, Kand’ umanurire ku mucyo uv’ ahera.

title: Dusingiz’ Uwiteka
verses: 1. Dusingiz’ Uwiteka, Tumushimir’ ineza ye, Kukw’ imbabazi ze nyinshi, Zizahorahw’ iteka.
2. Umuremyi wa byose, Uwakwij’ umucyo kw’ isi, Agir’ imbabazi nyinshi, Zizahorahw’ iteka.
3. Abibeshaho byose, Akabimar’ ubukene, Agir’ imbabazi nyinshi, Zizahorahw’ iteka.
4. Yahiriy’ ubwoko bwe, Ubwo bwari mu butayu, Agir’ imbabazi nyinshi, Zizahorahw’ iteka.
5. Ni nyir’ impuhwe nyinshi, Ameny’ ubukene bwacu, Agir’ imbabazi nyinshi, Zizahorahw’ iteka.
6. Tumusingiz’ iteka, Kubw’ imbabazi ze nyinshi, Ahoran’ impuhwe nyinshi, Zizahorahw’ iteka.

title: Kuber’ Iki Utindiganya?
verses: 1. Kuber’ iki utindiganya? Yes’ aragushaka none, Haguruk’ uve mu mwijima, Aragukunda, Musange.
2. Igihe kirahita vuba, Uyu munsi ni wo wawe, Reka Yes’ aguhumurize, N’ ubutunzi bw’ igiciro.
3. Ese ntiwumva mu mutima, Wuzuwe n’ Umwuka Wera? Ntiwifuza kumurikirwa na Yesu agukomeze.
4. Kuber’ iki wanga kwitaba? Urupfu rugusatira! Ngwino Yes’ akumurikire, Ngwin’ aragutegereje
chorus: Gusubiramo: Kuki? Kuki? Utamusang’ uyu munsi? Kuki? Kuki? Utamwitaba none?

title: Ku Rutare Har’ Isoko
verses: 1. Ku Rutare har’ isoko, Itemb’ imar’ inyota, Mugenzi ngwino kw’ isoko, Maz’ unywe ushir’ inyota. Gububiramo: Yesu ni we Gitare, Yaradupfiriye twese, Mugenzi ngwino kw’ isoko, Maz’ unywe ushir’ inyota.
2. Arahamagar’ ati: Ngwino kw’ isoko y’ ubuntu, Mugenz’ ufit’ inyota, Mbese ntiwakwitaba Yesu?
3. Munyabyaha ngwino Yesu akwambuts’ ubutayu, Umukiz’ aragutegereje, Ngwino umusange.

title: Ineza N’ Imbabazi

metadata.composer: John W. Peterson & Affred B. Smith

verses: 1. Igihe nari nd’ inzererezi, Ngenda mu mwijima w’ ibyaha, Ni h’ Umwungeri yantaruye, None ndi mu nzir’ ijy’ iwacu.
2. Ansubiz’ intege mu bugingo, Anyonger’ imbarag’ iteka, Anjyan’ ahar’ amaz’ atuje, Arind’ intambwe zanjye zose.
3. Mu gikombe cy’ umwijim’ ukaze, Umukiz’ azabana nanjye, Azanyoboz’ ukuboko kwe, Angez’ aho yanteguriye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ineza n’ imbabazi ze ni byo bizanyomaho, Iminsi yo kubaho kwanjy’ ibihe byose, Ineza n’ imbabazi ze ni byo bizanyomaho, Iminsi yose nzaba ndiho. Kandi nzaba mu nzu y’ Uwiteka iteka, Nzarira ku meza yanteguriye kera, Ineza n’ imbabazi ze ni byo bizanyomaho, Iminsi yose nzaba ndiho. ‘’Iminsi yose nzaba ndiho’’. (Ku gice cya 3).

title: Mur’ Iyi Si
verses: 1. Mur’ iyi si, yubitswe n’ ibyaha, Dukomezwa n’ amahoro ya Yesu.
2. Mu mihati yo mur’ iyi si mbi, Gukor’ ibyo Yes’ ashaka, n’ ingenzi.
3. N’ ubwo tugoswe n’ ibyago byinshi, Muri Yesu tuhabon’ amahoro.
4. N’ ubw’ incuti zacu zaba kure, Yes’ aduhor’ iruhande by’ ukuri.
5. Yes’ ari ku ntebe ye y’ Ubwami, Ahazaza hacu ni w’ uhafite.

title: Yesu Niw’ Ujy’ Unyobora
verses: 1. Yesu ni w’ ujy’ unyobora, Amurikir’ inzira, Mu ntege nke zanjye zose, Yesu ni w’ unyobora. Gububiramo: Amurikir’ inzira, Amurikir’ inzira. Mu ntege zanjye zose, Yesu ni w’ unyobora.
2. Yesu ni w’ ujy’ undengera, Yamviriy’ amaraso, Kwizera igitambo cye, Byatumye mbabarirwa. Gububiramo: Yamviriy’ amaraso, Yamviriy’ amaraso. Kwizera igitambo cye, Byatumye mbabarirwa.
3. Anyezahw’ inenge zose, Igihe munambyeho, Amp’ ubugingo bw’ iteka, Ntandukana n’ urupfu.
4. Yanyishyuriy’ umwenda, Ufit’ igiciro cyinshi, Yanteguriye umwanya, Nzabana na w’ iteka. Gububiramo: Yesu warancunguye, Yesu warancunguye. Yanteguriye umwanya, Nzabana na w’ iteka.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Igihe munambyeho, Igihe munambyeho, Amp’ ubugingo bw’ iteka, Ntandukana n’ urupfu.

title: Mukiza Wanjye Nyobora
verses: 1. Mukiza wanjye, Nyobor’ ah’ ushaka, Mfat’ ikiganza maze nkumve bugufi, Nubw’ amahwa yampanda, Ngukurikire, Nyobor’ ah’ ushaka, Mukiza wanjye.
2. Mukiza wanjye, Nyobor’ ah’ ushaka, Ukomez’ undinde unampumurize, Nubw’ umwijima wab’ umbudits’ imbere, Ntabwo nzatiny’ unyoboye Mukiza.
3. Njyan’ ah’ ushaka Mwam’ icyo ngusaba, Nyuza mu nzira ntoya ne guteshuka, Nubwo Satan’ anyoshya anyongorera, Mfasha njye nsubiza bwangu mpakana.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. : Nzagukurikira hose, Mukiza wanjye, Ngukurikire, Nzagukurikira Mukiza, Unyobore. A., T. na B. : Nzagukuriki…, …gukurikira hose, Mukiza wanjye, Ngukurikire, Nzagukuriki…, …rikira unyobore, …za unyobore, Nyobora.

title: Shimwa Ntama Y’ Imana
verses: 1. Shimwa Ntama y’ Imana, Turagushima Ntama, Shimwa Ntama y’ Imana, Turagushima cyane.
2. Ubwami bwawe buze, Dutsindire icyaha, Waradukunze cyane, Shimwa Ntama y’ Imana.
3. Tukunambeho Mwami, Tujye tuguh’ ikuzo, Turi kumwe n’ Umwami, Ku musozi Siyoni.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Shimwa haleluya, Shimwa haleluya, Singizwa Mukiza, Wowe  Ntama y’ Imana.

title: Nzahimbaza Imana
verses: 1. Nzahimbaz’ Imana mfite umutima unyuzwe, Kubw’ urukundo rwawe n’ imbabazi wangiriye, Mfasha mu ntege nke zanjye, Unsindire icyaha. Murikir’ umutima wanjye, Nguhimbaze Mwami.
2. Mutima wanjye umvira, Wubahe Uwiteka, Ungarure hafi yawe, Ne kuyoba Mukiza, Narazimiye, Mvana mu nzira y’ urupfu Mwami. Wampaye  ibyiringiro igihe wampfiraga.
3. Mfukamye  imbere yawe, Ngushima Mwami wanjye, Ndakwinginze Mwami mpa umugisha uyu munsi, Nkeney’ urukundo n’ ubuntu biva kuri wowe. Maz’ imibereho yanjye ijy’ iguhesh’ ikuzo.

title: Yesu Araguhamagara!
verses: 1. Yes’ arahamagara, Munyabyaha ngwino, Ubu turagusabira, Nyamuna ngwino, Arakwiteze munyabyaha, Ngwino, Ngwino, N’ igihe cyo kumumenya, Nyamuna ngwino.
2. Nib’ uremerewe n’ ibyaha, Ngwino, Ngwino, Yesu aragutur’ uwo mutwaro ngwino, Yesu n’ umunyebambe, Munyabyaha ngwino, Ni we wagucunguye, Munyabyaha ngwino.
3. Umv’ ubury’ akwinginga, Munyabyaha ngwino, Ngwin’ araguh’ umugisha, Nyamuna ngwino, Araguhamagara, Munyabyaha ngwino, Ubu turagusabira, Nyamuna ngwino.

title: Ndi Mu Maboko Akiza
verses: 1. Iy’ Umukiza wanjy’ anyoboye, Uko ndi kose ngir’ amahoro, Ankirish’ umuraba w’ ibyaha, Amaboko y’ akiza.
2. Ahor’ andamiz’ amaboko ye, Akanambwiz’ ijwi ry’ ihumure, Ati: Humura, Nzakuramiza, Amaboko akiza.
3. Azandinda anyobor’ iteka, Ntacyo nzatinya ndi kumwe na we, Nzi kw’ ahor’ andind’ iteka ryose, Ndi mu mabokw’ akiza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Ndi mu mabokw’ akiza, Amaboko y’ akiza, N’ ubwo naba ngeze no mu kaga, Ndi mu mabokw’ akiza. T. na B.: Ndi mu mabo... ...kw’ aki... mabokw’ akiza, Amaboko akiza ....mabokw’ akiza, N’ ubwo naba ngeze no mu kaga, Ndi mu mabokw’ akiza.

title: Manyur’ Umutsima
verses: 1. Manyur’ umutsima w’ ubugingo, Nk’ uko wabigize mu kibaya, Natw’ uduhaz’ Ibyanditswe Byera, Turakwifuza Jambo rizima.
2. Mwami  hir’ ukuri menyeshejwe, Nk’ uko wahiriye wa mutsima, Uri ku nyanja y’ i Galilaya, Mbeshweho naw’ Ushobora byose.
3. Mwam’  ur’ umutsima w’ ubugingo, Ijambo ryawe rimbeshejeho, Mpa guhazwa na ryo tuzabane, Mpa kugukunda nzabane nawe.
4. Amagamb’ uvuga n’ ubugingo, Mfasha ngo nyumvire, jye nta ntege, Ni wowe nkesh’ ubugingo bwanjye, Ijambo ryawe rimpa gutsinda.

title: Nakurikiye Yesu
verses: 1. Nakurikiye Yesu mu kibaya akiz’ abarwayi, Ac’ iminyururu y’ ibyaha no kuruhur’ imitwaro.
2. Namukurikiye ku musoz’ igihe yahindurwaga, Imana iravuga iti: Ur’ Umwana wanjye nkunda.
3. Namukurikiy’ i Kalvari, Agend’ atukwa na benshi, Akomez’ inzira y’ Umwanzi, Yikorey’ umusaraba.
4. Nzamukurikira nkiriho, Maz’ atume mpora nesha, Kugez’ ubwo nzager’ iwacu, Ahahor’ umunezero.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S.: Mbega ngo biranezeza gukurikira Yesu! Akanyoboz’ ubuntu bwe, Akangeza mw’ ijuru. A., T., B.: Mbega ngo biranezeza, gu – kuriki – ra Yesu! … . Akanyoboz’ ubuntu bwe, a - kangeza mw’ ijuru (mw’ ijuru).

title: Nabony’ Umuntu Unaniwe
verses: 1. Nabony’ umunt’ unaniwe, Kand’ agenda yihanganye, Yikorey’ umusaraba, Nyamara ntabwo yari yihebye. Imibabar’ iba myinshi! Arik’ uw’ urahebuje! Mubaz’ ikimuh’ intege, Ati: N’uko mfit’ ibyiringiro.

2. Nabony’ afite n’ intwaro, Arwany’ iby’ is’ ashikamye, Kand’ arwan’ amaramaje ngw’ azabon’ ikamba rihoraho. N’ubwo yari yarenganye, Ntiyigeze yivovota; Mubaz’ ikimuh’ intege, Ati: N’uko mfit’ ibyiringiro.

3. Nabony’ uwasiz’ inshuti ze, Bakundanaga cyane, Atandukana n’ iby’ isi, Ahitamw’ inzir’ imuruhije. N’ubw’ irimw’ ibibabaza, Arikw’ ariyumanganya, Mubaz’ ikimuh’ intege, Ati: N’uko mfit’ ibyiringiro.

4. Tur’ abagenzi mur’ iyi si, Y’ akaga n’ agahinda, Irimw’ ibyago n’ urwango, N’ ibituro byuzuyemw’ abantu, Kugez’ ubwo Krist’ azaza, Akarokor’ abe bose, Se, n’ iki cyadukomeza, Atar’ ibyiringiro bishyitse?

title: Mugenzi Komera
verses: 1. Mugenzi komera Yes’ ari hafi, Twamutegereje kera, Tugiye kwitahir’ iwacu heza, Turirimbe ko dutsinze. Twihangane twe kumuhemukaho, Kandi w’ ataduhemukiye, Yatwerets’ urukundo ruhebuje, Ni rwo rwatumy’ adupfira.

2. Mugenzi komera, Utegerez’ umudugudu w’ izahabu, Wateguriwe abakiranutsi, Ni ho tuzaruhukira. Ihangane ntabwo tuzagum’ aha, Mu buhanya no mu miruho, Har’ ubw’ umwijim’ uzatamuruka, Igitondo gitangaze.

3. Mugenzi komera dore araje, Uwo Muremyi wa byose, Azanye n’ abamarayika benshi, Azanye n’ ingororano. Ihangan’ ugez’ igih’ Umukiza, Azakubwir’ aya magambo, Ngo mugaragu mwiz’ ukiranuka, Igire mu munezero.

4. Mugenzi ujy’ uhora wihanganye, Komeza kwizera kwawe, Amarira yawe ahanagurwe, Maz’ uzahabwe n’ ikamba. Ihangane mwene Data ni koko, Isezerano rye n’ impamo; Uzibanirayo n’ abakijijwe, Na Yes’ Umukiza wacu.

title: Umunsi Mwiza Uri Bugufi
verses: 1. Dor’ umunsi mwiza ugiye kugera, Tukibera ibudapfa. Aho tuzibera hahebuj’ ubwiza, N’ umuns’ utangaje!
2. Imitima yacu irahumurirwa, Ntabwo ijya igoheka. Turifuza kubon’ uwo munsi mwiza, Tuzaba mu bwiza.
3. Za ntwari zasinzirany’ ibyiringiro, Tugiye kuzabonana. Nta marir’ azongera kuturangwaho, Mu murwa w’ Imana.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Umwijim’ ugiye gutamuruka, Tukabah’ ubutazongera gupfa. Mbega ihumure twahawe na Yesu! Dor’ ari bugufi.

title: Nitugera Mw’ Ijuru
verses: 1. Turirimb’ urukundo rwa Yesu; Impuhwe ndetse n’ ubuntu bye. Ari kudutegurir’ aho tuzaba, mw’ ijuru.
2. N’ ubw’ ibicu bidukingirije, Bitubuza kureba neza, Turi hafi yo gusoz’ urugendo rukomeye.
3. Dukomeze dukorer’ Imana, Tuzabihemberwa nta shiti; Turi hafi guhabw’ ubugingo bw’ iteka ryose!
4. Dor’ ikamba rir’ imbere yacu, Tuzaryambikirwa mw’ ijuru, N’ ahantu h’ igikundiro, harahebuje rwose.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nitugera mw’ ijuru, mbeg’ umunezero tuzagira! Turirimb’ indirimbo nziza z’abanesheje.

title: Mu Maboko Ya Yesu
verses: 1. Mu maboko ya Yesu, Ndi mu gituza cye! Mpabon’ umunezero, Kubw’ urukundo rwe. Mbega ngo ndaririmba, Nk’ abamarayika: Aho hantu heza, Ku Nyanja ya Yasipi!
2. Mu maboko ya Yesu, Anyitaho rwose; Ntsind’ ibigeragezo, Ni ho nesh’ icyaha. Mu maboko ya Yesu, Hehe n’ umubabaro! Ntabwo ngishidikanya, Yes’ amar’ ubwoba.
3. Yesu Mukunzi wanjye, Wowe nihishamo; Ni wowe niringira, Wowe wampfiriye. Gitare gikomeye, Ndagutegereje; Nuza ku manywa cyangwa nijor’ uzanjyana!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mu maboko ya Yesu, Ndi mu gituza cye; Mpabon’ umunezero, Kubw’ urukundo rwe.

title: Mbe! Basare Tugashya
verses: 1. Mbe! Basare tugashya tugana hakurya; Nidusakirana n’ umuraba, Har’ aho gutsik’ ubwato, Ku cyambu gituje cyane.
2. Twe kurangamir’ inyungu z’ igihe gito, Nta mumaro zifite haba namba! Dushak’ aho dutsika, Ku nkombe hakury’ iwacu.
3. Yesu ni we Nyenyeri itumurikira, Kandi ni w’ udukingir’ umuraba. Tyo twerekez’ ubwato, kuri Yesu Murengezi.
4. N’ ubw’ ubukana bw’ inyanja bwakara gute! Urusaku rukaba rwinshi cyane! Ntacyo ruzadutwara, Yes’ azaruducyahira.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Igice 4: Mw’ ijuru n’ iwacu hakurya ku cyambu Mw’ ijuru mw’ ijuru ni ho tuzibera. Mw’ ijuru heza pe! Mw’ ijuru n’ iwacu (mw’ ijuru n’ iwacu).

title: Turakuramya Mana
verses: 1. Tuje kukuramya Mana yacu y’ icyubahiro, Twubamye nk’ ukw’ indabyo zimer’ imbere y’ izuba. Wow’ utang’ umunezero, Utubabarir’ ibyaha; Utumurikire Mana twe guteshuk’ inzira.
2. Imirimo yawe Mana yigaragaza hose! Ijuru n’ isi bihamya icyubahiro cyawe; Inyenyeri, izuba n’ inyanja, ndetse n’ imisozi, N’ inyoni ziririmbira mu biti by’ inzitane.
3. Soko y’ imigisha yose, uratubabarira! Ni wowe Nyir’ ubuzima, ni wow’ utubeshaho. Utwuzuze urukundo, uduhire Mana yacu; Uduhaz’ umunezero, turagusabye Mana.

title: Nkomoko Y’ Ibyiza Bidateka
verses: 1. Nkomoko y’ ibyiza bidateka, Mana y’ amahoro; Tw’ abana bawe tuje kugusingiza; Akira kuramya kwacu, Mana yacu. Tw’ abana bawe tuje kugusingiza; Akira kuramya kwacu, Mana yacu.
2. Dushoboze gukor’ iby’ ushaka Mana, Uduhire. Tukumvire rwose, tukubahe Mana; Naw’ uduhundagazehw’ imigisha yawe. Tukumvire rwose, tukubahe Mana; Naw’ uduhundagazehw’ imigisha yawe.

title: Ndishimye Pe! Yes’ Arankunda
verses: 1. Nishimiye ko Data wa twese, Yandikishij’ iby’ urukundo rwe. Mu byanditswe muri Bibiliya, Nta cyaruta yuko Yes’ ankunda.
2. Iyo nyobye maze ngateshuka, Ntabw’ ajy’ amvirira haba namba. Angaruz’ ineza n’ urukundo, Nkamugarukira kukw’ ankunda.
3. Ningera mu bwami bwo mw’ ijuru, Nzaririmb’ indirimbo z’ ikuzo. Ariko cyane cyane nzishima, Ndirimb’ urukundo rw’ Umukiza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ndishimye pe! Yes’ arankunda; Arankunda, arankunda! Ndishimye pe! Yes’ arankunda; Anyakir’ uko ndi.

title: Yesu Yarampinduye Rwose!
verses: 1. Nahoze ndindagira mu mwijima w’ ibyaha; Maze Yes’ arambatura, none narahindutse; Nd’ umwana w’ Imana rwos’ ubu, mfit’ amahoro.
2. Nahoze nd’ ikigenge, sinari nzi gusenga; Yes’ araz’ arampindura, Yankunze bihebuje; Arapfa kubwanjye; Ubu narihannye rwose.
3. Urukund’ umunezero n’ amahoro, Ni byo byuzuy’ umutima wanjye! Yesu yanyuzuyemw’ amp’ ubugingo bushya; Nzibanira na w’ iteka.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yarampinduye rwose, Anyigisha gusenga. Nzasingiz’ urukundo Rwe! Ubu yangiz’ uwe rwose; Nahinduts’ umuntu mushya.

title: Umucyo Uva Mw’ Ijuru
verses: 1. Umucyo uva mw’ ijuru, Uyobor’ abagenzi, Uzadufasha tugere, Ku nkombe yo hakurya.
2. Umwijim’ urabuditse, Inyanj’ irahorera; Yes’ aduhozahw’ amas’ azadufasha twambuke.
3. Mutyo ducan’ amatara, Dukomez’ urugendo. Twe kuyobywa n’ abasare, Badafit’ urumuri.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mwami Yes’ umucyo waw’ umurikir’ abagenzi Winjire mu nyanja, Maz’ ubakingir’ umuraba .

title: Wisubika Kwihana Nshuti
verses: 1. Wisubika kwihana nshuti; Ni nko kubwir’ Umwuka Wera, Ngo genda rwose, jye nzihan’ undi munsi. Mbega ng’ uribuza amahirwe!
2. Wisubika kwihana nshuti; Dore Yes’ atez’ ibiganza. Ihan’ uyu munsi, emer’ umusange; Aguh’ ubugingo agukize.
3. Wisubika kwihana nshuti; Dor’ igihe kirarangiye. Rwos’ igihe cy’ imbabazi kirashize, Fatirana bwang’ usange Yesu.

title: Ubuntu Butangaje!
verses: 1. Mbeg’ ubuntu butangaje cyane! Umutindi nkanjye gukizwa! Ntabwo nabonaga, none ndabona. Nakijijw’ ibyaha byanjye.
2. N’ ubuntu bwanyerets’ aho nari; Nari mu byaha byinshi cyane. Kubw’ ubuntu Yesu yarandokoye; Singifit’ ubwoba rwose.
3. Navanywe mu kaga nari ndimo; Mpagaze mu buntu bwa Yesu. Kubw’ ubwo buntu nzager’ ibudapfa; Mw’ ijuru kwa Data heza!
4. Imyak’ igihumbi ndi mw’ ijuru; Nzabanayo n’ Umwami Yesu. Mbeg’ indirimbo nziza nzaririmba! Nzaba nkeye cyane rwose.

title: N’ Umutima Utuje
verses: 1. N’ umutim’ utuje, nj’ imbere yawe; Umbe hafi Yesu, nkumve bugufi.
2. Nta rindi jwi nshaka kumva na gato; Kerets’ ijwi ryawe, Yesu Mukiza.
3. Amagambo yaw’ ambe mu mutima; Yes’ ump’ ubugingo bw’ iteka ryose.

title: Yesu Mu Bugingo Bwanjye
verses: 1. Mbese har’ icyanezeza, Nko kubana na Yesu? Nta cyanezeza nko kubana n’ uwo munyakuri.
2. Yitangiye kuncungura, Kubw’ ubuntu bw’ Imana. Urukundo rwe rusumb’ ijuru n’ inyanja zose.
3. Ntacyo nshobora gukena, Mfit’ uwo Mucunguzi. Ni w’ ump’ ibyo nkennye byose, Ni w’ unshoboza byose.
4. Ku mugez’ ubengerana, Nzaririmb’ indirimbo; Ndi kumwe n’ abarokotse, Turirimbir’ Imana.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Niba har’ ikinezeza, Kurut’ ibindi byose; Yesu mu bugingo bwanjye, Rwos’ andutira byose

title: Nyir’ Ukwiringirwa Mana
verses: 1. Nyir’ ukwiringirwa, Man’ Ihoraho, Ntabw’ ubundikirwa n’ umwijima. Ntuhinduka Mana yac’ idatsindwa; Kand’ uhor’ uko wahoze Mana.
2. Haba mu cyi cyangwa se mu muvumbi, Inyenyeri, izuba n’ ukwezi, Ibyo waremye byose Mana yacu, Bihamya k’ ur’ Iman’ ikomeye.
3. Ugir’ imbabazi n’ impuhwe nyinshi. Umunsi ku wund’ uraturinda. Uduh’ ibyiringiro bikomeye; By’ uko tuzabahw’ iteka ryose.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nyir’ ukwiringirwa Mana ikomeye, Ni wow’ uduh’ ibyo dukeneye. Ikiganza cyawe, kitugabira, Ibyo dukeneye buri munsi.

title: Dor’ Umwami Yes’ Araje
verses: 1. Dor’ Umwami Yes’ araje, Nguriya araje mu bicu. Ashagawe n’ abamarayika, Benshi batabarika.
2. Reb’ abera bazamurwa, Baririmb’ indirimbo nziza. Impanda zirangurura, Mbega ngo Yes’ aramwenyura!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ndatwaranira rwose, Kugera mw’ ijuru heza. Haleluya Yesu nahimbazwe!

title: Isoko Itemba
verses: 1. Har’ isoko y’ ubunt’ isokw’ ihor’ itemba. Mu mitim’ inaniwe, Sokw’ iryoshye cyane. N’ isoko nziza cyane pe! N’ isokw’ itumar’ inyota.
2. Ndumv’ ijwi ryongorera, Nk’ indirimbo nziza! Rituruka mw’ isoko nziza idakama. Ni yo soko y’ ubugingo, Ni y’ idukiz’ ubwihebe.
3. N’ isoko y’ umugisha, Itang’ ibyishimo. N’ amaraso ya Yes’ akiz’ abanyabyaha. N’ amaraso y’ Umukiza, Kand’ aratunganye rwose.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Iyo Soko, Ihora itemba; Uyinywaho iramukiza.

title: Kubw’ Ijambo Ryawe
verses: 1. Kubw’ Ijambo ryawe Nyagasani, Turagushima Mwami Mana. Uduh’ amaso abona neza, Kangur’ imitima yacu.
2. Mw’ Ijambo ryawe harimw’ umucyo, Tubonamw’ amasezerano. N’ itabaza ry’ ibirenge byacu, Ritumurikir’ inzira.
3. Hahirw’ abakomez’ iryo Jambo, Bazabana na Yes’ iteka. Bazarya ku giti cy’ ubugingo; Hafi y’ umugezi mwiza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Waduhaye Bibiliya Yera, Turagushimye Nyagasani. Dufashe twumv’ Ijambo ryawe, Tuyoborwe na ryo Muremyi.

title: Kwizera Kwanjye
verses: 1. Kwizera kwanjye kwabonye uburuhukiro; Niringiye Uhoraho wantangiy’ incungu.
2. Nta bwoba ngifite namba! Yes’ arampagije. Yankuyehw’ ibyaha byose, Kubw’ amaraso Ye.
3. Yesu yaje gukiz’ imitima yazimiye. Yatanz’ amaraso Ye, Kugira ngo ndokoke.
4. Har’ Ijambo rihindura, Kandi rimp’ ituza. N’ Ijambo ryiza ry’ Iman’ Ijambo ry’ ubugingo.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nta yindi ncungw’ ikenewe, Yesu yarishye byose. Yarapfuye, arazuka; Yaranyitangiye.

title: Ibyaha Byanjye Mbihaye Yesu
verses: 1. Ibyaha byanjye mbihaye Yes’ Umwana w’ Intama; Byose ndabimwikoreje, Ngo mbon’ umudendezo. Ibicumuro byanjye, Mbihay’ Umwami Yesu; Anyejesh’ amaraso Ye, Anyeze nse n’ urubura.
2. Kand’ ibyo nkennye byose, Mbishyize ku birenge Bye. Yes’ akiz’ indwara zose, Ndetse n’ ibicumuro. Intimba zanjye zose, Nzishyikiriza Yesu; Kand’ imitwaro yanjye yose, Yes’ arayinyakira.
3. Ndifuza kuba nka Yesu, Niyoroheje nka We. Ndifuza kureba Yes’ Umwana w’ Imana Data. Ndifuza kuzabana, Na Yes’ iyo mw’ ijuru; Nkaririmbana n’ abera, Ntozwa n’ abamarayika.

title: Twegerej’ Igihe
verses: 1. Twegerej’ igihe cyo gutah’ iwacu; Abacu twabuze tuzongera kubonana. Mwami Yesu, Tegur’ ubugingo bwanjye; Nyejesh’ amaraso yaw’ ankiz’ ibyaha byanjye.
2. Dore duhanganye n’ imirab’ ikaze; Arikw’ iri hafi kurangira bidatinze. Tugiye kwiber’ ahatab’ amakuba; Yesu nkiz’ ibyaha mbashe kuzager’ iwawe.
3. Intugunda zose zigiye gushira. Turi hafi guhanagurw’ amarira yose. Mwami Yesu wamviriye amaraso. Mfasha rwose, nzabe mur’ uwo muns’ uhiriwe.
4. N’ igihe kigufi Yes’ akagaruka. Yaradupfiriye, kugira ngo tuzabeho. Mwami Yesu, Tegur’ ubugingo bwanjye; Nyejesh’ amaraso yaw’ ankiz’ ibyaha byanjye.

title: Nagiriw’ Ubuntu
verses: 1. Nagiriw’ ubuntu na Yesu, N’ ubuntu bw’ ikirenga rwose. Umutwaro w’ ibyaha byanjye, Wasigaye i Kaluvari.
2. Ibyaha byarazimanganye; Mbese nk’ uk’ umurab’ utuza. Kubw’ ubuntu butarondorwa; Nakize kubw’ umusaraba.
3. Ubuntu butagereranywa, Bwahawe uwizera wese. Ushaka kubon’ agakiza, Nasange Yes’ aramwakira.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na T.: Kubw’ ubuntu bw’ Imana, Butangaje cyane: Mbeg’ ubuntu! Ubuntu, Bwankijij’ ibyaha. A. na B.: Mbeg’ ubuntu, mbeg’ ubuntu; Bw’ Imana butangaje cyane: Mbeg’ ubuntu! Mbeg’ ubuntu! Ubuntu bwankijij’ ibyaha.

title: Kwa Kwizera Kw’ Abakurambere
verses: 1. Kwa kwizera kw’ abakurambere, Kwa kundi kwababashishaga, Kwemera kuzir’ akarengane; Kwicishw’ inkota n’ umuriro.
2. Baraboshywe baranakubitwa, Baroshywe mu mazu y’ imbohe; Bajugunywa mu byobo by’ intare, Nyamara bagumye kwizera!
3. N’ ubwo batotejwe bikomeye, Nta nzika bigeze bagira! Ntibikomy’ ababatotezaga, Babasabirag’ imigisha!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Uko kwizera natw’ ubu, Tugufite mu mitima. Tuzakunambaho rwose, N’ iyo byaba ngombwa gupfa.

title: Tur’ Abagenzi
verses: 1. Tur ‘ abagenzi mw’ iyi si, Twerekeje mw’ ijuru. Yes’ araduhamagara, Ku nkombe ya yor’dani. Yes’ uw’ uduhamagara, Arashaka ko tumusanga, Tukabana mu bwiza bwe, Turirimb’ iteka.
2. Mbeg’ ukuntu bizaba byiza, Kumv’ amajwi meza; Asingiz’ Umwana w’ Intam’ amajw’ atey’ ubwuzu! Kand’ amajwi yac’ azab’ urwunge n’ ay’ abamarayika. Twese tuzaririmbira Umwami w’ abami.
3. Abacunguwe na Kristo, Bazabon’ ubwiza bwe, N’ abapfuye bamwizeye, Bazakangurwa na we. Tuzasingiz’ intsinzi ye, Twese dukikij’ intebe ye. Tuzataramana n’ Umwam’ atuganirize.
4. Dor’ umunsi w’ Uwiteka, Uri hafi kugera, Kand’ abamwizeye twese, Tuzamusanganira. Tuzasingiz’ urukundo, Rwatumye atang’ Umwana We, Yesu Krist’ akadupfir’ akadukiz’ urupfu.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Bizab’ umunezero kubana na Yesu, Mu  Bwami bwo mw’ ijuru, turirimb’ iteka. Itorero Rye ryo mw’ ijuru, rizaririmb’ aleluya! Rihimbaza Yes’ Umwami Mucunguzi wacu!

title: Duhimbaz’ Imana Y’ Abrahamu

metadata.composer: Arr. Jewish Melody By Meyer Lyon

verses: 1. Mana y’ Abrahamu, Data wo mw’ ijuru; Mana y’ urukundo, Uhorahw’ iteka. Uwiteka Mana, Ijuru n’ isi bikuramye. Izina ryawe niryubahwe, Muremyi wacu.
2. Mana y’ Abrahamu, Mu biganza byawe, Ugabir’ is’ umunezero nyakuri. Ubwema n’ ikuzo, n’ ibyawe Mana yacu nziza. Uri kw’ isonga, Nta wahwana nawe Gitare.
3. Twese dusingiz’ Iman’ Isumba byose. Icyubahiro cyose, n’ icyawe Mana; Wowe Mana Data, Man’ Umwana na Mwuka Wera; Nyir’ ubushoboz’ uhimbazwe, Iteka ryose.

title: Mbeg’ Urukundo!
verses: 1. Mbeg’ urukundo ruhebuje byose! Turasaba Man’ urukomeze; Rub’ urukundo rw’ iteka n’ iteka; Nibab’ umwe muri wowe Mana.
2. Bah’ ubuzima bwiza Mana yacu; Bibere mu bwishingizi bwawe. Ubahe gushikama mu kwizera; Banesh’ imibabaro y’ iyi si.
3. Bah’ ubutwari buzira kwiheba; Banezerwe bagir’ amahoro; Man’ ubahe urukundo rusāze; Bah’ urukundo rutagajuka.

title: Isabato Yera, Munsi W’ Uwiteka
verses: 1. Isabato yera, Munsi w’ Uwiteka; Duhabw’ amahirwe, Yo kumv’ Ijambo ry’ Imana.
2. Mbeg’ umunsi mwiza, Umunsi w’ Imana! Ukwiye kubahwa rwose, tukaramy’ Imana.
3. Abera b’ ijuru baterana natwe; Tugafatanya guhimbaz’ Umuremyi wacu.
4. Ubwo tuzava mw’ iyi si y’ igomero; Tuzakomereza kwez’ Isabato mw’ ijuru.

title: Shuri ry’ Isabato Nkunda
verses: 1. Shuri ry’ Isabato nkunda, Munezero wanjye; Unyongeramw’ imbaraga; Mu rugamba ndwana.
2. Nig’ ibyigisho by’ ingenzi, Umunsi ku wundi. Bituma nsobanukirwa, Ibyiza by’ ijuru.
3. Mw’ ishuri ryo kw’ Isabato, Twiga Bibiliya; Tugahabw’ amabang’ atuma twizera cyane.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mvugisha Mwami Yesu, Nyongera kwizera. Mw’ ishuri ryo kw’ Isabato; Ntabwo nzacogora.

title: Mwami Ha Umugisha Uru Rugo
verses: 1. Aba bashyingiwe, Bah’ umugisha wawe; Wow’ ubagiz’ umwe, By’ itek’ uyu munsi. Barabagiranishwe n’ ubwiza bwawe. Bagwiriz’ urukundo n’ umunezero.
2. Bari ku birenge, Byawe Mwam’ ubahire; Uhir’ amasezerano bagiranye. Mu nzira y’ ubuzima bwab’ ubane na bo; Bahore babumbatiwe naw’ iteka.
3. Amahoro yawe, Atah’ urugo rwabo; Kand’ Ijambo ryawe, Ribamurikire. Yes’ abane na bo, Mu migendere yabo. Yes’ ahore yonger’ urukundo rwabo.
4. Baba mu mahoro, Haba se mu makuba; Yes’ ubagumane, Mu maboko yawe. Be guhungabanywa n’ imiraba y’ iyi si; Ukuboko kwawe kubahe kunesha.

title: Mbeg’ Umunsi Mwiza!
verses: 1. Mbeg’ umunsi mwiza! N’ umunsi wera de! Munsi wo kuruhukwa; Twongerwa mw’ imbaraga.
2. Kand’ Umwuka Wera, Aterana natwe; Agatesh’ inkomyi yatubuz’ umudendezo.
3. Mbeg’ ikiruhuko! Gituma turamya, Imana yo mw’ ijuru, Maze tugasābana.
4. Mbeg’ umunsi mwiza, Umunsi wejejwe! Imitim’ irakanguka; Tukanesh’ urupfu.

title: Umunsi W’ Isabat’ Uragarutse
verses: 1. Umunsi w’ Isabat’ uragarutse; Munsi wera wahiriwe n’ Imana yacu. Munsi mwiza turuhuk’ imirimo; Munsi w’ ituze, Munsi w’ amahoro.
2. Twite kur’ uyu munsi w’ Uwiteka; Twige kandi tumenye gukor’ iby’ ashaka. Azajya yumv’ amasengesho yacu; N’ indirimbo zacu zizamunyura.
3. Uwiteka Mana, duteg’ amatwi; Wumv’ ijwi ry’ abana bawe bagutakira. Udukomerez’ amasezerano; Ubuntu bwawe busage muri twe.
4. Data wo mw’ ijur’ ur’ Umurengezi; Ni wowe twubatsehw’ ibyiringiro byacu. Ur’ inshuti itadutererana; Icyubahiro kib’ icyawe Mana!

title: Mwami Nyir’ Isabato

metadata.composer: Arr. From Frederick M. A. Venua, c. 1810

verses: 1. Mwami Nyir’ isabato yera de! Nkez’ umunsi wawe w’ ikiruhuko. Muns’ umpora ku mutima, N’ umuns’ ungarura mw’ intege; Mpabwamw’  imigisha ngakomera.
2. Munsi wuj’ amahoro n’ ituze, Umunsi wose numva nezerewe! Intekerezo mbi zose, Zirahunga zikanjya kure; Nkibwir’ ibyiza byera by’ ijuru.
3. Mbeg’ ukunt’ ar’ iby’ igikundiro, Iyo ngeze mu munsi wahiriwe! Nkumv’ indirimbo z’ ihozo, Ntwarwa gusa n’ ibyo mw’ ijuru! Munsi mwiza mbonamw’ imigisha.
4. Ntaramana nawe Mwami Yesu, Mur’ uyu munsi mwiza wahiriwe! Jyew’ umugaragu wawe, Gukomez’ isabato yawe, Bizampesha imigisha myinshi.

title: Umubano Uba Mwiza
verses: 1. Umubano uba mwiza, Mu rugo Yes’ arimo; Urukundo ruranesha, Hab’ ituze rihamye. Ikinyabupfura ni cyo kiranga urwo rugo, Umugabo n’ umugore, Iyo bubah’ Imana.
2. Urugo rwunguts’ umwana, Hab’ ibyishimo byinshi. Nahabw’ uburere bwiza, Ab’ umwana w’ ijuru; Umwan’ unezez’ Imana, Kand’ uzabana na yo; Abane n’ Umwami Yesu, Kand’ ayoborwe na we.
3. Urugo rwa hano mw’ isi, n’ urw’ igihe kigufi, N’ ubund’ ibyo mw’ isi byose, Ntabwo biramba rwose. Ibyiza birut’ ibindi, Kandi bizahoraho, Tuzahurizwa mw’ ijuru; Tuzabana by’ iteka.
4. Ibyo duhabwa n’ Imana mu rugendo turimo; Tubyakiran’ ibyishimo, Tubyifatemo neza. Twirinde gutsindwa n’ ibigeragezo by’ Umwanzi; Dusarur’ iby’ urukundo, Rw’ Imana yac’ iduha.

title: Mu Gihe Ntugarijwe
verses: 1. Mu gihe ntugarijwe N’ akaga gakomeye; Yes’ umbwiz’ ijwi ryiz’ uti: Humura ndahari.
2. Iy’ umurab’ ukaramye, Ntabwo mpungabana. Krist’ ankomez’ ambwir’ ati: Humura ndahari.
3. Umwijim’ iy’ ubuditse, Nkabur’ iyo ngana; Numv’ ijwi rimpabura ngo: Humura ndahari.

title: Inyungu N’ Ibyubahiro …
verses: 1. Inyungu n’ ibyubahiro byo mw’ iyi si, Jye ndabizinukwa. Iyo ndeby’ umusaraba Yes’ Umwami yabambweho; Nsang’ iby’ is’ ar’ impfabusa.
2. Yesu yarababajwe cyane, Intimba imen’ umutima; Kubw’ ubuntu yangiriye, N’ urukundo ruhanitse, Rwamuteye kuncungura.
3. Nari narazimiye rwose, Narabuze ibyiringiro; Ancunguz’ amaraso ye, Nanjye mpabw’ icyubahiro; Maz’ amahor’ aransāba.
4. Urukundo rwawe rurera, Ruhoraho ibihe byose. Nzahora ndwogez’ iteka, Kandi nzahora ndurata; Sinzareka kuruvuga!

title: Munsi Mwiza W’ Umunezero
verses: 1. Munsi mwiza w’ umunezero! Ur’ umunsi wera de! Ur’ umuns’ urut’ indi yose; Munsi wo kuruhukwa. Abakomeye n’ aboroheje, Bunamir’ Uwiteka; Baririmba: Wera! Wera! Wera! Uhimbazw’ iteka.
2. Muns’ urinzwe cyane n’ Imana; nta cyawuhungabanya. Tugomororerw’ amasoko yo muri Paradizo. Soko y’ amariba mez’ afutse, Y’ amaz’ amar’ inyota. Duhagarara kuri Pisiga, Tureb’ i Kanani.
3. N’ umunsi tuzirikana cyan’ urukundo rw’ Imana; Turushaho gutekereza ibyiza byo mw’ ijuru. Duhabw’ imigisha myinshi cyane, Mur’ uyu munsi mwiza; Twumva rwose twakwigumira, Mur’ uyu munsi wera!

title: Ibyaremwe Byose …
verses: 1. Ibyaremwe byose nibiter’ amajwi hejuru; Byishimir’ Umuremyi, Bimuririmbire. Koko yaraturemye; Kandi n’ Umurinzi wacu, N’ Umuyobozi wacu, Kugez’ imperuka. Adukingir’ ibihe byose, Atugend’ imber’ iteka. Mu mwijim’ atuber’ inkingi y’ umuriro; Atamurur’ ibihu; Akadukiz’ umwijima; Tukagendera mu mucyo wera w’ Imana.

2. Yahanits’ inyenyeri; Ategek’ izuba kuva. Ni we wahanz’ imisozi, N’ inyanja zose; Imigezi n’ inzuzi n’ amasoko birasuma! Byose kw’ itegeko ry’ Umuremy’ udukunda. Guhera mu bushorishori, No mu kuzimu mu nyanja; Byose bihamy’ Imana, Yukw’ ar’ Umuremyi. Natwe biradukwiye, Guhanik’ amajwi yacu; Tugasingiz’ iyo Mana; tuti: Hozana!

title: Iyo Ngukoreye Yesu
verses: 1. Iyo ngukoreye Yesu, Biranezeza; Iri turo ntuye, Mwami rikunezeze.
2. Warancunguye Mukiza, Mb’ uwawe rwose. None rer’ umbashishe, Gukor’ iby’ ushaka.
3. Ungir’ umumarayika wihuta cyane; Njyan’ Ijambo ryawe hose, Mvug’ ubutumwa.
4. Rwose kuzaba mw’ ijuru, Ni byo nifuza; Nta byago nta n’ amakuba bizantezura.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nguhay’ ubugingo bwanjye, Bwakire Yesu Kubw’ ubuntu bwawe Mwami, Undind’ ibibi.

title: Gihome Kidukingira
verses: 1. Mana yac’ urakomeye; Gihome kidukingira; Udukingir’ imiraba, Y’ ingorane n’ amakuba. Uturind’ Umwanzi uhor’ aduhiga; Afit’ imbaraga, Ntabwo twamwifasha; Ntitwamwibashisha na gato.
2. Dushatse kwirwanirira, Twatsindwa rwose ruhemu. Keretse dufite Yesu, We mukiranutsi wera. Yaneshej’ umwanzi; Kandi yiteguye Kuturwanirira; Turi kumwe na We; Nta kabuza tuzanesha.
3. Iyi si yuzuy’ ibibi, Bishobora kuturimbura. Ntidukwiye guhabuka; Twisung’ umucyo w’ Imana. Ntiduterw’ ubwoba n’ Umwanzi w’ umucyo. Ni Se w’ umwijima; Kand’ azarimburwa; Azajugunywa mu muriro!
4. Nta wabasha guhindura ubushake bwa Rurema; Ibyo yategetse byose, Ntibikomwa mu nkokora. N’ ubwo byab’ urupfu, Cyangw’ ikindi cyose, Ijambo ry’ Imana nta cyarivanaho, Kugez’ iteka n’ iteka.

title: Ukomere Ub’ Intwari

metadata.composer: W. B. Bradbury and Philip P. Bliss

verses: 1. Mukristo byuka, Yes’ aragushaka. Ambar’ intwaro zose z’ urugamba; Hangana n’ Umwanz’ udafit’ ubwoba; Rwana; Shikama; Ntutiny’ urugamba.
2. Rwanira Yesu, Ushyizeh’ umwete; Kand’ ube maso kugez’ iherezo; Ujy’ aho Yes’ akuyobora hose. Rwana; Shikama; Ntutiny’ urugamba.
3. Ntushidikanye Yesu n’ Umugaba. Azakurinda; Azagukomeza, Kand’ akuyoboresh’ urukundo rwe. Rwana; Shikama; Ntutiny’ urugamba.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Tyo shikama, Ukomere ub’ intwari; Utsind’ Umubisha.

title: Mbes’ Aho Tuzahurira Ku Cyambu? (B)
verses: 1. Mbes’ aho tuzahurira, Ku cyambu cya rwa ruzi, Ahahor’ umucy’ iteka, Ntihab’ umubabaro?
2. Tuzahurira ku cyamb’ urugendo rurangiye? Mbes’ aho tuzahurirayo, Maze twiruhutse?
3. Mbes’ aho twese tuzahurira mu mudugudu, Wubatswe n’ Uhoraho, Urimbishijwe Yasipi?
4. Abacunguwe bose, Bazaririmb’ indirimbo; Kand’ ibiremwa byose, Bizasingiz’ Uhoraho.
5. Mbes’ aho tuzabonana n’ abo twakundanaga? Maze twumv’ amajwi yabo, Tubareba mu maso?
6. Mbese tuzabonana na Krist’ Umukiza wacu, Aje kujyan’ intore ze, Mu bwami buhoraho?
chorus: Gusubiramo: Se koko tuzahurira hakurya y’ uruzi? Tuzabonanirayo tuhanezererw’ iteka?

title: Data Umv’ Isengesho Ryacu
verses: 1. Dat’ umv’ isengesho ryacu; Uduhire, Uduh’ umugisha. Amen.

title: Ducan’ Amatara Yacu
verses: 1. Muze dushikame, Ducany’ amatara yacu; Umukw’ agiye guhamagar’ Umugeni we.
2. Abamarayika hamwe n’ abatoranijwe; Bazateranira hamwe, Basingize Yesu.
3. Yesu n’ umuneshi wacu, Yaratwitangiye. Afit’ umucy’ utangaje, Urabagirana.
4. Yes’ azahamagar’ abo yacunguye bose; Ati: Muz’ abihanganye, Mu rugo rwa Data.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Twitegure kuririmba tuti: Hozana! Tuzasabwa n’ ibyishimo turirimb’ Aleluya; Turirimba Aleluya!

title: Bana, Nimwitonde
verses: 1. Bana nimwitonde, Kandi mwishime; Muse n’ abo mw’ ijuru, Munezerwe.
2. Mur’ abavandimwe, Nimukundane; Mwubah’ ababyeyi, Kandi mwumvire.
3. Mwirind’ umujinya; Ntimukabeshye; Ibyo muvuga, Bishimishe Yesu.

title: Gupfa Ni Ibitotsi
verses: 1. Gupfa n’ ibitotsi gusa, Kandi by’ akanya gato. N’ ubw’ urupfu rubabaza, Rugater’ agahinda; Ijoro rizatamuruka, Maz’ umucy’ utangaze; Abasinziriye mu bituro, Bazakangurwa.
2. Gupfa n’ ibitotsi gusa, Kandi by’ akanya gato. Yesu yaneshej’ urupfu; Yavuye mu gituro. N’ akanya gato gasigaye, Tukigira mw’ ijuru; Aho Yes’ azatujyana; Tuzaban’ ibudapfa.

title: Hagarara Kigabo Nka Daniel
verses: 1. Komez’ amategeko yera y’ Imana; Shikama mu kuri kw’ Imana nka Daniel.
2. Benshi barananiwe, Bacits’ intege; Ntibashoboye gushikama nka Daniel.
3. Benshi baharanira iby’ isi gusa; Ntibazi gufat’ icyemezo nka Daniel.
4. Twirinde cyane rwose, Kandi tuneshe; Twung’ ubumwe na Daniel, Tumere nka we.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Hagarara kigabo nka Daniel; Hamy’ Imana n’ubwo wab’ usigay’ ur’ umwe.

title: Ngwino Mwuka Wera We!
verses: 1. Ngwino Mwuka  Wera We! Maz’ uture muri twe. Tuber’ umuyobozi; Tugan’ iwacu.

title: Har’ Igihe Ntegereje
verses: 1. Har’ igi-he ntegereje, Nza-nezerwamo; Icyo gi-he kiri hafi, nza-habw’ ikamba. Amasengesho yanjye, Imana ira-yumva; Nzakome-za mpirimbane, Nza-habw’ ikamba.
2. Ikamba ritegereje a-bazanesha. Nzashika-ma, Nzakomeza nyo-boke Yesu; Sinshaka kuza-bura mu bwami bwo mw’ i-juru; Mu biro-ri byateguriwe abaneshi.
3. Ndatanya, ndater’ intambwe, Si-ndeb’ inyuma. Nyobowe na Nyagasani si-nzatezuka; Ibirangaza by’ isi, Simbyitayeho namba! N’ubw’ ibi-ndwany’ ari byinshi, Mfi-t’ a-mahoro.
4. Mana y’ u-buntu n’ impuhwe, U-murikire. Mfatish’ u-kuboko kwawe, Ma-z’ unkomeze. Nd’ umunyantege nkeya, Ariko nitu-bana, Sinshidi-kanya na gato, Ma-na nzanesha.

title: Uwiteka Ari Mu Rusengero
verses: 1. Uwitek’ ari mu rusengero; Ari mu rusengero rwe rwera. Isi yose nituze; Duturiz’ imbere y’ Imana; Tyo dutuze, dutuze, dutuze. Amen.

title: Yesu Nikoreye Umusaraba
verses: 1. Yesu ndagukurikiye, Ndetse byose ndaje Mwami. Nikorey’ umusaraba, Ndagukurikiye Mukiza. Dor’ ibyar’ indamu zanjye, Sinkibyitayeho namba; Mpisemo kugira Yesu, Akaba mu bugingo bwanjye.
2. Ab’ isi barantoteza, Kuko badafite Yesu. Batay’ Umukiza wanjye, Barashaka kungerageza. N’ ubwo bampana bakandeka, Yesu ampor’ iruhande. Yes’ ampa kwihanganira, Ingorane z’ iyi si zose.
3. Isi yahaw’ agakiza, Yesu yarayicunguye. Yesu yaneshej’ icyaha; Nta bwoba ngifite na gato. Umwuka  Wer’ ari muri twe; Mbeg’ umunezero mwinshi! Nawe yaragupfiriye, Ng’ uzabane na we mw’ ijuru!
4. Twar’ intwaro zo kwizera; Senga cyan’ ubudatuza; Ugiye gutah’ ijuru, Hazab’ umunezero mwinshi! Ibyo dukorera mw’ isi, Biri hafi kurangira. N’ ibyiringiro bishyitse, Tuzabona Data mw’ ijuru.

title: Mwami Nje Ngusanga
verses: 1. Mwami nje ngusanga, Nje bugufi bwawe. Umpire Mwami, Wowe soko y’ ubugingo bw’ iteka; Umpire Mwami; Wowe soko y’ ubugingo bw’ iteka.
2. Mp’ umutim’ utuje, Mwami ndakwinginze. Ngwin’ umvugishe, Unganirize, Mwami mwiza wera; Ngwin’ umvugishe, Unganirize, Mwami mwiza wera.
3. Umpe gusa nawe, Mpa kamere yawe; Ndashaka rwose kumera nkawe, Mpa kumera nkawe; Ndashaka rwose kumera nkawe, Mpa kumera nkawe.
4. Mp’ ubutwari Mwami, Unshoboze Mwami; Umpe gukor’ umurimo wawe, Uko bikwiriye; Umpe gukor’ umurimo wawe, Uko bikwiriye.
5. Ubw’ uzab’ uje kujyan’ intore zawe; Nanjy’ uzanjyane Mwami w’ abami, Ubw’ uzagaruka; Nanjy’ uzanjyane Mwami w’ abami, Ubw’ uzagaruka.

title: Uko Duteraniye Hamwe
verses: 1. Uko tur’ aha, Duteraniye hamwe, Mwami Nyagasan’ uduh’ umugisha. Uduhana kugira ngo twihan’ ibyaha; N’ubwo tur’ abanyabyaha, Ntujy’ utureka.
2. Ni wow’ uturinda, Nyagasani Mana; Wow’ udushyira ku murimo wawe. Ni wowe uduha kunesha ku rugamba, Maz’ Imana yac’ igahabw’ icyubahiro.
3. Twererez’ izina ryawe Mana yera. Urind’ umukumbi waw’ amakuba, Utuber’ Umurengezi mu bihe byose. Duh’ umudendezo, Tuguhimbaze Mana.

title: Mfat’ Ikiganza
verses: 1. Mu gihe ndi hafi kubur’ ibyiringiro; Mu gihe ntentebutse; Yesu ndakwinginze, Wumve gutaka kwanjye; Mfat’ ikiganza, Maz’ ungez’ iwacu.
2. Mu gihe mbundikiwe n’ umwijima mwinshi, W’ ibyago n’ amakuba, Umpe kwambuk’ inyanja y’ ibigeragezo. Mfat’ ikiganza, Maz’ ungez’ iwacu.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mwami mwiza cyane, Umfate unkomeze. Ndarushye, Ndihebye, Nta ntege. Mu  mwijim’ ukaze, Umfate unkomeze; Mfat’ ikiganza, Maz’ ungez’ iwacu.

title: Mwami Wanjye Nyakira
verses: 1. Mwami wanjy’ akir’ umubiri wanjye; Uwuhindur’ urusengero rwawe rwera. Nywugukoreshereze kujya nguhimbaza, Mpore nguhesh’ ikuzo.
2. Mwami wanjy’ akira impano zanjye; Zikoresh’ uk’ ushaka, Ziguhesh’ ikuzo. Ngiz’ italanto zanjye, Zikuramye Mwami, Mpore nguhesh’ ikuzo.
3. Mwami wanjye nguhay’ igihe cyanjye; Umwanya wose mfite, ndawukweguriye; Ngo kimber’ igihe cyo gukor’ iby’ ushaka, Mpore nguhesh’ ikuzo.
4. Mwami wanjy’ akir’ ubutunzi bwanjye; Wabumpereye kugira ngo mbukoreshe. Unyonger’ imigisha, mubyo nkora byose, Mpore nguhesh’ ikuzo.

title: Mucunguzi Mwiza
verses: 1. Ndareb’ Umucunguzi wanjye, Azamukan’ intimba nyinshi! Ku musozi wa Kaluvari, Bamwikorej’ umusaraba!
2. Data mwiza, bababarire! Ni ko yasabiy’ abagome. Amaraso y’ arameneka, Azir’ ibyaha byanjye nawe.
3. Yes’ Umucunguz’ arankunda; Kubw’ ibyo nanjye ndamukunda. Nzahora muhimbaz’ iteka! Yarancunguye, nahimbazwe!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ndareb’ Umucunguzi wanjye, Ababaye; Agan’ i Kaluvari. Yatew’ intimba n’ ibyaha byanjye; Yarambabarijwe ngo nkire.

title: Mpa Umugisha Waw’ Ubu
verses: 1. Mbe Data wo mw’ ijuru, Ngwin’ umpire rwos’ ubu; Umbabarir’ ibyaha, Unkiz’ ibicumuro.
2. Nkeney’ ubuntu bwawe, Nyongerer’ imbaraga. Ndi kwig’ Ijambo ryawe, Ngwino rwos’ umpir’ ubu.
3. Yesu nkiz’ umvaneho imbogamizi zose. Ni wowe ndangamiye, Nkorah’ unyez’ ibyaha.
4. Nicishije bugufi, Mpfukamy’ imbere yawe. Yesu ngwin’ unkiz’ ubu, Wumve gutaka kwanjye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Data wo mw’ ijuru, Mp’ umugisha waw’ ubu.

title: Kuba Mu Maboko Yawe
verses: 1. Kuba mu maboko yawe, N’ iby’ igikundiro; Man’ iyo nkumva bugufi, Numva nkomeye cyane.
2. Wemera ko nguh’ ibimbabaza byanjye byose, Nkakwikorez’ amaganya yanjye yos’ ukw’ angana.
3. Ndakwiringira Nyagasani, Nguhanz’ amaso; Ucuby’ imiraba, Wumv’ amasengesho dusenga.
4. Iby’ ejo ntibimpangayikishije na hato. Ko ngufite Mana yanjye, Naterw’ ubwoba n’ iki?
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Umwikorez’ amaganya, Umuh’ imitwaro yawe. Muh’ ibikurushya byose, Kukw’ anezezwa no kukurinda. T. na B.: Umwiko-re-ze, Korez’ amaganya, Umuh’ i - h’imitwaro yawe. Muh’ ibikuru - bikurushya byose, Kunezezwa no kurinda.

title: Mwibur’ Ibyiringiro
verses: 1. Mwibur’ ibyiringiro, Ngo mukuk’ imitima. Mureke guhogora, Abapfiriye muri Yesu bazazuka.
2. Igihe kiri bugufi, Tyo nimube maso. Yes’ agiye kwimika ingom’ idahanguka, Tuzaba mw’ iteka.
3. Tyo twe gukuk’ imitima, Yesu ntazatinda, Azaduhanagura amarira ku maso, Nta kurir’ ukundi.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Humuriza bose, Bibuts’ ayo magambo; Ko Yesu yapfuye, Arikw’ akazuka. Tuzabana na we, Kuko yaducunguye; Urupfu ntiruzongera kubaho.

title: Dushim’ Umwam’ Imana
verses: 1. Duhimbaz’ Umwam’ Imana, Ushobora byose; Umutima wanjy’ urahimbaz’ Imana Data. Tumuramye, Tumuh’ icyubahiro, Kukw’ ar’ Umwami w’ abami.
2. Duhimbaz’ Umwam’ utegek’ ibyaremwe byose; Atubundikishij’ amabab’ araturinda. Mbeg’ uburyo ibyo yaremye byose, Byumvir’ amategeko Ye!
3. Duhimbaz’ Umwami, Nyir’ ibyiza bihebuje! Imbabazi ze n’ impuhwe bihorahw’ iteka. Tuzirikan’ ibyiz’ adukorera, N’ inshut’ itagereranwa.

title: Nimuze Kwa Yes’ Arabakunda
verses: 1. Nimuze kwa Yes’ arabakunda, Nimucik’ ingoyi z’ umwanzi; Yesu yiteguye kubakira, Atez’ ibiganza.
2. Yemwe banyabyaha nimwitabe, Yes’ abafitiy’ urukundo. Mwe kwigomeka nimumusange, Mwisubir’ inyuma.
3. Dor’ igihe kirihuta bwangu, Nimureke kwirindiriza. Yes’ arahari nimumusange, Rwos’ arabakira.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mbeg’ umuns’ uneje-je cyane! Kwibera mu mabo-ko ye! Mu  nzu ya Data ni heza cyane, Har’ umunezero.

title: Iby’ Imana Ikora
verses: 1. Iby’ Iman’ ikor’ ibikora mu buryo bwayo! Iter’ intambwe mu nyanj’ umurab’ ugahunga.
2. Ntabw’ abubah’ Imana, Bakwiye kuyitinya, Ni yo Nyir’ impuhwe nyinshi, Itang’ imigisha.
3. Kubw’ ubuntu, Tubasha kuyisobanukirwa. Iyo tuyirengagije, Tugir’ igihombo.
4. N’ Iman’ itabura gusohoz’ ibyo yavuze, Idufitiy’ imigambi myiz’ ikiranuka.
5. Umunt’ udafite kwizera, Ntiyayimenya. Ihishurir’ abayikund’ imigambi yayo.

title: Nkeneye Umukiza
verses: 1. Nkeney’ Umukiza Yesu, Nshaka kumwigiraho; Nkager’ ikirenge mu cye, Nca mu nzir’ ifunganye.
2. Nzajy’ ahw’ azantuma hose, Nzahora niteguye. Sindi muto byatuma ntabasha kujy’ ahw’ antuma.
3. Dor’ ahagaze ku rugi, Kand’ arampamagara. Ngo musange anyakire, Ankiz’ ibyaha byanjye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Arankunda, Arankunda, Yes’ arankunda cyane! Yarapfuy’ ari jy’ azira; Ni yo mpamvu mukunda.

title: Abarembejwe N’ Ibyaha
verses: 1. Abarembejwe n’ ibyaha, Musang’ Umukiza, Arabaruhura, Nimumwiringira rwose.
2. Yabaviriy’ amaraso, Ahesh’ umugisha; Mwiyuhagire mo, Arabeza nk’ urubura.
3. Yesu ni we kuri, Ni we nzira y’ amahoro, Nimumwizer’ azabah’ ubugingo bw’ iteka.
4. Nimusang’ abera, Maze musingize Yesu, Ni bwo muzatura, Mu gihugu cy’ amahoro.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mwiringire Yesu, Nimumwiringire rwose. Mwiringire Yesu, Mumwiringire mukire.

title: Ngwino Hafi Y’ Umusaraba
verses: 1. Tyo ngwino hafi y’ umusaraba, Wa munyabyaha we; Ikiganza cya Yesu cyiteguye kugukiza.
2. Wowe wahumanijwe n’ ibyaha, Ngwino Yes’ akweze; Wihane Yes’ akugire mushya mu kanya gato!
3. Ngwino Yes’ agutur’ umutwaro, Maz’ akuruhure; Hafi y’ umusaraba ni h’ uzabon’ amahoro.
4. Uhor’ ufata hirya no hino, Wabuz’ ishyikizo; Ngwino hafi y’ umusaraba ubon’ agakiza.

title: Wari Aho Babamby’ Umwami Wanjye?
verses: 1. War’ aho babamby’ Umwami Yesu? War’ aho babamby’ Umwami wanjye? War’ uhari? Binter’ umubabaro mwinshi. Mbese koko war’ aho babamby’ Umwami wanjye?
2. War’ uhari abambwa ku giti? War’ uhari abambwa ku giti? War’ uhari? Binter’ umubabaro mwinshi. Mbese koko war’ aho babamby’ Umwami wanjye?
3. Wari yo bamucumit’ icumu? Wari yo bamucumit’ icumu? War’ uhari? Binter’ umubabaro mwinshi. Mbese koko war’ aho babamby’ Umwami wanjye?
4. Wariy’ igih’ izuba ryijima? Wariy’ igih’ izuba ryijima? War’ uhari? Binter’ umubabaro mwinshi. Mbese koko war’ aho babamby’ Umwami wanjye?
5. War’ uhar’ igihe bamuhamba? War’ uhar’ igihe bamuhamba? War’ uhari? Binter’ umubabaro mwinshi. Mbese koko war’ aho babamby’ Umwami wanjye?

title: Nimuzan’ Icyacumi
verses: 1. Nimwumv’ amagambo y’ ibyanditswe kera, Avug’ ati: Muzan’ icyacumi. Nimwih’ Imana mwezwe, Ngo mubon’ uko muhabw’ umugisha mwinshi.
2. Nimushak’ imbaraga y’ Umwuka Wera, Nimuzan’ icyacumi gishyitse. Kandi nimukizane nk’ uko byanditswe, Ibasukehw’ imigisha.
3. Se har’ icyabatandukanya n’ Imana? Nimuzan’ icyacumi gishyitse; Mubone  kubana n’ Imana iteka, Isohoz’ isezerano.
4. Nimwegurire Yes’ imitima yanyu; Nimuzan’ icyacumi gishyitse; Nimwizer’ isezerano ry’ Uhoraho, Bizabah’ umunezero.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nimuzan’ icyacumi gishyitse. Iman’ iti: Mungerageze. Izabasukahw’ imigisha, Maze mubur’ aho muzayikwiza.

title: Hirya No Hino Har’ Umukumbi
verses: 1. Hirya no hino har’ umukumbi, Ugoswe n’ amakub’ akomeye, N’ ubutayu bucuz’ umwijima, Dor’ inzira ntabw’ igaragara. Wumv’ amajwi mensh’ aratabaza, Bakeney’ umutabazi; Har’ ijwi ryiza rihumuriza, Ribabwira riti: Mukomere.

2. Uwo mukumb’  ukeney’ umucyo, Ku mategeko cumi y’ Imana, Yukw’ ar’ ayera kand’ aboneye; Bakwiriye kuyakurikiza. Mw’ uru rugendo rujya mw’ ijuru, Bakeneye Yesu Kristo, Kung’ ubumw’ urukundo kwizera, Bakicisha buguf’ imbere Ye.

3. Har’ ahantu hahebuj’ ubwiza, Mu rurembo rurabagirana; Amarembo yarw’ aruguruye, N’ ahantu heza h’ igikundiro; Hazirana n’ icyaha n’ urupfu; Nta mubabar’ uzabayo. Aho ni ho tuzateranira, Ntabwo tuzongera gupf’ ukundi.

4. Dore Yes’ agiye kugaruka hamwe n’ ibic’ azur’ abapfuye. Abacunguwe bazazamurwa, Baririmbana umunezero. Ngwino Mwami, Ngwin’ udutabare; Twigir’ iwacu mw’ ijuru, Turagutegereje Mukiza, Utujyane kwibera mw’ ijuru.

title: Tur’ Abasirikari Mu Ngabo Za Yesu
verses: 1. Tur’ abasirikari mu ngabo za Yesu; Ku rugamba tuyobowe na Yesu; Tugamije gutsinda Satani n’ ingabo ze, Kandi ntiduteze gusubir’ inyuma.
2. Abanzi b’ Ubutumwa barahagurutse; Bagambiriye kutugamburuza. Bafit’ ishyari ryinshi, n’ umujiny’ utavugwa, Dukomez’ ibirindiro tuzanesha.
3. Tugendere munsi y’ ibendera rya Yesu; Dufit’ intwaro zirabagirana; Zacuriwe mu ruganda rutoz’ urukundo, Duharanir’ ikamba ritangirika.
4. Turaharanira kuzataha mw’ ijuru; Mu bwami bw’ Umukiza wacu Yesu. Mubivuge hose mwamamaz’ ubutumwa bwe, Abantu babumenye bakizw’ ibyaha.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Dushyire hamwe, Twitabir’ urugamba. Yesu ni w’ utuyoboy’ atur’ imbere, N’ubw’ urugamba rwakomera rute, Tuzarutsinda kubw’ Umwami Yesu.

title: N’ Iki Cyatuma Tumwirengagiza?
verses: 1. N’ iki cyatuma twirengagiz’ Umukiza, Se har’ icyadutera kumwibagirwa? Kand’ aturinda ku manywa na nijoro, Aturagira nk’ Umwunger’ udakenesha.
2. N’ iki cyatuma twirengagiz’ Umukiza, Tukibagirwa uwatubabarijwe, Ubu yicaye ku ntebe ye ya cyami, N’ Umuhuza wacu w’ ibihe bidashira.
3. N’ iki cyatuma twirengagiz’ Umukiza, Kand’ ahor’ abera maso kuturinda. N’ inshuti nziza irut’ izindi zose, Nta muntu n’ umwe yigera ahemukira.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Tuzagendera mu mucyo w’ Umwami wacu iteka, Tuzitangira kumukorera, Turamwumvira ngw’ aduhe k’ Umwuka we, Tubone kumuhesh’ icyubahiro cyinshi.

title: Inanga Z’ Izahabu Ziracurangwa
verses: 1. Inanga z’ izahabu ziracurangwa, Amaremb’ arakinguk’ arinjira. Umwami  w’ imbabazi n’ urukundo, Yaratabarutse atsinz’ urupfu.
2. Yavukiye mw’ isi ngw’ aturokore, Arapf’ arazuka, ajya mw’ ijuru. Vuz’ impundu koko yaranesheje, Nasingizwe n’ abo mw’ iyi si n’ ijuru.
3. Twes’ abana b’ ahor’ adusabira, Muze tweger’ intebe ye y’ ubwami. Yaduteguriye amazu meza, Ngo tuzabaneyo mu munezero.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yesu yasohoj’ umurimo we, Non’ ari mw’ ijuru, Tumuhimbaze.

title: Yesu Ngwino Ubane N’ Itorero Ryawe
verses: 1. Yesu ngwin’ ubane n’ itorero ryawe ryose. Rifashe, ribashe gutsind’ ibigeragezo.
2. Ribashe gutunganya nez’ inshingano zaryo; Riburir’ abo mw’ isi, Bitegur’ urubanza.
3. Ryite ku batabona, N’ abakene bo mw’ isi; Rihabur’ abahabye, Ribabwir’ ibya Yesu.
4. Ryuzur’ Umwuka Wera, Maze rinesh’ icyaha, Rihuze mw’ isi yose, Yesu turakwinginze.

title: Duhimbaze Yesu
verses: 1. Duhimbaze Yesu Mucunguzi wacu, Turirimb’ urukundo rwe rwinshi. Afit’ icyubahiro giheranije; Izina rye ryera risingizwe! N’ Umwungeri mwiza wita ku ntama ze, Arind’ abana b’ ibihe byose.
2. Duhimbaze Yesu Mucunguzi wacu, Yatew’ intimb’ arapfa ku bwacu! Ni we byiringiro by’ agakiza kacu, Ni yubahwe yaratubambiwe. Yarababajwe apfa mu cyimbo cyacu, Kubw’ urukundo rwe rutangaje!
