3. Duhimbaze Yesu Mucunguzi wacu, Ijuru ryasābwe n’ ibyishimo! N’ intwari n’ umuneshi yambay’ ikamba. N’ Umwami wac’ utuvuganira, Umwami Yesu ugiye kugaruka, Azaza mu cyubahiro cyinshi!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Tumuhimbaze tumuh’ ikuzo ryinshi, Tumutur’ indirimbo y’ ishimwe.

title: Ukw’ Ibihe Bigenda Bihita
verses: 1. Ukw’ ibihe bigenda bihita, Mpangana n’ ibigeragezo; Ariko kubwo kwisung’ Imana, Nshobozwa kubitsinda byose. Kubwo  kwiringir’ Imana Data, Sinshobora kwiheba rwose; Irankunda birenz’ urugero; Imp’ amahoro n’ ibyishimo!

2. Uwitek’ Umwami wanjye mwiza, Ntasiba kungirir’ impuhwe. Yita ku mitwaro yanjye yose, Amber’ umujyanama mwiza. Ni w’ urind’ imibereho yanjye, Kand’ afit’ imbaraga nyinshi; Kumugira n’ ubutunzi bwinshi, Ni we mahirwe yanjye yose.

3. Mfasha Data nkomeze nkwizere, N’ ubwo nanyura mu makuba, Niringir’ isezerano ryawe, Niringir’ ihumure ryawe. Unkiz’ umuraba w’ amakuba, Mbashisha guhangana neshe; Kw’ iherez’ uzangeze mw’ ijuru, Mu gihugu cy’ isezerano.

title: Mfit’ Umukiza N’ Inshut’ Inkunda
verses: 1. Mfit’ Umukiza kand’ adukunda twese, Iyaba namwe mwari mumumenye. Aramvuganira kwa Data wo mw’ ijuru, Icyampa namw’ akababer’ inshuti.
2. Yesu yampay’ amahoro mu mutima, Iyab’ ibyo mwari mubizi neza. Kubw’ amaraso yaviriy’ i Gologota, Nawe numwakira urayahabwa.
3. Har’ ibyiringiro duhabwa n’ Imana, Iyab’ ibyo mwari mubizi neza. Ijwi riduhamagara rihumuriza, Ritang’ amahoro yo mu mutima.
4. Mumeny’ ubury’ Umwami Yes’ abakunda, Umutwar’ aguha nturemereye. Umubwire n’ abandi na bo bamumenye, Maz’ ubabwir’ ibyo yagukoreye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yes’ aragukunda, Umugir’ inshuti. Kand’ abe kw’ isonga; Azajy’ agufasha.

title: Urukundo Rwawe Mana
verses: 1. Urukundo rwawe Mana, Ni rwo ruduhamagara. Ni muri rwo twaremewe, Ni na rwo rutubeshaho. N’ ubwo twagucumuyeho, Tugaruts’ imbere yawe.
2. Tuje kugutur’ intimba z’ imitima imenetse; Tugoswe n’ ingoyi nyinshi, Zitubuz’ umudendezo; Utuvane mu bwigunge, Uduhaz’ ibyiringiro.
3. Mana Data muri Yesu watugiz’ abana bawe; Ntacyo twakoze na kimwe, Cyaduhesh’ ayo mahirwe; N’ ubuntu bwawe Nyagasani, Twese tugupfukamire!
4. Imitima yacu Mana, Icishwe bugufi cyane; Dusingize mu ndirimbo, Imana yakunz’ ab’ isi; Yatugize inshuti zayo, Natwe tuyikunde cyane.
5. Ni y’ iduh’ umudendezo, Muri Yes’ Umwana wayo; Kubw’ amaraso yavuye, Twagizwe bashya muri we; Kubw’ ubugingo bwe yatanze, Twagizw’ abana b’ Imana!

title: Ni Mutyo Turirimbe…
verses: 1. Nimutyo turirimbe ineza ya Yesu, Ibyishimo bisābe imitima yacu. Twabony’ agakiza, Kavuye mw’ ijuru; Twahaw’ Umukiza, Twahaw’ Umukiza.
2. N’ umunezero mwinshi, twarababariwe; Imana yadukuyehw’ iteka ryo gupfa. Yesu yikorey’ imitwaro y’ ibyaha; Yaradupfiriye, Yaradupfiriye,
3. Ku ntebe y’ ubwami kwa Data wo mw’ ijuru, Dufit’ Umuvugizi utuvuganira; Uturwanirira kandi n’ Umuneshi; Yaradutsindiye, n’ Umuneshi wacu.
4. Yambik’ abo yacunguye bos’ ubwiza bwe, Akabah’ imico ye iboneye rwose. Kubw’ ubuntu bw’ atuyoboz’ Umwuka we, N’ukuri kwe kwera, N’ukuri kwe kwera.
5. Yes’ ari hafi kugaruka mu bwiza bwe; Azaza kutujyana tw’ abo yacunguye; Twimane na we mu bwami bwo mw’ ijuru; Tuzamwirebera, Tuzamwirebera.

title: Har’ Urukundo Rutangaje
verses: 1. Har’ urukundo rutangaje, Runzamura mu bitekerezo, Nkamera amababa, Nkumva nigereye mw’ ijuru, Nkibona ndi hamwe n’ Umukiza, Ndi gusangira na we.
2. Ndi ku musozi muremure, Maze ndeb’ iburasirazuba, Mbon’ igihugu cyiza, N’ igihugu gitey’ ubwuzu. N’ igihugu cy’ amata n’ ubuki, N’ imbuto z’ agahozo.
3. Ibyo kurya by’ icyo gihugu, Twabiteguriwe n’ Uwiteka. Ni byiza bitavugwa! Iman’ izatumwenyurira, Tuzaba turi kumwe na Yesu, Mu bwami bwo mw’ ijuru.
4. Nshaka kwambuka yorodani, Ngatandukana n’ imibabaro, N’ amakuba by’ iyi si, Y’ ibyago no gushidikanya; N’ ubutayu n’ isi y’ igomero, Mw’ iyi si si hw’ iwacu.

title: Icyampa Igihe Kikihuta Bwangu
verses: 1. Icyamp’ igihe kikihuta bwangu, Nkigira iwacu! Nkibera mu mahoro nta kuganya, Ndahakumbuye.
2. Mur’ iyi si nta mutekan’ ubamo, N’ is’ irimw’ akaga; N’ isi yuzuyemo imibabaro, S’ iyo guturwa.
3. Nzibera mu ruhande rw’ Umukiza, Sinzamurekura; Azambashisha kunesha urupfu, Ntashye mw’ ijuru.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Tuzakomeza dukorer’ Umwami wacu Yesu, Kugez’ ubw’ azatugeza mw’ ijuru. Alto: Tuzakomeza du - rer’ U - mwami wacu, wacu, Kugez’ ubw’ a - tugeza mw’ ijuru.

title: Haguruka, Haguruka
verses: 1. Umwam’  araguhamagara haguruka. Akuyobora mu mucyo, Mu nzira yo kwizera; Mu  rugendo rwo mw’ iyi si, Wigir’ ubwoba rwose; Ngaho haguruka.
2. Komera shikama b’ intwari ku rugamba; N’ ubwo Satan’ atontoma, Yarangije gutsindwa; Yesu yaramunesheje, Komez’ ibendera Rye; Komera shikama.
3. Komeza komeza, Rwanan’ ibyiringiro; Ririmb’ indirimb’ igutera gushikama cyane. Ntugashidikanye rwose, Gir’ umutim’ utuje; Komez’ ukomere!

title: Intekerezo Zanjye Zibera Mw’ Ijuru
verses: 1. Dor’ intekerezo zanjye zibera mw’ ijuru, Ibyiringiro byanjye ni ho bituriza; Mu mucyo w’ Uwiteka, Yes’ azaduhuriza; Mw’ ijuru, ibudapfa ni ho tuzibera.
2. Mw’ ijuru nta mibabaro, Tuzaba dutuje; Tuzahanagurw’ amarira tugezeyo. Nta rupfu ruzabayo, nta kiduhungabanya; Tuzabana by’ iteka, Turi mu mahoro.
3. Mbeg’ ukuntu tuzishima, Twongeye guhura, N’ abo twari twaratandukanijwe kera! Mw’ iteraniro ryiza, Maze duhoberane, Twibere mu byishimo bitazahinduka.
4. Mbeg’ inanga z’ izahabu zizacurangwayo! Ubw’ abacunguwe bazaba bateranye. Yes’ azatuzamura, Atugeze mw’ ijuru, Dusingiz’ urukundo, Twakunzwe n’ Imana.

title: Nabara Nte Uburyo Yesu Yapfuye?
verses: 1. Nabara nte uburyo Yesu yapfuye? Uw’ abamarayika baramya! N’ Umwunger’ ushak’ uwari wazimiye, Ngw’ amucyur’ agaruke mu rugo. Se ntiyabyawe n’ umukobwa Mariya, Mu muvure i Betelehemu! Kandi se ntiyakuriy’ i Nazareti! Ng’ uk’ uko yaje hano mw’ isi y’ ibyaha!

2. Mvuge nt’ uko yababajw’ akituriza! Agakiz’ iyi si y’ amarira; N’ umutim’ umenetse ku musaraba, Yesu yambitsw’ ikamba ry’ amahwa! Ni w’ ukiza ab’ imitim’ imenetse, Kand’ akiz’ ubwob’ umunyabyaha! Adukiz’ imitwaro yose y’ ibyaha, N’ ub’ ari hano rwos’ ari kumwe natwe.

3. Nabara nte uko yireherejeho amahanga yose yo mw’ iyi si! Yahaw’ ubutware mw’ isi no mw’ ijuru, Nta na hamwe Yes’ atar’ Umwami. Ari hafi kugaruka mu bwiza bwe, Kand’ amaso yos’ azamubona; Azab’ aje kujyan’ abe bamwizeye; Babane mu bwiza burabagirana!

4. Nabara nte ukw’ isi yos’ imuramya! Ukw’ acyah’ umurab’ ugahunga! Niw’ ushyir’ umunezero mu mitima, Kubw’ urukundo rwe rutangaje! Mwa bari mw’ isi mwe, ni mumuhimbaze, Amajw’ ibihumb’ amusingize! Ijuru ni rihamy’ icyubahiro cye; Yukw’ ar’ Umwami n’ Umucunguzi w’ isi.

title: Twese Hamwe
verses: 1. Twese hamwe muze dushyire hamwe; Dusang’ Umwam’ Imana yacu. Iyo Mana irakomeye, Muze tuyih’ icyubahiro.
2. Iyo tur’ imbere y’ Imana yacu, Nta bugoryi buturangwaho. Twibera mu buturo bwera, Kubwo kwizera turakirwa.
3. Turi hamwe twambaz’ Imana yacu, Tukabon’ ubwiza bwa Jambo. Kubw’ Umwuka Wera w’ Imana, Duhabw’ imbarag’ ikomeye.
4. Dat’ utwumve, Data mwiz’ udukunda! Nyamuna uduteg’ amatwi; Wumve gusenga kwacu Data, Mw’ izina rya Yes’ uduhire.

title: Duhore Twishimye
verses: 1. Mureke duhore twishimye, Imitima yac’ inezerwe. Mbese n’ iki cyatubabaza, Kand’ Iman’ idukunda?
2. Dor’ ukuboko k’ Uwiteka, Kuturind’ imyambi y’ ibyaha; Kubw’ ubuntu araturinda, Kand’ atuma tunesha.
3. Kand’ iyo turets’ inshingano, Iman’ iratuguyaguya; N’ ubwo tuba twitey’ akaga, Itureban’ impuhwe.
4. Dukurikiz’ inama nziza, Tub’ abantu beza b’ intwari; Mu rukundo kandi twishimye, Dukorere mu kuri.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Dukwiriye guhora twishimye, Mu  mibereho yacu yose. Kandi mu nshingano zacu zose, Tunezerwe twishime.

title: Nyenyeri Yo Mu Ruturuturu
verses: 1. Nyenyeri yo mu ruturuturu unyobore; Igih’ inzir’ icuz’ umwijima unyobore. Umfash’ ukubok’ ukanyobora, Mbese nabur’ ibyiringiro nte?
2. Jye ntabwo nagushidikanyaho unyobore; Umpumure maze mbon’ inzira unyobora. Natinze rwose kukuyoboza, Ubu ndaje noneho nyobora.
3. Mu bihanamanga mu bitare unyobore; Mu bishanga ndetse no mu bihu unyobore. Ndashaka kumv’ ijwi ryawe Yesu; We Muyobozi mwiz’ utayobya.
4. Mu gihe ntentebutse mbabaye unyobore; Ndi mu cyunamo nabuz’ abanjye unyobore. Nzi k’ undeba nez’ uri mw’ ijuru; Ntey’ intambwe ngusang’ unyobore.
5. Kubw’ urukundo rwawe, Mukiza unyobore; Ndakwiyeguriye Mwami mwiza unyobore. Yesu wabambwe ku musaraba, Muri byose komez’ unyobore.

title: Bakristo Twite Ku Batishoboye
verses: 1. Bakristo, Bakristo twite ku batishoboye; Nib’ umuken’ agez’ iwaw’ aje kugusaba, Burya har’ und’ uhagaz’ iruhande rw’ utabona! Kumwakir’ iwawe bizaguhesh’ umugisha.
2. Ijish’ ureb’ umukene Yes’ ab’ arireba. Iy’ umwugururiy’ iremb’ akinjir’ iwawe, Yesu yinjirana na w’ akazamur’ ibiganza, Maz’ akaguh’ umugisha mu by’ utunze byose.
3. Yes’ azaguhir’ iteka mu buzima bwawe, Kand’ azanaguh’ ikamba ry’ abakiranutsi. Vub’ ah’ amarembo y’ ijur’ agiye gufunguka; Yes’ azagororer’ abamukoreye neza.

title: Agira Neza
verses: 1. Kanguka mutima wanjy’ ishime! Maz’ usingiz’ Umucunguzi wawe; Akwiriy’ indirimbo kubw’ ineza ye, N’ ubunt’ agira bw’ igitangaza. Agira neza kubw’ urukundo rwe rwinshi, Muze tumuririmbire.
2. Yantabaye nar’ uwo gupfa, Maz’ arankiz’ ambeshahw’ amp’ ubugingo. Yankuye mw’ isayo y’ ibyaha, Maz’ arankiza kubw’ urukundo rwe rwinshi. Agira neza kubw’ urukundo rwe rwinshi, Muze tumuririmbire.
3. N’ ubw’ imbaraga z’ ikuzimu zampagurukira, Ntabwo zanshobora. N’ ubw’ abanzi bandwanya bakanyibasira, Ntabwo bashobora kunesha. Agira neza kubw’ urukundo rwe rwinshi, Muze tumuririmbire.
4. N’ ubw’ imirabyo n’ inkuba byahinda, Ntabwo nzagir’ ubwoba na gato. Yes’ ampora bugufi akarind’ ubugingo, Sinzagir’ ubwoba namba. Agira neza kubw’ urukundo rwe rwinshi, Muze tumuririmbire.

title: Yewe Nzimizi We, Garuka
verses: 1. Yewe nzimizi we, garuka; Umubyey’ aragushaka. N’ Umubyeyi ugukunda, Kand’ aragutegereje. Ngwino! Ngwino!
2. Yewe nzimizi we, garuka; So aguteze amatwi. Yita cyane ku bafite imitima imenetse. Ngwino! Ngwino!
3. Yewe nzimizi we, garuka; Umukiz’ aragushaka. Az’ intege nkeya zawe, Jya ku birenge bya Yesu. Ngwino! Ngwino!
4. Yewe nzimizi we, garuka; Uhanagurw’ amarira. Ni So uguhamagara; Kand’ aragukunda cyane. Ngwino! Ngwino!

title: Ntabwo Nzakureka
verses: 1. Ntabwo nzakureka, ntabwo nzakuvaho. Ntabwo nzagusiga wenyine. Nzakurinda kandi nzajya ngukomeza, Nzajya nkwitaho ngushoboze. Witiny’ ahubwo kurikiza amabwiriza n’ inama byanjye.
2. Igih’ umugaru uguteragana, Koresh’ isengesh’ ubimbwire. Nzakubumbatiza amaboko yanjye, Nzakurinda kandi nkwiteho. N’ igih’ uzajy’ ugeragezwa, Nzajya nkubonesherez’ inzira.
3. Ijuru rizakinguruka habone, Uhishurirw’ ubwiza bwanjye. Uzabon’ amahor’ atemba nk’ uruzi, Byose bizaba byiza gusa. Nzajya mbana nawe iteka, Kandi nzajya ndind’ intambwe zawe.
4. Mu gih’ ubugingo bwawe busakiranye n’ umwijim’ ukaze cyane, Nzajya ntamurur’ umwijim’ ukugose, Nzakuyoboz’ umucyo waka. Nzagukund’ urukundo, Nzajya nkumurikira ah’ ujya hose.

title: Hano Mur’ Iyi Si Sihw’ Iwacu
verses: 1. Hano mur’ iyi si si hw’ iwacu; Ahubwo mw’ ijuru ni hw’ iwacu. Mw’ isi y’ umubabaro n’ intimba zidashira, Kwa Data mw’ ijuru ni hw’ iwacu.
2. Mw’ ijuru n’ iwacu nta kabuza; N’ igihe gitoya ngatahayo. Ibi bihe ducamo biri hafi gushira, Ngiye kuger’ iwacu mw’ ijuru.
3. Mw’ ijuru kwa Yesu ni ho nzaba; Mw’ ijuru nzahaboner’ ikuzo. Tuzabana n’ abera, n’ inshuti twakundaga; Nzaruhukirayo ni hw’ iwacu.

title: Ubugingo Bwanjye Buratakamba
verses: 1. Ubugingo bwanjye buratakamba, Buragukeneye Mwami Yesu we! Umutwaro wawe uroroheje! Mwungeri mwiza umbe mu mutima.
2. Mwami Yes’ unyobor’ intambwe zanjye; Kand’ umber’ igihome kinkingira, Mu mwijim’ ukaze mfat’ ikiganza, Umurikire mu nzir’ ijy’ iwawe.
3. Soko y’ ubuging’ uturuk’ ahera, Mutsima w’ ubuging’ uva mw’ ijuru. Ni ho mbon’ amahoro mu mutima, Kugez’ ubw’ umusek’ uzatambika.

title: Mutima Wanjye Singiza Imana
verses: 1. Mutima wanjye singiza Imana yo mw’ ijuru. Ibabarir’ ibyaha, kand’ ikiz’ indwara zose; Nta wahwany’ icyubahiro nawe Man’ ikomeye.
2. Uwitek’ Imana yacu igir’ ibambe ryinshi! Irakiranuka, kand’ ic’ imanza zitabera. Ikwiriy’ icyubahiro, Nihimbazw’ Aleluya.
3. Idukingir’ ababisha, Iz’ intege nke zacu. Turi mu maboko yayo, Iturind’ abagome. Nihimbazwe Aleluya! Igir’ impuhwe nyinshi.
4. Bamarayika nimuze mudufashe kuramya, Umuremyi wahanz’ izub’ ukwezi n’ inyenyeri. Ibyaremwe byose ni bisingiz’ uwo Muremyi.

title: Namaramaje Gutaha
verses: 1. Namaramaje gutaha mu gihugu cy’ ibyiza, Ibyo mpora mvug’ iteka, N’ urukundo rwa Yesu.
2. Nari narapfuye rwose, Nta Mana nta cyizere! Nazuts’ ubwo nabwirwaga ko Yesu yampfiriye!
3. Umutima winangira Yesu yawunkuyemo; Yampay’ umutima mushya, Yesu ni w’ unyobora.
4. Kuv’ ubwo nemeye Yesu, Nagiye ngeragezwa, Ariko Umwami Yesu, Ni w’ umpesha kunesha.
5. Mwami Yes’ udahemuka, Nyuzuzamw’ urukundo Runtere kugir’ umwete, Wo kugukurikira.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yesu n’ Umukunzi wanjye, Twarabisezeranye. Arankunda ndamukunda, Nk’ intama n’ umwungeri.

title: Ugururira Yesu
verses: 1. Ugururira Yesu araguhamagara, Ahagaze ku rugi umukingurire.
2. Kugira ngw’ agukize yatanz’ ubugingo bwe; Yatsinz’ urupfu, none mwemer’ umwakire.
3. Mwumv’  aracyakomanga, Mwiyegurire rwose. Kingur’ umutima waw’ umwiyegurire.
4. Tyo reka kuzarira wikwitesh’ amahirwe. Wikwitesh’ agakiza ashaka kuguha.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mwugururire, Mwugururire. Yaje kugucungura, Tyo mwugururire. Alto: Mwuguru… Mwugururire, Mwuguru… Mwugururire; Yaje kugucungura, Mwuguru… Mwugururire.

title: Nshuti Zanjye Munsabire
verses: 1. Ndi mu ntambar’ ikomeye, Intambara yo kwizera; Nimunsabire ku Mana, Rwose nd’ uwo gusabirwa.
2. Ndi mu ntambar’ ikomeye, Intambara yo kwizera; Nshuti zanjye bavandimwe, Muntwerer’ amasengesho.
3. Buri gihe mba mpanganye n’ ibigeragezo byinshi; Ndifuza kubashishwa kunyura mu nzir’ ifunganye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nshuti zanjye munsabire, Kugira ngo mbashe kunesha. Ni munsabire ku Mana, Rwose nd’ uwo gusabirwa.

title: Har’ Icyo Nsobanukiwe
verses: 1. Har’ icyo nsobanukiwe, Yes’ amp’ ikiruhuko. Mwami nguy’ umutima wanjye, Uwitegekere.
2. Iby’ isi mbisiz’ inyuma, Niberey’ uwa Yesu; Ahebuj’ ibintu byose, Ni w’ ump’ umunezero.
3. Arabagirana cyane, Akwiy’ icyubahiro; Agir’ urukundo rwinshi, N’ imbabazi n’ impuhwe.
4. Yesu yarankunze cyane, Bitum’ aza kumpfira; Kubw’ urukundo rw’ Imana, Se kuki ntamukunda?
5. Yesu ndakwiyeguriye, Nkomeza nkunambeho; Ubuzima bwanjye bwose, Buhishwe muri wowe.

title: Bigiye Gusobanuka
verses: 1. Turi hafi kujy’ aheza, Mu gihugu cyiza cyane. Ntituzongera kurira, Bigiye gusobanuka!
2. Ibyiza twari twahombye, Tuzongera kubihabwa. Mw’ ijuru tuzanezerwa, Bigiye gusobanuka!
3. Tuzamenya nez’ impamvu, Twahuraga n’ amakuba, Indirimbo zigatuza, Bigiye gusobanuka!
4. Ibijya bidushobera, Tukibaz’ impamvu yabyo, Tukabur’ ibyiringiro, Bigiye gusobanuka!
5. Imana yac’ iz’ inzira, Ni y’ ifit’ urufunguzo, Izadukiz’ amarira, Bigiye gusobanuka!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Twiringir’ Imana gusa, Ntitugir’ ubwoba rwose. N’ ubwo duhura n’ ibiruhije, Bigiye gusobanuka!

title: Mwami W’ Amahanga Yose
verses: 1. Mwami w’ amahanga yose, Uduhe gukunda bose; Uturinde kurobanura, No kuvangurana mu moko.
2. Kurah’ urusika Mwami, Rwabasha gutandukanya, Abana bawe wacunguye; Utugir’ umwe dukundane.
3. Mwami ngusaby’ imbabazi, Nataniye mu bwanganyi; Mfasha menye ibyaha byanjye, Ne kukubamb’ ubwa kabiri.
4. Mbashisha kuvuganira, Abanyantege nke bose, Barenganwa ntibitabweho; Mpa gushikama mbavugire.
5. Unyuzuz’ Umwuka Wera, Mbashe gukor’ ibikwiye, Aho mba hos’ igihe cyose, Nkorah’ unkoresh’ ibikwiye.

title: Nimuze Dushim’ Uwiteka
verses: 1. Nimuze dushim’ Uwiteka, Kubw’ ibambe rye ryinshi! Kukw’ ineza y’ ihoraho, N’ umurava w’ uhoraho!
2. Kandi ni w’ utegeka byose; Akwiz’ umucyo hose! Kukw’ ineza y’ ihoraho, N’ umurava w’ uhoraho!
3. Ni w’ utung’ ibyaremwe byose, Ni w’ ubigaburira. Kukw’ ineza y’ ihoraho, N’ umurava w’ uhoraho!
4. Nuko rero tumuhimbaze; Uwiteka ni mwiza! Kukw’ ineza y’ ihoraho, N’ umurava w’ uhoraho!

title: Ninde Utegek’ Izuba
verses: 1. Nind’ utegek’ izuba kuva, Rikamurikira abantu? Mbese ninde utegek’ ijoro? N’ Uwiteka Imana yacu. N’ Uwiteka Imana yacu.
2. Mbese ninde wahanz’ ijuru, Maz’ agahanik’ ikirere? Nind’ ubashish’ ibyatsi gutoha? N’ Uwiteka Imana yacu. N’ Uwiteka Imana yacu.
3. Nind’ ujy’ uduhoz’ amarira, Atuber’ Umuhumuriza? Nind’ ufit’ ijambo rikomeye? N’ Uwiteka Imana yacu. N’ Uwiteka Imana yacu.

title: Dusingize Yesu Nyir’ Ukunesha
verses: 1. Dusingize Yesu Nyir’ ukunesha! Yaratwitangiye tumuhimbaze. Twubur’ amaso turebe hejuru, Tuzirikan’ urukundo rwa Yesu. Kand’ urukundo rwe rurahanitse, Ubwami bw’ Imana buri muri twe.
2. Kand’ isi yac’ igez’ ahakomeye, Dor’ amahoro rwos’ ayishizemo. Is’ ikeney’ umucy’ uva mw’ ijuru, Tuyerek’ Umukiza Emanweli. Bwoko bw’ Imana nitwitange rwose, Tuvug’ ubutumwa twitange rwose.
3. Tujy’ ahantu hose tubabwirize, Hirya hino hakeney’ ubutumwa. Benshi ntacyo bazi cyo gucungurwa, Bakwiriye kubwirw’ iby’ agakiza; Bakameny’ ibyo gucungurwa kwabo. Nimutyo dutwaze tubagereho.
4. Abavugabutumwa bakeneye, Amasengesho n’ urukundo rwinshi. Tubazirikane tubasabire, Tubashyigikire, tubakomeze. Yes’ agiye kuza mu cyubahiro, Twe kugir’ ubwoba tub’ abaneshi.

title: Kera Ntabwo Nagutekerezaga
verses: 1. Kera ntabwo nagutekerezaga, None nameny’ urukundo rwawe. Kand’ umucyo wawe warandasiye, Nanjye nguhay’ umutima wanjye.
2. Ubwo nari maze gucik’ intege, Iby’ isi bimaze kuncogoza, Warankomeje ngumya kukwizera; Mwam’ iby’ ushaka byose bibeho.
3. Nimara kuger’ iwacu mw’ ijuru, Nzahora ndi mu rukundo rwawe. Umutima wanjye ntuzacogora, Ntabwo nzongera kuruh’ ukundi.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mwami numvis’ Ijambo ryawe ryera, Maze numva rindemy’ umutima; Ubwo nari ntafit’ ibyiringiro, Ijambo ryawe riranyobora.

title: Kwibera Hafi Ya Yesu
verses: 1. Kwibera hafi ya Yesu, Kwibera mu bwiza bwe; Kwibera mu murimo we, ni bwo numva ntekanye.
2. Kwibera hafi ya Yesu, Nta cyabasha kuntanya, N’ urukundo n’ ubuntu bye, Mpore hafi ya Yesu.
3. Kwibera hafi ya Yesu, Mbasha gukiranuka; Mbwir’ aband’ iby’ ineza ye, Nkurikiz’ iby’ ashaka.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Kwibera hafi ya Yesu, Ni byo numva nifuza; Buri gihe mbane na we, Mpore ndi kumwe na we.

title: Mbeg’ Umuns’ Utey’ Ubwuzu
verses: 1. Umunsi w’ ihozo dore uri bugufi; Kurira, kuganya, gusuhuz’ umutima, Bizatamururwaho, twibere mu mahoro. Mbeg’ umuns’ uzab’ utey’ ubwuzu!
2. Mu bwami bw’ ijuru, nta marir’ azabayo; Igihu kizadutamuruka mu maso. Tuzaba mu mahoro atagir’ impinduka. Mbeg’ umuns’ uzab’ utey’ ubwuzu!

title: Senga
verses: 1. Senga mu gitondo kare, Ujy’ usenga no ku manywa. Senga na nimugoroba, Iman’ ihora yumva.
2. Haba mu  gitondo kare, Haba ndetse no ku manywa, Haba na nimugoroba, Iman’ ihora yumva.
3. Igih’ icy’ ari cyo cyose, Yesu yakugenderera; Ahor’ agutez’ amatwi, Ntucogore gusenga.

title: Iyo Ngenda Mba Ndi Kumwe N’ Imana
verses: 1. Iyo ngenda mba ndi kumwe n’ Imana, Kandi tugenda twiganirira. Turasabana rwose, tukishima, N’ iyo haba mu mugaru mwinshi. Turasabana rwose, tukishima, Ibihe byose turagendana.
2. Inyibutsa amateka ya kera, Umugambi wabaye mw’ ijuru, Wo kuncungura ngo mbon’ ubugingo. Wabayeho jyewe ntarabaho, Njya kuremwa ntabwo byar’ impanuka, Habay’ umugambi wo kundema.
3. Mw’ ijuru nzatemberana n’ Imana, Dufatanye na yo mu biganza. Iyi si turimo izakurwaho, Nzabana n’ Iman’ iteka ryose. Iyi si dutuyemw’ izakurwaho, Hazaz’ indi tuzabamw’ iteka.

title: Ndumv’ Ijwi Rinyongorera
verses: 1. Har’ ijwi rya Marayika, Rimbwira ryongorera. Iryo jwi rirankomeza, Rinter’ ibyiringiro. N’ ubw’ ijoro ryegereje, N’ umurab’ ar’ icyago; Bigiye gutamuruka, Maz’ umucy’ utangaze.
2. No mu gihe cy’ akabwibwi, Umucy’ urengarenga; Inyenyer’ ifit’ umucyo, Izamurika cyane. Ijoro niribudika, Ntugir’ ubwoba rwose; Hasigay’ igihe gito, Umucy’ ugatangaza.
3. Ibyo byiringiro bitsika mu mutima wanjye; Bitamurur’ umwijima, Umucy’ ugatangaza! Iy’ Umwami yimye mu mutima waw’ ushavuye, Ibyiringiro bishyitse biguma mu mutima.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ijwi numva, Rinter’ ibyiringiro; Rinter’ ibyishimo, Mu – mu mutima. Alto: Ijwi numva, …jwi numva ry’ ihozo, Rintera ibyiri – byiringiro; Rinter’ ibyi – byishimo pe! …shimo mu mutima. Tenor na Bass: Ijwi numva – mva ry’ ihozo, Rintera ibyiri – byiringiro; Rinter’ ibyi – byishimo pe! …shimo mu muti… mu mutima.

title: Yes’ Arankunda
verses: 1. Iy’ inzir’ icuz’ umwijima, Yes’ aranyeger’ akambwira; Ati: “Komera mwana wanjye, Ndagukunda.”
2. Arankunda bihebuje pe! Urukundo rutadohoka. Ampaz’ umunezero mwinshi, Arankunda!
3. Mu minsi mib’ arandengera, Akandwanaho mu makuba. Andokora mu byago byose, Arankunda!
4. Ibyo mw’ isi birarangira, Bikayonga bigashiraho. Arik’ urukundo rwa Yesu, Ruhoraho.
5. Yaryamishijwe mu muvure, Yabambwe no ku musaraba. Ni jye yagiriraga rwose, Arankunda.
6. Kand’ azagaruka mu bicu, Aje kunjyana iwe mw’ ijuru. Tuzasingiz’ urukundo rwe, Mu ndirimbo.

title: Nd’ Umugenzi Mur’ Iyi Si
verses: 1. Nd’ umugenzi mur’ iyi si, Nerekeye mw’ ijuru; Mu gihugu gihoramw’ umucy’ utazima! N’ ubwo ngoswe n’ abagome; N’ ubw’ is’ inyibasiye; Nta cyambuza gukomeza, Yes’ arankunda!
2. Data wa twes’ arankunda, Kandi niw’ unyobora. Ankomereza kwizera, N’ ukuboko kwe. Mu mugaru, mu bishuko, Mu gahinda mu byago; Ijwi ry’ Umukiza wanjye rirankomeza.
3. Gukorer’ Umwami nk’ uwo, Ntibigir’ uko bisa! Nifuza kumumenya, Nkanamwigiraho. N’ ibyishimo bitavugwa; Umucunguzi wanjye, Azanyambutsa rwa ruzi, Ngere hakurya!
4. Ku cyambu gituje cyane, Ni ho ngiye kwambuka. Nta marir’ azagerayo, Krist’ arahari! Kand’ imibabaro yose, Tugirira mw’ iyi si; Yes’ araje bidatinze, Adutabare.

title: Wafashe Kamere Yanjye
verses: 1. N’ ubw’ ur’ Iman’ ikomey’ ite! Wafashe kamere yanjye! Mwami wumv’ isengesho ryanjye, Umwana wawe ngusaba.
2. Uz’ intege nke zanjye Yesu! Uzi amakub’ angose, Undinde kubw’ ineza yawe; Mwunger’ utajy’ uzimiza.
3. Kand’ inshyimbo n’ inkoni byawe, Bihora bimpumuriza. Ntacyo nzatinya Mwami Mwiz’ ubwo ndi mu maboko yawe.
4. Unyobora ku mazi meza, Y’ ubugingo buhoraho. Urambohora ukankiza, Mu maboko y’ umubisha!

title: Ndi Umukristo Ucumbitse Mur’ Iyi Si
verses: 1. Nd’ umukristo ncumbitse mw’ iyi si, Ku bwanjye byose ni byiza! N’ ubwo nsakirana n’ ingorane, Ku bwanjye byose ni byiza! Kuki narira cyangwa nkinuba? Krist’ ari hamwe nanjy’ ibihe byose. Ndi hafi yo kwigira mw’ ijuru; Ku bwanjye byose ni byiza!

2. N’ ubw’ amarir’ ari menshi mw’ isi, Ku bwanjye byose ni byiza! Ndater’ intambwe ngan’ i Kanani, Ku bwanjye byose ni byiza! N’ ubw’ iyi s’ ibeshy’ abayituye, N’ ubw’ ishaka kumbabariz’ umutima; Amaso yanjye nyahanze Yesu; Ku bwanjye byose ni byiza!

3. Ndi hafi yo kugera ku ntego, Ku bwanjye byose ni byiza! Nzahabw’ igihugu cy’ agakiza, Ku bwanjye byose ni byiza! Iyi s’ iri hafi yo gushira, Mugenzi we! Komera wihangane. Mu man’ uzahabw’ ikiruhuko; Ku bwanjye byose ni byiza!

title: Wow’ Uruhijwe N’ Iby’ Isi …
verses: 1. Wow’ uruhijwe n’ iby’ is’ urushy’ umutima, Ntuzi ko Yesu yakuruhur’ umutima?
2. Ko nkeneye Yesu Kristo, namubona nte? Hang’ amaso ku musarab’ i Kaluvari.
3. Mbes’ ikamba ry’ uwo Mwami rimeze rite? Dore yambitsw’ ikamba ry’ amahwa ku bwawe.
4. Mukurikiye mw’ iyi si bigenda bite? N’ ukwemera ukamunambaho by’ iteka.
5. Mbes’ ukurikiy’ uwo Mwam’ azahabw’ iki? N’ amahoro adashira n’ umunezero.
6. Mwami mwiza nkyumv’ ijwi ryawe ndakwitabye. Ungir’ uwawe, nshyira mu bawe by’ iteka.

title: Nyongerera Kwizera
verses: 1. Mwami Yesu nyongerera kwizera. Akira kwizera kwanjye Yesu we! Nyamururahw’ ibimboshye byose Mwami; Ungeze ku rugero ruhanitse.
2. Yesu ni wow’ umar’ umubabaro; Ni wow’ unezez’ umutima wanjye! Mu rugamba ndwana, urwany’ abankwena; Ungeze ku rugero ruhanitse.
3. Uzi nez’ icyifuzo cyanjye Mwami; Nyongerera kwizera Mwami mwiza! Mu mwijima w’ icuraburindi mfasha; Mpore mbon’ umucyo wawe Yesu we!
4. Kristo Yes’ arambwir’ ati: Twarana! Ntucik’ intege komez’ uhatane! Ari hafi kuza kunjyana mw’ ijuru; Azanjyan’ iwe mw’ ijuru ahw’ aba!

title: Impano Y’ Ijuru
verses: 1. Ngwino Soko y’ ubugingo, Ngwino Mpano y’ ijuru; Uduhire Mwuka Wera, Duhishurire Kristo.
2. Mwuka Wer’ ur’ urumuri, Ntacy’ ubasha guhishwa; Ntacy’ usobwa, Mwuka Wera utuboneshereze.
3. Utuyobore kwa Data, Tumusange twishimye; Mu masengesho dusenga, Tuber’ Umuyobozi.
4. Hindura byose bishyashya, Duhabwe gusa nawe! Uzatugeze mw’ ijuru, Mu Bwami buhoraho.

title: Wikwishimira Kunyura Inzira Mbi
verses: 1. Wikwishimira kunyura inzira mbi; Kandi Yes’ ari hw’ aguhamagara. Wishaka kujya mu mwijima; None itaba Yesu, Aragukunda.
2. Kuki waremererwa n’ umutwaro, Ukadandabiranwa n’ ubusinzi? Yes’ arakiza, humura pe! Umva ubutumwa bwe, Maz’ umusange.
3. Wabaye nk’ uburabyo bwumagaye; Wagendanye n’ abanzi b’ ubutumwa; Ariko Yesu ugukunda, Muh’ umutima wawe, Arawakira.

title: Icyampa Ngahora Hafi Y’ Imana
verses: 1. Icyampa ngahora hafi y’ Imana ibihe byose; Ngahora nibera mw’ Ijambo ryayo umunsi ku wundi.
2. Mbe Mwami, nshaka kwibanira nawe ibihe byose; Ni bwo ntazigera mbur’ amahoro umunsi ku wundi.
3. Mwami ngwin’ ugeng’ umutima wanjye wugire mushya; Umpe kutazatandukana nawe iteka n’ iteka.

title: Reb’ Umutim’ Ubabaye
verses: 1. Reb’ umutim’ ubabaye cyan’ i Kaluvari, Reba Yes’ ari ku musaraba; Yabambwe ku bwawe, Nta wundi yaziraga; Numureba urakira rwose! Reba, Reba; Wizer’ imbabazi zituruk’ i Kalvari; Tyo reba, Reba ku musaraba.

2. Ujya wibaz’ impamvu Yesu yakubiswe, Kand’ akambikwa n’ ikamba ry’ amahwa? N’ impamvu yabambw’ ari nta cyaha yakoze? Tyo byibaze, Ubitekereze. Reba, Reba; Yaragucunguye apfa mu cyimbo cyawe. Tyo reba, Reba ku musaraba.

3. Amarira n’ amaraso byawe ntibyashobora, Kwez’ ibyaha byawe na gato. Keretse wizeye Yesu wakubambwiwe, Numwizera urakira rwose! Reba, Reba Yes’ araguhanagur’ amarira Yose, Tyo mwizer’ urakira rwose.

title: Umusaruro Uratubutse
verses: 1. Dor’ umusarur’ uratubutse, Hakenewe abasaruzi. Manur’ Umwuka wawe Mana, Twongerer’ abasaruzi. Ahw’ abakozi bawe bari, Man’ ubah’ imigisha yawe.
2. Ubambik’ imbarag’ ikomeye, Ubambike ukuri kwawe. Bah’ umurava ku nshingano, Kandi bagir’ urukundo. Aho bakwiriye hose, Man’ ubah’ imigisha yawe.
3. Ijisho ryawe ribahoreho, Mu bihugu bakoreramo; Imitim’ icishwe bugufi, Izanwe ku musaraba. Uhire abakozi bawe, Man’ ubah’ imigisha yawe.
4. Data tebutsa wa munsi mwiza, Wo kugaruka kw’ Umukiza. Amavi yos’ azapfukama, Indimi zigusingize! Yes’ azahora yererezwa, Azahoran’ icyubahiro.

title: Turi Ab’ Umwami Yesu
verses: 1. Ntabwo tur’ abacu, Tur’ ab’ Umwami Yesu. Yesu ni w’ utugenga, Twaramwiyeguriye; N’ aho rwab’ urupfu, Tuzamunambaho rwose; Umusaraba we, Ni wo tuzirata!
2. Icyubahiro cye, Kitugaragaremo; Dupfe ku cyaha cyose, Duharanir’ ijuru. Baragwa b’ ijuru, Twer’ imbuto z’ abihannye; Mureke twibere mu Man’ Ihoraho.
3. Tw’ ab’ Umwami Yesu, Ntitugacik’ intege; N’ iyo twaba mu kaga cyangwa mu munezero; Turi kumwe na we nta kabuza tuzanesha! Azabana natwe ntazaturekura!

title: Tang’ Ubuto Bwawe
verses: 1. Tang’ ubuto bwawe, Ukorer’ Imana; Umutima wawe wos’ uwegurir’ Imana.
2. Uwitek’ ashaka umutima wawe, Numuh’ umutima waw’ araguh’ amahoro.
3. Mu by’ ukora byose, Iman’ ib’ imbere; Na y’ izajy’ ikwikorerer’ imitwaro yawe.

title: Turakuramya
verses: 1. Turakuramya Mwami udukunda; Dusonzey’ ukwera kwawe. Mwami Nyir’ imigisha, Mwami mwiza, Dukeneye kuzuzw’ urukundo; Tumurikirwe n’ ubwiza bwawe.
2. Mwigisha mwiza utagereranywa; Uduhire, Mwam’ utweze. Duh’ umutima mushya, twiyoroshye. Dukeneye kuzuzw’ urukundo; Tumurikirwe n’ ubwiza bwawe.
3. Dusagiz’ urukundo rwawe Mwami; Urukundo rudashira. Ruzan’ abanyabyaha kuri Yesu. Dukeneye kuzuzw’ urukundo; Tumurikirwe n’ ubwiza bwawe.
4. Mwam’ abazajya batubona bose, Batangare batubonye; Dufit’ ubumwe nyabwo, dufatanya. Dukeneye kuzuzw’ urukundo; Tumurikirwe n’ ubwiza bwawe.
5. Wumve Mwami  amasengesho yacu, Utwuzuz’ Umwuka wawe; Twigish’ Ijambo ryawe, turimenye. Dukeneye kuzuzw’ urukundo; Tumurikirwe n’ ubwiza bwawe.

title: Nta Ntwaro Dawidi Yajyanye
verses: 1. Nta ntwaro Dawidi yajyanye, Guter’ umufilistiya! Atar’ umuhumetso we, Wahangamuy’ igihangange; Cyasuzugurag’ Imana, Iman’ ikomeye y’ abisirayeli.
2. Aratanya gusakirana n’ uwo mufilisitiya, Wasuzugurag’ Imana, Ari na kw’ ayishongoraho. Yitakumag’ atamenye ko Dawidi yatoranijwe n’ Imana.
3. Dawidi nta gususumira, Asatira Goliyati. Areker’ ibuye rimwe, Rihitan’ icyo gihangange! Imana yihesh’ ikuzo, Binyuze mu mwana mutoya Dawidi.
4. Umwami  Yes’ aragushaka, Ngo witabir’ urugamba; N’ ubwo wab’ umwana muto, Tinyuka winjir’ urugamba! Uzaber’ is’ igihamya, K’ uri mu ruhande rw’ Iman’ idatsindwa.
5. Nitugotwa n’ abanzi benshi, Turi hafi kugwabira; Tujye ku mavi dusenge, Yesu ntazadutererana. Yumv’ amasengesho yacu, Azatugir’ abaneshi ku rugamba.

title: Yes’ Uradukunda!
verses: 1. Yes’ uradukunda nka Data wa twese, Kand’ urukundo rwawe, Ruradukomeza, Iy’ imitim’ itentebutse. Amaraso yawe urayatwejesha; Kubw’ urukundo rwawe, Wemeye kwitanga; Ni twe wagiriraga Mwami.
2. Ugiye kugenda wasiz’ uvuz’ uti: “Muzajye mukundana nk’ uko nabakunze.” Nta wakunda nkawe Mwami we! Duhe gukundana, Nk’uko wadukunze; Uduhe gufatanya, Bitum’ is’ imenya, Y’ uko tur’ abana ba Yesu.
3. Mbe, Mwami mwiza we! N’ iby’ igikundiro, Y’ uko tugukorera, Dusengera hamwe, Twita no ku nshingano zacu. Twite ku murimo; Tuzi neza y’ uko uduhora bugufi, Ukatubashisha gutungany’ inshingano zacu.

title: Nje Kugushima
verses: 1. Nje kugushima Mwami Mana, Nkuzaniy’ ishimwe ryanjye; N’ ubw’ umwijima wabudika, Wow’ uramboneshereza. Wangiz’ umwana wawe Mana, Unyitaho buri munsi; Ni wowe soko y’ imigisha, Ngushimiy’ imigish’ umpa.
2. Ngushimira k’ uhor’ undinda, N’ ukuboko kwawe Mana. Iy’ umutim’ ucits’ intege, Unsubizamw’ imbaraga; Iyo nabuze kivurira, Undwanah’ ukanduhura; Dor’ ukuboko kw’ Uwiteka, Ntikwananiwe gukiza.
3. Ngushimiy’ impuhw’ ungirira, Unkurahw’ ibicumuro. Iy’ utambabarir’ ibyaha, Nari guhungira he se? Data ntabwo nzagutenguha, Warankijije ndakira. Mu maraso y’ Umwami Yesu, Ni ho mboner’ agakiza.

4. Nzi neza rwos’ uwo nizeye, Ni we umboneshereza; Ni we Gitare kinkingira, Ni we byiringiro byanjye; Kabone n’ ubwo nacogozwa, Ntazabura kunyitaho. Yampay’ ubugingo bw’ iteka, Nzajya mushimir’ iteka.

title: Indirimbo N’ Amasengesho Byacu
verses: 1. Indirimbo n’ amasengesho byacu bizamuke; Iman’ ibyakire, Yo yatugiz’ abavandimwe.
2. Kuko dufite Dat’ umwe, n’ Umwami wacu Yesu; Mu kwizera, tuyoborwa n’ Umwuk’ umwe wa Kristo.
3. Ibyiringiro bihire ni byo bidukomeza; Ku rugamba tuyoborwa n’ urukundo rwa Yesu.
4. Urwo rukundo ruganze, rudusabemo twese; Ruduhuze, kandi rutume duhora twishimye!

title: Urukundo rwa Kristo
verses: 1. Urukundo rwa Kristo ruduhata; Dore yitangiy’ umukumbi we. Tumukurikire Ntama w’ Imana, Twese dufatanye ubudahwema.
2. Tyo bavandimwe kubw’ Umucunguzi, Mutyo dufatane mu biganza; Tugendane kugeza kw’ iherezo; Tubonesherejwe na Yesu Kristo.
3. Data, turebe twebw’ abana bawe, Twiyeguriye Umwana wawe, Ngwin’ udufashe utwuzuz’ Umwuka, Duh’ urukundo, twongerer’ umwete.
4. Turitanze Mukiza utwakire; Tugir’ umwe tube muri wowe. Uture mu mitima yacu Mwami; Mwuka Wer’ atwez’ atugire bashya.

title: Twererez’ Umusaraba Mwiza
verses: 1. Muze bakristo, dukurikire, Umugaba wac’ Umwana w’ Imana.
2. Tuyobowe n’ umusaraba we, Nta shiti rwose tuzab’ abaneshi.
3. Umusaraba n’ ikimenyetso, Gifitwe n’ abavuts’ ubwa kabiri.
4. Turirimbe cyane indirimbo, Dusingize Uwatuneshereje.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Twererez’ umusaraba mwiza. Tuvug’ urukundo rw’ Umwami Yesu

title: Dor’ Umwami Yes’ Araje
verses: 1. Dor’ Umwami Yes’ araje; Nguy’ araje mu bicu! Kand’ azanye n’ abamarayika batabarika. Halleluya, Halleluya; Yes’ aje kwim’ ingoma ye.
2. Kand’ ijisho ryose rizabon’ icyubahiro Cye! Kand’ abamubambye n’ abamutey’ imisumari; Bazabon’ icyubahiro cye, Maze banyinyirirwe!
3. Ubw’ impand’ izavug’ ijuru n’ isi bizahunga! Abanze kwakira Yesu bazabur’ iyo bajya! Kuk’ urubanza rukomeye rurabategereje.
4. Mureke twese turamy’ Iman’ ishobora byose. Ngwino Mwami, Dusonzey’ ingoma yaw’ itangaje! Ngwino Mwami, Ngwino bwangu wimike ubwami bwawe.

title: Umunsi Ku Wundi
verses: 1. Umunsi ku wundi turi mu rugendo; Tuguman’ urukundo n’ ibyiringiro. Mw’ ijoro riganje, Mu mwijima mwinshi, Dukomez’ urugendo rujya mw’ ijuru, Umunsi ku munsi turukomeze.
2. Umunsi ku wundi dukomez’ imbere; Ibihe birahita ntibigaruka. Dukomere kw’ Ijambo ry’ Imana yacu, Rituyobore rinatumurikire; Dukomez’ urugendo buri munsi.
3. Umunsi ku munsi kugeza kw’ isonga; Twihangane ntituzasubir’ inyuma. Baturajuru n’ ubwo turi mw’ iyi si; Yemwe basirikare b’ Umwami Yesu, Dukomez’ urugendo buri munsi.
4. Umunsi ku wundi tugamij’ ijuru; Kugeza kuri wa munsi tuzataha, Ni bwo tuzaragw’ ubugingo bw’ iteka. Tuzahabw’ imigisha tutazanyagwa; Dukomez’ urugendo buri munsi.

title: Mu Gihe Itorero
verses: 1. Mu gih’ itorero ririho risenga, Risabir’ abatoranijwe gukor’ inshingano, Ubeze Mwam’ Imana, Ubah’ imbaraga, Bayoborwe n’ Umwuka wawe!
2. Abatoranijwe n’ Umwami w’ abami, Kwatura no guhamya mw’ izina ry’ Umwami Yesu; Mwakir’ inshingano mwerejwe uyu munsi; Mub’ indahemuka ku murimo wa Yesu, Yes’ azabahira, azabashoboza.
3. Iman’ ibambike imbaraga yayo, Mwuzur’ Umwuka Wera, Ibambike imbaraga nshya; Uyu munsi mwatangiy’ inshingano zanyu, Ijuru riranezerewe cyane rwose, Ariko Satani ntabwo abyishimiye.
4. Muzirikane ko is’ itabakunze, Izahuriza hamw’ imbaraga zo kubarwanya; Ntimugir’ ubwoba Yes’ azajy’ abarinda, Ni we mutwe w’ itorer’ ubwe yihangiye; Muhore ku mavi nibwo muzanesha.
5. Mwitegur’ imvune muzahura na zo, Ni mugir’ urukundo kandi mugire kwizera, Murabukw’ ikamba mugiye kuzahabwa, Ni mushir’ ubwoba, Mutsind’ urugamba, Mw’ izina rya Yesu muzanesha rwose. Amen

title: Umwami W’ I Siyoni
verses: 1. Umwami w’ i Siyoni ni w’ utegek’ isi; Isi yose yishim’ amav’ amupfukamire! Imbere y’ intebe y’ ubuntu, Imitim’ iranezerwa, Ikaruhuka, Mutyo mwese tumuramye.
2. Umwami w’ i Siyoni ni w’ utegek’ isi; Nta wahwanya n’ uwo Mwami gukomera rwose! Impera z’ isi, ikuzimu hamwe n’ inyanja zose, Biri mu biganza by’ uwo Mwami ukomeye!
3. Umwami w’ i Siyoni ni w’ utegek’ isi; Ni we mugenga w’ ibihe, tumutaramire! Tyo nimuze mu ngoro ye, Muririmbe mwese; Muze mu marembo ye mwishimye, mumupfukamire.

title: Tweze Mwami Yesu
verses: 1. Tweze Mwami Yesu, Tweze Mwami Yesu; Tweze Mwami Yesu, Kugez’ ubw’ uzatujyana.
2. Tub’ abiringirwa, Mw’ izina rya Yesu; Tub’ abiringirwa, Kugez’ ubw’ uzatujyana.
3. Ducishwe bugufi, Mw’ izina rya Yesu; Ducishwe bugufi, Kugez’ ubw’ uzatujyana.
4. Twuzuz’ urukundo, Mw’ izina rya Yesu; Twuzuz’ urukundo, Kugez’ ubw’ uzagaruka; Tumere nkawe Mwami, Kugez’ ubw’ uzatujyana.

title: Singizwa Data
verses: 1. Data ugira neza, Mana yacu; Munyebambe nyinshi, Natw’ uratumenya! Wowe usingizwa n’ abera bo mw’ ijuru; Singizwa Yehova!
2. Tuguhimbaze Murengezi wacu, Uhor’ utwitaho, Twebw’ ubwoko bwawe! Abat’ abakuze, Inkumi n’ abasore; Yesu we, Singizwa!
3. Mwuka Wera we! Turaguhimbaza! Imana Data hamwe n’ Imana Mwana, Barakuduhaye ng’ utuber’ umufasha! Mugiz’ Iman’ imwe!

title: Mwam’ Ushobora Byose
verses: 1. Mwam’ ushobora byose, Duhe kukuririmbira; Duhimbaza, Dat’ usumba byose; Nyir’ icyubahiro, Mutegeka wac’ ibihe byose.
2. Mw’ Ijambo ryawe Mwami, Kandi ni ryo nkota yawe. Mu gusenga, Hir’ ubwoko bwawe; Hir’ Ijambo ryawe, Umwuka Wer’ atumanukire.
3. Mwuka Wera w’ Imana, Ur’ Umuhamy’ ukomeye. Mw’ uyu mwanya, Ngwin’ ubane natwe; Turagukeneye, Ngwino wuzur’ imitima yacu.
4. Ur’ umwe mu Butatu, Uhor’ usingizwa Mana. Nyakubahwa! Gahor’ usingizwa! Ishimwe n’ iryawe! Tuzahora tukuramy’ iteka!

title: Nd’ Umukozi Mutoya
verses: 1. Nd’ umukozi mutoya, Mwami ntiwankoresha? N’ ubwo nta ntege mfite, Ndagukunda cyane pe! Mfit’ akaganza gato, Yesu ugakoreshe.
2. Nigire buri munsi, Mu rukund’ udukunda; Ngender’ imbere yawe, Nkuririmbire Mwami; Mfat’ ikiganza Mwami, Uhor’ umpa gutsinda.
3. Unyigishe gukunda, Mpa kwera no gutuza; Umpe ku Mwuka  wawe, Umbemo buri gihe; Mwigisha unyigishe, Kugukorera neza.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nd’ umukozi mutoya; Mwami  ntiwankoresha?

title: Basirikare Ba Yesu …
verses: 1. Basirikare ba Yesu, Tyo nimushikame, Tyo duhaguruke, Turwane tunezerewe; Dukurikiy’ Umwami Yesu.
2. Niduhura n’ ingorane, Tukumva turushye, Cyane tunaniwe; Twihangane duhangane, Ntitugwabire ku rugamba.
3. Niba dukiz’ imitima, Byasaba kunyura mu marira menshi, Dor’ ukuboko k’ Umukiza, Kuzaduhesha kunesha.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Ngabo mwe, ngabo mwe! Nta mususu namba! Tugire kwizera, Yes’ atur’ imbere. Dore tugiye kuririmb’ indirimbo yo gucungurwa.

title: Kwizera Gutum’ Inkike …
verses: 1. Kwizera gutum’ inkike ziriduka tubireba; Kwizera gutuma tunesh’ urugamba rukomeye.
2. Kwizera kutwugururir’ ubutunzi bukomeye; Kwizera gutum’ abanyantege nke bab’ abatunzi.
3. Dufit’ ingab’ ikomeye idukingir’ amakuba; Turi mu bwihisho bw’ Imana nta cyaduhungabanya.

title: Bivuge Ku Musozi
verses: 1. Abungeri baragiy’ amatungo yabo, Mw’ ijuru haz’ umucyo urabagirana.
2. Bakibon’ ibyongibyo, Bamarwa n’ ubwoba; Marayik’ ababwira ko Yesu yavutse.
3. Babony’ Umwana Yes’ aryamye mu muvure, Bamutur’ amaturo, Bashim’ ivuka rye!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Bivuge ku musozi, Bivuge hejuru ku tununga; Bivuge ku musozi, Yuko Yesu yavutse.

title: Yes’ Adusaba Kub’ Urumuri
verses: 1. Yes’ adusaba kub’ urumuri; Umucyo  ubonesha mu mwijima. Tugomba  kub’ umucyo w’ isi, Mu  midugudu y’ iwacu.
2. Yes’ adusaba kujyan’ umucyo; Hirya hino hose mu mpande z’ isi; Barababaye cyane rwose; Tubagezeho umucyo.
3. Bury’ iyo tumurikiy’ abandi, Yesu ntacy’ ahishwa ab’ abireba; Aho yibereye mw’ ijuru, Burya nta na kimw’ asobwa.
4. Yesu n’ intwari, aradukunda; Tub’ umucyo iyo tumurebyeho. Tumurik’ umucyo we waka, Hirya no hino mw’ iyi si.

title: Mwami Yesu Nshimishwa …
verses: 1. Mwami Yesu nshimishwa no kub’ iruhande rwawe; Ngateg’ amatw’ iby’ umbwira, Ndi ku birenge byawe.
2. Mwami Yesu ndagusabye, Nyuzuz’ Umwuka Wera; Kand’ ibyaha byanjye byos’ ubitwikish’ umuriro.
3. Mu cyanya cyawe gitoshye, Ab’ ari h’ unyobora; Nd’ uwawe nd’ imbata yawe, Narakwiyeguriye.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mpugura menye kugukorera, Mukiza wanjye; Mp’ Umwuka waw’ umbashishe, Kubwiriz’ ubutumwa.

title: Kiruhuko Cyiza
verses: 1. Kiruhuko cyiza gihire, Twagabiwe n’ Umuremyi wacu; Sabato we, mpano y’ akataraboneka! Munsi wuj’ amahoro!
2. Kiruhuko cyiza gihire, Duhishurirw’ ubwiza bw’ Imana; N’ iby’ Uwiteka yadukoreye, Sabato, muns’ uhebuj’ ubwiza!
3. Kiruhuko cyiza gihire, Kingurukanir’ intekerezo; Zikagera hakurya mw’ ijuru, Iwabo w’ Umwami w’ amahoro.
4. Sabato munsi wahiriwe, Munsi wera, muns’ urut’ iyindi; Mu rugendo rugana mw’ ijuru, Twumva turuhutse mu mitima.

title: Nd’ Umwana W’ Umwami

metadata.composer: Arr. from a melody by John B. Summer

verses: 1. Dat’ afit’ amazu menshi cyane; Kand’ akungahaye no ku masambu. Afit’ ubukungu bwinshi cyane, Zahabu na feza n’ umutungo we.
2. Yes’ Umwana w’ Iman’ Umukiza, Ni we Mucunguzi w’ abanyabyaha. Ub’ ari mw’ ijur’ adusabira, Aradutegurir’ aho tuzaba.
3. Nar’ igicibwa narazimiye, Nar’ umunyabyaha narazimiye; None nagizw’ umwana w’ Imana, Nzambikw’ ikanzu yera de, n’ ikamba!
4. Mbese ni kuki nagir’ ubwoba; Ngw’ aha nta cumbi mfite mur’ iyi si! Mfit’ ubutunzi nateguriwe, Ntacyo bintwaye nd’ igikomangoma!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Nd’ umwana w’ Umwami! Yes’ Umukiza, Nd’ umwana w’ Imana, Nd’ igikomangoma!

title: Tuzabon’ Imana Mw’ Ijuru
verses: 1. Nzabon’ Imana mw’ ijuru, Yicaye ku ntebe y’ ubwami. Ku birenge bya Yesu Mukiza, Ni ho nzarambik’ ikamba!
2. Amajwi yac’ azab’ urwunge, N’ amajwi y’ abamarayika; Tuzahora dusingiz’ Imana, Mu munezer’ udashira!
3. Tuzataramana n’ inshuti, Twari twaratandukanijwe; Ntituzongera gutandukana, Tuzahoran’ ibyishimo.
4. Tuzabon’ abera bakikij’ intebe y’ ubwami y’ Imana; Tuzaban’ ubuziraherezo, Mu munezer’ uhoraho.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Mw’ ijuru, Mw’ ijuru, Tuzibanira na Yesu (mw’ ijuru); Mw’ ijuru (mw’ ijuru), Mw’ ijuru kwa Yesu, Tuzahoran’ ibyishimo!

title: Twinjire Mw’ Ishuri
verses: 1. Tyo twinjire mw’ ishuri, Mu munsi wera, Twig’ Ijambo ry’ Imana dushyizeh’ umwete. Kuva tukiri batoya twibwir’ iby’ ijuru, Kuk’ umwan’ uz’ ubwenge ahora yishimye.
2. Dufungur’ igitabo cyera dusenge, Turamye Yes’ Umwam’ Umucunguzi wacu. Yes’ utanga amahoro iyo tumwizeye, Kand’ azajy’ atwigisha amategeko ye.
3. Yes’ ubwe yagiz’ ati: Murek’ abana, Baze banyisangire, Kuko nkund’ abana. Turirimb’ icyubahiro cye giheranije; Yuj’ urukundo rwinshi rw’ uwo Mwami mwiza.

title: Uwiteka Mana, Data Mukiza
verses: 1. Uwiteka Mana, Data Mukiza, Mpfukamy’ imbere yawe ngushima. Nubwo nd’ umunyabyaha bikabije, Urankunda Data wera. Urukundo rwawe rwarancunguye, Rumvana mu bubata bw’ icyaha.
2. Simfit’ ubwoba, mfit’ ibyiringiro, Wangiriy’ ubunt’ ump’ agakiza. Nzahora ndirimbir’ Iman’ ishimwe, Rizamuke rigere mw’ ijuru; Indirimbo nziza y’ umunezero, Iger’ ahera cyane mw’ ijuru.
3. Muze muvome kw’ isōko y’ ubuntu, Imitima yany’ ishir’ inyota. Ibyaha byanyu mubibabarirwe, N’ Uwitek’ Imana y’ amahoro; Muzahabwa ubugingo bw’ iteka, N’ Iman’ itabera y’ amahoro!
4. Nimureke duhimbaz’ Uwiteka, Maze duhanik’ amajwi yacu! Dutere hejuru tumusingize, Twogez’ izina rye rikomeye. Twamamaz’ impuhwe n’ imbabazi ze, N’ Iman’ ikomey’ ihabw’ ikuzo.

title: Igihe Yesu Azahamagara Intore Ze
verses: 1. Igihe Yes’ azahamagar’ intore ze, Akazijyan’ iwe, aho yaziteguriye;
2. Tuzahura n’ inshuti twari twaratanye, Tuzahurira mw’ iteraniro rikomeye.
3. Abahanuzi n’ abami tuzababona, N’ abahow’ Imana batigeze bayivaho.
4. Tuzabon’ ubwiza bubengerana cyane; Bw’ Uwitanze kugira ng’ umwizera adapfa.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na B.: Tuzahurira mw’ ijuru kwa Data; Mw’ ijuru heza, ni ho tuzahurira. A. na T.: Tuzahurira – hurirayo, Mw’ ijuru ku Mana Data. N’ ahantu h’ icyubahiro, Aho ni ho tuzahurira.

title: Ntabwo Nzaguhāna
verses: 1. Ntabwo nzaguhāna sinzakureka, Sinzagutererana na hato; Nzahora nkurinda, nzajya nkurengera, Nzubahirish’ izina ryanjye, Nd’ Uwiteka ntugir’ ubwoba, Umvira gus’ iby’ Iman’ ivuga.
2. Umurab’ usheze nugotwa n’ ibyago, Utabaz’ Imana usenge, Izakubumbatiz’ amaboko yayo, Kand’ izakurind’ ikwiteho, Mu bishuko nugeragezwa, Iman’ izajy’ ikwerek’ inzira.
3. Nuhabw’ imigisha iva mw’ ijuru, Menya yukw’ Iman’ ikuba hafi, Niwumva wishimye ufit’ amahoro, iyo byose bigenda neza, Uwiteka ntazakureka, Azajy’ arinda intambwe zawe.
4. Igih’ ubugingo bugoswe n’ ijoro, nugotwa n’ ibicu komera. Uwitek’ azajya akumurikira, azakuyobora mu mucyo! Humur’ urukundo rw’ Imana, Ntabwo ruzigera rukuvaho.

title: Ndakwihaye
verses: 1. Ndakwihaye ndakwiyeguriy’ ubu, Nkwishyize mu maboko unkoreshe! Mber’ ingabo undinde abashaka gutuma ndeka kwizera kwanjye.
2. Ndakwihaye umbabarir’ ibyaha, Bimveho ntibizongere kwibukwa; Muri Yesu byose bibe bishyashya, Uranyeze Mwami nere rwose.
3. Nguhay’ impagarike n’ ubugingo, Sinkiri uwanjye ngira umwe nawe! Unyuzuz’ umuriro wawe waka, Maze nkugarurir’ inzimizi.
4. Mwam’ utagereranywa ndakwihaye, Mbese nakwanga nte kugukorera? Nubwo twasakirana n’ ibirushya, Ntuzajy’ ubura kuturengera.
chorus: Gusubiramo: Yesu yarankijije kubw’ ubuntu; Yes’ Umwami yameney’ amaraso; Ndi hafi ye, na w’ ampora bugufi; Ijwi rye rirankomeza cyane.

title: Nzogera Murangurure
verses: 1. Nzogera murangurure, Mutangaz’ ubutumwa! Mu  byaro mu mijyi hose, Humvikan’ indirimbo. Dor’ Imana yakunz’ isi, Yatanz’ Umwana wayo, Aza mw’ isi kudupfira, Is’ ishim’ iyo Mana.
2. Nzogera nimutangaze ivuka ry’ Umukiza; Kubw’ ineza yagiriye umunyabyaha wese. Mubivug’ ahantu hose, N’ inkuru y’ imbabazi. Ijuru n’ isi nibyamamaz’ iyo neza nyinshi.
3. Mureb’ Umukiza Yesu, Mureb’ asuzugurwa, Kand’ ar’ Umwana w’ Imana, Tukabon’ agakiza. Yaducunguj’ amaraso ye y’ igiciro cyinshi; Turangurure tuvuge iby’ uko gucungurwa.
4. Nimugende mujye hose, Mugere mw’ isi yose; Mwingingir’ abigometse, Bagarukir’ Imana. Dore bari mu makuba, Bakeney’ agakiza; Bemer’ Umukiza Yesu, Abah’ umudendezo!
chorus: Gusubiramo: Sop.: Nimurangurure, Muvug’ iby’ amahoro! Nimurangurure, Nimuvug’ iby’ agakiza! A. T. na B.: Nimura-ngurure, Muvug’ iby’ amahoro! Nimura-ngurure, Muvuge i - gakiza!

title: Muze Dusingiz’ Umwami Wacu
verses: 1. Muze dusingiz’ Umwami wacu, Wadukunze bitarondoreka! Kumumenya bituma dutuza, Dore ni we Mwungeri wacu!
2. Mu byaha ndetse no mu bujiji, Tutizera nta byiringiro; Yameny’ ibyacu aratwegera, Maz’ adukiz’ imibabaro.
3. Yamurikiy’ imitima yacu, Tumenya nez’ ukuri kwera! Maz’ uwo Mwam’ ab’ Umuvandimwe; Yatuberey’ Umucunguzi.
4. Ubu ntitugitwarwa n’ ubwoba, Kuko yaduciriy’ akanzu; Duhore dutez’ ijwi Ry’ amatwi, Ntabwo tuzigera tuyoba.
chorus: Gusubiramo: S. na A.: Dusingiz’ Umucunguzi, Yes’ Umwami, Nyir’ ukunesha! Yaduhaye ibyishimo, N’ imigisha yo mw’ ijuru T. na B.: Dusingiz’ Umucunguzi, Mucunguz’ Umwami wacu, Yes’ Umwami, Yes’ Umwami, Nyir’ u(ku)nesha, ukunesha! Yaduhaye – yaduhaye ibyishimo – ibyishimo, N’ imigisha – n’ imigisha yo mw’ ijuru – yo mw’ ijuru.

title: Duhimbaze Yes’ Umucunguzi!
verses: 1. Duhimbaze Yes’ Umucunguzi wacu, Twamamaze twes’ urukundo rwe! Afit’ icyubahiro giheranije, Izina rye ryera niryubahwe! Nk’ uk’ umwungeri arind’ umukumbi we, Ni ko Yesu arind’ abana be! Duhimbaze Yes’ Umucunguzi wacu, Twamamaze twes’ urukundo rwe!

2. Duhimbaze Yes’ Umucunguzi wacu, Watubabarijw’ akadupfira! Ni we Gitare cy’ ibyiringiro byacu, By’ agakiza gahorahw’ iteka. Yikorey’ imibabaro yacu yose, Kubw’ urukundo rwe rwinshi cyane. Duhimbaze Yes’ Umucunguzi wacu, Watubabarijw’ akadupfira!

3. Duhimbaze Yes’ Umucunguzi mwiza, Mw’ ijur’ indirimbo zihanikwe! Yaranesheje rwose yambay’ ikamba, N’ Umutware Nyir’ icyubahiro! Dor’ agiye kugaruka bidatinze, Abengerana mu cyubahiro. Duhimbaze Yes’ Umucunguzi mwiza, Mw’ ijur’ indirimbo zihanikwe!

title: Ku Marembo Y’ Ijuru
verses: 1. Tuzahura mu gitondo, Ku marembo y’ ijuru; B’ umugenzi wo kwizerwa, Utazakerererwa.
2. Nimutebutse kuza kwe, Mwe gutinda mu nzira; Dor’ araza mu gitondo, Aradutegereje.
3. Rek’ umucyo wawe wake, Yes’ arategereje. Tuzabana na w’ iteka, Mw’ iteraniro ryiza!

4. Naza n’ ibyishimo byinshi, Ku marembo y’ ijuru; Mbeg’ iteraniro ryiza, Turi kumwe n’ abera!
